genesis:11:27@01-genesis/11.tex.english: And these are the records of Terah: Terah had fathered Abram, Nahor, and Haran, and Haran had fathered Lot.

genesis:11:28@01-genesis/11.tex.original: וַיָּמת הָרָן עַל פְּנֵי תֶּרַח אָבִיו בְּאֶרֶץ מוֹלַדְתּוֹ בְּאוּר כַּשְׂדִּים׃
genesis:11:28@01-genesis/11.tex.english: And Haran died in the lifetime of Terah, his father, in the land of his birthplace, in Ur of the Chaldees.

genesis:11:29@01-genesis/11.tex.original: וַיִּקַּח אַבְרָם וְנָחוֹר לָהֶם נָשִׁים שֵׁם אֵשֶׁת אַבְרָם שָׂרָי וְשֵׁם אֵשֶׁת נָחוֹר מִלְכָּה בַּת הָרָן אֲבִי מִלְכָּה וַאֲבִי יִסְכָּה׃
genesis:11:29@01-genesis/11.tex.english: And Abram and Nahor took wives. Abram's wife's name was Sarai, and Nahor's wife's name was Milcah, daughter of Haran, father of Milcah and father of Iscah.

genesis:11:30@01-genesis/11.tex.original: וַתְּהִי שָׂרַי עֲקָרָה אֵין לָהּ וָלָד׃
genesis:11:30@01-genesis/11.tex.english: And Sarai was infertile. She did not have a child.

genesis:11:31@01-genesis/11.tex.original: וַיִּקַּח תֶּרַח אֶת אַבְרָם בְּנוֹ וְאֶת לוֹט בֶּן הָרָן בֶּן בְּנוֹ וְאֵת שָׂרַי כַּלָּתוֹ אֵשֶׁת אַבְרָם בְּנוֹ וַיֵּצְאוּ אִתָּם מֵאוּר כַּשְׂדִּים לָלֶכֶת אַרְצָה כְּנַעַן וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד חָרָן וַיֵּשְׁבוּ שָׁם׃
genesis:11:31@01-genesis/11.tex.english: And Terah took Abram, his son, and Lot, son of Haran, his grandson, and Sarai, his daughter-in-law, the wife of Abram, his son; and they went with them from Ur of the Chaldees to go to the land of Canaan. And they came as far as Haran, and they stayed there.

genesis:11:32@01-genesis/11.tex.original: ויהיו ימי תרח חמש שנים ומאתים שנה וימת תרח בחרן׃
genesis:11:32@01-genesis/11.tex.english: And Terah's days were five years and two hundred years. And Terah died in Haran.

genesis:12:1@01-genesis/12.tex.original: ויאמר יהוה אל אברם לך לך מארצך וממולדתך ומבית אביך אל הארץ אשר אראך׃
genesis:12:1@01-genesis/12.tex.english: And YHWH said to Abram, “Go from your land and from your birthplace and from your father’s house to the land that I’ll show you.

genesis:12:2@01-genesis/12.tex.original: ואעשך לגוי גדול ואברכך ואגדלה שמך והיה ברכה׃
genesis:12:2@01-genesis/12.tex.english: And I’ll make you into a big nation, and I’ll bless you and make your name great. And be a blessing!

genesis:12:3@01-genesis/12.tex.original: ואברכה מברכיך ומקללך אאר ונברכו בך כל משפחת האדמה׃
genesis:12:3@01-genesis/12.tex.english: And I’ll bless those who bless you, and those who affront you I’ll curse. And all the families of the earth will be blessed through you.”

genesis:12:4@01-genesis/12.tex.original: וילך אברם כאשר דבר אליו יהוה וילך אתו לוט וְאַבְרָם בֶּן חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים וְשִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה בְּצֵאתוֹ מֵחָרָן׃
genesis:12:4@01-genesis/12.tex.english: And Abram went as YHWH had spoken to him, and Lot went with him. And Abram was seventy-five years old when he went out from Haran.

genesis:12:5@01-genesis/12.tex.original: וַיִּקַּח אַבְרָם אֶת שָׂרַי אִשְׁתּוֹ וְאֶת לוֹט בֶּן אָחִיו וְאֶת כּל רְכוּשָׁם אֲשֶׁר רָכָשׁוּ וְאֶת הַנֶּפֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ בְחָרָן וַיֵּצְאוּ לָלֶכֶת אַרְצָה כְּנַעַן וַיָּבֹאוּ אַרְצָה כְּנָעַן׃
genesis:12:5@01-genesis/12.tex.english: And Abram took Sarai, his wife, and Lot, his brother’s son, and all their property that they had accumulated and the persons whom they had gotten in Haran; and they went out to go to the land of Canaan. And they came to the land of Canaan.

genesis:12:6@01-genesis/12.tex.original: ויעבר אברם בארץ עד מקום שכם עד אלון מורה והכנעני אז בארץ׃
genesis:12:6@01-genesis/12.tex.english: And Abram passed through the land as far as the place of Shechem, as far as the oak of Moreh. And the Canaanite was in the land then.

genesis:12:7@01-genesis/12.tex.original: וירא יהוה אל אברם ויאמר לזרעך אתן את הארץ הזאת ויבן שם מזבח ליהוה הנראה אליו׃
genesis:12:7@01-genesis/12.tex.english: And YHWH appeared to Abram and said, “I’ll give this land to your seed.” And he built an altar there to YHWH who had appeared to him.

genesis:12:8@01-genesis/12.tex.original: ויעתק משם ההרה מקדם לבית אל ויט אהלה בית אל מים והעי מקדם ויבן שם מזבח ליהוה ויקרא בשם יהוה׃
genesis:12:8@01-genesis/12.tex.english: And he moved on from there to the hill country east of Beth-El and pitched his tent—Beth-El to the west and Ai to the east—and he built an altar there to YHWH and invoked the name YHWH.

genesis:12:9@01-genesis/12.tex.original: ויסע אברם הלוך ונסוע הנגבה׃
genesis:12:9@01-genesis/12.tex.english: And Abram traveled on, going to the Negeb.

genesis:12:10@01-genesis/12.tex.original: ויהי רעב בארץ וירד אברם מצרימה לגור שם כי כבד הרעב בארץ׃
genesis:12:10@01-genesis/12.tex.english: And there was a famine in the land, and Abram went down to Egypt to reside there because the famine was heavy in the land.

genesis:12:11@01-genesis/12.tex.original: ויהי כאשר הקריב לבוא מצרימה ויאמר אל שרי אשתו הנה נא ידעתי כי אשה יפת מראה את׃
genesis:12:11@01-genesis/12.tex.english: And it was when he was close to coming to Egypt: and he said to Sarai, his wife, “Here, I know that you’re a beautiful woman.

genesis:12:12@01-genesis/12.tex.original: והיה כי יראו אתך המצרים ואמרו אשתו זאת והרגו אתי ואתך יחיו׃
genesis:12:12@01-genesis/12.tex.english: And it will be when the Egyptians see you that they’ll say, ‘This is his wife,’ and they’ll kill me and keep you alive.

genesis:12:13@01-genesis/12.tex.original: אמרי נא אחתי את למען ייטב לי בעבורך וחיתה נפשי בגללך׃
genesis:12:13@01-genesis/12.tex.english: Say you’re my sister so it will be good for me on your account and I’ll stay alive because of you.”

genesis:12:14@01-genesis/12.tex.original: ויהי כבוא אברם מצרימה ויראו המצרים את האשה כי יפה הוא מאד׃
genesis:12:14@01-genesis/12.tex.english: And it was as Abram came to Egypt, and the Egyptians saw the woman, that she was very beautiful.

genesis:12:15@01-genesis/12.tex.original: ויראו אתה שרי פרעה ויהללו אתה אל פרעה ותקח האשה בית פרעה׃
genesis:12:15@01-genesis/12.tex.english: And Pharaoh’s officers saw her and praised her to Pharaoh, and the woman was taken to Pharaoh’s house.

genesis:12:16@01-genesis/12.tex.original: ולאברם היטיב בעבורה ויהי לו צאן ובקר וחמרים ועבדים ושפחת ואתנת וגמלים׃
genesis:12:16@01-genesis/12.tex.english: And he was good to Abram on her account, and he had a flock and oxen and he-asses and servants and maids and she-asses and camels.

genesis:12:17@01-genesis/12.tex.original: וינגע יהוה את פרעה נגעים גדלים ואת ביתו על דבר שרי אשת אברם׃
genesis:12:17@01-genesis/12.tex.english: And YHWH plagued Pharaoh and his house, big plagues, over the matter of Sarai, Abram’s wife.

genesis:12:18@01-genesis/12.tex.original: ויקרא פרעה לאברם ויאמר מה זאת עשית לי למה לא הגדת לי כי אשתך הוא׃
genesis:12:18@01-genesis/12.tex.english: And Pharaoh called Abram and said, “What is this you’ve done to me? Why didn’t you tell me that she was your wife?

genesis:12:19@01-genesis/12.tex.original: למה אמרת אחתי הוא ואקח אתה לי לאשה ועתה הנה אשתך קח ולך׃
genesis:12:19@01-genesis/12.tex.english: Why did you say, ‘She’s my sister,’ so I took her for a wife for myself! And now, here’s your wife. Take her and go.”

genesis:12:20@01-genesis/12.tex.original: ויצו עליו פרעה אנשים וישלחו אתו ואת אשתו ואת כל אשר לו׃
genesis:12:20@01-genesis/12.tex.english: And Pharaoh commanded people over him, and they let him and his wife and all he had go.

genesis:13:1@01-genesis/13.tex.original: ויעל אברם ממצרים הוא ואשתו וכל אשר לו ולוט עמו הנגבה׃
genesis:13:1@01-genesis/13.tex.english: And Abram went up from Egypt, he and his wife and all he had and Lot with him, to the Negeb.

genesis:13:2@01-genesis/13.tex.original: ואברם כבד מאד במקנה בכסף ובזהב׃
genesis:13:2@01-genesis/13.tex.english: And Abram was very heavy with livestock and silver and gold.

genesis:13:3@01-genesis/13.tex.original: וילך למסעיו מנגב ועד בית אל עד המקום אשר היה שם אהלה בתחלה בין בית אל ובין העי׃
genesis:13:3@01-genesis/13.tex.english: And he went on his travels from the Negeb as far as Beth-El, as far as the place where his tent was at the start, between Beth-El and Ai,

genesis:13:4@01-genesis/13.tex.original: אל מקום המזבח אשר עשה שם בראשנה ויקרא שם אברם בשם יהוה׃
genesis:13:4@01-genesis/13.tex.english: to the place of the altar that he had made there at the beginning. And Abram invoked the name YHWH there.

genesis:13:5@01-genesis/13.tex.original: וגם ללוט ההלך את אברם היה צאן ובקר ואהלים׃
genesis:13:5@01-genesis/13.tex.english: And Lot, who was going with Abram, also had a flock and oxen and tents.

genesis:13:6@01-genesis/13.tex.original: וְלֹא נָשָׂא אֹתָם הָאָרֶץ לָשֶׁבֶת יַחְדָּו כִּי הָיָה רְכוּשָׁם רָב וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לָשֶׁבֶת יַחְדָּו׃
genesis:13:6@01-genesis/13.tex.english: And the land did not suffice them to live together, because their property was great, and they were not able to live together.

genesis:13:7@01-genesis/13.tex.original: ויהי ריב בין רעי מקנה אברם ובין רעי מקנה לוט והכנעני והפרזי אז ישב בארץ׃
genesis:13:7@01-genesis/13.tex.english: And there was a quarrel between those who herded Abram’s livestock and those who herded Lot’s livestock. And the Canaanite and the Perizzite lived in the land then.

genesis:13:8@01-genesis/13.tex.original: ויאמר אברם אל לוט אל נא תהי מריבה ביני ובינך ובין רעי ובין רעיך כי אנשים אחים אנחנו׃
genesis:13:8@01-genesis/13.tex.english: And Abram said to Lot, “Let there be no quarreling between me and you and between my herders and your herders, because we’re brothers.

genesis:13:9@01-genesis/13.tex.original: הלא כל הארץ לפניך הפרד נא מעלי אם השמאל ואימנה ואם הימין ואשמאילה׃
genesis:13:9@01-genesis/13.tex.english: Isn’t the whole land before you? Separate from me: if left then I’ll go right, and if right then I’ll go left.”

genesis:13:10@01-genesis/13.tex.original: וישא לוט את עיניו וירא את כל ככר הירדן כי כלה משקה לפני שחת יהוה את סדם ואת עמרה כגן יהוה כארץ מצרים באכה צער׃
genesis:13:10@01-genesis/13.tex.english: And Lot raised his eyes and saw all the plain of the Jordan, that all of it was well watered (before YHWH’s destroying Sodom and Gomorrah) like YHWH’s garden, like the land of Egypt, as you come to Zoar.

genesis:13:11@01-genesis/13.tex.original: ויבחר לו לוט את כל ככר הירדן ויסע לוט מקדם וַיִּפָּרְדוּ אִישׁ מֵעַל אָחִיו׃
genesis:13:11@01-genesis/13.tex.english: And Lot chose all the plain of the Jordan for himself, and Lot traveled east. And they separated, each from his brother.

genesis:13:12@01-genesis/13.tex.original: אַבְרָם יָשַׁב בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וְלוֹט יָשַׁב בְּעָרֵי הַכִּכָּר ויאהל עד סדם׃
genesis:13:12@01-genesis/13.tex.english: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, and Lot lived in the cities of the plain and tented as far as Sodom.

genesis:13:13@01-genesis/13.tex.original: ואנשי סדם רעים וחטאים ליהוה מאד׃
genesis:13:13@01-genesis/13.tex.english: And the people of Sodom were very bad and sinful to YHWH.

genesis:13:14@01-genesis/13.tex.original: ויהוה אמר אל אברם אחרי הפרד לוט מעמו שא נא עיניך וראה מן המקום אשר אתה שם צפנה ונגבה וקדמה וימה׃
genesis:13:14@01-genesis/13.tex.english: And YHWH said to Abram after Lot’s separation from him, “Lift your eyes and see from the place where you are to the north and south and east and west.

genesis:13:15@01-genesis/13.tex.original: כי את כל הארץ אשר אתה ראה לך אתננה ולזרעך עד עולם׃
genesis:13:15@01-genesis/13.tex.english: For all the land that you see, I’ll give it to you and to your seed forever.

genesis:13:16@01-genesis/13.tex.original: ושמתי את זרעך כעפר הארץ אשר אם יוכל איש למנות את עפר הארץ גם זרעך ימנה׃
genesis:13:16@01-genesis/13.tex.english: And I’ll make your seed like the dust of the earth, so that if a man could count the dust of the earth then your seed also could be counted.

genesis:13:17@01-genesis/13.tex.original: קום התהלך בארץ לארכה ולרחבה כי לך אתננה׃
genesis:13:17@01-genesis/13.tex.english: Get up, go around in the land to its length and its width, because I’m giving it to you.”

genesis:13:18@01-genesis/13.tex.original: ויאהל אברם ויבא וישב באלני ממרא אשר בחברון ויבן שם מזבח ליהוה׃
genesis:13:18@01-genesis/13.tex.english: And Abram took up his tent and came and lived among the oaks of Mamre which are in Hebron, and he built an altar to YHWH there.

genesis:14:1@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WYHY BYMY AMRPL MLK VN]R ARYWK MLK ALSR KDRL]MR MLK ]YLM WTD]L MLK GWYM׃</bdo>
genesis:14:1@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.english: And it was in the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar, Arioch, king of Ellasar, Chedor-laomer, king of Elam, and Tidal, king of Goiim.

genesis:14:2@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">]VW MLXMH AT BR] MLK SDM WAT BRV] MLK ]MRH VNAB MLK ADMH WVMABR MLK (CBYYM) [CBWYM] WMLK BL] HYA C]R׃</bdo>
genesis:14:2@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.english: They made war with Bera, king of Sodom, and Birsha, king of Gomorrah, Shinab, king of Admah, and Shemeber, king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela. (That is Zoar.)

genesis:14:3@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">KL ALH XBRW AL ]MQ HVDYM HWA YM HMLX׃</bdo>
genesis:14:3@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.english: All these were allied at the Siddim Valley. (That is the Dead Sea.)

genesis:14:4@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">VTYM ]VRH VNH ]BDW AT KDRL]MR WVLV ]VRH VNH MRDW׃</bdo>
genesis:14:4@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.english: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and the thirteenth year they revolted,

genesis:14:5@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WBARB] ]VRH VNH BA KDRL]MR WHMLKYM AVR ATW WYKW AT RPAYM B]VTRT QRNYM WAT HZWZYM BHM WAT HAYMYM BVWH QRYTYM׃</bdo>
genesis:14:5@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.english: and in the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him came, and they struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim and the Zuzum in Ham and the Emim in Shaveh Kiriataim

genesis:14:6@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WAT HXRY BHRRM V]YR ]D AYL PARN AVR ]L HMDBR׃</bdo>
genesis:14:6@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.english: and the Horites in their mountain Seir to El Paran, which is by the wilderness.

genesis:14:7@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WYVBW WYBAW AL ]YN MVPJ HWA QDV WYKW AT KL VDH H]MLQY WGM AT HAMRY HYVB BXCCN TMR׃</bdo>
genesis:14:7@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.english: And they came back and came to En Mishpat (that is Kadesh) and struck the area of the Amalekites and also the Amorites who live in Hazazon Tamar.

genesis:14:8@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WYCA MLK SDM WMLK ]MRH WMLK ADMH WMLK (CBYYM) [CBWYM] WMLK BL] HWA C]R WY]RKW ATM MLXMH B]MQ HVDYM׃</bdo>
genesis:14:8@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.english: And the king of Sodom and the king of Gomorrah and the king of Admah and the king of Zeboiim and the king of Bela (that is Zoar) went out and aligned with them for war in the Siddim Valley

genesis:14:9@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">AT KDRL]MR MLK ]YLM WTD]L MLK GWYM WAMRPL MLK VN]R WARYWK MLK ALSR ARB]H MLKYM AT HXMVH׃</bdo>
genesis:14:9@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.english: with Chedorlaomer, king of Elam, and Tidal, king of Goiim, and Amraphel, king of Shinar, and Arioch, king of Ellasar—four kings with five.

genesis:14:10@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">W]MQ HVDYM BART BART XMR WYNSW MLK SDM W]MRH WYPLW VMH WHNVARYM HRH NSW׃</bdo>
genesis:14:10@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.english: And Siddim Valley was pits, pits of bitumen, and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and they fell there; and those who were left fled to the mountain.

genesis:14:11@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WYQXW AT KL RKV SDM W]MRH WAT KL AKLM WYLKW׃</bdo>
genesis:14:11@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.english: And they took all the property of Sodom and Gomorrah and all their food, and they went.

genesis:14:12@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WYQXW AT LWJ WAT RKVW BN AXY ABRM WYLKW WHWA YVB BSDM׃</bdo>
genesis:14:12@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.english: And they took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, and his property when they went. And he had been living in Sodom.

genesis:14:13@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WYBA HPLYJ WYGD LABRM H]BRY WHWA VKN BALNY MMRA HAMRY AXY AVKL WAXY ]NR WHM B]LY BRYT ABRM׃</bdo>
genesis:14:13@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.english: And an escapee came and told Abram the Hebrew, and he was tenting among the oaks of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol and brother of Aner; and they were covenant partners of Abram.

genesis:14:14@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WYVM] ABRM KY NVBH AXYW WYRQ AT XNYKYW YLYDY BYTW VMNH ]VR WVLV MAWT WYRDP ]D DN׃</bdo>
genesis:14:14@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.english: And Abram heard that his brother had been taken prisoner, and he had his trained men, born in his house, unsheathe: three hundred eighteen. And he pursued as far as Dan.

genesis:14:15@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WYXLQ ]LYHM LYLH HWA W]BDYW WYKM WYRDPM ]D XWBH AVR MVMAL LDMVQ׃</bdo>
genesis:14:15@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.english: And he divided against them by night, he and his servants, and he struck them and pursued them as far as Hobah, which is at the left of Damascus.

genesis:14:16@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WYVB AT KL HRKV WGM AT LWJ AXYW WRKVW HVYB WGM AT HNVYM WAT H]M׃</bdo>
genesis:14:16@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.english: And he brought back all the property, and he also brought back Lot, his brother, and his property, and also the women and the people.

genesis:14:17@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WYCA MLK SDM LQRATW AXRY VWBW MHKWT AT KDRL]MR WAT HMLKYM AVR ATW AL ]MQ VWH HWA ]MQ HMLK׃</bdo>
genesis:14:17@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.english: And the king of Sodom came out to him after he came back from striking Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him at the Shaveh Valley. (That is the valley of the king.)

genesis:14:18@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WMLKY CDQ MLK VLM HWCYA LXM WYYN WHWA KHN LAL ]LYWN׃</bdo>
genesis:14:18@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.english: And Melchizedek, king of Salem, had brought out bread and wine. And he was a priest of El the Highest.

genesis:14:19@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WYBRKHW WYAMR BRWK ABRM LAL ]LYWN QNH VMYM WARC׃</bdo>
genesis:14:19@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.english: And he blessed him and said, “Blessed is Abram to El the Highest, creator of skies and earth.

genesis:14:20@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WBRWK AL ]LYWN AVR MGN CRYK BYDK WYTN LW M]VR MKL׃</bdo>
genesis:14:20@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.english: And blessed is El the Highest, who delivered your foes into your hand.” And he gave him a tithe from everything.

genesis:14:21@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WYAMR MLK SDM AL ABRM TN LY HNPV WHRKV QX LK׃</bdo>
genesis:14:21@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.english: And the king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give the persons to me, and take the property for you.”

genesis:14:22@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WYAMR ABRM AL MLK SDM HRMTY YDY AL YHWH AL ]LYWN QNH VMYM WARC׃</bdo>
genesis:14:22@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.english: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, “I’ve lifted my hand to YHWH, El the Highest, creator of skies and earth,

genesis:14:23@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">AM MXWJ W]D VRWK N]L WAM AQX MKL AVR LK WLA TAMR ANY H]VRTY AT ABRM׃</bdo>
genesis:14:23@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.english: that, from a thread to a shoelace, I won’t take anything that is yours, so you won’t say, ‘I made Abram rich.’

genesis:14:24@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">BL]DY RQ AVR AKLW HN]RYM WXLQ HANVYM AVR HLKW ATY ]NR AVKL WMMRA HM YQXW XLQM׃</bdo>
genesis:14:24@01-genesis/14-raw.tex.english: Except only what the boys have eaten and the share of the people who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. They shall take their share.”

genesis:14:1@01-genesis/14.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WYHY BYMY AMRPL MLK VN]R ARYWK MLK ALSR KDRL]MR MLK ]YLM WTD]L MLK GWYM׃</bdo>
genesis:14:1@01-genesis/14.tex.english: And it was in the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar, Arioch, king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer, king of Elam, and Tidal, king of Goiim.

genesis:14:2@01-genesis/14.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">]VW MLXMH AT BR] MLK SDM WAT BRV] MLK ]MRH VNAB MLK ADMH WVMABR MLK (CBYYM) [CBWYM] WMLK BL] HYA C]R׃</bdo>
genesis:14:2@01-genesis/14.tex.english: They made war with Bera, king of Sodom, and Birsha, king of Gomorrah, Shinab, king of Admah, and Shemeber, king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela. (That is Zoar.)

genesis:14:3@01-genesis/14.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">KL ALH XBRW AL ]MQ HVDYM HWA YM HMLX׃</bdo>
genesis:14:3@01-genesis/14.tex.english: All these were allied at the Siddim Valley. (That is the Dead Sea.)

genesis:14:4@01-genesis/14.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">VTYM ]VRH VNH ]BDW AT KDRL]MR WVLV ]VRH VNH MRDW׃</bdo>
genesis:14:4@01-genesis/14.tex.english: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and the thirteenth year they revolted,

genesis:14:5@01-genesis/14.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WBARB] ]VRH VNH BA KDRL]MR WHMLKYM AVR ATW WYKW AT RPAYM B]VTRT QRNYM WAT HZWZYM BHM WAT HAYMYM BVWH QRYTYM׃</bdo>
genesis:14:5@01-genesis/14.tex.english: and in the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him came, and they struck the Rephaim^[Rephaim (Hebrew: רְפָאִים) in biblical and ancient Near Eastern contexts refers to a mythical race of ancient giants, and to the shadowy spirits of the dead in the underworld.]^[Rephaim are like these really tall ghosts.] in Ashteroth Karnaim and the Zuzum in Ham and the Emim in Shaveh Kiriataim

genesis:14:6@01-genesis/14.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WAT HXRY BHRRM V]YR ]D AYL PARN AVR ]L HMDBR׃</bdo>
genesis:14:6@01-genesis/14.tex.english: and the Horites in their mountain Seir to El Paran, which is by the wilderness.

genesis:14:7@01-genesis/14.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WYVBW WYBAW AL ]YN MVPJ HWA QDV WYKW AT KL VDH H]MLQY WGM AT HAMRY HYVB BXCCN TMR׃</bdo>
genesis:14:7@01-genesis/14.tex.english: And they came back and came to En Mishpat (that is Kadesh) and struck the area of the Amalekites and also the Amorites who live in Hazazon Tamar.

genesis:14:8@01-genesis/14.tex.english: And the king of Sodom and the king of Gomorrah and the king of Admah and the king of Zeboiim and the king of Bela (that is Zoar) went out and aligned with them for war in the Siddim Valley

genesis:14:9@01-genesis/14.tex.english: with Chedorlaomer, king of Elam, and Tidal, king of Goiim, and Amraphel, king of Shinar, and Arioch, king of Ellasar—four kings with five.

genesis:14:10@01-genesis/14.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">W]MQ HVDYM BART BART XMR WYNSW MLK SDM W]MRH WYPLW VMH WHNVARYM HRH NSW׃</bdo>
genesis:14:10@01-genesis/14.tex.english: And Siddim Valley was pits, pits of bitumen, and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and they fell there; and those who were left fled to the mountain.

genesis:14:11@01-genesis/14.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WYQXW AT KL RKV SDM W]MRH WAT KL AKLM WYLKW׃</bdo>
genesis:14:11@01-genesis/14.tex.english: And they took all the property of Sodom and Gomorrah and all their food, and they went.

genesis:14:12@01-genesis/14.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WYQXW AT LWJ WAT RKVW BN AXY ABRM WYLKW WHWA YVB BSDM׃</bdo>
genesis:14:12@01-genesis/14.tex.english: And they took Lot, Abram's brother's son, and his property when they went. And he had been living in Sodom.

genesis:14:13@01-genesis/14.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WYBA HPLYJ WYGD LABRM H]BRY WHWA VKN BALNY MMRA HAMRY AXY AVKL WAXY ]NR WHM B]LY BRYT ABRM׃</bdo>
genesis:14:13@01-genesis/14.tex.english: And an escapee came and told Abram the Hebrew, and he was tenting among the oaks^[You know the ones.] of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol and brother of Aner; and they were covenant partners of Abram.

genesis:14:14@01-genesis/14.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WYVM] ABRM KY NVBH AXYW WYRQ AT XNYKYW YLYDY BYTW VMNH ]VR WVLV MAWT WYRDP ]D DN׃</bdo>
genesis:14:14@01-genesis/14.tex.english: And Abram heard that his brother had been taken prisoner, and he had his trained men, born in his house, unsheathe: three hundred eighteen. And he pursued as far as Dan.

genesis:14:15@01-genesis/14.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WYXLQ ]LYHM LYLH HWA W]BDYW WYKM WYRDPM ]D XWBH AVR MVMAL LDMVQ׃</bdo>
genesis:14:15@01-genesis/14.tex.english: And he divided against them by night, he and his servants, and he struck them and pursued them as far as Hobah, which is at the left^[Yes, they really just said something is “to the left” of a city.] of Damascus.

genesis:14:16@01-genesis/14.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WYVB AT KL HRKV WGM AT LWJ AXYW WRKVW HVYB WGM AT HNVYM WAT H]M׃</bdo>
genesis:14:16@01-genesis/14.tex.english: And he brought back all the property, and he also brought back Lot, his brother, and his property, and also the women and the people.^[The women are different from the people.]

genesis:14:17@01-genesis/14.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WYCA MLK SDM LQRATW AXRY VWBW MHKWT AT KDRL]MR WAT HMLKYM AVR ATW AL ]MQ VWH HWA ]MQ HMLK׃</bdo>
genesis:14:17@01-genesis/14.tex.english: And the king of Sodom came out to him after he came back from striking Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him at the Shaveh Valley. (That is the valley of the king.)

genesis:14:18@01-genesis/14.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WMLKY CDQ MLK VLM HWCYA LXM WYYN WHWA KHN LAL ]LYWN׃</bdo>
genesis:14:18@01-genesis/14.tex.english: And Melchizedek, king of Salem, had brought out bread and wine. And he was a priest of El the Highest.

genesis:14:19@01-genesis/14.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WYBRKHW WYAMR BRWK ABRM LAL ]LYWN QNH VMYM WARC׃</bdo>
genesis:14:19@01-genesis/14.tex.english: And he blessed him and said, "Blessed is Abram to El the Highest, creator of skies and earth.

genesis:14:20@01-genesis/14.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WBRWK AL ]LYWN AVR MGN CRYK BYDK WYTN LW M]VR MKL׃</bdo>
genesis:14:20@01-genesis/14.tex.english: And blessed is El the Highest, who delivered your foes into your hand." And he gave him a tithe from everything.

genesis:14:21@01-genesis/14.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WYAMR MLK SDM AL ABRM TN LY HNPV WHRKV QX LK׃</bdo>
genesis:14:21@01-genesis/14.tex.english: And the king of Sodom said to Abram, "Give the persons to me, and take the property for you."

genesis:14:22@01-genesis/14.tex.original: WYAMR ABRM AL MLK SDM HRMTY YDY AL יהוה AL ]LYWN QNH VMYM WARC׃
genesis:14:22@01-genesis/14.tex.english: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, "I've lifted my hand to YHWH El the Highest, creator of skies and earth,

genesis:14:23@01-genesis/14.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">AM MXWJ W]D VRWK N]L</bdo> <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">WAM AQX MKL AVR LK WLA TAMR ANY H]VRTY AT ABRM׃</bdo>
genesis:14:23@01-genesis/14.tex.english: that, from a thread to a shoelace, I won't take anything that is yours, so you won't say, 'I made Abram rich.'

genesis:14:24@01-genesis/14.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-other hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Other">BL]DY RQ AVR AKLW HN]RYM WXLQ HANVYM AVR HLKW ATY ]NR AVKL WMMRA HM YQXW XLQM׃</bdo>
genesis:14:24@01-genesis/14.tex.english: Except only what the boys have eaten and the share of the people who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. They shall take their share."

genesis:15:1@01-genesis/15.tex.original: אחר הדברים האלה היה דבר יהוה אל אברם במחזה לאמר אל תירא אברם אנכי מגן לך שכרך הרבה מאד׃
genesis:15:1@01-genesis/15.tex.english: After these things YHWH’s word came to Abram in a vision, saying, “Don’t fear, Abram. I’m a shield for you. Your reward is very much.”

genesis:15:2@01-genesis/15.tex.original: ויאמר אברם אדני יהוה מה תתן לי ואנכי הולך ערירי ובן משק ביתי הוא דמשק אליעזר׃
genesis:15:2@01-genesis/15.tex.english: And Abram said, “My Lord, YHWH, what would you give me when I go childless and my household is an acquired person!” (That is Damascus Eliezer.)

genesis:15:3@01-genesis/15.tex.original: ויאמר אברם הן לי לא נתתה זרע והנה בן ביתי יורש אתי׃
genesis:15:3@01-genesis/15.tex.english: And Abram said, “Here, you haven’t given me seed. And, here, a member of my household is taking possession of what is mine.”

genesis:15:4@01-genesis/15.tex.original: והנה דבר יהוה אליו לאמר לא יירשך זה כי אם אשר יצא ממעיך הוא יירשך׃
genesis:15:4@01-genesis/15.tex.english: And, here, YHWH’s word came to him, saying, “This one won’t take possession from you, but rather one who will come out of your in-sides: he will take possession from you.”

genesis:15:5@01-genesis/15.tex.original: ויוצא אתו החוצה ויאמר הבט נא השמימה וספר הכוכבים אם תוכל לספר אתם ויאמר לו כה יהיה זרעך׃
genesis:15:5@01-genesis/15.tex.english: And He brought him outside and said, “Look at the skies and count the stars—if you’ll be able to count them.” And He said to him, “That is how your seed will be.”

genesis:15:6@01-genesis/15.tex.original: והאמן ביהוה ויחשבה לו צדקה׃
genesis:15:6@01-genesis/15.tex.english: And he trusted in YHWH, and He considered it for him as virtue.

genesis:15:7@01-genesis/15.tex.original: ויאמר אליו אני יהוה אשר הוצאתיך מאור כשדים לתת לך את הארץ הזאת לרשתה׃
genesis:15:7@01-genesis/15.tex.english: And He said to him, “I am YHWH, who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldees to give you this land, to possess it.”

genesis:15:8@01-genesis/15.tex.original: ויאמר אדני יהוה במה אדע כי אירשנה׃
genesis:15:8@01-genesis/15.tex.english: And he said, “My Lord YHWH, how will I know that I’ll possess it?”

genesis:15:9@01-genesis/15.tex.original: ויאמר אליו קחה לי עגלה משלשת ועז משלשת ואיל משלש ותר וגוזל׃
genesis:15:9@01-genesis/15.tex.english: And He said to him, “Take a three-year-old heifer and a three-year-old she-goat and a three-year-old ram and a dove and a pigeon for me.”

genesis:15:10@01-genesis/15.tex.original: ויקח לו את כל אלה ויבתר אתם בתוך ויתן איש בתרו לקראת רעהו ואת הצפר לא בתר׃
genesis:15:10@01-genesis/15.tex.english: And he took all of these for Him and split them up the middle and set each half opposite its other half, but he did not split the birds.

genesis:15:11@01-genesis/15.tex.original: וירד העיט על הפגרים וישב אתם אברם׃
genesis:15:11@01-genesis/15.tex.english: And birds of prey came down on the carcasses, and Abram retrieved them.

genesis:15:12@01-genesis/15.tex.original: ויהי השמש לבוא ותרדמה נפלה על אברם והנה אימה חשכה גדלה נפלת עליו׃
genesis:15:12@01-genesis/15.tex.english: And the sun was about to set, and a slumber had come over Abram; and, here, a big, dark terror was coming over him.

genesis:15:13@01-genesis/15.tex.original: ויאמר לאברם ידע תדע כי גר יהיה זרעך בארץ לא להם ועבדום וענו אתם ארבע מאות שנה׃
genesis:15:13@01-genesis/15.tex.english: And He said to Abram, “You shall know that your seed will be an alien in a land that is not theirs, and they will serve them, and they will degrade them four hundred years.

genesis:15:14@01-genesis/15.tex.original: וגם את הגוי אשר יעבדו דן אנכי ואחרי כן יצאו ברכש גדול׃
genesis:15:14@01-genesis/15.tex.english: But I’ll judge the nation whom they’ll serve as well, and after that they’ll go out with much property.

genesis:15:15@01-genesis/15.tex.original: ואתה תבוא אל אבתיך בשלום תקבר בשיבה טובה׃
genesis:15:15@01-genesis/15.tex.english: And you: you’ll come to your fathers in peace. You’ll be buried at a good old age.

genesis:15:16@01-genesis/15.tex.original: ודור רביעי ישובו הנה כי לא שלם עון האמרי עד הנה׃
genesis:15:16@01-genesis/15.tex.english: And a fourth generation will come back here, because the Amor-ite’s crime is not yet complete.”

genesis:15:17@01-genesis/15.tex.original: ויהי השמש באה ועלטה היה והנה תנור עשן ולפיד אש אשר עבר בין הגזרים האלה׃
genesis:15:17@01-genesis/15.tex.english: And the sun was setting, and there was darkness, and here was an oven of smoke and a flame of fire that went between these pieces.

genesis:15:18@01-genesis/15.tex.original: ביום ההוא כרת יהוה את אברם ברית לאמר לזרעך נתתי את הארץ הזאת מנהר מצרים עד הנהר הגדל נהר פרת׃
genesis:15:18@01-genesis/15.tex.english: In that day YHWH made a covenant with Abram, saying, “I’ve given this land to your seed, from the river of Egypt to the big river, the river Euphrates:

genesis:15:19@01-genesis/15.tex.original: את הקיני ואת הקנזי ואת הקדמני׃
genesis:15:19@01-genesis/15.tex.english: the Cainites and the Kenizzites and the Kadmonites

genesis:15:20@01-genesis/15.tex.original: ואת החתי ואת הפרזי ואת הרפאים׃
genesis:15:20@01-genesis/15.tex.english: and the Hittites and the Perizzites and the Rephaim

genesis:15:21@01-genesis/15.tex.original: ואת האמרי ואת הכנעני ואת הגרגשי ואת היבוסי׃
genesis:15:21@01-genesis/15.tex.english: and the Amorites and the Canaanites and the Girgashites and the Jebu-sites.”

genesis:16:1@01-genesis/16.tex.original: ושרי אשת אברם לא ילדה לו ולה שפחה מצרית ושמה הגר׃
genesis:16:1@01-genesis/16.tex.english: And Abram’s wife Sarai had not given birth by him. And she had an Egyptian maid, and her name was Hagar.

genesis:16:2@01-genesis/16.tex.original: ותאמר שרי אל אברם הנה נא עצרני יהוה מלדת בא נא אל שפחתי אולי אבנה ממנה וישמע אברם לקול שרי׃
genesis:16:2@01-genesis/16.tex.english: And Sarai said to Abram, “Here, YHWH has held me back from giving birth. Come to my maid. Maybe I’ll get ‘childed’ through her.” And Abram listened to Sarai’s voice.

genesis:16:3@01-genesis/16.tex.original: וַתִּקַּח שָׂרַי אֵשֶׁת אַבְרָם אֶת הָגָר הַמִּצְרִית שִׁפְחָתָהּ מִקֵּץ עֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים לְשֶׁבֶת אַבְרָם בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וַתִּתֵּן אֹתָהּ לְאַבְרָם אִישָׁהּ לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃
genesis:16:3@01-genesis/16.tex.english: And Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar, the Egyptian, her maid, at the end of ten years of Abram’s living in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram, her husband, as a wife to him.

genesis:16:4@01-genesis/16.tex.original: ויבא אל הגר ותהר ותרא כי הרתה ותקל גברתה בעיניה׃
genesis:16:4@01-genesis/16.tex.english: And he came to Hagar, and she became pregnant. And she saw that she had become pregnant, and her mistress was lowered in her eyes.

genesis:16:5@01-genesis/16.tex.original: ותאמר שרי אל אברם חמסי עליך אנכי נתתי שפחתי בחיקך ותרא כי הרתה ואקל בעיניה ישפט יהוה ביני וביניך׃
genesis:16:5@01-genesis/16.tex.english: And Sarai said to Abram, “My injury is on you. I, I, placed my maid in your bosom, and she saw that she had become pregnant, and I was lowered in her eyes. Let YHWH judge between me and you.”

genesis:16:6@01-genesis/16.tex.original: ויאמר אברם אל שרי הנה שפחתך בידך עשי לה הטוב בעיניך ותענה שרי ותברח מפניה׃
genesis:16:6@01-genesis/16.tex.english: And Abram said to Sarai, “Here, your maid is in your hand. Do to her whatever is good in your eyes.” And Sarai degraded her, and she fled from her.

genesis:16:7@01-genesis/16.tex.original: וימצאה מלאך יהוה על עין המים במדבר על העין בדרך שור׃
genesis:16:7@01-genesis/16.tex.english: And an angel of YHWH found her at a spring of water in the wilderness, by the spring on the way to Shur,

genesis:16:8@01-genesis/16.tex.original: ויאמר הגר שפחת שרי אי מזה באת ואנה תלכי ותאמר מפני שרי גברתי אנכי ברחת׃
genesis:16:8@01-genesis/16.tex.english: and said, “Hagar, Sarai’s maid, from where have you come, and where will you go?” And she said, “I’m fleeing from Sarai, my mistress.”

genesis:16:9@01-genesis/16.tex.original: ויאמר לה מלאך יהוה שובי אל גברתך והתעני תחת ידיה׃
genesis:16:9@01-genesis/16.tex.english: And the angel of YHWH said to her, “Go back to your mistress, and suffer the degradation under her hands.”

genesis:16:10@01-genesis/16.tex.original: ויאמר לה מלאך יהוה הרבה ארבה את זרעך ולא יספר מרב׃
genesis:16:10@01-genesis/16.tex.english: And the angel of YHWH said, “I’ll multiply your seed, and it won’t be countable because of its great number.”

genesis:16:11@01-genesis/16.tex.original: ויאמר לה מלאך יהוה הנך הרה וילדת בן וקראת שמו ישמעאל כי שמע יהוה אל עניך׃
genesis:16:11@01-genesis/16.tex.english: And the angel of YHWH said to her, “Here, you’re pregnant and will give birth to a son, and you shall call his name Ishmael, for YHWH has listened to your suffering.

genesis:16:12@01-genesis/16.tex.original: והוא יהיה פרא אדם ידו בכל ויד כל בו ועל פני כל אחיו ישכן׃
genesis:16:12@01-genesis/16.tex.english: And he’ll be a wild ass of a man, his hand against everyone, and everyone’s hand against him, and he will live in hostility toward all his brothers.”

genesis:16:13@01-genesis/16.tex.original: ותקרא שם יהוה הדבר אליה אתה אל ראי כי אמרה הגם הלם ראיתי אחרי ראי׃
genesis:16:13@01-genesis/16.tex.english: And she called the name of YHWH who spoke to her “You are El-roi,” for she said, “Have I also seen after the one who sees me here?”

genesis:16:14@01-genesis/16.tex.original: על כן קרא לבאר באר לחי ראי הנה בין קדש ובין ברד׃
genesis:16:14@01-genesis/16.tex.english: On account of this the well was called Beer Lahai Roi. Here it is between Kadesh and Bered.

genesis:16:15@01-genesis/16.tex.original: וַתֵּלֶד הָגָר לְאַבְרָם בֵּן וַיִּקְרָא אַבְרָם שֶׁם בְּנוֹ אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה הָגָר יִשְׁמָעֵאל׃
genesis:16:15@01-genesis/16.tex.english: And Hagar gave birth to a son for Abram, and Abram called the name of his son whom Hagar had borne Ishmael.

genesis:16:16@01-genesis/16.tex.original: וְאַבְרָם בֶּן שְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה וְשֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים בְּלֶדֶת הָגָר אֶת יִשְׁמָעֵאל לְאַבְרָם׃
genesis:16:16@01-genesis/16.tex.english: And Abram was eighty years and six years old when Hagar gave birth to Ishmael for Abram.

genesis:17:1@01-genesis/17.tex.original: וַיְהִי אַבְרָם בֶּן תִּשְׁעִים שָׁנָה וְתֵשַׁע שָׁנִים וַיֵּרָא יְהֹוָה אֶל אַבְרָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֲנִי אֵל שַׁדַּי הִתְהַלֵּךְ לְפָנַי וֶהְיֵה תָמִים׃
genesis:17:1@01-genesis/17.tex.english: And Abram was ninety years and nine years old, and YHWH appeared to Abram and said to him, “I am El Shadday. Walk before me and be unblemished,

genesis:17:2@01-genesis/17.tex.original: וְאֶתְּנָה בְרִיתִי בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ וְאַרְבֶּה אוֹתְךָ בִּמְאֹד מְאֹד׃
genesis:17:2@01-genesis/17.tex.english: and let me place my covenant between me and you, and I’ll make you very, very numerous.”

genesis:17:3@01-genesis/17.tex.original: וַיִּפֹּל אַבְרָם עַל פָּנָיו וַיְדַבֵּר אִתּוֹ אֱלֹהִים לֵאמֹר׃
genesis:17:3@01-genesis/17.tex.english: And Abram fell on his face, and God spoke with him, saying,

genesis:17:4@01-genesis/17.tex.original: אֲנִי הִנֵּה בְרִיתִי אִתָּךְ וְהָיִיתָ לְאַב הֲמוֹן גּוֹיִם׃
genesis:17:4@01-genesis/17.tex.english: “I: here, my covenant is with you, and you’ll become a father of a mass of nations.

genesis:17:5@01-genesis/17.tex.original: וְלֹא יִקָּרֵא עוֹד אֶת שִׁמְךָ אַבְרָם וְהָיָה שִׁמְךָ אַבְרָהָם כִּי אַב הֲמוֹן גּוֹיִם נְתַתִּיךָ׃
genesis:17:5@01-genesis/17.tex.english: And your name will not be called Abram anymore, but your name will be Abraham, because I’ve set you to be a father of a mass of nations.

genesis:17:6@01-genesis/17.tex.original: וְהִפְרֵתִי אֹתְךָ בִּמְאֹד מְאֹד וּנְתַתִּיךָ לְגוֹיִם וּמְלָכִים מִמְּךָ יֵצֵאוּ׃
genesis:17:6@01-genesis/17.tex.english: And I’ll make you very, very fruitful and make you into nations. And kings will come out of you.

genesis:17:7@01-genesis/17.tex.original: וַהֲקִמֹתִי אֶת בְּרִיתִי בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ וּבֵין זַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ לְדֹרֹתָם לִבְרִית עוֹלָם לִהְיוֹת לְךָ לֵאלֹהִים וּלְזַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ׃
genesis:17:7@01-genesis/17.tex.english: And I’ll establish my covenant between me and you and your seed after you for their generations as an eternal covenant, to become God to you and to your seed after you.

genesis:17:8@01-genesis/17.tex.original: וְנָתַתִּי לְךָ וּלְזַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ אֵת אֶרֶץ מְגֻרֶיךָ אֵת כּל אֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן לַאֲחֻזַּת עוֹלָם וְהָיִיתִי לָהֶם לֵאלֹהִים׃
genesis:17:8@01-genesis/17.tex.english: And I’ll give you and your seed after you the land where you’re residing, all the land of Canaan, as an eternal possession, and I’ll become a God to them.”

genesis:17:9@01-genesis/17.tex.original: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל אַבְרָהָם וְאַתָּה אֶת בְּרִיתִי תִשְׁמֹר אַתָּה וְזַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ לְדֹרֹתָם׃
genesis:17:9@01-genesis/17.tex.english: And God said to Abraham, “And you: you shall observe my covenant, you and your seed after you through their generations.

genesis:17:10@01-genesis/17.tex.original: זֹאת בְּרִיתִי אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁמְרוּ בֵּינִי וּבֵינֵיכֶם וּבֵין זַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ הִמּוֹל לָכֶם כּל זָכָר׃
genesis:17:10@01-genesis/17.tex.english: This is my covenant that you shall observe between me and you and your seed after you: every male is to be circumcised among you.

genesis:17:11@01-genesis/17.tex.original: וּנְמַלְתֶּם אֵת בְּשַׂר ערְלַתְכֶם וְהָיָה לְאוֹת בְּרִית בֵּינִי וּבֵינֵיכֶם׃
genesis:17:11@01-genesis/17.tex.english: And you shall be circumcised at the flesh of your foreskin, and it will become a sign of a covenant between me and you.

genesis:17:12@01-genesis/17.tex.original: וּבֶן שְׁמֹנַת יָמִים יִמּוֹל לָכֶם כּל זָכָר לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם יְלִיד בָּיִת וּמִקְנַת כֶּסֶף מִכֹּל בֶּן נֵכָר אֲשֶׁר לֹא מִזַּרְעֲךָ הוּא׃
genesis:17:12@01-genesis/17.tex.english: And at eight days old every male shall be circumcised among you through your generations: homeborn or purchased with money from any foreigner who is not from your seed.

genesis:17:13@01-genesis/17.tex.original: הִמּוֹל יִמּוֹל יְלִיד בֵּיתְךָ וּמִקְנַת כַּסְפֶּךָ וְהָיְתָה בְרִיתִי בִּבְשַׂרְכֶם לִבְרִית עוֹלָם׃
genesis:17:13@01-genesis/17.tex.english: Your homeborn and the one purchased with your money will be circumcised. And my covenant will become an eternal covenant in your flesh.

genesis:17:14@01-genesis/17.tex.original: וְעָרֵל זָכָר אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִמּוֹל אֶת בְּשַׂר ערְלָתוֹ וְנִכְרְתָה הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא מֵעַמֶּיהָ אֶת בְּרִיתִי הֵפַר׃
genesis:17:14@01-genesis/17.tex.english: And an uncircumcised—a male the flesh of whose foreskin will not be circumcised—that person will be cut off from his people. He has broken my covenant.”

genesis:17:15@01-genesis/17.tex.original: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל אַבְרָהָם שָׂרַי אִשְׁתְּךָ לֹא תִקְרָא אֶת שְׁמָהּ שָׂרָי כִּי שָׂרָה שְׁמָהּ׃
genesis:17:15@01-genesis/17.tex.english: And God said to Abraham, “Sarai, your wife: you shall not call her name Sarai, because her name is Sarah.”

genesis:17:16@01-genesis/17.tex.original: וּבֵרַכְתִּי אֹתָהּ וְגַם נָתַתִּי מִמֶּנָּה לְךָ בֵּן וּבֵרַכְתִּיהָ וְהָיְתָה לְגוֹיִם מַלְכֵי עַמִּים מִמֶּנָּה יִהְיוּ׃
genesis:17:16@01-genesis/17.tex.english: And I’ll bless her, and I’ll also give you a son from her. And I’ll bless her, and she’ll become nations. Kings of peoples will be from her.”

genesis:17:17@01-genesis/17.tex.original: וַיִּפֹּל אַבְרָהָם עַל פָּנָיו וַיִּצְחָק וַיֹּאמֶר בְּלִבּוֹ הַלְּבֶן מֵאָה שָׁנָה יִוָּלֵד וְאִם שָׂרָה הֲבַת תִּשְׁעִים שָׁנָה תֵּלֵד׃
genesis:17:17@01-genesis/17.tex.english: And Abraham fell on his face and laughed and said in his heart, “Will he be born to someone who’s a hundred years old?! And will Sarah, who’s ninety years old, give birth?!”

genesis:17:18@01-genesis/17.tex.original: וַיֹּאמֶר אַבְרָהָם אֶל הָאֱלֹהִים לוּ יִשְׁמָעֵאל יִחְיֶה לְפָנֶיךָ׃
genesis:17:18@01-genesis/17.tex.english: And Abraham said to God, “If only Ishmael will live before you.”

genesis:17:19@01-genesis/17.tex.original: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֲבָל שָׂרָה אִשְׁתְּךָ יֹלֶדֶת לְךָ בֵּן וְקָרָאתָ אֶת שְׁמוֹ יִצְחָק וַהֲקִמֹתִי אֶת בְּרִיתִי אִתּוֹ לִבְרִית עוֹלָם לְזַרְעוֹ אַחֲרָיו׃
genesis:17:19@01-genesis/17.tex.english: And God said, “But Sarah, your wife, is giving birth to a son for you. And you shall call his name Isaac. And I’ll establish my covenant with him as an eternal covenant for his seed after him.

genesis:17:20@01-genesis/17.tex.original: וּלְיִשְׁמָעֵאל שְׁמַעְתִּיךָ הִנֵּה בֵּרַכְתִּי אֹתוֹ וְהִפְרֵיתִי אֹתוֹ וְהִרְבֵּיתִי אֹתוֹ בִּמְאֹד מְאֹד שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר נְשִׂיאִם יוֹלִיד וּנְתַתִּיו לְגוֹי גָּדוֹל׃
genesis:17:20@01-genesis/17.tex.english: And I’ve listened to you about Ishmael. Here, I’ve blessed him, and I’ll make him fruitful and make him very, very numerous. He’ll father twelve chieftains, and I’ll make him into a big nation.

genesis:17:21@01-genesis/17.tex.original: וְאֶת בְּרִיתִי אָקִים אֶת יִצְחָק אֲשֶׁר תֵּלֵד לְךָ שָׂרָה לַמּוֹעֵד הַזֶּה בַּשָּׁנָה הָאַחֶרֶת׃
genesis:17:21@01-genesis/17.tex.english: But I’ll establish my covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear for you at this appointed time in the next year.”

genesis:17:22@01-genesis/17.tex.original: וַיְכַל לְדַבֵּר אִתּוֹ וַיַּעַל אֱלֹהִים מֵעַל אַבְרָהָם׃
genesis:17:22@01-genesis/17.tex.english: And He finished speaking with him, and God went up from Abraham.

genesis:17:23@01-genesis/17.tex.original: וַיִּקַּח אַבְרָהָם אֶת יִשְׁמָעֵאל בְּנוֹ וְאֵת כּל יְלִידֵי בֵיתוֹ וְאֵת כּל מִקְנַת כַּסְפּוֹ כּל זָכָר בְּאַנְשֵׁי בֵּית אַבְרָהָם וַיָּמל אֶת בְּשַׂר ערְלָתָם בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אִתּוֹ אֱלֹהִים׃
genesis:17:23@01-genesis/17.tex.english: And Abraham took Ishmael, his son, and all his homeborn and everyone purchased with his money, every male among the men of Abraham’s house, and he circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in that very day, as God had spoken with him.

genesis:17:24@01-genesis/17.tex.original: וְאַבְרָהָם בֶּן תִּשְׁעִים וָתֵשַׁע שָׁנָה בְּהִמֹּלוֹ בְּשַׂר ערְלָתוֹ׃
genesis:17:24@01-genesis/17.tex.english: And Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised, the flesh of his foreskin,

genesis:17:25@01-genesis/17.tex.original: וְיִשְׁמָעֵאל בְּנוֹ בֶּן שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה בְּהִמֹּלוֹ אֵת בְּשַׂר ערְלָתוֹ׃
genesis:17:25@01-genesis/17.tex.english: and Ishmael, his son, was thirteen years old when he was circumcised at the flesh of his foreskin.

genesis:17:26@01-genesis/17.tex.original: בְּעֶצֶם הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה נִמּוֹל אַבְרָהָם וְיִשְׁמָעֵאל בְּנוֹ׃
genesis:17:26@01-genesis/17.tex.english: In that very day Abraham was circumcised, and Ishmael, his son;

genesis:17:27@01-genesis/17.tex.original: וְכל אַנְשֵׁי בֵיתוֹ יְלִיד בָּיִת וּמִקְנַת כֶּסֶף מֵאֵת בֶּן נֵכָר נִמֹּלוּ אִתּוֹ׃
genesis:17:27@01-genesis/17.tex.english: and all the men of his house, homeborn and purchased with money from a foreigner, were circumcised with him.

genesis:18:1@01-genesis/18.tex.original: וירא אליו יהוה באלני ממרא והוא ישב פתח האהל כחם היום׃
genesis:18:1@01-genesis/18.tex.english: And YHWH appeared to him at the oaks of Mamre. And he was sitting at the tent entrance in the heat of the day,

genesis:18:2@01-genesis/18.tex.original: וישא עיניו וירא והנה שלשה אנשים נצבים עליו וירא וירץ לקראתם מפתח האהל וישתחו ארצה׃
genesis:18:2@01-genesis/18.tex.english: and he raised his eyes and saw, and here were three people standing over him. And he saw and ran toward them from the tent entrance and bowed to the ground.

genesis:18:3@01-genesis/18.tex.original: ויאמר אדני אם נא מצאתי חן בעיניך אל נא תעבר מעל עבדך׃
genesis:18:3@01-genesis/18.tex.english: And he said, “My Lord, if I’ve found favor in your eyes don’t pass on from your servant.

genesis:18:4@01-genesis/18.tex.original: יקח נא מעט מים ורחצו רגליכם והשענו תחת העץ׃
genesis:18:4@01-genesis/18.tex.english: Let a little water be gotten, and wash your feet and relax under a tree,

genesis:18:5@01-genesis/18.tex.original: ואקחה פת לחם וסעדו לבכם אחר תעברו כי על כן עברתם על עבדכם ויאמרו כן תעשה כאשר דברת׃
genesis:18:5@01-genesis/18.tex.english: and let me get a bit of bread, and satisfy your heart. Afterward you’ll pass on, for that’s why you’ve passed by your servant.” And they said, “Do that, as you’ve spoken.”

genesis:18:6@01-genesis/18.tex.original: וימהר אברהם האהלה אל שרה ויאמר מהרי שלש סאים קמח סלת לושי ועשי עגות׃
genesis:18:6@01-genesis/18.tex.english: And Abraham hurried to the tent, to Sarah, and said, “Hurry, three measures of fine flour. Knead it and make cakes.”

genesis:18:7@01-genesis/18.tex.original: ואל הבקר רץ אברהם ויקח בן בקר רך וטוב ויתן אל הנער וימהר לעשות אתו׃
genesis:18:7@01-genesis/18.tex.english: And Abraham ran to the herd and took a calf, tender and good, and he gave it to a servant, and he hurried to prepare it.

genesis:18:8@01-genesis/18.tex.original: ויקח חמאה וחלב ובן הבקר אשר עשה ויתן לפניהם והוא עמד עליהם תחת העץ ויאכלו׃
genesis:18:8@01-genesis/18.tex.english: And he took curds and milk and the calf that he had prepared and placed them in front of them, and he was standing over them under the tree, and they ate.

genesis:18:9@01-genesis/18.tex.original: ויאמרו אליו איה שרה אשתך ויאמר הנה באהל׃
genesis:18:9@01-genesis/18.tex.english: And they said to him, “Where is Sarah, your wife?” And he said, “Here in the tent.”

genesis:18:10@01-genesis/18.tex.original: ויאמר שוב אשוב אליך כעת חיה והנה בן לשרה אשתך ושרה שמעת פתח האהל והוא אחריו׃
genesis:18:10@01-genesis/18.tex.english: And He said, “I shall come back to you at the time of life, and, here, Sarah, your wife, will have a son.” And Sarah was listening at the tent entrance, which was behind him.

genesis:18:11@01-genesis/18.tex.original: ואברהם ושרה זקנים באים בימים חדל להיות לשרה ארח כנשים׃
genesis:18:11@01-genesis/18.tex.english: And Abraham and Sarah were old, well along in days; Sarah had stopped having the way of women.

genesis:18:12@01-genesis/18.tex.original: ותצחק שרה בקרבה לאמר אחרי בלתי היתה לי עדנה ואדני זקן׃
genesis:18:12@01-genesis/18.tex.english: And Sarah laughed inside her and said, “After I’ve become worn out am I to have pleasure?! And my lord is old!”

genesis:18:13@01-genesis/18.tex.original: ויאמר יהוה אל אברהם למה זה צחקה שרה לאמר האף אמנם אלד ואני זקנתי׃
genesis:18:13@01-genesis/18.tex.english: And YHWH said to Abraham, “Why is this? Sarah laughed, saying, ‘Shall I indeed give birth? And I am old!’ Is anything too wondrous for YHWH?

genesis:18:14@01-genesis/18.tex.original: היפלא מיהוה דבר למועד אשוב אליך כעת חיה ולשרה בן׃
genesis:18:14@01-genesis/18.tex.english: At the appointed time I’ll come back to you, at the time of life, and Sarah will have a son.”

genesis:18:15@01-genesis/18.tex.original: ותכחש שרה לאמר לא צחקתי כי יראה ויאמר לא כי צחקת׃
genesis:18:15@01-genesis/18.tex.english: And Sarah lied, saying, “I didn’t laugh,” because she was afraid. And He said, “No, but you did laugh.”

genesis:18:16@01-genesis/18.tex.original: ויקמו משם האנשים וישקפו על פני סדם ואברהם הלך עמם לשלחם׃
genesis:18:16@01-genesis/18.tex.english: And the people got up from there and gazed at the sight of Sodom, and Abraham was going with them to send them off.

genesis:18:17@01-genesis/18.tex.original: ויהוה אמר המכסה אני מאברהם אשר אני עשה׃
genesis:18:17@01-genesis/18.tex.english: And YHWH had said, “Shall I conceal what I’m doing from Abraham,

genesis:18:18@01-genesis/18.tex.original: ואברהם היו יהיה לגוי גדול ועצום ונברכו בו כל גויי הארץ׃
genesis:18:18@01-genesis/18.tex.english: since Abraham will become a big and powerful nation, and all the nations of the earth will be blessed through him?

genesis:18:19@01-genesis/18.tex.original: כי ידעתיו למען אשר יצוה את בניו ואת ביתו אחריו ושמרו דרך יהוה לעשות צדקה ומשפט למען הביא יהוה על אברהם את אשר דבר עליו׃
genesis:18:19@01-genesis/18.tex.english: For I've chosen him so that he'll command his children and his household after him, and they'll keep YHWH's way by practicing righteousness and justice, so that YHWH will fulfill what He promised Abraham.

genesis:18:20@01-genesis/18.tex.original: ויאמר יהוה זעקת סדם ועמרה כי רבה וחטאתם כי כבדה מאד׃
genesis:18:20@01-genesis/18.tex.english: And YHWH said, “The cry of Sodom and Gomorrah: how great it is. And their sin: how very heavy it is.

genesis:18:21@01-genesis/18.tex.original: ארדה נא ואראה הכצעקתה הבאה אלי עשו כלה ואם לא אדעה׃
genesis:18:21@01-genesis/18.tex.english: Let me go down, and I’ll see if they’ve done, all told, like the cry that has come to me. And if not, let me know.”

genesis:18:22@01-genesis/18.tex.original: ויפנו משם האנשים וילכו סדמה ואברהם עודנו עמד לפני יהוה׃
genesis:18:22@01-genesis/18.tex.english: And the people turned from there and went to Sodom. And Abraham was still standing before YHWH,

genesis:18:23@01-genesis/18.tex.original: ויגש אברהם ויאמר האף תספה צדיק עם רשע׃
genesis:18:23@01-genesis/18.tex.english: and Abraham came over and said, “Will you also annihilate the virtuous with the wicked?

genesis:18:24@01-genesis/18.tex.original: אולי יש חמשים צדיקם בתוך העיר האף תספה ולא תשא למקום למען חמשים הצדיקם אשר בקרבה׃
genesis:18:24@01-genesis/18.tex.english: Maybe there are fifty virtuous people within the city. Will you also annihilate and not sustain the place for the fifty virtuous who are in it?

genesis:18:25@01-genesis/18.tex.original: חללה לך מעשת כדבר הזה להמית צדיק עם רשע והיה כצדיק כרשע חללה לך השפט כל הארץ לא יעשה משפט׃
genesis:18:25@01-genesis/18.tex.english: Far be it from you to do a thing like this, to kill virtuous with wicked—and it will be the same for the virtuous and the wicked—far be it from you. Will the judge of all the earth not do justice?”

genesis:18:26@01-genesis/18.tex.original: ויאמר יהוה אם אמצא בסדם חמשים צדיקם בתוך העיר ונשאתי לכל המקום בעבורם׃
genesis:18:26@01-genesis/18.tex.english: And YHWH said, “If I find in Sodom fifty virtuous people within the city, then I’ll sustain the whole place for their sake.”

genesis:18:27@01-genesis/18.tex.original: ויען אברהם ויאמר הנה נא הואלתי לדבר אל אדני ואנכי עפר ואפר׃
genesis:18:27@01-genesis/18.tex.english: And Abraham answered, and he said, “Here I’ve undertaken to speak to my Lord, and I’m dust and ashes.

genesis:18:28@01-genesis/18.tex.original: אולי יחסרון חמשים הצדיקם חמשה התשחית בחמשה את כל העיר ויאמר לא אשחית אם אמצא שם ארבעים וחמשה׃
genesis:18:28@01-genesis/18.tex.english: Maybe the fifty virtuous people will be short by five. Will you destroy the whole city for the five?” And He said, “I won’t destroy if I find forty-five there.”

genesis:18:29@01-genesis/18.tex.original: ויסף עוד לדבר אליו ויאמר אולי ימצאון שם ארבעים ויאמר לא אעשה בעבור הארבעים׃
genesis:18:29@01-genesis/18.tex.english: And he went on again to speak to Him and said, “Maybe forty will be found there.” And He said, “I won’t do it for the sake of the forty.”

genesis:18:30@01-genesis/18.tex.original: ויאמר אל נא יחר לאדני ואדברה אולי ימצאון שם שלשים ויאמר לא אעשה אם אמצא שם שלשים׃
genesis:18:30@01-genesis/18.tex.english: And he said, “May my Lord not be angry, and let me speak. Maybe thirty will be found there.” And He said, “I won’t do it if I find thirty there.”

genesis:18:31@01-genesis/18.tex.original: ויאמר הנה נא הואלתי לדבר אל אדני אולי ימצאון שם עשרים ויאמר לא אשחית בעבור העשרים׃
genesis:18:31@01-genesis/18.tex.english: And he said, “Here I’ve undertaken to speak to my Lord. Maybe twenty will be found there.” And He said, “I won’t destroy for the sake of the twenty.”

genesis:18:32@01-genesis/18.tex.original: ויאמר אל נא יחר לאדני ואדברה אך הפעם אולי ימצאון שם עשרה ויאמר לא אשחית בעבור העשרה׃
genesis:18:32@01-genesis/18.tex.english: And he said, “May my Lord not be angry, and let me speak just this one time. Maybe ten will be found there.” And He said there, “I won’t destroy for the sake of the ten.”

genesis:18:33@01-genesis/18.tex.original: וילך יהוה כאשר כלה לדבר אל אברהם ואברהם שב למקמו׃
genesis:18:33@01-genesis/18.tex.english: And YHWH went when He had finished speaking to Abraham, and Abraham went back to his place.

genesis:19:1@01-genesis/19.tex.original: ויבאו שני המלאכים סדמה בערב ולוט ישב בשער סדם וירא לוט ויקם לקראתם וישתחו אפים ארצה׃
genesis:19:1@01-genesis/19.tex.english: And the two angels came to Sodom in the evening, and Lot was sitting at Sodom’s gate, and Lot saw and got up toward them, and he bowed, nose to the ground.

genesis:19:2@01-genesis/19.tex.original: ויאמר הנה נא אדני סורו נא אל בית עבדכם ולינו ורחצו רגליכם והשכמתם והלכתם לדרככם ויאמרו לא כי ברחוב נלין׃
genesis:19:2@01-genesis/19.tex.english: And he said, “Here, my lords, turn to your servant’s house and spend the night and wash your feet, and you’ll get up early and go your way.” And they said, “No, we’ll spend the night in the square.”

genesis:19:3@01-genesis/19.tex.original: ויפצר בם מאד ויסרו אליו ויבאו אל ביתו ויעש להם משתה ומצות אפה ויאכלו׃
genesis:19:3@01-genesis/19.tex.english: And he pressed them very much, and they turned to him and came to his house, and he made a feast and baked unleavened bread for them, and they ate.

genesis:19:4@01-genesis/19.tex.original: טרם ישכבו ואנשי העיר אנשי סדם נסבו על הבית מנער ועד זקן כל העם מקצה׃
genesis:19:4@01-genesis/19.tex.english: They had not yet lain down, and the people of the city, the people of Sodom, surrounded the house, from youth to old man, all the people, from the farthest reaches.

genesis:19:5@01-genesis/19.tex.original: ויקראו אל לוט ויאמרו לו איה האנשים אשר באו אליך הלילה הוציאם אלינו ונדעה אתם׃
genesis:19:5@01-genesis/19.tex.english: And they called to Lot and said to him, “Where are the people who came to you tonight? Bring them out to us, and let’s know them!”

genesis:19:6@01-genesis/19.tex.original: ויצא אלהם לוט הפתחה והדלת סגר אחריו׃
genesis:19:6@01-genesis/19.tex.english: And Lot went out to them at the entrance and closed the door behind him,

genesis:19:7@01-genesis/19.tex.original: ויאמר אל נא אחי תרעו׃
genesis:19:7@01-genesis/19.tex.english: and he said, “Don’t do bad, my brothers.

genesis:19:8@01-genesis/19.tex.original: הנה נא לי שתי בנות אשר לא ידעו איש אוציאה נא אתהן אליכם ועשו להן כטוב בעיניכם רק לאנשים האל אל תעשו דבר כי על כן באו בצל קרתי׃
genesis:19:8@01-genesis/19.tex.english: Here I have two daughters who haven’t known a man. Let me bring them out to you, and do to them as is good in your eyes. Only don’t do anything to these people, because that is why they came under the shadow of my roof.”

genesis:19:9@01-genesis/19.tex.original: ויאמרו גש הלאה ויאמרו האחד בא לגור וישפט שפוט עתה נרע לך מהם ויפצרו באיש בלוט מאד ויגשו לשבר הדלת׃
genesis:19:9@01-genesis/19.tex.english: And they said, “Come over here,” and they said, “This one comes to live, and then he judges! Now we’ll be worse to you than to them.” And they pressed the man, Lot, very much and came over to break down the door.

genesis:19:10@01-genesis/19.tex.original: וישלחו האנשים את ידם ויביאו את לוט אליהם הביתה ואת הדלת סגרו׃
genesis:19:10@01-genesis/19.tex.english: And the people reached their hand out and brought Lot in to them in the house, and they closed the door.

genesis:19:11@01-genesis/19.tex.original: ואת האנשים אשר פתח הבית הכו בסנורים מקטן ועד גדול וילאו למצא הפתח׃
genesis:19:11@01-genesis/19.tex.english: And they struck the people who were at the house’s entrance with blindness, from smallest to biggest, and they wearied themselves with finding the entrance.

genesis:19:12@01-genesis/19.tex.original: ויאמרו האנשים אל לוט עד מי לך פה חתן ובניך ובנתיך וכל אשר לך בעיר הוצא מן המקום׃
genesis:19:12@01-genesis/19.tex.english: And the people said to Lot, “Who else do you have here—son-in-law and your sons and your daughters and all that you have in the city-take them out from the place,

genesis:19:13@01-genesis/19.tex.original: כי משחתים אנחנו את המקום הזה כי גדלה צעקתם את פני יהוה וישלחנו יהוה לשחתה׃
genesis:19:13@01-genesis/19.tex.english: because we’re destroying this place, because its cry has grown big before YHWH’s face, and YHWH has sent us to destroy it.”

genesis:19:14@01-genesis/19.tex.original: ויצא לוט וידבר אל חתניו לקחי בנתיו ויאמר קומו צאו מן המקום הזה כי משחית יהוה את העיר ויהי כמצחק בעיני חתניו׃
genesis:19:14@01-genesis/19.tex.english: And Lot went out and spoke to his sons-in-law, who had married his daughters, and said, “Get up, get out of this place, for YHWH is destroying the city.” And he was like a joker in his sons-in-law’s eyes.

genesis:19:15@01-genesis/19.tex.original: וכמו השחר עלה ויאיצו המלאכים בלוט לאמר קום קח את אשתך ואת שתי בנתיך הנמצאת פן תספה בעון העיר׃
genesis:19:15@01-genesis/19.tex.english: And as the dawn rose the angels urged Lot, saying, “Get up, take your wife and your two daughters who are present, or else you’ll be annihilated for the city’s crime.”

genesis:19:16@01-genesis/19.tex.original: ויתמהמה ויחזיקו האנשים בידו וביד אשתו וביד שתי בנתיו בחמלת יהוה עליו ויצאהו וינחהו מחוץ לעיר׃
genesis:19:16@01-genesis/19.tex.english: And he delayed. And the people took hold of his hand and his wife’s hand and his two daughters’ hands because of YHWH’s compassion for him, and they brought him out and set him outside the city.

genesis:19:17@01-genesis/19.tex.original: ויהי כהוציאם אתם החוצה ויאמר המלט על נפשך אל תביט אחריך ואל תעמד בכל הככר ההרה המלט פן תספה׃
genesis:19:17@01-genesis/19.tex.english: And it was as they were bringing them outside, and He said, “Escape for your life. Don’t look behind you and don’t stop in all of the plain. Escape to the mountain or else you’ll be annihilated.”

genesis:19:18@01-genesis/19.tex.original: ויאמר לוט אלהם אל נא אדני׃
genesis:19:18@01-genesis/19.tex.english: And Lot said to them, “Let it not be, my Lord.

genesis:19:19@01-genesis/19.tex.original: הנה נא מצא עבדך חן בעיניך ותגדל חסדך אשר עשית עמדי להחיות את נפשי ואנכי לא אוכל להמלט ההרה פן תדבקני הרעה ומתי׃
genesis:19:19@01-genesis/19.tex.english: Here, your servant has found favor in your eyes, and you’ve magnified your kindness that you’ve done for me, keeping my soul alive, and I’m not able to escape to the mountain, in case the bad thing will cling to me and I’ll die.

genesis:19:20@01-genesis/19.tex.original: הנה נא העיר הזאת קרבה לנוס שמה והוא מצער אמלטה נא שמה הלא מצער הוא ותחי נפשי׃
genesis:19:20@01-genesis/19.tex.english: Here, this city is close to flee there, and it’s small. Let me escape there—isn’t it small?—and my soul will live.”

genesis:19:21@01-genesis/19.tex.original: ויאמר אליו הנה נשאתי פניך גם לדבר הזה לבלתי הפכי את העיר אשר דברת׃
genesis:19:21@01-genesis/19.tex.english: And He said to him, “Here, I’ve granted you this thing, too, that I won’t overturn the city of which you spoke.

genesis:19:22@01-genesis/19.tex.original: מהר המלט שמה כי לא אוכל לעשות דבר עד באך שמה על כן קרא שם העיר צוער׃
genesis:19:22@01-genesis/19.tex.english: Quickly, escape there, because I can’t do a thing until you get there.” On account of this the city’s name was called Zoar.

genesis:19:23@01-genesis/19.tex.original: השמש יצא על הארץ ולוט בא צערה׃
genesis:19:23@01-genesis/19.tex.english: The sun rose on the earth, and Lot came to Zoar.

genesis:19:24@01-genesis/19.tex.original: ויהוה המטיר על סדם ועל עמרה גפרית ואש מאת יהוה מן השמים׃
genesis:19:24@01-genesis/19.tex.english: And YHWH rained brimstone and fire on Sodom and on Gomorrah, from YHWH out of the skies.

genesis:19:25@01-genesis/19.tex.original: ויהפך את הערים האל ואת כל הככר ואת כל ישבי הערים וצמח האדמה׃
genesis:19:25@01-genesis/19.tex.english: And He overturned these cities and all of the plain and all of the residents of the cities and all the growth of the ground.

genesis:19:26@01-genesis/19.tex.original: ותבט אשתו מאחריו ותהי נציב מלח׃
genesis:19:26@01-genesis/19.tex.english: And his wife looked behind him, and she was a pillar of salt!

genesis:19:27@01-genesis/19.tex.original: וישכם אברהם בבקר אל המקום אשר עמד שם את פני יהוה׃
genesis:19:27@01-genesis/19.tex.english: And Abraham got up early in the morning to the place where he had stood in YHWH’s presence,

genesis:19:28@01-genesis/19.tex.original: וישקף על פני סדם ועמרה ועל כל פני ארץ הככר וירא והנה עלה קיטר הארץ כקיטר הכבשן׃
genesis:19:28@01-genesis/19.tex.english: and he gazed at the sight of Sodom and Gomorrah and at the sight of all the land of the plain. And he saw: and, here, the smoke of the land went up like the smoke of a furnace.

genesis:19:29@01-genesis/19.tex.original: וַיְהִי בְּשַׁחֵת אֱלֹהִים אֶת עָרֵי הַכִּכָּר וַיִּזְכֹּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת אַבְרָהָם וַיְשַׁלַּח אֶת לוֹט מִתּוֹךְ הַהֲפֵכָה בַּהֲפֹךְ אֶת הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר יָשַׁב בָּהֵן לוֹט׃
genesis:19:29@01-genesis/19.tex.english: And it was, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham and let Lot go from inside the overthrow: at the overthrowing of the cities in which Lot lived.

genesis:19:30@01-genesis/19.tex.original: ויעל לוט מצוער וישב בהר ושתי בנתיו עמו כי ירא לשבת בצוער וישב במערה הוא ושתי בנתיו׃
genesis:19:30@01-genesis/19.tex.english: And Lot went up from Zoar and lived in the mountain, and his two daughters with him, because he feared to live in Zoar, and he lived in a cave, he and his two daughters.

genesis:19:31@01-genesis/19.tex.original: ותאמר הבכירה אל הצעירה אבינו זקן ואיש אין בארץ לבוא עלינו כדרך כל הארץ׃
genesis:19:31@01-genesis/19.tex.english: And the firstborn said to the younger one, “Our father is old, and there’s no man in the earth to come to us in the way of all the earth.

genesis:19:32@01-genesis/19.tex.original: לכה נשקה את אבינו יין ונשכבה עמו ונחיה מאבינו זרע׃
genesis:19:32@01-genesis/19.tex.english: Come on, let’s make our father drink wine, and let’s lie with him and make seed live from our father.”

genesis:19:33@01-genesis/19.tex.original: ותשקין את אביהן יין בלילה הוא ותבא הבכירה ותשכב את אביה ולא ידע בשכבה ובקומה׃
genesis:19:33@01-genesis/19.tex.english: And they made their father drink wine in that night, and the firstborn came and lay with her father. And he did not know of her lying down and her getting up.

genesis:19:34@01-genesis/19.tex.original: ויהי ממחרת ותאמר הבכירה אל הצעירה הן שכבתי אמש את אבי נשקנו יין גם הלילה ובאי שכבי עמו ונחיה מאבינו זרע׃
genesis:19:34@01-genesis/19.tex.english: And it was on the next day, and the firstborn said to the younger one, “Here, I lay with my father last night. Let’s make him drink wine tonight as well, and you come and lie with him, and we’ll make seed live from our father.”

genesis:19:35@01-genesis/19.tex.original: ותשקין גם בלילה ההוא את אביהן יין ותקם הצעירה ותשכב עמו ולא ידע בשכבה ובקמה׃
genesis:19:35@01-genesis/19.tex.english: And they made their father drink wine in that night as well, and the younger one got up and lay with him, and he did not know of her lying down and her getting up.

genesis:19:36@01-genesis/19.tex.original: ותהרין שתי בנות לוט מאביהן׃
genesis:19:36@01-genesis/19.tex.english: And Lot’s two daughters became pregnant by their father.

genesis:19:37@01-genesis/19.tex.original: ותלד הבכירה בן ותקרא שמו מואב הוא אבי מואב עד היום׃
genesis:19:37@01-genesis/19.tex.english: And the firstborn gave birth to a son and called his name Moab. He is the father of Moab to this day.

genesis:19:38@01-genesis/19.tex.original: והצעירה גם הוא ילדה בן ותקרא שמו בן עמי הוא אבי בני עמון עד היום׃
genesis:19:38@01-genesis/19.tex.english: And the younger one, she too gave birth to a son and called his name ben-Ammi. He is the father of the children of Ammon to this day.

genesis:20:1@01-genesis/20.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-rje hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="RJE">WYS] MVM ABRHM ARCH HNGB WYVB BYN QDV WBYN VWR WYGR BGRR׃</bdo>
genesis:20:1@01-genesis/20.tex.english: And Abraham traveled from there to the Negeb country and lived between Kadesh and Shur and resided in Gerar.

genesis:20:2@01-genesis/20.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR ABRHM AL VRH AVTW AXTY HWA WYVLX ABYMLK MLK GRR WYQX AT VRH׃</bdo>
genesis:20:2@01-genesis/20.tex.english: And Abraham said of Sarah, his wife, “She’s my sister.” Now Abimelek, king of Gerar, sent and took Sarah.

genesis:20:3@01-genesis/20.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYBA ALHYM AL ABYMLK BXLWM HLYLH WYAMR LW HNK MT ]L HAVH AVR LQXT WHWA B]LT B]L׃</bdo>
genesis:20:3@01-genesis/20.tex.english: And God came to Abimelek in a night dream and said to him, “Here, you’re dead over the woman whom you took, for she’s a man’s wife!”

genesis:20:4@01-genesis/20.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WABYMLK LA QRB ALYH WYAMR ADNY HGWY GM CDYQ THRG׃</bdo>
genesis:20:4@01-genesis/20.tex.english: And Abimelek had not come close to her, and he said, “My Lord, will you kill a virtuous nation as well?

genesis:20:5@01-genesis/20.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">HLA HWA AMR LY AXTY HWA WHYA GM HWA AMRH AXY HWA BTM LBBY WBNQYN KPY ]VYTY ZAT׃</bdo>
genesis:20:5@01-genesis/20.tex.english: Didn’t he say to me, ‘She’s my sister’? And she—she, too—said, ‘He’s my brother.’ I did this in my heart’s innocence and in my hands’ cleanness.”

genesis:20:6@01-genesis/20.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR ALYW HALHYM BXLM GM ANKY YD]TY KY BTM LBBK ]VYT ZAT WAXVK GM ANKY AWTK MXJW LY ]L KN LA NTTYK LNG] ALYH׃</bdo>
genesis:20:6@01-genesis/20.tex.english: And God said to him in the dream, “I, too, knew that you did this in your heart’s innocence; and I, too, held you back from sinning against me. On account of this, I didn’t let you touch her.

genesis:20:7@01-genesis/20.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">W]TH HVB AVT HAYV KY NBYA HWA WYTPLL B]DK WXYH WAM AYNK MVYB D] KY MWT TMWT ATH WKL AVR LK׃</bdo>
genesis:20:7@01-genesis/20.tex.english: And now, give the man’s wife back, because he’s a prophet, and he’ll pray for you. And live! And if you don’t give back, know that you will die, you and all that you have.”

genesis:20:8@01-genesis/20.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYVKM ABYMLK BBQR WYQRA LKL ]BDYW WYDBR AT KL HDBRYM HALH BAZNYHM WYYRAW HANVYM MAD׃</bdo>
genesis:20:8@01-genesis/20.tex.english: And Abimelek got up in the morning and called to all his servants and spoke all these things in their ears, and the people were very afraid.

genesis:20:9@01-genesis/20.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYQRA ABYMLK LABRHM WYAMR LW MH ]VYT LNW WMH XJATY LK KY HBAT ]LY W]L MMLKTY XJAH GDLH M]VYM AVR LA Y]VW ]VYT ]MDY׃</bdo>
genesis:20:9@01-genesis/20.tex.english: And Abimelek called Abraham and said to him, “What have you done to us, and how did I sin against you, that you brought a big sin over me and over my kingdom? You’ve done things with me that are not done!”

genesis:20:10@01-genesis/20.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR ABYMLK AL ABRHM MH RAYT KY ]VYT AT HDBR HZH׃</bdo>
genesis:20:10@01-genesis/20.tex.english: And Abimelek said to Abraham, “What did you see, that you did this thing?”

genesis:20:11@01-genesis/20.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR ABRHM KY AMRTY RQ AYN YRAT ALHYM BMQWM HZH WHRGWNY ]L DBR AVTY׃</bdo>
genesis:20:11@01-genesis/20.tex.english: And Abraham said, “Because I said, ‘There just isn’t the fear of God in this place, and they’ll kill me on account of my wife.

genesis:20:12@01-genesis/20.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WGM AMNH AXTY BT ABY HWA AK LA BT AMY WTHY LY LAVH׃</bdo>
genesis:20:12@01-genesis/20.tex.english: And also she is, in fact, my sister, my father’s daughter but not my mother’s daughter, and she became a wife to me.

genesis:20:13@01-genesis/20.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYHY KAVR HT]W ATY ALHYM MBYT ABY WAMR LH ZH XSDK AVR T]VY ]MDY AL KL HMQWM AVR NBWA VMH AMRY LY AXY HWA׃</bdo>
genesis:20:13@01-genesis/20.tex.english: And it was when God had me roam from my father’s house, and I said to her, This will be your kindness that you’ll do with me: to every place where we come, say about me, “He’s my brother.”‘”

genesis:20:14@01-genesis/20.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYQX ABYMLK CAN WBQR W]BDYM WVPXT WYTN LABRHM WYVB LW AT VRH AVTW׃</bdo>
genesis:20:14@01-genesis/20.tex.english: And Abimelek took sheep and oxen and servants and maids, and he gave them to Abraham, and he gave Sarah, his wife, back to him.

genesis:20:15@01-genesis/20.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR ABYMLK HNH ARCY LPNYK BJWB B]YNYK VB׃</bdo>
genesis:20:15@01-genesis/20.tex.english: And Abimelek said, “Here’s my land in front of you. Live wherever it’s good in your eyes.”

genesis:20:16@01-genesis/20.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WLVRH AMR HNH NTTY ALP KSP LAXYK HNH HWA LK KSWT ]YNYM LKL AVR ATK WAT KL WNKXT׃</bdo>
genesis:20:16@01-genesis/20.tex.english: And to Sarah he said, “Here, I’ve given a thousand weights of silver to your brother. Here, it’s a covering of eyes for you with everyone with you, and you’re justified with everyone.”

genesis:20:17@01-genesis/20.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYTPLL ABRHM AL HALHYM WYRPA ALHYM AT ABYMLK WAT AVTW WAMHTYW WYLDW׃</bdo>
genesis:20:17@01-genesis/20.tex.english: And Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelek and his wife and his maids, and they gave birth,

genesis:20:18@01-genesis/20.tex.original: KY ]CR ]CR יהוה B]D KL RXM LBYT ABYMLK ]L DBR VRH AVT ABRHM׃
genesis:20:18@01-genesis/20.tex.english: because YHWH had held back every womb of Abimelek’s house on account of Sarah, Abraham’s wife!

genesis:21:1@01-genesis/21.tex.original: ויהוה פקד את שרה כאשר אמר וַיַּעַשׂ יְהֹוָה לְשָׂרָה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֵּר׃
genesis:21:1@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And YHWH took account of Sarah as He had said, and YHWH did to Sarah as He had spoken.

genesis:21:2@01-genesis/21.tex.original: ותהר ותלד שרה לאברהם בן לזקניו למועד אשר דבר אתו אלהים׃
genesis:21:2@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And Sarah became pregnant and gave birth to a son for Abraham in his old age at the appointed time that God had spoken.

genesis:21:3@01-genesis/21.tex.original: וַיִּקְרָא אַבְרָהָם אֶת שֶׁם בְּנוֹ הַנּוֹלַד לוֹ אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לּוֹ שָׂרָה יִצְחָק׃
genesis:21:3@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And Abraham called the name of his son who was born to him, to whom Sarah had given birth for him: Isaac.

genesis:21:4@01-genesis/21.tex.original: וַיָּמל אַבְרָהָם אֶת יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ בֶּן שְׁמֹנַת יָמִים כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֹתוֹ אֱלֹהִים׃
genesis:21:4@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And Abraham circumcised Isaac, his son, at eight days old, as God had commanded him.

genesis:21:5@01-genesis/21.tex.original: וְאַבְרָהָם בֶּן מְאַת שָׁנָה בְּהִוָּלֶד לוֹ אֵת יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ׃
genesis:21:5@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And Abraham was a hundred years old when Isaac, his son, was born to him.

genesis:21:6@01-genesis/21.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WTAMR VRH CXQ ]VH LY ALHYM KL HVM] YCXQ LY׃</bdo>
genesis:21:6@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And Sarah said, “God has made laughter for me. Everyone who hears will laugh for me.”

genesis:21:7@01-genesis/21.tex.original: ותאמר מי מלל לאברהם היניקה בנים שרה כי ילדתי בן לזקניו׃
genesis:21:7@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And she said, “Who would have said to Abraham, ‘Sarah has nursed children’? Yet I’ve given birth to a son in his old age.”

genesis:21:8@01-genesis/21.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYGDL HYLD WYGML WY]V ABRHM MVTH GDWL BYWM HGML AT YCXQ׃</bdo>
genesis:21:8@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And the boy grew and was weaned. And Abraham made a big feast in the day that Isaac was weaned.

genesis:21:9@01-genesis/21.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WTRA VRH AT BN HGR HMCRYT AVR YLDH LABRHM MCXQ׃</bdo>
genesis:21:9@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar, the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, fooling around.

genesis:21:10@01-genesis/21.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WTAMR LABRHM GRV HAMH HZAT WAT BNH KY LA YYRV BN HAMH HZAT ]M BNY ]M YCXQ׃</bdo>
genesis:21:10@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And she said to Abraham, “Drive this maid out—and her son, because the son of this maid will not inherit with my son, with Isaac.”

genesis:21:11@01-genesis/21.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYR] HDBR MAD B]YNY ABRHM ]L AWDT BNW׃</bdo>
genesis:21:11@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And the thing was very bad in Abraham’s eyes in regard to his son.

genesis:21:12@01-genesis/21.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR ALHYM AL ABRHM AL YR] B]YNYK ]L HN]R W]L AMTK KL AVR TAMR ALYK VRH VM] BQLH KY BYCXQ YQRA LK ZR]׃</bdo>
genesis:21:12@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And God said to Abraham, “Let it not be bad in your eyes about the boy and about your maid. Everything that Sarah tells you: listen to her voice; because seed for you will be called by Isaac.

genesis:21:13@01-genesis/21.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WGM AT BN HAMH LGWY AVYMNW KY ZR]K HWA׃</bdo>
genesis:21:13@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And I’ll make the maid’s son into a nation as well, because he’s your seed.”

genesis:21:14@01-genesis/21.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYVKM ABRHM BBQR WYQX LXM WXMT MYM WYTN AL HGR VM ]L VKMH WAT HYLD WYVLXH WTLK WTT] BMDBR BAR VB]׃</bdo>
genesis:21:14@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And Abraham got up early in the morning and took bread and a bottle of water and gave to Hagar—he put them on her shoulder—and the boy and he sent her off. And she went and strayed in the Beer-sheba wilderness.

genesis:21:15@01-genesis/21.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYKLW HMYM MN HXMT WTVLK AT HYLD TXT AXD HVYXM׃</bdo>
genesis:21:15@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And the water was finished from the bottle, and she thrust the boy under one of the shrubs,
