genesis:21:16@01-genesis/21.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WTLK WTVB LH MNGD HRXQ KMJXWY QVT KY AMRH AL ARAH BMWT HYLD WTVB MNGD WTVA AT QLH WTBK׃</bdo>
genesis:21:16@01-genesis/21.tex.english: and she went and sat opposite, going as far as a bow-shot, because she said, “Let me not see the boy’s death.” And she sat opposite and raised her voice and wept.

genesis:21:17@01-genesis/21.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYVM] ALHYM AT QWL HN]R WYQRA MLAK ALHYM AL HGR MN HVMYM WYAMR LH MH LK HGR AL TYRAY KY VM] ALHYM AL QWL HN]R BAVR HWA VM׃</bdo>
genesis:21:17@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And God heard the boy’s voice. And an angel of God called to Hagar from the heavens and said to her, “What trouble do you have, Hagar? Don’t be afraid. Because God has heard the boy’s voice where he is.

genesis:21:18@01-genesis/21.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">QWMY VAY AT HN]R WHXZYQY AT YDK BW KY LGWY GDWL AVYMNW׃</bdo>
genesis:21:18@01-genesis/21.tex.english: Get up. Carry the boy and hold him up in your hand, because I shall make him into a big nation.”

genesis:21:19@01-genesis/21.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYPQX ALHYM AT ]YNYH WTRA BAR MYM WTLK WTMLA AT HXMT MYM WTVQ AT HN]R׃</bdo>
genesis:21:19@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a water well, and she went and filled the bottle with water and had the boy drink.

genesis:21:20@01-genesis/21.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYHY ALHYM AT HN]R WYGDL WYVB BMDBR WYHY RBH QVT׃</bdo>
genesis:21:20@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And God was with the boy, and he grew, and he lived in the wilderness and was a bowman.

genesis:21:21@01-genesis/21.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYVB BMDBR PARN WTQX LW AMW AVH MARC MCRYM׃</bdo>
genesis:21:21@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And he lived in the Paran wilderness, and his mother took him a wife from the land of Egypt.

genesis:21:22@01-genesis/21.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYHY B]T HHWA WYAMR ABYMLK WPYKL VR CBAW AL ABRHM LAMR ALHYM ]MK BKL AVR ATH ]VH׃</bdo>
genesis:21:22@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And it was at that time, and Abimelek and Phichol, the commander of his army, said to Abraham, saying, “God is with you in everything that you do.

genesis:21:23@01-genesis/21.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">W]TH HVB]H LY BALHYM HNH AM TVQR LY WLNYNY WLNKDY KXSD AVR ]VYTY ]MK T]VH ]MDY W]M HARC AVR GRTH BH׃</bdo>
genesis:21:23@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And now, swear to me here by God that you won’t act falsely to me and to my offspring and to my posterity Like the kindness that I’ve done with you, you’ll do with me and with the land in which you’ve resided.”

genesis:21:24@01-genesis/21.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR ABRHM ANKY AVB]׃</bdo>
genesis:21:24@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And Abraham said, “I’ll swear,”

genesis:21:25@01-genesis/21.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WHWKX ABRHM AT ABYMLK ]L ADWT BAR HMYM AVR GZLW ]BDY ABYMLK׃</bdo>
genesis:21:25@01-genesis/21.tex.english: and Abraham criticized Abimelek about a water well that Abimelek’s servants had seized.

genesis:21:26@01-genesis/21.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR ABYMLK LA YD]TY MY ]VH AT HDBR HZH WGM ATH LA HGDT LY WGM ANKY LA VM]TY BLTY HYWM׃</bdo>
genesis:21:26@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And Abimelek said, “I don’t know who did this thing; and also, you didn’t tell me; and also, I didn’t hear of it except for today.”

genesis:21:27@01-genesis/21.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYQX ABRHM CAN WBQR WYTN LABYMLK WYKRTW VNYHM BRYT׃</bdo>
genesis:21:27@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And Abraham took sheep and oxen and gave to Abimelek, and the two of them made a covenant.

genesis:21:28@01-genesis/21.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYCB ABRHM AT VB] KBVT HCAN LBDHN׃</bdo>
genesis:21:28@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And Abraham stood seven ewes of the sheep by themselves.

genesis:21:29@01-genesis/21.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR ABYMLK AL ABRHM MH HNH VB] KBVT HALH AVR HCBT LBDNH׃</bdo>
genesis:21:29@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And Abimelek said to Abraham, “What are these seven ewes that you’ve stood by themselves?”

genesis:21:30@01-genesis/21.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR KY AT VB] KBVT TQX MYDY B]BWR THYH LY L]DH KY XPRTY AT HBAR HZAT׃</bdo>
genesis:21:30@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And he said, “Because you’ll take these seven ewes from my hand so that it will be evidence for me that I dug this well.”

genesis:21:31@01-genesis/21.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">]L KN QRA LMQWM HHWA BAR VB] KY VM NVB]W VNYHM׃</bdo>
genesis:21:31@01-genesis/21.tex.english: On account of this he called that place Beer-sheba, because the two of them swore there

genesis:21:32@01-genesis/21.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYKRTW BRYT BBAR VB] WYQM ABYMLK WPYKL VR CBAW WYVBW AL ARC PLVTYM׃</bdo>
genesis:21:32@01-genesis/21.tex.english: and made a covenant in Beer-sheba. And Abimelek and Phichol, the commander of his army, got up and went to the land of the Philistines.

genesis:21:33@01-genesis/21.tex.original: WYJ] AVL BBAR VB] WYQRA VM BVM יהוה AL ]WLM׃
genesis:21:33@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And he planted a tamarisk in Beer-sheba and he called the name of YHWH El Olam.

genesis:21:34@01-genesis/21.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYGR ABRHM BARC PLVTYM YMYM RBYM׃</bdo>
genesis:21:34@01-genesis/21.tex.english: And Abraham resided in the land of the Philistines many days.

genesis:22:1@01-genesis/22.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYHY AXR HDBRYM HALH WHALHYM NSH AT ABRHM WYAMR ALYW ABRHM WYAMR HNNY</bdo>
genesis:22:1@01-genesis/22.tex.english: And it was after these things, and God tested Abraham. And He said to him, “Abraham.” And he said, “I’m here.”

genesis:22:2@01-genesis/22.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR QX NA AT BNK AT YXYDK AVR AHBT AT YCXQ WLK LK AL ARC HMRYH WH]LHW VM L]LH ]L AXD HHRYM AVR AMR ALYK</bdo>
genesis:22:2@01-genesis/22.tex.english: And He said, “Take your son, your only one, whom you love, Isaac, and go to the land of Mo-riah and make him a burnt offering there on one of the mountains that I’ll say to you.”

genesis:22:3@01-genesis/22.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYVKM ABRHM BBQR WYXBV AT XMRW WYQX AT VNY N]RYW ATW WAT YCXQ BNW WYBQ] ]CY ]LH WYQM WYLK AL HMQWM AVR AMR LW HALHYM</bdo>
genesis:22:3@01-genesis/22.tex.english: And Abraham got up early in the morning and harnessed his ass and took his two boys with him and Isaac, his son. And he cut the wood for the burnt offering, and he got up and went to the place that God had said to him.

genesis:22:4@01-genesis/22.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">BYWM HVLYVY WYVA ABRHM AT ]YNYW WYRA AT HMQWM MRXQ</bdo>
genesis:22:4@01-genesis/22.tex.english: On the third day: and Abraham raised his eyes and saw the place from a distance.

genesis:22:5@01-genesis/22.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR ABRHM AL N]RYW VBW LKM PH ]M HXMWR WANY WHN]R NLKH ]D KH WNVTXWH WNVWBH ALYKM</bdo>
genesis:22:5@01-genesis/22.tex.english: And Abraham said to his boys, “Sit here with the ass; and I and the boy: we’ll go over there, and we’ll bow, and we’ll come back to you.”

genesis:22:6@01-genesis/22.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYQX ABRHM AT ]CY H]LH WYVM ]L YCXQ BNW WYQX BYDW AT HAV WAT HMAKLT WYLKW VNYHM YXDW</bdo>
genesis:22:6@01-genesis/22.tex.english: And Abraham took the wood for the burnt offering and put it on Isaac, his son, and took the fire and the knife in his hand. And the two of them went together.

genesis:22:7@01-genesis/22.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR YCXQ AL ABRHM ABYW WYAMR ABY WYAMR HNNY BNY WYAMR HNH HAV WH]CYM WAYH HVH L]LH</bdo>
genesis:22:7@01-genesis/22.tex.english: And Isaac said to Abraham, his father; and he said, “My father.” And he said, “I’m here, my son.” And he said, “Here are the fire and the wood, but where is the sheep for the burnt offering?”

genesis:22:8@01-genesis/22.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR ABRHM ALHYM YRAH LW HVH L]LH BNY WYLKW VNYHM YXDW</bdo>
genesis:22:8@01-genesis/22.tex.english: And Abraham said, “God will see to the sheep for the burnt offering, my son.” And the two of them went together.

genesis:22:9@01-genesis/22.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYBAW AL HMQWM AVR AMR LW HALHYM WYBN VM ABRHM AT HMZBX WY]RK AT H]CYM WY]QD AT YCXQ BNW WYVM ATW ]L HMZBX MM]L L]CYM</bdo>
genesis:22:9@01-genesis/22.tex.english: And they came to the place that God had said to him. And Abraham built the altar there and arranged the wood, and he bound Isaac, his son, and put him on the altar on top of the wood.

genesis:22:10@01-genesis/22.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYVLX ABRHM AT YDW WYQX AT HMAKLT LVXJ AT BNW</bdo>
genesis:22:10@01-genesis/22.tex.english: And Abraham put out his hand and took the knife to slaughter his son.

genesis:22:11@01-genesis/22.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-rje hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="RJE">WYQRA ALYW MLAK YHWH MN HVMYM WYAMR ABRHM ABRHM WYAMR HNNY</bdo>
genesis:22:11@01-genesis/22.tex.english: And an angel of YHWH^[Fourth of five. This one's above my pay grade.] called to him from the skies and said, “Abraham! Abraham!” And he said, “I’m here.”

genesis:22:12@01-genesis/22.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-rje hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="RJE">WYAMR AL TVLX YDK AL HN]R WAL T]V LW MAWMH KY ]TH YD]TY KY YRA ALHYM ATH WLA XVKT AT BNK AT YXYDK MMNY</bdo>
genesis:22:12@01-genesis/22.tex.english: And he said, “Don’t put your hand out toward the boy, and don’t do anything to him, because now I know that you fear LꞀ, and you didn’t withhold your son, your only one, from me.”

genesis:22:13@01-genesis/22.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-rje hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="RJE">WYVA ABRHM AT ]YNYW WYRA WHNH AYL AXR NAXZ BSBK BQRNYW WYLK ABRHM WYQX AT HAYL WY]LHW L]LH TXT BNW</bdo>
genesis:22:13@01-genesis/22.tex.english: And Abraham raised his eyes and saw, and here was a ram behind, caught in the thicket by its horns. And Abraham went and took the ram and made it a burnt offering instead of his son.

genesis:22:14@01-genesis/22.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-rje hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="RJE">WYQRA ABRHM VM HMQWM HHWA YHWH YRAH AVR YAMR HYWM BHR YHWH YRAH</bdo>
genesis:22:14@01-genesis/22.tex.english: And Abraham called the name of that place “YHWH Yir’eh,” as is said today: “In YHWH’s mountain it will be seen.”

genesis:22:15@01-genesis/22.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-rje hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="RJE">WYQRA MLAK YHWH AL ABRHM VNYT MN HVMYM</bdo>
genesis:22:15@01-genesis/22.tex.english: And an angel of YHWH called to Abraham a second time from the skies

genesis:22:16@01-genesis/22.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR BY NVB]TY</bdo> <bdo class="source source-rje hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="RJE">NAM YHWH</bdo> <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">KY Y]N AVR ]VYT AT HDBR HZH WLA XVKT AT BNK AT YXYDK</bdo>
genesis:22:16@01-genesis/22.tex.english: and said, “I swear by me—word of YHWH—that because you did this thing and didn’t withhold your son, your only one,

genesis:22:17@01-genesis/22.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">KY BRK ABRKK WHRBH ARBH AT ZR]K KKWKBY HVMYM WKXWL AVR ]L VPT HYM WYRV ZR]K AT V]R AYBYW</bdo>
genesis:22:17@01-genesis/22.tex.english: that I’ll bless you and multiply your seed like the stars of the skies and like the sand that’s on the seashore, and your seed will possess its enemies’ gate.

genesis:22:18@01-genesis/22.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WHTBRKW BZR]K KL GWYY HARC ]QB AVR VM]T BQLY</bdo>
genesis:22:18@01-genesis/22.tex.english: And all the nations of the earth will be blessed through your seed because you listened to my voice

genesis:22:19@01-genesis/22.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYVB ABRHM AL N]RYW WYQMW WYLKW YXDW AL BAR VB] WYVB ABRHM BBAR VB]</bdo>
genesis:22:19@01-genesis/22.tex.english: And Abraham went back to his boys And they got up And went together to Beer-sheba And Abraham lived in Beer-sheba

genesis:22:20@01-genesis/22.tex.original: ויהי אחרי הדברים האלה ויגד לאברהם לאמר הנה ילדה מלכה גם הוא בנים לנחור אחיך
genesis:22:20@01-genesis/22.tex.english: And it was after these things, and it was told to Abraham, saying, “Here Milcah has given birth, she also, to sons for your brother Nahor:

genesis:22:21@01-genesis/22.tex.original: את עוץ בכרו ואת בוז אחיו ואת קמואל אבי ארם
genesis:22:21@01-genesis/22.tex.english: Uz, his firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel, the father of Aram,

genesis:22:22@01-genesis/22.tex.original: ואת כשד ואת חזו ואת פלדש ואת ידלף ואת בתואל
genesis:22:22@01-genesis/22.tex.english: and Chesed and Hazo and Pildash and Jidlaph and Bethuel.

genesis:22:23@01-genesis/22.tex.original: ובתואל ילד את רבקה שמנה אלה ילדה מלכה לנחור אחי אברהם
genesis:22:23@01-genesis/22.tex.english: And Bethuel fathered Rebekah.” Milcah gave birth to these eight for Nahor, Abraham’s brother.

genesis:22:24@01-genesis/22.tex.original: ופילגשו ושמה ראומה ותלד גם הוא את טבח ואת גחם ואת תחש ואת מעכה
genesis:22:24@01-genesis/22.tex.english: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she too gave birth, to Tebah and Gaham and Tahash and Maacah.

genesis:23:1@01-genesis/23.tex.original: וַיִּהְיוּ חַיֵּי שָׂרָה מֵאָה שָׁנָה וְעֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וְשֶׁבַע שָׁנִים שְׁנֵי חַיֵּי שָׂרָה׃
genesis:23:1@01-genesis/23.tex.english: And Sarah’s life was a hundred years and twenty years and seven years: the years of Sarah’s life.

genesis:23:2@01-genesis/23.tex.original: וַתָּמת שָׂרָה בְּקִרְיַת אַרְבַּע הִוא חֶבְרוֹן בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וַיָּבֹא אַבְרָהָם לִסְפֹּד לְשָׂרָה וְלִבְכֹּתָהּ׃
genesis:23:2@01-genesis/23.tex.english: And Sarah died in Kiriath Arba—it is Hebron—in the land of Canaan. And Abraham came to grieve for Sarah and to weep for her.

genesis:23:3@01-genesis/23.tex.original: וַיָּקם אַבְרָהָם מֵעַל פְּנֵי מֵתוֹ וַיְדַבֵּר אֶל בְּנֵי חֵת לֵאמֹר׃
genesis:23:3@01-genesis/23.tex.english: And Abraham got up from in front of his dead, and he spoke to the children of Heth, saying,

genesis:23:4@01-genesis/23.tex.original: גֵּר וְתוֹשָׁב אָנֹכִי עִמָּכֶם תְּנוּ לִי אֲחֻזַּת קֶבֶר עִמָּכֶם וְאֶקְבְּרָה מֵתִי מִלְּפָנָי׃
genesis:23:4@01-genesis/23.tex.english: “I’m an alien and a visitor with you. Give me a possession for a tomb with you so I may bury my dead from in front of me.”

genesis:23:5@01-genesis/23.tex.original: וַיַּעֲנוּ בְנֵי חֵת אֶת אַבְרָהָם לֵאמֹר לוֹ׃
genesis:23:5@01-genesis/23.tex.english: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,

genesis:23:6@01-genesis/23.tex.original: שְׁמָעֵנוּ אֲדֹנִי נְשִׂיא אֱלֹהִים אַתָּה בְּתוֹכֵנוּ בְּמִבְחַר קְבָרֵינוּ קְבֹר אֶת מֵתֶךָ אִישׁ מִמֶּנּוּ אֶת קִבְרוֹ לֹא יִכְלֶה מִמְּךָ מִקְּבֹר מֵתֶךָ׃
genesis:23:6@01-genesis/23.tex.english: “Listen to us, my lord. You’re a chieftain of God among us. Bury your dead in the choice of our tombs. Not a man of us will hold back his tomb from you, from burying your dead.”

genesis:23:7@01-genesis/23.tex.original: וַיָּקם אַבְרָהָם וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ לְעַם הָאָרֶץ לִבְנֵי חֵת׃
genesis:23:7@01-genesis/23.tex.english: And Abraham got up and bowed to the people of the land, to the children of Heth,

genesis:23:8@01-genesis/23.tex.original: וַיְדַבֵּר אִתָּם לֵאמֹר אִם יֵשׁ אֶת נַפְשְׁכֶם לִקְבֹּר אֶת מֵתִי מִלְּפָנַי שְׁמָעוּנִי וּפִגְעוּ לִי בְּעֶפְרוֹן בֶּן צֹחַר׃
genesis:23:8@01-genesis/23.tex.english: and he spoke with them, saying, “If it’s acceptable to you to bury my dead from in front of me, listen to me, and intercede for me with Ephron, son of Zohar,

genesis:23:9@01-genesis/23.tex.original: וְיִתֶּן לִי אֶת מְעָרַת הַמַּכְפֵּלָה אֲשֶׁר לוֹ אֲשֶׁר בִּקְצֵה שָׂדֵהוּ בְּכֶסֶף מָלֵא יִתְּנֶנָּה לִּי בְּתוֹכְכֶם לַאֲחֻזַּת קָבֶר׃
genesis:23:9@01-genesis/23.tex.english: that he’ll give me the cave of Machpelah which he has, that is at the edge of his field. For full price let him give it to me among you as a possession for a tomb.”

genesis:23:10@01-genesis/23.tex.original: וְעֶפְרוֹן יֹשֵׁב בְּתוֹךְ בְּנֵי חֵת וַיַּעַן עֶפְרוֹן הַחִתִּי אֶת אַבְרָהָם בְּאזְנֵי בְנֵי חֵת לְכֹל בָּאֵי שַׁעַר עִירוֹ לֵאמֹר׃
genesis:23:10@01-genesis/23.tex.english: And Ephron was sitting among the children of Heth, and Ephron, the Hittite, answered Abraham in the ears of the children of Heth, for all who were coming to his city’s gate, saying,

genesis:23:11@01-genesis/23.tex.original: לֹא אֲדֹנִי שְׁמָעֵנִי הַשָּׂדֶה נָתַתִּי לָךְ וְהַמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ לְךָ נְתַתִּיהָ לְעֵינֵי בְנֵי עַמִּי נְתַתִּיהָ לָּךְ קְבֹר מֵתֶךָ׃
genesis:23:11@01-genesis/23.tex.english: “No, sir. Listen to me: I’ve given the field to you, and I’ve given the cave that’s in it to you. I’ve given it to you before the eyes of the children of my people. Bury your dead.”

genesis:23:12@01-genesis/23.tex.original: וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ אַבְרָהָם לִפְנֵי עַם הָאָרֶץ׃
genesis:23:12@01-genesis/23.tex.english: And Abraham bowed in front of the people of the land,

genesis:23:13@01-genesis/23.tex.original: וַיְדַבֵּר אֶל עֶפְרוֹן בְּאזְנֵי עַם הָאָרֶץ לֵאמֹר אַךְ אִם אַתָּה לוּ שְׁמָעֵנִי נָתַתִּי כֶּסֶף הַשָּׂדֶה קַח מִמֶּנִּי וְאֶקְבְּרָה אֶת מֵתִי שָׁמָּה׃
genesis:23:13@01-genesis/23.tex.english: and he spoke to Ephron in the ears of the people of the land, saying, “Just if you’ll listen to me: I’ve given the money for the field. Take it from me so I may bury my dead there.”

genesis:23:14@01-genesis/23.tex.original: וַיַּעַן עֶפְרוֹן אֶת אַבְרָהָם לֵאמֹר לוֹ׃
genesis:23:14@01-genesis/23.tex.english: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,

genesis:23:15@01-genesis/23.tex.original: אֲדֹנִי שְׁמָעֵנִי אֶרֶץ אַרְבַּע מֵאֹת שֶׁקֶל כֶּסֶף בֵּינִי וּבֵינְךָ מַה הִוא וְאֶת מֵתְךָ קְבֹר׃
genesis:23:15@01-genesis/23.tex.english: “Sir, listen to me. Land worth four hundred shekels of silver: what’s that between me and you?! And bury your dead.”

genesis:23:16@01-genesis/23.tex.original: וַיִּשְׁמַע אַבְרָהָם אֶל עֶפְרוֹן וַיִּשְׁקֹל אַבְרָהָם לְעֶפְרֹן אֶת הַכֶּסֶף אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר בְּאזְנֵי בְנֵי חֵת אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שֶׁקֶל כֶּסֶף עֹבֵר לַסֹּחֵר׃
genesis:23:16@01-genesis/23.tex.english: And Abraham listened to Ephron, and Abraham weighed out to Ephron the money that he had spoken in the ears of the children of Heth: four hundred shekels of silver, at the merchant’s current rate.

genesis:23:17@01-genesis/23.tex.original: וַיָּקם שְׂדֵה עֶפְרוֹן אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּכְפֵּלָה אֲשֶׁר לִפְנֵי מַמְרֵא הַשָּׂדֶה וְהַמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ וְכל הָעֵץ אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר בְּכל גְּבֻלוֹ סָבִיב׃
genesis:23:17@01-genesis/23.tex.english: And Ephron’s field that was in Machpelah, which faces Mamre, the field and the cave that was in it and every tree that was in the field, that was in all of its border all around, was established

genesis:23:18@01-genesis/23.tex.original: לְאַבְרָהָם לְמִקְנָה לְעֵינֵי בְנֵי חֵת בְּכֹל בָּאֵי שַׁעַר עִירוֹ׃
genesis:23:18@01-genesis/23.tex.english: for Abraham as a purchase in the eyes of the children of Heth, among all who were coming to his city’s gate.

genesis:23:19@01-genesis/23.tex.original: וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן קָבַר אַבְרָהָם אֶת שָׂרָה אִשְׁתּוֹ אֶל מְעָרַת שְׂדֵה הַמַּכְפֵּלָה עַל פְּנֵי מַמְרֵא הִוא חֶבְרוֹן בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃
genesis:23:19@01-genesis/23.tex.english: And after that Abraham buried Sarah, his wife, at the cave of the field of Machpelah, facing Mamre—it is Hebron—in the land of Canaan.

genesis:23:20@01-genesis/23.tex.original: וַיָּקם הַשָּׂדֶה וְהַמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ לְאַבְרָהָם לַאֲחֻזַּת קָבֶר מֵאֵת בְּנֵי חֵת׃
genesis:23:20@01-genesis/23.tex.english: And the field and the cave that was in it were established for Abraham as a possession for a tomb from the children of Heth.

genesis:24:1@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ואברהם זקן בא בימים ויהוה ברך את אברהם בכל׃
genesis:24:1@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And Abraham was old, well along in days, and YHWH had blessed Abraham in everything.

genesis:24:2@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויאמר אברהם אל עבדו זקן ביתו המשל בכל אשר לו שים נא ידך תחת ירכי׃
genesis:24:2@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And Abraham said to his servant, the elder of his house, who was in charge of all that he had, “Place your hand under my thigh,

genesis:24:3@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ואשביעך ביהוה אלהי השמים ואלהי הארץ אשר לא תקח אשה לבני מבנות הכנעני אשר אנכי יושב בקרבו׃
genesis:24:3@01-genesis/24.tex.english: and I’ll have you swear by YHWH, God of the skies and God of the earth, that you won’t take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanite among whom I live,

genesis:24:4@01-genesis/24.tex.original: כי אל ארצי ואל מולדתי תלך ולקחת אשה לבני ליצחק׃
genesis:24:4@01-genesis/24.tex.english: but you’ll go to my land and my birthplace and take a wife for my son, for Isaac.”

genesis:24:5@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויאמר אליו העבד אולי לא תאבה האשה ללכת אחרי אל הארץ הזאת ההשב אשיב את בנך אל הארץ אשר יצאת משם׃
genesis:24:5@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And the servant said to him, “Maybe the woman won’t be willing to follow me to this land. Shall I take back your son to the land you came from?”

genesis:24:6@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויאמר אליו אברהם השמר לך פן תשיב את בני שמה׃
genesis:24:6@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And Abraham said to him, “Watch yourself, that you don’t take my son back there.

genesis:24:7@01-genesis/24.tex.original: יהוה אלהי השמים אשר לקחני מבית אבי ומארץ מולדתי ואשר דבר לי ואשר נשבע לי לאמר לזרעך אתן את הארץ הזאת הוא ישלח מלאכו לפניך ולקחת אשה לבני משם׃
genesis:24:7@01-genesis/24.tex.english: YHWH, God of the skies, who took me from my father’s house and from the land of my birth and who spoke to me and who swore to me, saying, ‘I’ll give this land to your seed,’ He’ll send His angel ahead of you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.

genesis:24:8@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ואם לא תאבה האשה ללכת אחריך ונקית משבעתי זאת רק את בני לא תשב שמה׃
genesis:24:8@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And if the woman won’t be willing to go after you, then you’ll be freed from this oath of mine. Only you are not to take my son back there.”

genesis:24:9@01-genesis/24.tex.original: וישם העבד את ידו תחת ירך אברהם אדניו וישבע לו על הדבר הזה׃
genesis:24:9@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And the servant placed his hand under his lord Abraham’s thigh and swore to him about this thing.

genesis:24:10@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויקח העבד עשרה גמלים מגמלי אדניו וילך וכל טוב אדניו בידו ויקם וילך אל ארם נהרים אל עיר נחור׃
genesis:24:10@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And the servant took ten camels of his lord’s camels and went, and all of his lord’s best things were in his hand. And he got up and went to Aram Naharaim, to the city of Nahor,

genesis:24:11@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויברך הגמלים מחוץ לעיר אל באר המים לעת ערב לעת צאת השאבת׃
genesis:24:11@01-genesis/24.tex.english: and he had the camels kneel outside the city at the water well at evening time, the time that the women went out to draw water.

genesis:24:12@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויאמר יהוה אלהי אדני אברהם הקרה נא לפני היום ועשה חסד עם אדני אברהם׃
genesis:24:12@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And he said, “YHWH, God of my lord Abraham, make something happen in front of me today and show kindness to my lord Abraham:

genesis:24:13@01-genesis/24.tex.original: הנה אנכי נצב על עין המים ובנות אנשי העיר יצאת לשאב מים׃
genesis:24:13@01-genesis/24.tex.english: Here I am, standing over the spring of water, and the daughters of the people of the city are going out to draw water.

genesis:24:14@01-genesis/24.tex.original: והיה הנער אשר אמר אליה הטי נא כדך ואשתה ואמרה שתה וגם גמליך אשקה אתה הכחת לעבדך ליצחק ובה אדע כי עשית חסד עם אדני׃
genesis:24:14@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And let it be that the girl to whom I’ll say, ‘Tip your jar so I may drink,’ and she’ll say, ‘Drink, and I’ll water your camels, too,’ she’ll be the one you’ve pointed out for your servant, for Isaac, and I’ll know by this that you’ve shown kindness to my lord.”

genesis:24:15@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויהי הוא טרם כלה לדבר והנה רבקה יצאת אשר ילדה לבתואל בן מלכה אשת נחור אחי אברהם וכדה על שכמה׃
genesis:24:15@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And he had not even finished speaking, and here was Rebekah—who was born to Bethuel son of Milcah, wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother—coming out, and her jar was on her shoulder.

genesis:24:16@01-genesis/24.tex.original: והנער טבת מראה מאד בתולה ואיש לא ידעה ותרד העינה ותמלא כדה ותעל׃
genesis:24:16@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And the girl was very good-looking, a virgin, and no man had known her. And she went down to the spring and filled her jar and went up.

genesis:24:17@01-genesis/24.tex.original: וירץ העבד לקראתה ויאמר הגמיאיני נא מעט מים מכדך׃
genesis:24:17@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And the servant ran toward her and said, “Give me a little water from your jar.”

genesis:24:18@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ותאמר שתה אדני ותמהר ותרד כדה על ידה ותשקהו׃
genesis:24:18@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And she said, “Drink, my lord,” and she hurried and lowered her jar on her arm and let him drink.

genesis:24:19@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ותכל להשקתו ותאמר גם לגמליך אשאב עד אם כלו לשתת׃
genesis:24:19@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And she finished letting him drink, and she said, “I’ll draw water for your camels, too, until they finish drinking.”

genesis:24:20@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ותמהר ותער כדה אל השקת ותרץ עוד אל הבאר לשאב ותשאב לכל גמליו׃
genesis:24:20@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And she hurried and emptied her jar into the trough and ran again to the well to draw water, and she drew water for all his camels.

genesis:24:21@01-genesis/24.tex.original: והאיש משתאה לה מחריש לדעת ההצליח יהוה דרכו אם לא׃
genesis:24:21@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And the man, astonished at her, was keeping quiet so as to know if YHWH had made his trip successful or not.

genesis:24:22@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויהי כאשר כלו הגמלים לשתות ויקח האיש נזם זהב בקע משקלו ושני צמידים על ידיה עשרה זהב משקלם׃
genesis:24:22@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And it was when the camels finished drinking: and the man took a gold ring—its weight was a beqa—and two bracelets for her arms—their weight was ten of gold.

genesis:24:23@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויאמר בת מי את הגידי נא לי היש בית אביך מקום לנו ללין׃
genesis:24:23@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And he said, “Tell me, whose daughter are you? Is there a place at your father’s house for us to spend the night?”

genesis:24:24@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ותאמר אליו בת בתואל אנכי בן מלכה אשר ילדה לנחור׃
genesis:24:24@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And she said to him, “I’m a daughter of Bethuel, Milcah’s son whom she bore to Nahor.”

genesis:24:25@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ותאמר אליו גם תבן גם מספוא רב עמנו גם מקום ללון׃
genesis:24:25@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And she said to him, “We also have plenty of both straw and fodder, also a place to spend the night.”

genesis:24:26@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויקד האיש וישתחו ליהוה׃
genesis:24:26@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And the man knelt and bowed to YHWH

genesis:24:27@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויאמר ברוך יהוה אלהי אדני אברהם אשר לא עזב חסדו ואמתו מעם אדני אנכי בדרך נחני יהוה בית אחי אדני׃
genesis:24:27@01-genesis/24.tex.english: and said, “Blessed is YHWH, God of my lord Abraham, whose kindness and faithfulness have not left my lord. I: YHWH has led me to the house of my lord’s brother.”

genesis:24:28@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ותרץ הנער ותגד לבית אמה כדברים האלה׃
genesis:24:28@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And the girl ran and told her mother’s household about these things.

genesis:24:29@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ולרבקה אח ושמו לבן וירץ לבן אל האיש החוצה אל העין׃
genesis:24:29@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban, and Laban ran outside to the man, at the spring.

genesis:24:30@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויהי כראת את הנזם ואת הצמדים על ידי אחתו וכשמעו את דברי רבקה אחתו לאמר כה דבר אלי האיש ויבא אל האיש והנה עמד על הגמלים על העין׃
genesis:24:30@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And it was when he saw the ring and the bracelets on his sister’s hands and when he heard his sister Rebekah’s words, saying, “The man spoke like this to me.” And he came to the man, and here he was standing by the camels at the spring.

genesis:24:31@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויאמר בוא ברוך יהוה למה תעמד בחוץ ואנכי פניתי הבית ומקום לגמלים׃
genesis:24:31@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And he said, “Come, blessed one of YHWH. Why do you stand outside when I’ve prepared the house and a place for the camels!”

genesis:24:32@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויבא האיש הביתה ויפתח הגמלים ויתן תבן ומספוא לגמלים ומים לרחץ רגליו ורגלי האנשים אשר אתו׃
genesis:24:32@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And the man came to the house and unloaded the camels and gave straw and fodder to the camels and water to wash his feet and the feet of the people who were with him.

genesis:24:33@01-genesis/24.tex.original: (ויישם) [ויושם] לפניו לאכל ויאמר לא אכל עד אם דברתי דברי ויאמר דבר׃
genesis:24:33@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And [bread] was set in front of him to eat. And he said, “I won’t eat until I’ve said what I have to say.” And he said, “Speak.”

genesis:24:34@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויאמר עבד אברהם אנכי׃
genesis:24:34@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And he said, “I am Abraham’s servant.

genesis:24:35@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויהוה ברך את אדני מאד ויגדל ויתן לו צאן ובקר וכסף וזהב ועבדם ושפחת וגמלים וחמרים׃
genesis:24:35@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And YHWH has blessed my lord very much, and he has become great. And He has given him a flock and oxen and silver and gold and male and female servants and camels and asses.

genesis:24:36@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ותלד שרה אשת אדני בן לאדני אחרי זקנתה ויתן לו את כל אשר לו׃
genesis:24:36@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And my lord’s wife Sarah gave birth to a son by my lord in her old age, and he has given him everything that he has.

genesis:24:37@01-genesis/24.tex.original: וישבעני אדני לאמר לא תקח אשה לבני מבנות הכנעני אשר אנכי ישב בארצו׃
genesis:24:37@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And my lord had me swear, saying, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanite in whose land I live,

genesis:24:38@01-genesis/24.tex.original: אם לא אל בית אבי תלך ואל משפחתי ולקחת אשה לבני׃
genesis:24:38@01-genesis/24.tex.english: but you shall go to my father’s house and to my family and take a wife for my son.’

genesis:24:39@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ואמר אל אדני אלי לא תלך האשה אחרי׃
genesis:24:39@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And I said to my lord, ‘Maybe the woman won’t follow me.’

genesis:24:40@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויאמר אלי יהוה אשר התהלכתי לפניו ישלח מלאכו אתך והצליח דרכך ולקחת אשה לבני ממשפחתי ומבית אבי׃
genesis:24:40@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And he said to me, ‘YHWH, before whom I have walked, will send His angel with you and make your trip successful, and you shall take a wife for my son from my family and from my father’s house.

genesis:24:41@01-genesis/24.tex.original: אז תנקה מאלתי כי תבוא אל משפחתי ואם לא יתנו לך והיית נקי מאלתי׃
genesis:24:41@01-genesis/24.tex.english: Then you’ll be freed from my oath: when you’ll come to my family, and if they won’t give her to you, then you’ll be free from my oath.’

genesis:24:42@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ואבא היום אל העין ואמר יהוה אלהי אדני אברהם אם ישך נא מצליח דרכי אשר אנכי הלך עליה׃
genesis:24:42@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And I came to the spring today and I said, ‘YHWH, God of my lord Abraham, if you’re making my trip on which I’m going successful,

genesis:24:43@01-genesis/24.tex.original: הנה אנכי נצב על עין המים והיה העלמה היצאת לשאב ואמרתי אליה השקיני נא מעט מים מכדך׃
genesis:24:43@01-genesis/24.tex.english: here I am, standing at the spring of water, and let it be that the young woman who goes to draw water and I say to her, “Let me drink a little water from your jar,”

genesis:24:44@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ואמרה אלי גם אתה שתה וגם לגמליך אשאב הוא האשה אשר הכיח יהוה לבן אדני׃
genesis:24:44@01-genesis/24.tex.english: and she says to me, “Both drink yourself and I’ll draw water for your camels, too,” she will be the woman whom YHWH has designated for my lord’s son.’

genesis:24:45@01-genesis/24.tex.original: אני טרם אכלה לדבר אל לבי והנה רבקה יצאת וכדה על שכמה ותרד העינה ותשאב ואמר אליה השקיני נא׃
genesis:24:45@01-genesis/24.tex.english: I hadn’t even finished speaking in my heart, and here was Rebekah coming out, and her jar was on her shoulder, and she went down to the spring and drew water. And I said to her, ‘Give me a drink.’

genesis:24:46@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ותמהר ותורד כדה מעליה ותאמר שתה וגם גמליך אשקה ואשת וגם הגמלים השקתה׃
genesis:24:46@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And she hurried and lowered her jar from on her and said, ‘Drink, and I’ll water your camels, too.’ And I drank, and she watered the camels, too.

genesis:24:47@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ואשאל אתה ואמר בת מי את ותאמר בת בתואל בן נחור אשר ילדה לו מלכה ואשם הנזם על אפה והצמידים על ידיה׃
genesis:24:47@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And I asked her and said, ‘Whose daughter are you?’ And she said, ‘The daughter of Bethuel, son of Nahor, whom Milcah bore for him.’ And I put the ring on her nose and the bracelets on her hands,

genesis:24:48@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ואקד ואשתחוה ליהוה ואברך את יהוה אלהי אדני אברהם אשר הנחני בדרך אמת לקחת את בת אחי אדני לבנו׃
genesis:24:48@01-genesis/24.tex.english: and I knelt and bowed to YHWH and blessed YHWH, my lord Abraham’s God, who had led me in a faithful way to take a daughter of my lord’s brother for his son.

genesis:24:49@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ועתה אם ישכם עשים חסד ואמת את אדני הגידו לי ואם לא הגידו לי ואפנה על ימין או על שמאל׃
genesis:24:49@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And now, if you’re exercising kindness and faithfulness with my lord, tell me; and if not, tell me; so I’ll turn to right or to left.”

genesis:24:50@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויען לבן ובתואל ויאמרו מיהוה יצא הדבר לא נוכל דבר אליך רע או טוב׃
genesis:24:50@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And Laban and Bethuel answered, and they said, “The thing has come from YHWH. We can’t speak bad or good to you.

genesis:24:51@01-genesis/24.tex.original: הנה רבקה לפניך קח ולך ותהי אשה לבן אדניך כאשר דבר יהוה׃
genesis:24:51@01-genesis/24.tex.english: Here is Rebekah before you. Take her and go, and let her be a wife to your lord’s son as YHWH has spoken.”

genesis:24:52@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויהי כאשר שמע עבד אברהם את דבריהם וישתחו ארצה ליהוה׃
genesis:24:52@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And it was, when Abraham’s servant heard their words, that he bowed to the ground to YHWH.

genesis:24:53@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויוצא העבד כלי כסף וכלי זהב ובגדים ויתן לרבקה ומגדנת נתן לאחיה ולאמה׃
genesis:24:53@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And the servant brought out silver articles and gold articles and garments and gave them to Rebekah and gave precious things to her brother and to her mother.

genesis:24:54@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויאכלו וישתו הוא והאנשים אשר עמו וילינו ויקומו בבקר ויאמר שלחני לאדני׃
genesis:24:54@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And they ate and drank, he and the people who were with him, and spent the night. And they got up in the morning, and he said, “Send me back to my lord.”

genesis:24:55@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויאמר אחיה ואמה תשב הנער אתנו ימים או עשור אחר תלך׃
genesis:24:55@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And her brother and her mother said, “Let the girl stay with us a few days—or ten. After that, she’ll go.”

genesis:24:56@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויאמר אלהם אל תאחרו אתי ויהוה הצליח דרכי שלחוני ואלכה לאדני׃
genesis:24:56@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And he said to them, “Don’t hold me back, since YHWH has made my trip successful. Send me away, so I may go to my lord.”

genesis:24:57@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויאמרו נקרא לנער ונשאלה את פיה׃
genesis:24:57@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And they said, “We’ll call the girl and ask her from her own mouth.”

genesis:24:58@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויקראו לרבקה ויאמרו אליה התלכי עם האיש הזה ותאמר אלך׃
genesis:24:58@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And they called Re-bekah and said to her, “Will you go with this man?” And she said, “I’ll go.”

genesis:24:59@01-genesis/24.tex.original: וישלחו את רבקה אחתם ואת מנקתה ואת עבד אברהם ואת אנשיו׃
genesis:24:59@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And they sent their sister Rebekah and her nurse and Abraham’s servant and his people.

genesis:24:60@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויברכו את רבקה ויאמרו לה אחתנו את היי לאלפי רבבה ויירש זרעך את שער שנאיו׃
genesis:24:60@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And they blessed Rebekah and said to her, “You’re our sister. Become thousands of ten-thousands. And may your seed possess the gate of those who hate him.”

genesis:24:61@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ותקם רבקה ונערתיה ותרכבנה על הגמלים ותלכנה אחרי האיש ויקח העבד את רבקה וילך׃
genesis:24:61@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And Rebekah and her maids got up and rode on the camels and followed the man, and the servant took Rebekah and went.

genesis:24:62@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויצחק בא מבוא באר לחי ראי והוא יושב בארץ הנגב׃
genesis:24:62@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And Isaac was coming from the area of the well Lahai-roi, and he was living in the territory of the Negeb,

genesis:24:63@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויצא יצחק לשוח בשדה לפנות ערב וישא עיניו וירא והנה גמלים באים׃
genesis:24:63@01-genesis/24.tex.english: and Isaac went to meditate in a field toward evening, and he raised his eyes and saw, and here were camels coming.

genesis:24:64@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ותשא רבקה את עיניה ותרא את יצחק ותפל מעל הגמל׃
genesis:24:64@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And Rebekah raised her eyes and saw Isaac, and she fell from the camel.

genesis:24:65@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ותאמר אל העבד מי האיש הלזה ההלך בשדה לקראתנו ויאמר העבד הוא אדני ותקח הצעיף ותתכס׃
genesis:24:65@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And she said to the servant, “Who is that man who’s walking in the field toward us?” And the servant said, “He’s my lord.” And she took a veil and covered herself.

genesis:24:66@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויספר העבד ליצחק את כל הדברים אשר עשה׃
genesis:24:66@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And the servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.

genesis:24:67@01-genesis/24.tex.original: ויבאה יצחק האהלה שרה אמו ויקח את רבקה ותהי לו לאשה ויאהבה וינחם יצחק אחרי אמו׃
genesis:24:67@01-genesis/24.tex.english: And Isaac brought her to his mother Sarah’s tent. And he took Rebekah, and she became his wife, and he loved her. And Isaac was consoled after his mother.

genesis:25:1@01-genesis/25.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYSP ABRHM WYQX AVH WVMH QJWRH׃</bdo>
genesis:25:1@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And Abraham went on and took a wife, and her name was Keturah,

genesis:25:2@01-genesis/25.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WTLD LW AT ZMRN WAT YQVN WAT MDN WAT MDYN WAT YVBQ WAT VWX׃</bdo>
genesis:25:2@01-genesis/25.tex.english: and she gave birth to Zimran and Jokshan and Medan and Midian and Ishbak and Shuah for him.

genesis:25:3@01-genesis/25.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYQVN YLD AT VBA WAT DDN WBNY DDN HYW AVWRM WLJWVM WLAMYM׃</bdo>
genesis:25:3@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And Jokshan fathered Sheba and Dedan. And the children of Dedan were Ashurim and Letushim and Leummim.

genesis:25:4@01-genesis/25.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WBNY MDYN ]YPH W]PR WXNK WABYD] WALD]H KL ALH BNY QJWRH׃</bdo>
genesis:25:4@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And the children of Midian: Ephah and Epher and Hanoch and Abida and Eldaah. All these were children of Keturah.

genesis:25:5@01-genesis/25.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-rje hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="RJE">WYTN ABRHM AT KL AVR LW LYCXQ׃</bdo>
genesis:25:5@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And Abraham gave everything that he had to Isaac.

genesis:25:6@01-genesis/25.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-rje hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="RJE">WLBNY HPYLGVYM AVR LABRHM NTN ABRHM MTNT WYVLXM M]L YCXQ BNW B]WDNW XY QDMH AL ARC QDM׃</bdo>
genesis:25:6@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And Abraham gave gifts to the children of the concubines that Abraham had, and he sent them away from Isaac, his son, while he was still living:^[What's going on with that colon? I know it's not in the original Hebrew but what's that colon doing there? While "he" was still living? Which he?] east, to the land of the East.

genesis:25:7@01-genesis/25.tex.original: וְאֵלֶּה יְמֵי שְׁנֵי חַיֵּי אַבְרָהָם אֲשֶׁר חָי מְאַת שָׁנָה וְשִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים׃
genesis:25:7@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And these are the days of the years of Abraham’s life that he lived: a hundred years and seventy years and five years.

genesis:25:8@01-genesis/25.tex.original: וַיִּגְוַע וימת אברהם בשיבה טובה זקן ושבע וַיֵּאָסֶף אֶל עַמָּיו׃
genesis:25:8@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And he expired. And Abraham died at a good old age, old and full, and was gathered to his people.

genesis:25:9@01-genesis/25.tex.original: וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ יִצְחָק וְיִשְׁמָעֵאל בָּנָיו אֶל מְעָרַת הַמַּכְפֵּלָה אֶל שְׂדֵה עֶפְרֹן בֶּן צֹחַר הַחִתִּי אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי מַמְרֵא׃
genesis:25:9@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, buried him at the cave of Machpelah at the field of Ephron, son of Zohar, the Hittite, facing Mamre,

genesis:25:10@01-genesis/25.tex.original: הַשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר קָנָה אַבְרָהָם מֵאֵת בְּנֵי חֵת שָׁמָּה קֻבַּר אַבְרָהָם וְשָׂרָה אִשְׁתּוֹ׃
genesis:25:10@01-genesis/25.tex.english: the field that Abraham bought from the children of Heth. Abraham was buried there—and Sarah, his wife.

genesis:25:11@01-genesis/25.tex.original: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי מוֹת אַבְרָהָם וַיְבָרֶךְ אֱלֹהִים אֶת יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ וישב יצחק עם באר לחי ראי׃
genesis:25:11@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And it was after Abraham’s death, and God blessed Isaac, his son. And Isaac lived at the well Lahai-roi.

genesis:25:12@01-genesis/25.tex.original: ואלה תלדת ישמעאל בן אברהם אשר ילדה הגר המצרית שפחת שרה לאברהם׃
genesis:25:12@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And these are the records of Ishmael, son of Abraham, to whom Hagar, the Egyptian, Sarah’s maid, gave birth for Abraham:

genesis:25:13@01-genesis/25.tex.original: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׁמָעֵאל בִּשְׁמֹתָם לְתוֹלְדֹתָם בְּכֹר יִשְׁמָעֵאל נְבָיֹת וְקֵדָר וְאַדְבְּאֵל וּמִבְשָׂם׃
genesis:25:13@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And these are the names of Ishmael’s sons, by their names, according to their records: Ishmael’s firstborn was Nebaioth, and Kedar and Adbeel and Mibsam

genesis:25:14@01-genesis/25.tex.original: וּמִשְׁמָע וְדוּמָה וּמַשָּׂא׃
genesis:25:14@01-genesis/25.tex.english: and Mishma and Dumah and Massa,

genesis:25:15@01-genesis/25.tex.original: חֲדַד וְתֵימָא יְטוּר נָפִישׁ וָקֵדְמָה׃
genesis:25:15@01-genesis/25.tex.english: Hadar and Tema, Jetur, Naphish and Kedmah.

genesis:25:16@01-genesis/25.tex.original: אֵלֶּה הֵם בְּנֵי יִשְׁמָעֵאל וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמֹתָם בְּחַצְרֵיהֶם וּבְטִירֹתָם שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר נְשִׂיאִם לְאֻמֹּתָם׃
genesis:25:16@01-genesis/25.tex.english: These are they, Ishmael’s sons, and these are their names in their settlements and in their encampments, twelve chieftains by their clans.

genesis:25:17@01-genesis/25.tex.original: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁנֵי חַיֵּי יִשְׁמָעֵאל מְאַת שָׁנָה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה וְשֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וַיִּגְוַע וַיָּמת וַיֵּאָסֶף אֶל עַמָּיו׃
genesis:25:17@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And these are the years of Ishmael’s life: a hundred years and thirty years and seven years. And he expired and died and was gathered to his people.

genesis:25:18@01-genesis/25.tex.original: וַיִּשְׁכְּנוּ מֵחֲוִילָה עַד שׁוּר אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי מִצְרַיִם בֹּאֲכָה אַשּׁוּרָה עַל פְּנֵי כל אֶחָיו נָפָל׃
genesis:25:18@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And they tented from Havilah to Shur, which faces Egypt, as you come toward Asshur. He fell facing all of his brothers.

genesis:25:19@01-genesis/25.tex.original: ואלה תולדת יצחק בן אברהם אברהם הוליד את יצחק׃
genesis:25:19@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And these are the records of Isaac, son of Abraham: Abraham had fathered Isaac.

genesis:25:20@01-genesis/25.tex.original: וַיְהִי יִצְחָק בֶּן אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה בְּקַחְתּוֹ אֶת רִבְקָה בַּת בְּתוּאֵל הָאֲרַמִּי מִפַּדַּן אֲרָם אֲחוֹת לָבָן הָאֲרַמִּי לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃
genesis:25:20@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, daughter of Bethuel, the Aramean, from Paddan Aram, sister of Laban, the Aramean, to him as a wife.

genesis:25:21@01-genesis/25.tex.original: ויעתר יצחק ליהוה לנכח אשתו כי עקרה הוא ויעתר לו יהוה ותהר רבקה אשתו׃
genesis:25:21@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And Isaac prayed to YHWH for his wife because she was infertile, and YHWH was prevailed upon by him, and his wife Rebekah became pregnant.

genesis:25:22@01-genesis/25.tex.original: ויתרצצו הבנים בקרבה ותאמר אם כן למה זה אנכי ותלך לדרש את יהוה׃
genesis:25:22@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And the children struggled inside her, and she said, “If it’s like this, why do I exist?” And she went to inquire of YHWH.

genesis:25:23@01-genesis/25.tex.original: ויאמר יהוה לה שני (גיים) [גוים] בבטנך ושני לאמים ממעיך יפרדו ולאם מלאם יאמץ ורב יעבד צעיר׃
genesis:25:23@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And YHWH said to her, Two nations are in your womb, And two peoples will be dispersed from your insides, And one people will be mightier than the other people, And the older the younger will serve.

genesis:25:24@01-genesis/25.tex.original: וימלאו ימיה ללדת והנה תומם בבטנה׃
genesis:25:24@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And her days to give birth were completed, and here were twins in her womb.

genesis:25:25@01-genesis/25.tex.original: ויצא הראשון אדמוני כלו כאדרת שער ויקראו שמו עשו׃
genesis:25:25@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And the first came out all ruddy, like a hairy robe, and they called his name Esau.

genesis:25:26@01-genesis/25.tex.original: ואחרי כן יצא אחיו וידו אחזת בעקב עשו ויקרא שמו יעקב ויצחק בן ששים שנה בלדת אתם׃
genesis:25:26@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And after that his brother came out, and his hand was holding Esau’s heel, and he called his name Jacob. And Isaac was sixty years old at their birth.

genesis:25:27@01-genesis/25.tex.original: ויגדלו הנערים ויהי עשו איש ידע ציד איש שדה ויעקב איש תם ישב אהלים׃
genesis:25:27@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And the boys grew up, and Esau was a man who knew hunting, a man of the field, and Jacob was a simple man, living in tents.

genesis:25:28@01-genesis/25.tex.original: ויאהב יצחק את עשו כי ציד בפיו ורבקה אהבת את יעקב׃
genesis:25:28@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And Isaac loved Esau because he put game meat in his mouth, and Rebekah loved Jacob.

genesis:25:29@01-genesis/25.tex.original: ויזד יעקב נזיד ויבא עשו מן השדה והוא עיף׃
genesis:25:29@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And Jacob made a stew, and Esau came from the field, and he was exhausted.

genesis:25:30@01-genesis/25.tex.original: ויאמר עשו אל יעקב הלעיטני נא מן האדם האדם הזה כי עיף אנכי על כן קרא שמו אדום׃
genesis:25:30@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And Esau said to Jacob, “Will you feed me some of the red stuff, this red stuff, because I’m exhausted.” (On account of this he called his name “Edom.”)

genesis:25:31@01-genesis/25.tex.original: ויאמר יעקב מכרה כיום את בכרתך לי׃
genesis:25:31@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And Jacob said, “Sell your birthright to me, today.”

genesis:25:32@01-genesis/25.tex.original: ויאמר עשו הנה אנכי הולך למות ולמה זה לי בכרה׃
genesis:25:32@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And Esau said, “Here I’m going to die, and what use is this, that I have a birthright?”

genesis:25:33@01-genesis/25.tex.original: ויאמר יעקב השבעה לי כיום וישבע לו וימכר את בכרתו ליעקב׃
genesis:25:33@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And Jacob said, “Swear to me, today.” And he swore to him and sold his birthright to Jacob.

genesis:25:34@01-genesis/25.tex.original: ויעקב נתן לעשו לחם ונזיד עדשים ויאכל וישת ויקם וילך ויבז עשו את הבכרה׃
genesis:25:34@01-genesis/25.tex.english: And Jacob gave bread and lentil stew to Esau. And he ate and drank and got up and went. And Esau disdained the birthright.

genesis:26:1@01-genesis/26.tex.original: ויהי רעב בארץ מלבד הרעב הראשון אשר היה בימי אברהם וילך יצחק אל אבימלך מלך פלשתים גררה׃
genesis:26:1@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And there was a famine in the land (other than the first famine, which was in Abraham’s days), and Isaac went to Abimelek, king of the Philistines, at Gerar.

genesis:26:2@01-genesis/26.tex.original: וירא אליו יהוה ויאמר אל תרד מצרימה שכן בארץ אשר אמר אליך׃
genesis:26:2@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And YHWH appeared to him and said, “Don’t go down to Egypt. Reside in the land that I say to you.

genesis:26:3@01-genesis/26.tex.original: גור בארץ הזאת ואהיה עמך ואברכך כי לך ולזרעך אתן את כל הארצת האל והקמתי את השבעה אשר נשבעתי לאברהם אביך׃
genesis:26:3@01-genesis/26.tex.english: Stay on in this land, and I’ll be with you and bless you, for I’ll give all these lands to you and your seed, and I’ll uphold the oath that I swore to Abraham your father,

genesis:26:4@01-genesis/26.tex.original: והרביתי את זרעך ככוכבי השמים ונתתי לזרעך את כל הארצת האל והתברכו בזרעך כל גויי הארץ׃
genesis:26:4@01-genesis/26.tex.english: and I’ll multiply your seed like the stars of the skies and give to your seed all these lands, and all the nations of the earth will be blessed through your seed

genesis:26:5@01-genesis/26.tex.original: עקב אשר שמע אברהם בקלי וישמר משמרתי מצותי חקותי ותורתי׃
genesis:26:5@01-genesis/26.tex.english: because Abraham listened to my voice and kept my watch, my commandments, my laws, and my instructions.”

genesis:26:6@01-genesis/26.tex.original: וישב יצחק בגרר׃
genesis:26:6@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And so Isaac lived in Gerar.

genesis:26:7@01-genesis/26.tex.original: וישאלו אנשי המקום לאשתו ויאמר אחתי הוא כי ירא לאמר אשתי פן יהרגני אנשי המקום על רבקה כי טובת מראה הוא׃
genesis:26:7@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And the people of the place asked about his wife, and he said, “She’s my sister,” because he was afraid to say, “My wife,” or else “the people of the place will kill me for Rebekah, because she’s good-looking.”

genesis:26:8@01-genesis/26.tex.original: ויהי כי ארכו לו שם הימים וישקף אבימלך מלך פלשתים בעד החלון וירא והנה יצחק מצחק את רבקה אשתו׃
genesis:26:8@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And it was when his days extended there: and Abimelek, king of the Philistines, gazed through the window, and he saw: and here was Isaac “fooling around” with Rebekah his wife!

genesis:26:9@01-genesis/26.tex.original: ויקרא אבימלך ליצחק ויאמר אך הנה אשתך הוא ואיך אמרת אחתי הוא ויאמר אליו יצחק כי אמרתי פן אמות עליה׃
genesis:26:9@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And Abimelek called Isaac and said, “But, here, she’s your wife! And how could you say, ‘She’s my sister’?” And Isaac said to him, “Because I said, ‘Or else I’ll die over her.’”

genesis:26:10@01-genesis/26.tex.original: ויאמר אבימלך מה זאת עשית לנו כמעט שכב אחד העם את אשתך והבאת עלינו אשם׃
genesis:26:10@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And Abimelek said, “What is this you’ve done to us? One of the people nearly could have lain with your wife, and you would have brought guilt on us.”

genesis:26:11@01-genesis/26.tex.original: ויצו אבימלך את כל העם לאמר הנגע באיש הזה ובאשתו מות יומת׃
genesis:26:11@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And Abimelek commanded all the people saying, “He who touches this man or his wife will be put to death!”

genesis:26:12@01-genesis/26.tex.original: ויזרע יצחק בארץ ההוא וימצא בשנה ההוא מאה שערים ויברכהו יהוה׃
genesis:26:12@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And Isaac planted seed in that land, and he harvested a hundredfold in that year. And YHWH blessed him,

genesis:26:13@01-genesis/26.tex.original: ויגדל האיש וילך הלוך וגדל עד כי גדל מאד׃
genesis:26:13@01-genesis/26.tex.english: and the man became great, and he went on getting greater until he was very great

genesis:26:14@01-genesis/26.tex.original: ויהי לו מקנה צאן ומקנה בקר ועבדה רבה ויקנאו אתו פלשתים׃
genesis:26:14@01-genesis/26.tex.english: and had livestock of flocks and livestock of herds and a large number of servants. And the Philistines envied him.

genesis:26:15@01-genesis/26.tex.original: וכל הבארת אשר חפרו עבדי אביו בימי אברהם אביו סתמום פלשתים וימלאום עפר׃
genesis:26:15@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And the Philistines stopped up all the wells that his father’s servants had dug in his father Abraham’s days, and they filled them with dirt.

genesis:26:16@01-genesis/26.tex.original: ויאמר אבימלך אל יצחק לך מעמנו כי עצמת ממנו מאד׃
genesis:26:16@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And Abimelek said to Isaac, “Go from among us, because you’ve become much mightier than we are.”

genesis:26:17@01-genesis/26.tex.original: וילך משם יצחק ויחן בנחל גרר וישב שם׃
genesis:26:17@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And Isaac went from there and camped in the wadi of Gerar and lived there.

genesis:26:18@01-genesis/26.tex.original: וישב יצחק ויחפר את בארת המים אשר חפרו בימי אברהם אביו ויסתמום פלשתים אחרי מות אברהם ויקרא להן שמות כשמת אשר קרא להן אביו׃
genesis:26:18@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And Isaac went back and dug the water wells that they had dug in the days of his father Abraham and that the Philistines had stopped up after Abraham’s death, and he called them by names, like the names that his father had called them.

genesis:26:19@01-genesis/26.tex.original: ויחפרו עבדי יצחק בנחל וימצאו שם באר מים חיים׃
genesis:26:19@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And Isaac’s servants dug in the wadi and found a well of fresh water there.

genesis:26:20@01-genesis/26.tex.original: ויריבו רעי גרר עם רעי יצחק לאמר לנו המים ויקרא שם הבאר עשק כי התעשקו עמו׃
genesis:26:20@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And the shepherds of Gerar quarreled with Isaac’s shepherds, saying, “The water is ours.” And he called the name of the well Esek because they tangled with him.

genesis:26:21@01-genesis/26.tex.original: ויחפרו באר אחרת ויריבו גם עליה ויקרא שמה שטנה׃
genesis:26:21@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And they dug another well, and they quarreled over it also, and he called its name Sitnah.

genesis:26:22@01-genesis/26.tex.original: ויעתק משם ויחפר באר אחרת ולא רבו עליה ויקרא שמה רחבות ויאמר כי עתה הרחיב יהוה לנו ופרינו בארץ׃
genesis:26:22@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And he moved on from there and dug another well, and they did not quarrel over it, and he called its name Rehovot and said, “Because now YHWH has widened for us, and we’ve been fruitful in the land.”

genesis:26:23@01-genesis/26.tex.original: ויעל משם באר שבע׃
genesis:26:23@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And he went up from there to Beer-sheba.

genesis:26:24@01-genesis/26.tex.original: וירא אליו יהוה בלילה ההוא ויאמר אנכי אלהי אברהם אביך אל תירא כי אתך אנכי וברכתיך והרביתי את זרעך בעבור אברהם עבדי׃
genesis:26:24@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And YHWH appeared to him that night and said, “I’m your father Abraham’s God. Don’t be afraid, because I’m with you, and I’ll bless you and multiply your seed on account of Abraham, my servant.”

genesis:26:25@01-genesis/26.tex.original: ויבן שם מזבח ויקרא בשם יהוה ויט שם אהלו ויכרו שם עבדי יצחק באר׃
genesis:26:25@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And he built an altar there and invoked the name YHWH. And he pitched his tent there, and Isaac’s servants dug a well there.

genesis:26:26@01-genesis/26.tex.original: ואבימלך הלך אליו מגרר ואחזת מרעהו ופיכל שר צבאו׃
genesis:26:26@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And Abimelek and Ahuzat, his companion, and Phicol, the commander of his army, went to him from Gerar.

genesis:26:27@01-genesis/26.tex.original: ויאמר אלהם יצחק מדוע באתם אלי ואתם שנאתם אתי ותשלחוני מאתכם׃
genesis:26:27@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And Isaac said to them, “Why have you come to me, since you hated me and sent me away from you?”

genesis:26:28@01-genesis/26.tex.original: ויאמרו ראו ראינו כי היה יהוה עמך ונאמר תהי נא אלה בינותינו בינינו ובינך ונכרתה ברית עמך׃
genesis:26:28@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And they said, “We’ve seen that YHWH has been with you; and we say, ‘Let there be an oath between us, between us and you, and let us make a covenant with you

genesis:26:29@01-genesis/26.tex.original: אם תעשה עמנו רעה כאשר לא נגענוך וכאשר עשינו עמך רק טוב ונשלחך בשלום אתה עתה ברוך יהוה׃
genesis:26:29@01-genesis/26.tex.english: that you won’t do bad toward us as we haven’t touched you and as we’ve done only good toward you and sent you away in peace. You are now blessed by YHWH.’”

genesis:26:30@01-genesis/26.tex.original: ויעש להם משתה ויאכלו וישתו׃
genesis:26:30@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And he made a feast for them, and they ate and drank.

genesis:26:31@01-genesis/26.tex.original: וישכימו בבקר וישבעו איש לאחיו וישלחם יצחק וילכו מאתו בשלום׃
genesis:26:31@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And they got up early in the morning and swore, each man to his brother, and Isaac sent them away, and they went from him in peace.

genesis:26:32@01-genesis/26.tex.original: ויהי ביום ההוא ויבאו עבדי יצחק ויגדו לו על אדות הבאר אשר חפרו ויאמרו לו מצאנו מים׃
genesis:26:32@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And it was in that day and Isaac’s servants came and told him about the well that they had dug and said to him, “We found water.”

genesis:26:33@01-genesis/26.tex.original: ויקרא אתה שבעה על כן שם העיר באר שבע עד היום הזה׃
genesis:26:33@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And he called it Seven. On account of this the name of the city is Beer-sheba to this day.

genesis:26:34@01-genesis/26.tex.original: וַיְהִי עֵשָׂו בֶּן אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וַיִּקַּח אִשָּׁה אֶת יְהוּדִית בַּת בְּאֵרִי הַחִתִּי וְאֶת בָּשְׂמַת בַּת אֵילֹן הַחִתִּי׃
genesis:26:34@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And Esau was forty years old, and he took a wife: Judith, daughter of Beeri, the Hittite, and Basemath, daughter of Elon, the Hittite.

genesis:26:35@01-genesis/26.tex.original: וַתִּהְיֶיןָ מֹרַת רוּחַ לְיִצְחָק וּלְרִבְקָה׃
genesis:26:35@01-genesis/26.tex.english: And they were a bitterness of spirit to Isaac and to Re-bekah.

genesis:27:1@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ויהי כי זקן יצחק ותכהין עיניו מראת ויקרא את עשו בנו הגדל ויאמר אליו בני ויאמר אליו הנני׃
genesis:27:1@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And it was when Isaac was old and his eyes were too dim for seeing: and he called Esau, his older son, and said to him, “My son.” And he said to him, “I’m here.”

genesis:27:2@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ויאמר הנה נא זקנתי לא ידעתי יום מותי׃
genesis:27:2@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And he said, “Here, I’ve become old. I don’t know the day of my death.

genesis:27:3@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ועתה שא נא כליך תליך וקשתך וצא השדה וצודה לי (צידה) [ציד]׃
genesis:27:3@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And now, take up your implements: your quiver and your bow, and go out to the field and hunt me some game

genesis:27:4@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ועשה לי מטעמים כאשר אהבתי והביאה לי ואכלה בעבור תברכך נפשי בטרם אמות׃
genesis:27:4@01-genesis/27.tex.english: and make me the kind of delicacies that I love and bring them to me and let me eat, so my soul will bless you before I die.”

genesis:27:5@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ורבקה שמעת בדבר יצחק אל עשו בנו וילך עשו השדה לצוד ציד להביא׃
genesis:27:5@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And Rebekah was listening as Isaac was speaking to Esau, his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt game to bring.

genesis:27:6@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ורבקה אמרה אל יעקב בנה לאמר הנה שמעתי את אביך מדבר אל עשו אחיך לאמר׃
genesis:27:6@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And Rebekah said to Jacob, her son, saying, “Here I’ve heard your father speaking to Esau, your brother, saying,

genesis:27:7@01-genesis/27.tex.original: הביאה לי ציד ועשה לי מטעמים ואכלה ואברככה לפני יהוה לפני מותי׃
genesis:27:7@01-genesis/27.tex.english: ‘Bring me game and make me delicacies so I may eat, and I’ll bless you in the presence of YHWH before my death.’

genesis:27:8@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ועתה בני שמע בקלי לאשר אני מצוה אתך׃
genesis:27:8@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And now, my son, listen to my voice, to what I’m commanding you.

genesis:27:9@01-genesis/27.tex.original: לך נא אל הצאן וקח לי משם שני גדיי עזים טבים ואעשה אתם מטעמים לאביך כאשר אהב׃
genesis:27:9@01-genesis/27.tex.english: Go to the flock and take two good goat kids for me from there, and I’ll make them the kind of delicacies that your father loves.

genesis:27:10@01-genesis/27.tex.original: והבאת לאביך ואכל בעבר אשר יברכך לפני מותו׃
genesis:27:10@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And bring them to your father, and he’ll eat, so he’ll bless you before his death.”

genesis:27:11@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ויאמר יעקב אל רבקה אמו הן עשו אחי איש שער ואנכי איש חלק׃
genesis:27:11@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And Jacob said to Rebekah, his mother, “Here, Esau, my brother, is a hairy man and I’m a smooth man.

genesis:27:12@01-genesis/27.tex.original: אולי ימשני אבי והייתי בעיניו כמתעתע והבאתי עלי קללה ולא ברכה׃
genesis:27:12@01-genesis/27.tex.english: Maybe my father will feel me, and I’ll be like a trickster in his eyes, and I’ll bring a curse on me and not a blessing.”

genesis:27:13@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ותאמר לו אמו עלי קללתך בני אך שמע בקלי ולך קח לי׃
genesis:27:13@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And his mother said to him, “Let your curse be on me, my son; just listen to my voice and go take them for me.”

genesis:27:14@01-genesis/27.tex.original: וילך ויקח ויבא לאמו ותעש אמו מטעמים כאשר אהב אביו׃
genesis:27:14@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And he went and took and brought them to his mother, and his mother made the kind of delicacies that his father loved.

genesis:27:15@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ותקח רבקה את בגדי עשו בנה הגדל החמדת אשר אתה בבית ותלבש את יעקב בנה הקטן׃
genesis:27:15@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And Rebekah took the finest clothes of Esau, her older son, that were with her in the house and put them on Jacob, her younger son,

genesis:27:16@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ואת ערת גדיי העזים הלבישה על ידיו ועל חלקת צואריו׃
genesis:27:16@01-genesis/27.tex.english: and put the skins of the goat kids on his hands and on the smooth part of his neck.

genesis:27:17@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ותתן את המטעמים ואת הלחם אשר עשתה ביד יעקב בנה׃
genesis:27:17@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And she put the delicacies and the bread that she’d made in the hand of Jacob, her son.

genesis:27:18@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ויבא אל אביו ויאמר אבי ויאמר הנני מי אתה בני׃
genesis:27:18@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And he came to his father. And he said, “My father.” And he said, “I’m here. Who are you, my son?”

genesis:27:19@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ויאמר יעקב אל אביו אנכי עשו בכרך עשיתי כאשר דברת אלי קום נא שבה ואכלה מצידי בעבור תברכני נפשך׃
genesis:27:19@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And Jacob said to his father, “I’m Esau, your firstborn. I did as you spoke to me. Get up, sit, and eat some of my game so your soul will bless me.”

genesis:27:20@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ויאמר יצחק אל בנו מה זה מהרת למצא בני ויאמר כי הקרה יהוה אלהיך לפני׃
genesis:27:20@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And Isaac said to his son, “What’s this? You were quick to find it, my son.” And he said, “Because YHWH your God made it happen for me.”

genesis:27:21@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ויאמר יצחק אל יעקב גשה נא ואמשך בני האתה זה בני עשו אם לא׃
genesis:27:21@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And Isaac said to Jacob, “Come over, and I’ll feel you, my son: is this you, my son Esau, or not?”

genesis:27:22@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ויגש יעקב אל יצחק אביו וימשהו ויאמר הקל קול יעקב והידים ידי עשו׃
genesis:27:22@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And Jacob came over to Isaac, his father, and he felt him. And he said, “The voice is the voice of Jacob, and the hands are the hands of Esau.”

genesis:27:23@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ולא הכירו כי היו ידיו כידי עשו אחיו שערת ויברכהו׃
genesis:27:23@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And he did not recognize him because his hands were hairy like the hands of Esau, his brother, and he blessed him.

genesis:27:24@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ויאמר אתה זה בני עשו ויאמר אני׃
genesis:27:24@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And he said, “Is this you, my son Esau?” And he said, “I am.”

genesis:27:25@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ויאמר הגשה לי ואכלה מציד בני למען תברכך נפשי ויגש לו ויאכל ויבא לו יין וישת׃
genesis:27:25@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And he said, “Bring it over to me and let me eat some of my son’s game so that my soul will bless you. And he brought it over to him, and he ate; and he brought him wine, and he drank.

genesis:27:26@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ויאמר אליו יצחק אביו גשה נא ושקה לי בני׃
genesis:27:26@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And Isaac, his father, said to him, “Come over and kiss me, my son.”

genesis:27:27@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ויגש וישק לו וירח את ריח בגדיו ויברכהו ויאמר ראה ריח בני כריח שדה אשר ברכו יהוה׃
genesis:27:27@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And he came over and kissed him, and he smelled the aroma of his clothes and blessed him and said, “See, my son’s aroma is like the aroma of a field that YHWH has blessed.

genesis:27:28@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ויתן לך האלהים מטל השמים ומשמני הארץ ורב דגן ותירש׃
genesis:27:28@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And may God give you from the dew of the skies and from the fat of the earth and much grain and wine.

genesis:27:29@01-genesis/27.tex.original: יעבדוך עמים (וישתחו) [וישתחוו] לך לאמים הוה גביר לאחיך וישתחוו לך בני אמך ארריך ארור ומברכיך ברוך׃
genesis:27:29@01-genesis/27.tex.english: May peoples serve you and nations bow to you. Be your brothers’ superior, and may your mother’s sons bow to you. May those who curse you be cursed and those who bless you be blessed.”

genesis:27:30@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ויהי כאשר כלה יצחק לברך את יעקב ויהי אך יצא יצא יעקב מאת פני יצחק אביו ועשו אחיו בא מצידו׃
genesis:27:30@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And it was as Isaac finished blessing Jacob, and it was: Jacob had just gone out from the presence of Isaac, his father!—and Esau, his brother, came from his hunting.

genesis:27:31@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ויעש גם הוא מטעמים ויבא לאביו ויאמר לאביו יקם אבי ויאכל מציד בנו בעבר תברכני נפשך׃
genesis:27:31@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And he, too, had made delicacies and brought them to his father. And he said to his father, “Let my father get up and eat some of his son’s game so you yourself will bless me.”

genesis:27:32@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ויאמר לו יצחק אביו מי אתה ויאמר אני בנך בכרך עשו׃
genesis:27:32@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And Isaac, his father, said to him, “Who are you?” And he said, “I’m your son, your firstborn, Esau.”

genesis:27:33@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ויחרד יצחק חרדה גדלה עד מאד ויאמר מי אפוא הוא הצד ציד ויבא לי ואכל מכל בטרם תבוא ואברכהו גם ברוך יהיה׃
genesis:27:33@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And Isaac trembled—a very big trembling. And he said, “Who then is the one who hunted game and brought it to me, and I ate some of it all before you came, and I blessed him? He will in fact be blessed.”

genesis:27:34@01-genesis/27.tex.original: כשמע עשו את דברי אביו ויצעק צעקה גדלה ומרה עד מאד ויאמר לאביו ברכני גם אני אבי׃
genesis:27:34@01-genesis/27.tex.english: When Esau heard his father’s words he cried—a very big and bitter cry. And he said to his father, “Bless me, also me, my father.”

genesis:27:35@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ויאמר בא אחיך במרמה ויקח ברכתך׃
genesis:27:35@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And he said, “Your brother came with deception, and he took your blessing.”

genesis:27:36@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ויאמר הכי קרא שמו יעקב ויעקבני זה פעמים את בכרתי לקח והנה עתה לקח ברכתי ויאמר הלא אצלת לי ברכה׃
genesis:27:36@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And he said, “Was his name really called Jacob! And he’s usurped me two times now. He’s taken my birthright, and, here, now he’s taken my blessing.” And he said, “Haven’t you saved a blessing for me?”

genesis:27:37@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ויען יצחק ויאמר לעשו הן גביר שמתיו לך ואת כל אחיו נתתי לו לעבדים ודגן ותירש סמכתיו ולכה אפוא מה אעשה בני׃
genesis:27:37@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And Isaac answered, and he said to Esau, “Here I’ve made him your superior, and I’ve given all his brothers as servants, and I’ve endowed him with grain and wine. And for you: where, what, will I do, my son?”

genesis:27:38@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ויאמר עשו אל אביו הברכה אחת הוא לך אבי ברכני גם אני אבי וישא עשו קלו ויבך׃
genesis:27:38@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And Esau said to his father, “Is it one blessing that you have, my father? Bless me, also me, my father.” And Esau raised his voice and wept.

genesis:27:39@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ויען יצחק אביו ויאמר אליו הנה משמני הארץ יהיה מושבך ומטל השמים מעל׃
genesis:27:39@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And Isaac, his father, answered, and he said to him, “Here, away from the fat of the earth will be your home, and from the dew of the skies from above.

genesis:27:40@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ועל חרבך תחיה ואת אחיך תעבד והיה כאשר תריד ופרקת עלו מעל צוארך׃
genesis:27:40@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And you’ll live by your sword. And you’ll serve your brother. And it will be that when you get dominion you’ll break his yoke from your neck.”

genesis:27:41@01-genesis/27.tex.original: וישטם עשו את יעקב על הברכה אשר ברכו אביו ויאמר עשו בלבו יקרבו ימי אבל אבי ואהרגה את יעקב אחי׃
genesis:27:41@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And Esau despised Jacob because of the blessing with which his father blessed him, and Esau said in his heart, “The days of mourning for my father will be soon, and then I’ll kill Jacob, my brother.”

genesis:27:42@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ויגד לרבקה את דברי עשו בנה הגדל ותשלח ותקרא ליעקב בנה הקטן ותאמר אליו הנה עשו אחיך מתנחם לך להרגך׃
genesis:27:42@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And the words of Esau, her older son, were told to Rebekah, and she sent and called to Jacob, her younger son, and said to him, “Here, Esau, your brother, consoles himself regarding you with the idea of killing you.

genesis:27:43@01-genesis/27.tex.original: ועתה בני שמע בקלי וקום ברח לך אל לבן אחי חרנה׃
genesis:27:43@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And now, my son, listen to my voice and get up, flee to Laban, my brother, at Haran

genesis:27:44@01-genesis/27.tex.original: וישבת עמו ימים אחדים עד אשר תשוב חמת אחיך׃
genesis:27:44@01-genesis/27.tex.english: and live with him for a number of days until your brother’s fury will turn back,

genesis:27:45@01-genesis/27.tex.original: עד שוב אף אחיך ממך ושכח את אשר עשית לו ושלחתי ולקחתיך משם למה אשכל גם שניכם יום אחד׃
genesis:27:45@01-genesis/27.tex.english: until your brother’s anger turns back from you and he forgets what you did to him. And I’ll send and take you from there. Why should I be bereaved of the two of you as well in one day?”

genesis:27:46@01-genesis/27.tex.original: וַתֹּאמֶר רִבְקָה אֶל יִצְחָק קַצְתִּי בְחַיַּי מִפְּנֵי בְּנוֹת חֵת אִם לֹקֵחַ יַעֲקֹב אִשָּׁה מִבְּנוֹת חֵת כָּאֵלֶּה מִבְּנוֹת הָאָרֶץ לָמָּה לִּי חַיִּים׃
genesis:27:46@01-genesis/27.tex.english: And Rebekah said to Isaac, “I’m disgusted with my life because of the daughters of Heth! If Jacob takes a wife from the daughters of Heth like these daughters of the land, why do I have a life!”

genesis:28:1@01-genesis/28.tex.original: וַיִּקְרָא יִצְחָק אֶל יַעֲקֹב וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתוֹ וַיְצַוֵּהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ לֹא תִקַּח אִשָּׁה מִבְּנוֹת כְּנָעַן׃
genesis:28:1@01-genesis/28.tex.english: And Isaac called Jacob, and he blessed him and commanded him, and he said to him, “You shall not take a wife from the daughters of Canaan.

genesis:28:2@01-genesis/28.tex.original: קוּם לֵךְ פַּדֶּנָה אֲרָם בֵּיתָה בְתוּאֵל אֲבִי אִמֶּךָ וְקַח לְךָ מִשָּׁם אִשָּׁה מִבְּנוֹת לָבָן אֲחִי אִמֶּךָ׃
genesis:28:2@01-genesis/28.tex.english: Get up. Go to Paddan Aram, to the house of Bethuel, your mother’s father, and take a wife from there, from the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.

genesis:28:3@01-genesis/28.tex.original: וְאֵל שַׁדַּי יְבָרֵךְ אֹתְךָ וְיַפְרְךָ וְיַרְבֶּךָ וְהָיִיתָ לִקְהַל עַמִּים׃
genesis:28:3@01-genesis/28.tex.english: And may El Shadday bless you and make you fruitful and multiply you, so you’ll become a community of peoples,

genesis:28:4@01-genesis/28.tex.original: וְיִתֶּן לְךָ אֶת בִּרְכַּת אַבְרָהָם לְךָ וּלְזַרְעֲךָ אִתָּךְ לְרִשְׁתְּךָ אֶת אֶרֶץ מְגֻרֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן אֱלֹהִים לְאַבְרָהָם׃
genesis:28:4@01-genesis/28.tex.english: and may He give you the blessing of Abraham, to you and to your seed with you, for you to possess the land of your residences, which God gave to Abraham.”

genesis:28:5@01-genesis/28.tex.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח יִצְחָק אֶת יַעֲקֹב וַיֵּלֶךְ פַּדֶּנָה אֲרָם אֶל לָבָן בֶּן בְּתוּאֵל הָאֲרַמִּי אֲחִי רִבְקָה אֵם יַעֲקֹב וְעֵשָׂו׃
genesis:28:5@01-genesis/28.tex.english: And Isaac sent Jacob, and he went to Paddan Aram, to Laban, son of Bethuel, the Aramean, brother of Rebekah, mother of Jacob and Esau.

genesis:28:6@01-genesis/28.tex.original: וַיַּרְא עֵשָׂו כִּי בֵרַךְ יִצְחָק אֶת יַעֲקֹב וְשִׁלַּח אֹתוֹ פַּדֶּנָה אֲרָם לָקַחַת לוֹ מִשָּׁם אִשָּׁה בְּבָרְכוֹ אֹתוֹ וַיְצַו עָלָיו לֵאמֹר לֹא תִקַּח אִשָּׁה מִבְּנוֹת כְּנָעַן׃
genesis:28:6@01-genesis/28.tex.english: And Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him to Paddan Aram to take a wife for himself from there when he blessed him, and he had commanded him, saying, “You shall not take a wife from the daughters of Canaan,”

genesis:28:7@01-genesis/28.tex.original: וַיִּשְׁמַע יַעֲקֹב אֶל אָבִיו וְאֶל אִמּוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ פַּדֶּנָה אֲרָם׃
genesis:28:7@01-genesis/28.tex.english: and Jacob had listened to his father and to his mother and had gone to Paddan Aram.

genesis:28:8@01-genesis/28.tex.original: וַיַּרְא עֵשָׂו כִּי רָעוֹת בְּנוֹת כְּנָעַן בְּעֵינֵי יִצְחָק אָבִיו׃
genesis:28:8@01-genesis/28.tex.english: And Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan were bad in his father Isaac’s eyes.

genesis:28:9@01-genesis/28.tex.original: וַיֵּלֶךְ עֵשָׂו אֶל יִשְׁמָעֵאל וַיִּקַּח אֶת מָחֲלַת בַּת יִשְׁמָעֵאל בֶּן אַבְרָהָם אֲחוֹת נְבָיוֹת עַל נָשָׁיו לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃
genesis:28:9@01-genesis/28.tex.english: And Esau went to Ishmael and took Mahalath, daughter of Ishmael, son of Abraham, sister of Nebaioth, in addition to his wives as a wife for him.

genesis:28:10@01-genesis/28.tex.original: ויצא יעקב מבאר שבע וילך חרנה׃
genesis:28:10@01-genesis/28.tex.english: And Jacob left Beer-sheba and went to Haran.

genesis:28:11@01-genesis/28.tex.original: ויפגע במקום וילן שם כי בא HVMV WYQX MABNY HMQWM WYVM MRAVTYW WYVKB BMQWM HHWA׃
genesis:28:11@01-genesis/28.tex.english: And he happened upon a place and stayed the night there because the sun was setting. And he took from the stones of the place and set it as his headrest and lay down in that place.

genesis:28:12@01-genesis/28.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYXLM WHNH SLM MCB ARCH WRAVW MGY] HVMYMH WHNH MLAKY ALHYM ]LYM WYRDYM BW׃</bdo>
genesis:28:12@01-genesis/28.tex.english: And he dreamed. And here was a ladder, set up on the earth, and its top reaching to the skies. And here were angels of God, going up and going down by it.

genesis:28:13@01-genesis/28.tex.original: והנה יהוה נצב עליו ויאמר אני יהוה אלהי אברהם אביך ואלהי יצחק הארץ אשר אתה שכב עליה לך אתננה ולזרעך׃
genesis:28:13@01-genesis/28.tex.english: And here was YHWH standing over him, and He said, “I am YHWH, your father Abraham’s God and Isaac’s God. The land on which you’re lying: I’ll give it to you and to your seed.

genesis:28:14@01-genesis/28.tex.original: והיה זרעך כעפר הארץ ופרצת ימה וקדמה וצפנה ונגבה ונברכו בך כל משפחת האדמה ובזרעך׃
genesis:28:14@01-genesis/28.tex.english: And your seed will be like the dust of the earth, and you’ll expand to the west and east and north and south, and all the families on the earth will be blessed through you and through your seed.

genesis:28:15@01-genesis/28.tex.original: והנה אנכי עמך ושמרתיך בכל אשר תלך והשבתיך אל האדמה הזאת כי לא אעזבך עד אשר אם עשיתי את אשר דברתי לך׃
genesis:28:15@01-genesis/28.tex.english: And here I am with you, and I’ll watch over you everywhere that you’ll go, and I’ll bring you back to this land, for I won’t leave you until I’ve done what I’ve spoken to you.”

genesis:28:16@01-genesis/28.tex.original: וייקץ יעקב משנתו ויאמר אכן יש יהוה במקום הזה ואנכי לא ידעתי׃
genesis:28:16@01-genesis/28.tex.english: And Jacob woke from his sleep and said, “YHWH is actually in this place, and I didn’t know!”

genesis:28:17@01-genesis/28.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYYRA WYAMR MH NWRA HMQWM HZH AYN ZH KY AM BYT ALHYM WZH V]R HVMYM׃</bdo>
genesis:28:17@01-genesis/28.tex.english: And he was afraid, and he said, “How awesome this place is! This is none other than God’s house, and this is the gate of the skies!”

genesis:28:18@01-genesis/28.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYVKM Y]QB BBQR WYQX AT HABN AVR VM MRAVTYW WYVM ATH MCBH WYCQ VMN ]L RAVH׃</bdo>
genesis:28:18@01-genesis/28.tex.english: And Jacob got up early in the morning and took the stone that he had set as his headrest and set it as a pillar and poured oil on its top.

genesis:28:19@01-genesis/28.tex.original: ויקרא את שם המקום ההוא בית אל ואולם לוז שם העיר לראשנה׃
genesis:28:19@01-genesis/28.tex.english: And he called that place’s name Beth-El, though in fact Luz was the name of the city at first.

genesis:28:20@01-genesis/28.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYDR Y]QB NDR LAMR AM YHYH ALHYM ]MDY WVMRNY BDRK HZH AVR ANKY HWLK WNTN LY LXM LAKL WBGD LLBV׃</bdo>
genesis:28:20@01-genesis/28.tex.english: And Jacob made a vow, saying, “If God will be with me and watch over me in this way that I’m going and give me bread to eat and clothing to wear,

genesis:28:21@01-genesis/28.tex.original: WVBTY BVLWM AL BYT ABY WHYH יהוה LY LALHYM׃
genesis:28:21@01-genesis/28.tex.english: and I come back in peace to my father’s house, then YHWH will become my God,

genesis:28:22@01-genesis/28.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WHABN HZAT AVR VMTY MCBH YHYH BYT ALHYM WKL AVR TTN LY ]VR A]VRNW LK׃</bdo>
genesis:28:22@01-genesis/28.tex.english: and this stone that I set as a pillar will be God’s house, and everything that you’ll give me I’ll tithe to you.”

genesis:29:1@01-genesis/29.tex.original: וישא יעקב רגליו וילך ארצה בני קדם׃
genesis:29:1@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And Jacob lifted his feet and went to the land of the people of the east.

genesis:29:2@01-genesis/29.tex.original: וירא והנה באר בשדה והנה שם שלשה עדרי צאן רבצים עליה כי מן הבאר ההוא ישקו העדרים והאבן גדלה על פי הבאר׃
genesis:29:2@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And he looked, and here was a well in the field, and here were three flocks of sheep lying by it, because they watered the flocks from that well, and the stone on the mouth of the well was big,
