genesis:29:3@01-genesis/29.tex.original: ונאספו שמה כל העדרים וגללו את האבן מעל פי הבאר והשקו את הצאן והשיבו את האבן על פי הבאר למקמה׃
genesis:29:3@01-genesis/29.tex.english: and all the flocks would be gathered there, and they would roll the stone from the mouth of the well and would water the sheep and then would put the stone back in its place on the mouth of the well.

genesis:29:4@01-genesis/29.tex.original: ויאמר להם יעקב אחי מאין אתם ויאמרו מחרן אנחנו׃
genesis:29:4@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And Jacob said to them, “My brothers, where are you from?” And they said, “We’re from Haran.”

genesis:29:5@01-genesis/29.tex.original: ויאמר להם הידעתם את לבן בן נחור ויאמרו ידענו׃
genesis:29:5@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And he said to them, “Do you know Laban, son of Nahor?” And they said, “We know.”

genesis:29:6@01-genesis/29.tex.original: ויאמר להם השלום לו ויאמרו שלום והנה רחל בתו באה עם הצאן׃
genesis:29:6@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And he said to them, “Is he well?” And they said, “Well. And here’s Rachel, his daughter, coming with the sheep.”

genesis:29:7@01-genesis/29.tex.original: ויאמר הן עוד היום גדול לא עת האסף המקנה השקו הצאן ולכו רעו׃
genesis:29:7@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And he said, “Here, it will still be daytime for a long time, not the time for gathering the livestock. Water the sheep and go, pasture them.”

genesis:29:8@01-genesis/29.tex.original: ויאמרו לא נוכל עד אשר יאספו כל העדרים וגללו את האבן מעל פי הבאר והשקינו הצאן׃
genesis:29:8@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And they said, “We can’t until all the flocks will be gathered and they’ll roll the stone from the mouth of the well, and then we’ll water the sheep.”

genesis:29:9@01-genesis/29.tex.original: עודנו מדבר עמם ורחל באה עם הצאן אשר לאביה כי רעה הוא׃
genesis:29:9@01-genesis/29.tex.english: He was still speaking with them, and Rachel came with her father’s sheep, because she was a shepherdess.

genesis:29:10@01-genesis/29.tex.original: ויהי כאשר ראה יעקב את רחל בת לבן אחי אמו ואת צאן לבן אחי אמו ויגש יעקב ויגל את האבן מעל פי הבאר וישק את צאן לבן אחי אמו׃
genesis:29:10@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And it was when Jacob saw Rachel, daughter of Laban, his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban, his mother’s brother: and he went over and rolled the stone from the mouth of the well and watered the sheep of Laban, his mother’s brother.

genesis:29:11@01-genesis/29.tex.original: וישק יעקב לרחל וישא את קלו ויבך׃
genesis:29:11@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And Jacob kissed Rachel and raised his voice and wept.

genesis:29:12@01-genesis/29.tex.original: ויגד יעקב לרחל כי אחי אביה הוא וכי בן רבקה הוא ותרץ ותגד לאביה׃
genesis:29:12@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s kin and that he was Rebekah’s son, and she ran and told her father.

genesis:29:13@01-genesis/29.tex.original: ויהי כשמע לבן את שמע יעקב בן אחתו וירץ לקראתו ויחבק לו וינשק לו ויביאהו אל ביתו ויספר ללבן את כל הדברים האלה׃
genesis:29:13@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And it was, when Laban heard the news of Jacob, his sister’s son, that he ran to him and embraced him and kissed him and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.

genesis:29:14@01-genesis/29.tex.original: ויאמר לו לבן אך עצמי ובשרי אתה וישב עמו חדש ימים׃
genesis:29:14@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And Laban said to him, “You are indeed my bone and my flesh.” And he stayed with him a month.

genesis:29:15@01-genesis/29.tex.original: ויאמר לבן ליעקב הכי אחי אתה ועבדתני חנם הגידה לי מה משכרתך׃
genesis:29:15@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And Laban said to Jacob, “Is it right because you’re my brother that you should work for me for free? Tell me what your pay should be.”

genesis:29:16@01-genesis/29.tex.original: וללבן שתי בנות שם הגדלה לאה ושם הקטנה רחל׃
genesis:29:16@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And Laban had two daughters. The older one’s name was Leah, and the younger one’s name was Rachel.

genesis:29:17@01-genesis/29.tex.original: ועיני לאה רכות ורחל היתה יפת תאר ויפת מראה׃
genesis:29:17@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And Leah’s eyes were tender, and Rachel had an attractive figure and was beautiful.

genesis:29:18@01-genesis/29.tex.original: ויאהב יעקב את רחל ויאמר אעבדך שבע שנים ברחל בתך הקטנה׃
genesis:29:18@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And Jacob loved Rachel. And he said, “I’ll work for you seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.”

genesis:29:19@01-genesis/29.tex.original: ויאמר לבן טוב תתי אתה לך מתתי אתה לאיש אחר שבה עמדי׃
genesis:29:19@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And Laban said, “Better for me to give her to you than for me to give her to another man. Live with me.”

genesis:29:20@01-genesis/29.tex.original: ויעבד יעקב ברחל שבע שנים ויהיו בעיניו כימים אחדים באהבתו אתה׃
genesis:29:20@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And Jacob worked seven years for Rachel, and they were like a few days in his eyes because of his loving her.

genesis:29:21@01-genesis/29.tex.original: ויאמר יעקב אל לבן הבה את אשתי כי מלאו ימי ואבואה אליה׃
genesis:29:21@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And Jacob said to Laban, “Give me my wife, because my days have been completed, and let me come to her.”

genesis:29:22@01-genesis/29.tex.original: ויאסף לבן את כל אנשי המקום ויעש משתה׃
genesis:29:22@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And Laban gathered all the people of the place and made a feast.

genesis:29:23@01-genesis/29.tex.original: ויהי בערב ויקח את לאה בתו ויבא אתה אליו ויבא אליה׃
genesis:29:23@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And it was in the evening, and he took Leah, his daughter, and brought her to him. And he came to her.

genesis:29:24@01-genesis/29.tex.original: ויתן לבן לה את זלפה שפחתו ללאה בתו שפחה׃
genesis:29:24@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And Laban gave her his maid Zilpah—to Leah, his daughter, as a maid.

genesis:29:25@01-genesis/29.tex.original: ויהי בבקר והנה הוא לאה ויאמר אל לבן מה זאת עשית לי הלא ברחל עבדתי עמך ולמה רמיתני׃
genesis:29:25@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And it was in the morning, and here she was: Leah! And he said to Laban, “What is this you’ve done to me? Didn’t I work with you for Rachel? And why have you deceived me?”

genesis:29:26@01-genesis/29.tex.original: ויאמר לבן לא יעשה כן במקומנו לתת הצעירה לפני הבכירה׃
genesis:29:26@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And Laban said, “It’s not done like that in our place, to give the younger one before the firstborn.

genesis:29:27@01-genesis/29.tex.original: מלא שבע זאת ונתנה לך גם את זאת בעבדה אשר תעבד עמדי עוד שבע שנים אחרות׃
genesis:29:27@01-genesis/29.tex.english: Complete this week, and this one will be given to you as well—for the work that you’ll do with me: another seven years.”

genesis:29:28@01-genesis/29.tex.original: ויעש יעקב כן וימלא שבע זאת ויתן לו את רחל בתו לו לאשה׃
genesis:29:28@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And Jacob did so; and he completed this week, and he gave him Rachel, his daughter, for a wife.

genesis:29:29@01-genesis/29.tex.original: ויתן לבן לרחל בתו את בלהה שפחתו לה לשפחה׃
genesis:29:29@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And Laban gave his maid Bilhah to Rachel, his daughter—to her as a maid.

genesis:29:30@01-genesis/29.tex.original: ויבא גם אל רחל ויאהב גם את רחל מלאה ויעבד עמו עוד שבע שנים אחרות׃
genesis:29:30@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And he also came to Rachel. And he also loved Rachel more than Leah. And he worked with him another seven years.

genesis:29:31@01-genesis/29.tex.original: וירא יהוה כי שנואה לאה ויפתח את רחמה ורחל עקרה׃
genesis:29:31@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And YHWH saw that Leah was hated, and He opened her womb, and Rachel was infertile.

genesis:29:32@01-genesis/29.tex.original: ותהר לאה ותלד בן ותקרא שמו ראובן כי אמרה כי ראה יהוה בעניי כי עתה יאהבני אישי׃
genesis:29:32@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And Leah became pregnant and gave birth to a son and called his name Reuben because she said, “Because YHWH looked at my suffering, so that now my man will love me.”

genesis:29:33@01-genesis/29.tex.original: ותהר עוד ותלד בן ותאמר כי שמע יהוה כי שנואה אנכי ויתן לי גם את זה ותקרא שמו שמעון׃
genesis:29:33@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And she became pregnant again and gave birth to a son and said, “Because YHWH listened because I was hated and gave me this one, too.” And she called his name Simeon.

genesis:29:34@01-genesis/29.tex.original: ותהר עוד ותלד בן ותאמר עתה הפעם ילוה אישי אלי כי ילדתי לו שלשה בנים על כן קרא שמו לוי׃
genesis:29:34@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And she became pregnant again and gave birth to a son, and she said, “Now, this time my man will become bound to me because I’ve given birth to three sons for him.” On account of this his name was called Levi.

genesis:29:35@01-genesis/29.tex.original: ותהר עוד ותלד בן ותאמר הפעם אודה את יהוה על כן קראה שמו יהודה ותעמד מלדת׃
genesis:29:35@01-genesis/29.tex.english: And she became pregnant again and gave birth to a son and said, “This time I’ll praise YHWH.” On account of this she called his name Judah. And she stopped giving birth.

genesis:30:1@01-genesis/30.tex.original: ותרא רחל כי לא ילדה ליעקב WTQNA RXL BAXTH WTAMR AL Y]QB HBH LY BNYM WAM AYN MTH ANKY׃
genesis:30:1@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And Rachel saw that she had not given birth for Jacob, and Rachel was jealous of her sister, and she said to Jacob, “Give me children. And if not I’m dying!”

genesis:30:2@01-genesis/30.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-je hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="JE">WYXR AP Y]QB BRXL WYAMR HTXT ALHYM ANKY AVR MN] MMK PRY BJN׃</bdo>
genesis:30:2@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And Jacob’s anger flared at Rachel, and he said, “Am I in place of God, who has held back the fruit of the womb from you?!”

genesis:30:3@01-genesis/30.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-je hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="JE">WTAMR HNH AMTY BLHH BA ALYH WTLD ]L BRKY WABNH GM ANKY MMNH׃</bdo>
genesis:30:3@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And she said, “Here’s my maid, Bilhah. Come to her, and she’ll give birth on my knees, and I too will get a child through her.”

genesis:30:4@01-genesis/30.tex.original: ותתן לו את בלהה שפחתה לאשה WYBA ALYH Y]QB׃
genesis:30:4@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And she gave him Bilhah, her maid, as a wife, and Jacob came to her.

genesis:30:5@01-genesis/30.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-je hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="JE">WTHR BLHH WTLD LY]QB BN׃</bdo>
genesis:30:5@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And Bilhah became pregnant and gave birth to a son for Jacob.

genesis:30:6@01-genesis/30.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-je hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="JE">WTAMR RXL DNNY ALHYM WGM VM] BQLY WYTN LY BN ]L KN QRAH VMW DN׃</bdo>
genesis:30:6@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And Rachel said, “God has judged me and heard my prayer as well and has given me a son.” On account of this she called his name Dan.

genesis:30:7@01-genesis/30.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-je hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="JE">WTHR ]WD WTLD BLHH VPXT RXL BN VNY LY]QB׃</bdo>
genesis:30:7@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And Bilhah, Rachel’s maid, became pregnant again and gave birth to a second son for Jacob.

genesis:30:8@01-genesis/30.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-je hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="JE">WTAMR RXL NPTWLY ALHYM NPTLTY ]M AXTY GM YKLTY WTQRA VMW NPTLY׃</bdo>
genesis:30:8@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And Rachel said, “I’ve had Godlike struggles with my sister. I’ve also prevailed.” And she called his name Naphtali.

genesis:30:9@01-genesis/30.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-je hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="JE">WTRA LAH KY ]MDH MLDT WTQX AT ZLPH VPXTH WTTN ATH LY]QB LAVH׃</bdo>
genesis:30:9@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And Leah saw that she had stopped giving birth, and she took Zilpah, her maid, and gave her to Jacob as a wife.

genesis:30:10@01-genesis/30.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-je hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="JE">WTLD ZLPH VPXT LAH LY]QB BN׃</bdo>
genesis:30:10@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And Zilpah, Leah’s maid, gave birth to a son for Jacob.

genesis:30:11@01-genesis/30.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-je hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="JE">WTAMR LAH (BGD) [BA GD] WTQRA AT VMW GD׃</bdo>
genesis:30:11@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And Leah said, “With fortune!” and called his name Gad.

genesis:30:12@01-genesis/30.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-je hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="JE">WTLD ZLPH VPXT LAH BN VNY LY]QB׃</bdo>
genesis:30:12@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And Zilpah, Leah’s maid, gave birth to a second son for Jacob.

genesis:30:13@01-genesis/30.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-je hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="JE">WTAMR LAH BAVRY KY AVRWNY BNWT WTQRA AT VMW AVR׃</bdo>
genesis:30:13@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And Leah said, “With my happiness!—because daughters will wish me happiness,” and called his name Asher.

genesis:30:14@01-genesis/30.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-je hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="JE">WYLK RAWBN BYMY QCYR XJYM WYMCA DWDAYM BVDH WYBA ATM AL LAH AMW WTAMR RXL AL LAH TNY NA LY MDWDAY BNK׃</bdo>
genesis:30:14@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And in the days of wheat harvest Reuben went and found mandrakes in the field and brought them to Leah, his mother. And Rachel said to Leah, “Give me some of your son’s mandrakes.”

genesis:30:15@01-genesis/30.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-je hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="JE">WTAMR LH HM]J QXTK AT AYVY WLQXT GM AT DWDAY BNY WTAMR RXL LKN YVKB ]MK HLYLH TXT DWDAY BNK׃</bdo>
genesis:30:15@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And she said to her, “Is your taking my man a small thing? And you’re taking my son’s mandrakes, too?!” And Rachel said, “Then let him lie with you tonight in return for your son’s mandrakes.”

genesis:30:16@01-genesis/30.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-je hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="JE">WYBA Y]QB MN HVDH B]RB WTCA LAH LQRATW WTAMR ALY TBWA KY VKR VKRTYK BDWDAY BNY WYVKB ]MH BLYLH HWA׃</bdo>
genesis:30:16@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And Jacob came from the field in the evening, and Leah went out to him and said, “You are to come to me, because I’ve hired you with my son’s mandrakes.” And he lay with her that night.

genesis:30:17@01-genesis/30.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYVM] ALHYM AL LAH WTHR WTLD LY]QB BN XMYVY׃</bdo>
genesis:30:17@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And God listened to Leah, and she became pregnant and gave birth to a fifth son for Jacob.

genesis:30:18@01-genesis/30.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-je hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="JE">WTAMR LAH NTN ALHYM VKRY AVR NTTY VPXTY LAYVY WTQRA VMW YVVKR׃</bdo>
genesis:30:18@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And Leah said, “God has given my hire because I gave my maid to my man,” and she called his name Issachar.

genesis:30:19@01-genesis/30.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-je hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="JE">WTHR ]WD LAH WTLD BN VVY LY]QB׃</bdo>
genesis:30:19@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And Leah became pregnant again and gave birth to a sixth son for Jacob.

genesis:30:20@01-genesis/30.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-je hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="JE">WTAMR LAH ZBDNY ALHYM ATY ZBD JWB HP]M YZBLNY AYVY KY YLDTY LW VVH BNYM WTQRA AT VMW ZBLWN׃</bdo>
genesis:30:20@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And Leah said, “God has given me a good gift. This time my man will value me highly, because I’ve given birth to six sons for him,” and she called his name Zebulun.

genesis:30:21@01-genesis/30.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-je hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="JE">WAXR YLDH BT WTQRA AT VMH DYNH׃</bdo>
genesis:30:21@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And after that she gave birth to a daughter and called her name Dinah.

genesis:30:22@01-genesis/30.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYZKR ALHYM AT RXL WYVM] ALYH ALHYM WYPTX AT RXMH׃</bdo>
genesis:30:22@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And God remembered Rachel, and God listened to her and opened her womb,

genesis:30:23@01-genesis/30.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-je hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="JE">WTHR WTLD BN WTAMR ASP ALHYM AT XRPTY׃</bdo>
genesis:30:23@01-genesis/30.tex.english: and she became pregnant and gave birth to a son. And she said, “God has taken away my humiliation”

genesis:30:24@01-genesis/30.tex.original: WTQRA AT VMW YWSP LAMR יסף יהוה לי בן אחר׃
genesis:30:24@01-genesis/30.tex.english: and called his name Joseph, saying, “May YHWH add another son to me.”

genesis:30:25@01-genesis/30.tex.original: ויהי כאשר ילדה רחל את יוסף ויאמר יעקב אל לבן שלחני ואלכה אל מקומי ולארצי׃
genesis:30:25@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And it was when Rachel had given birth to Joseph: and Jacob said to Laban, “Send me away so I may go to my place and my land.

genesis:30:26@01-genesis/30.tex.original: תנה את נשי ואת ילדי אשר עבדתי אתך בהן ואלכה כי אתה ידעת את עבדתי אשר עבדתיך׃
genesis:30:26@01-genesis/30.tex.english: Give me my wives and my children for whom I’ve worked for you and let me go; because you know my work that I’ve done for you.”

genesis:30:27@01-genesis/30.tex.original: ויאמר אליו לבן אם נא מצאתי חן בעיניך נחשתי ויברכני יהוה בגללך׃
genesis:30:27@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And Laban said to him, “If I’ve found favor in your eyes, I’ve divined that YHWH has blessed me because of you,”

genesis:30:28@01-genesis/30.tex.original: ויאמר נקבה שכרך עלי ואתנה׃
genesis:30:28@01-genesis/30.tex.english: and he said, “Designate your pay for me, and I’ll give it.”

genesis:30:29@01-genesis/30.tex.original: ויאמר אליו אתה ידעת את אשר עבדתיך ואת אשר היה מקנך אתי׃
genesis:30:29@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And he said to him, “You know how I’ve worked for you and how your cattle have become with me,

genesis:30:30@01-genesis/30.tex.original: כי מעט אשר היה לך לפני ויפרץ לרב ויברך יהוה אתך לרגלי ועתה מתי אעשה גם אנכי לביתי׃
genesis:30:30@01-genesis/30.tex.english: that a little that you had before me expanded into a lot, and YHWH blessed you wherever I set foot. And now, when shall I also take care of my house?”

genesis:30:31@01-genesis/30.tex.original: ויאמר מה אתן לך ויאמר יעקב לא תתן לי מאומה אם תעשה לי הדבר הזה אשובה ארעה צאנך אשמר׃
genesis:30:31@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And he said, “What shall I give you?” And Jacob said, “You won’t give me anything—if you’ll do this thing for me: Let me go back; I’ll tend and watch over your flock.

genesis:30:32@01-genesis/30.tex.original: אעבר בכל צאנך היום הסר משם כל שה נקד וטלוא וכל שה חום בכשבים וטלוא ונקד בעזים והיה שכרי׃
genesis:30:32@01-genesis/30.tex.english: I’ll pass among all your flock today removing from there every speckled and spotted lamb and every brown lamb among the sheep and every spotted and speckled one among the goats—and that will be my pay.

genesis:30:33@01-genesis/30.tex.original: וענתה בי צדקתי ביום מחר כי תבוא על שכרי לפניך כל אשר איננו נקד וטלוא בעזים וחום בכשבים גנוב הוא אתי׃
genesis:30:33@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And my virtue will answer for me in a future day: when you’ll come upon my pay, it will be in front of you. Any one that isn’t speckled and spotted among the goats and brown among the sheep, it’s stolen with me.”

genesis:30:34@01-genesis/30.tex.original: ויאמר לבן הן לו יהי כדברך׃
genesis:30:34@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And Laban said, “Here, let it be according to your word.”

genesis:30:35@01-genesis/30.tex.original: ויסר ביום ההוא את התישים העקדים והטלאים ואת כל העזים הנקדות והטלאת כל אשר לבן בו וכל חום בכשבים ויתן ביד בניו׃
genesis:30:35@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And in that day he removed the he-goats that were streaked and spotted and the she-goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had white in it, and every brown one among the sheep, and set them in his sons’ hand

genesis:30:36@01-genesis/30.tex.original: וישם דרך שלשת ימים בינו ובין יעקב ויעקב רעה את צאן לבן הנותרת׃
genesis:30:36@01-genesis/30.tex.english: and put three days’ distance between him and Jacob. And Jacob was tending Laban’s remaining sheep.

genesis:30:37@01-genesis/30.tex.original: ויקח לו יעקב מקל לבנה לח ולוז וערמון ויפצל בהן פצלות לבנות מחשף הלבן אשר על המקלות׃
genesis:30:37@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And Jacob took a rod of fresh poplar and one of almond tree and one of plane tree, and he peeled white stripes in them, exposing the white that was on the rods.

genesis:30:38@01-genesis/30.tex.original: ויצג את המקלות אשר פצל ברהטים בשקתות המים אשר תבאן הצאן לשתות לנכח הצאן ויחמנה בבאן לשתות׃
genesis:30:38@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And he set up the rods that he had peeled in the channels in the watering troughs at which the flock came to drink, facing the flock. And they copulated when they came to drink.

genesis:30:39@01-genesis/30.tex.original: ויחמו הצאן אל המקלות ותלדן הצאן עקדים נקדים וטלאים׃
genesis:30:39@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And the flock mated at the rods, and the flock gave birth to streaked, speckled, and spotted ones.

genesis:30:40@01-genesis/30.tex.original: והכשבים הפריד יעקב ויתן פני הצאן אל עקד וכל חום בצאן לבן וישת לו עדרים לבדו ולא שתם על צאן לבן׃
genesis:30:40@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And Jacob separated the sheep and had the flock face the streaked and every brown one among Laban’s flock, and he set his own droves apart and did not set them by Laban’s flock.

genesis:30:41@01-genesis/30.tex.original: והיה בכל יחם הצאן המקשרות ושם יעקב את המקלות לעיני הצאן ברהטים ליחמנה במקלות׃
genesis:30:41@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And it was that whenever the fittest sheep would copulate Jacob would put the rods in the channels before the sheep’s eyes so that they would copulate by the rods,

genesis:30:42@01-genesis/30.tex.original: ובהעטיף הצאן לא ישים והיה העטפים ללבן והקשרים ליעקב׃
genesis:30:42@01-genesis/30.tex.english: and when the sheep were feebler he would not put them, so the feeble ones became Laban’s and the fitter ones became Jacob’s.

genesis:30:43@01-genesis/30.tex.original: ויפרץ האיש מאד מאד ויהי לו צאן רבות ושפחות ועבדים וגמלים וחמרים׃
genesis:30:43@01-genesis/30.tex.english: And the man expanded very, very much, and he had many sheep and female and male servants and camels and asses.

genesis:31:1@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYVM] AT DBRY BNY LBN LAMR LQX Y]QB AT KL AVR LABYNW WMAVR LABYNW ]VH AT KL HKBD HZH׃</bdo>
genesis:31:1@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And he heard Laban’s sons’ words, saying, “Jacob has taken everything that was our father’s, and he has made all this wealth from what was our father’s.”

genesis:31:2@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYRA Y]QB AT PNY LBN WHNH AYNNW ]MW KTMWL VLVWM׃</bdo>
genesis:31:2@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And Jacob saw Laban’s face; and, here, he was not like the day before yesterday with him.

genesis:31:3@01-genesis/31.tex.original: ויאמר יהוה אל יעקב שוב אל ארץ אבותיך ולמולדתך ואהיה עמך׃
genesis:31:3@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And YHWH said to Jacob, “Go back to your fathers’ land and to your birthplace, and I’ll be with you.”

genesis:31:4@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYVLX Y]QB WYQRA LRXL WLLAH HVDH AL CANW׃</bdo>
genesis:31:4@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field, to his flock,

genesis:31:5@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR LHN RAH ANKY AT PNY ABYKN KY AYNNW ALY KTML VLVM WALHY ABY HYH ]MDY׃</bdo>
genesis:31:5@01-genesis/31.tex.english: and said to them, “I see your father’s face, that he’s not like the day before yesterday to me. And my father’s God has been with me,

genesis:31:6@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WATNH YD]TN KY BKL KXY ]BDTY AT ABYKN׃</bdo>
genesis:31:6@01-genesis/31.tex.english: and you know that I served your father with all my might,

genesis:31:7@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WABYKN HTL BY WHXLP AT MVKRTY ]VRT MNYM WLA NTNW ALHYM LHR] ]MDY׃</bdo>
genesis:31:7@01-genesis/31.tex.english: and your father has toyed with me and changed my pay ten times, and God hasn’t let him do bad with me.

genesis:31:8@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">AM KH YAMR NQDYM YHYH VKRK WYLDW KL HCAN NQDYM WAM KH YAMR ]QDYM YHYH VKRK WYLDW KL HCAN ]QDYM׃</bdo>
genesis:31:8@01-genesis/31.tex.english: If he would say this: ‘The speckled will be your pay’, then all the flock gave birth to speckled. And if he would say this: ‘The streaked will be your pay’, then all the flock gave birth to streaked.

genesis:31:9@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYCL ALHYM AT MQNH ABYKM WYTN LY׃</bdo>
genesis:31:9@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And God has delivered your father’s livestock and given them to me.

genesis:31:10@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYHY B]T YXM HCAN WAVA ]YNY WARA BXLWM WHNH H]TDYM H]LYM ]L HCAN ]QDYM NQDYM WBRDYM׃</bdo>
genesis:31:10@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And it was at the time of the flock’s being in heat, and I raised my eyes and saw in a dream: and here were the he-goats that were going up on the flock: streaked, speckled, and spotted.

genesis:31:11@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR ALY MLAK HALHYM BXLWM Y]QB WAMR HNNY׃</bdo>
genesis:31:11@01-genesis/31.tex.english: “And an angel of God said to me in the dream, ‘Jacob.’ “And I said, ‘I’m here.’

genesis:31:12@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR VA NA ]YNYK WRAH KL H]TDYM H]LYM ]L HCAN ]QDYM NQDYM WBRDYM KY RAYTY AT KL AVR LBN ]VH LK׃</bdo>
genesis:31:12@01-genesis/31.tex.english: “And he said, ‘Raise your eyes and see all the he-goats that are going up on the flock: streaked, speckled, and spotted. Because I’ve seen everything that Laban is doing to you.

genesis:31:13@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">ANKY HAL BYT AL AVR MVXT VM MCBH AVR NDRT LY VM NDR ]TH QWM CA MN HARC HZAT WVWB AL ARC MWLDTK׃</bdo>
genesis:31:13@01-genesis/31.tex.english: I am the God at Beth-El, where you anointed a pillar, where you made a vow to me. Now get up, go from this land, and go back to the land of your birth.’”

genesis:31:14@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WT]N RXL WLAH WTAMRNH LW H]WD LNW XLQ WNXLH BBYT ABYNW׃</bdo>
genesis:31:14@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And Rachel and Leah answered, and they said to him, “Do we still have a portion and legacy in our father’s house?

genesis:31:15@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">HLWA NKRYWT NXVBNW LW KY MKRNW WYAKL GM AKWL AT KSPNW׃</bdo>
genesis:31:15@01-genesis/31.tex.english: Aren’t we thought of as foreigners by him, because he sold us and has eaten up our money as well?!

genesis:31:16@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">KY KL H]VR AVR HCYL ALHYM MABYNW LNW HWA WLBNYNW W]TH KL AVR AMR ALHYM ALYK ]VH׃</bdo>
genesis:31:16@01-genesis/31.tex.english: Because all the wealth that God has delivered from our father: it’s ours and our children’s. And now, do everything that that God has said to you.”

genesis:31:17@01-genesis/31.tex.original: ויקם יעקב וישא את בניו ואת נשיו על הגמלים׃
genesis:31:17@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And Jacob got up and carried his children and his wives on the camels.

genesis:31:18@01-genesis/31.tex.original: וַיִּנְהַג אֶת כּל מִקְנֵהוּ וְאֶת כּל רְכֻשׁוֹ אֲשֶׁר רָכָשׁ מִקְנֵה קִנְיָנוֹ אֲשֶׁר רָכַשׁ בְּפַדַּן אֲרָם לָבוֹא אֶל יִצְחָק אָבִיו אַרְצָה כְּנָעַן׃
genesis:31:18@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And he drove all his cattle and all his property that he had acquired, the cattle that were in his possession that he had acquired in Paddan Aram, to come to Isaac, his father, at the land of Canaan.

genesis:31:19@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WLBN HLK LGZZ AT CANW WTGNB RXL AT HTRPYM AVR LABYH׃</bdo>
genesis:31:19@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And Laban had gone to shear his flock. And Rachel stole the teraphim that her father had.

genesis:31:20@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYGNB Y]QB AT LB LBN HARMY ]L BLY HGYD LW KY BRX HWA׃</bdo>
genesis:31:20@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And Jacob stole the heart of Laban, the Aramean, by not telling him that he was fleeing.

genesis:31:21@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYBRX HWA WKL AVR LW WYQM WY]BR AT HNHR WYVM AT PNYW HR HGL]D׃</bdo>
genesis:31:21@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And he fled, he and everyone he had, and he got up and crossed the river and set his face toward the mountain of Gilead.

genesis:31:22@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYGD LLBN BYWM HVLYVY KY BRX Y]QB׃</bdo>
genesis:31:22@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And it was told to Laban on the third day that Jacob had fled.

genesis:31:23@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYQX AT AXYW ]MW WYRDP AXRYW DRK VB]T YMYM WYDBQ ATW BHR HGL]D׃</bdo>
genesis:31:23@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And he took his brothers with him and pursued him seven days’ journey and caught up to him in the mountain of Gilead.

genesis:31:24@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYBA ALHYM AL LBN HARMY BXLM HLYLH WYAMR LW HVMR LK PN TDBR ]M Y]QB MJWB ]D R]׃</bdo>
genesis:31:24@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And God came to Laban, the Aramean, in a night dream and said to him, “Watch yourself in case you speak with Jacob: from good to bad.”

genesis:31:25@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYVG LBN AT Y]QB WY]QB TQ] AT AHLW BHR WLBN TQ] AT AXYW BHR HGL]D׃</bdo>
genesis:31:25@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And Laban caught up to Jacob, and Jacob had set up his tent in the mountain, and Laban set up with his brothers in the mountain of Gilead.

genesis:31:26@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR LBN LY]QB MH ]VYT WTGNB AT LBBY WTNHG AT BNTY KVBYWT XRB׃</bdo>
genesis:31:26@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And Laban said to Jacob, “What have you done, that you’ve stolen my heart and driven off my daughters like prisoners by the sword?

genesis:31:27@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">LMH NXBAT LBRX WTGNB ATY WLA HGDT LY WAVLXK BVMXH WBVRYM BTP WBKNWR׃</bdo>
genesis:31:27@01-genesis/31.tex.english: Why did you hide so as to flee, and you stole from me, and you didn’t tell me? And I would have sent you off with happiness and with songs and with a drum and with a lyre.

genesis:31:28@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WLA NJVTNY LNVQ LBNY WLBNTY ]TH HSKLT ]VW׃</bdo>
genesis:31:28@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And you didn’t permit me to kiss my sons and my daughters. Now you’ve been foolish to do this.

genesis:31:29@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">YV LAL YDY L]VWT ]MKM R] WALHY ABYKM AMV AMR ALY LAMR HVMR LK MDBR ]M Y]QB MJWB ]D R]׃</bdo>
genesis:31:29@01-genesis/31.tex.english: The god at my hand has the means to do bad to you. But your father’s God said to me yesterday saying, ‘Watch yourself from speaking with Jacob: from good to bad.’

genesis:31:30@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">W]TH HLK HLKT KY NKSP NKSPTH LBYT ABYK LMH GNBT AT ALHY׃</bdo>
genesis:31:30@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And now, you went, because you longed for your father’s house. Why did you steal my gods?”

genesis:31:31@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WY]N Y]QB WYAMR LLBN KY YRATY KY AMRTY PN TGZL AT BNWTYK M]MY׃</bdo>
genesis:31:31@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And Jacob answered, and he said to Laban, “Because I was afraid. Because I said, ‘In case you’ll seize your daughters from me.’

genesis:31:32@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">]M AVR TMCA AT ALHYK LA YXYH NGD AXYNW HKR LK MH ]MDY WQX LK WLA YD] Y]QB KY RXL GNBTM׃</bdo>
genesis:31:32@01-genesis/31.tex.english: Let the one with whom you’ll find your gods not live. In front of our brothers, recognize and take what of yours is with me.” And Jacob did not know that Rachel had stolen them.

genesis:31:33@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYBA LBN BAHL Y]QB WBAHL LAH WBAHL VTY HAMHT WLA MCA WYCA MAHL LAH WYBA BAHL RXL׃</bdo>
genesis:31:33@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And Laban came in Jacob’s tent and Leah’s tent and the two maids’ tent, and he did not find them. And he came out from Leah’s tent and came in Rachel’s tent.

genesis:31:34@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WRXL LQXH AT HTRPYM WTVMM BKR HGML WTVB ]LYHM WYMVV LBN AT KL HAHL WLA MCA׃</bdo>
genesis:31:34@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And Rachel had taken the teraphim and put them in the camel’s saddle and sat on them. And Laban felt around the whole tent and did not find them.

genesis:31:35@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WTAMR AL ABYH AL YXR B]YNY ADNY KY LWA AWKL LQWM MPNYK KY DRK NVYM LY WYXPV WLA MCA AT HTRPYM׃</bdo>
genesis:31:35@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And she said to her father, “Let it not offend in my lord’s eyes that I’m not able to get up before you, because I have the way of women.” And he searched and did not find the teraphim.

genesis:31:36@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYXR LY]QB WYRB BLBN WY]N Y]QB WYAMR LLBN MH PV]Y MH XJATY KY DLQT AXRY׃</bdo>
genesis:31:36@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And Jacob was angered, and he quarreled with Laban, and Jacob answered, and he said to Laban, “What is my offense? What is my sin, that you blazed after me,

genesis:31:37@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">KY MVVT AT KL KLY MH MCAT MKL KLY BYTK VYM KH NGD AXY WAXYK WYWKYXW BYN VNYNW׃</bdo>
genesis:31:37@01-genesis/31.tex.english: that you felt around all my belongings? What did you find out of all of your house’s belongings? Set it here, in front of my brothers and your brothers, and let them judge between the two of us.

genesis:31:38@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">ZH ]VRYM VNH ANKY ]MK RXLYK W]ZYK LA VKLW WAYLY CANK LA AKLTY׃</bdo>
genesis:31:38@01-genesis/31.tex.english: This twenty years I’ve been with you, your ewes and your she-goats haven’t lost their offspring, and I haven’t eaten your flock’s rams.

genesis:31:39@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">JRPH LA HBATY ALYK ANKY AXJNH MYDY TBQVNH GNBTY YWM WGNBTY LYLH׃</bdo>
genesis:31:39@01-genesis/31.tex.english: I haven’t brought you one torn up. I would miss it: you would ask it from my hand, be it stolen by day or stolen by night.

genesis:31:40@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">HYYTY BYWM AKLNY XRB WQRX BLYLH WTDD VNTY M]YNY׃</bdo>
genesis:31:40@01-genesis/31.tex.english: I was … In the daytime heat ate me up, and ice in the night. And my sleep fled from my eyes.

genesis:31:41@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">ZH LY ]VRYM VNH BBYTK ]BDTYK ARB] ]VRH VNH BVTY BNTYK WVV VNYM BCANK WTXLP AT MVKRTY ]VRT MNYM׃</bdo>
genesis:31:41@01-genesis/31.tex.english: This twenty years I’ve had in your house: I worked for you fourteen years for your two daughters and six years for your flock, and you changed my pay ten times.

genesis:31:42@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">LWLY ALHY ABY ALHY ABRHM WPXD YCXQ HYH LY KY ]TH RYQM VLXTNY AT ]NYY WAT YGY] KPY RAH ALHYM WYWKX AMV׃</bdo>
genesis:31:42@01-genesis/31.tex.english: If I hadn’t had my father’s God, the God of Abraham and Fear of Isaac, by now you would have sent me away empty-handed. saw my degradation and my hands’ exhaustion, and He pointed it out last night.”

genesis:31:43@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WY]N LBN WYAMR AL Y]QB HBNWT BNTY WHBNYM BNY WHCAN CANY WKL AVR ATH RAH LY HWA WLBNTY MH A]VH LALH HYWM AW LBNYHN AVR YLDW׃</bdo>
genesis:31:43@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And Laban answered, and he said to Jacob, “The daughters are my daughters, and the sons are my sons, and the flock is my flock, and everything that you see: it’s mine. But what shall I do to my daughters, to these, today, or to their children to whom they’ve given birth?

genesis:31:44@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">W]TH LKH NKRTH BRYT ANY WATH WHYH L]D BYNY WBYNK׃</bdo>
genesis:31:44@01-genesis/31.tex.english: So now, come and let’s make a covenant, I and you, and let it be a witness between me and you.”

genesis:31:45@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYQX Y]QB ABN WYRYMH MCBH׃</bdo>
genesis:31:45@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And Jacob took a stone and set it up as a pillar,

genesis:31:46@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR Y]QB LAXYW LQJW ABNYM WYQXW ABNYM WY]VW GL WYAKLW VM ]L HGL׃</bdo>
genesis:31:46@01-genesis/31.tex.english: and Jacob said to his brothers, “Collect stones.” And they took stones and made a pile and ate there at the pile.

genesis:31:47@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYQRA LW LBN YGR VHDWTA WY]QB QRA LW GL]D׃</bdo>
genesis:31:47@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And Laban called it ygar shdta’, and Jacob called it gal-‘d.

genesis:31:48@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR LBN HGL HZH ]D BYNY WBYNK HYWM ]L KN QRA VMW GL]D׃</bdo>
genesis:31:48@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And Laban said, “This pile is a witness between me and you today.” On account of this he called its name Gal-Ed.

genesis:31:49@01-genesis/31.tex.original: WHMCPH AVR AMR YCP YHWH BYNY WBYNK KY NSTR AYV MR]HW׃
genesis:31:49@01-genesis/31.tex.english: (And Mizpah, because he said, “May YHWH observe between me and you when one is hidden from the other.”)

genesis:31:50@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">AM T]NH AT BNTY WAM TQX NVYM ]L BNTY AYN AYV ]MNW RAH ALHYM ]D BYNY WBYNK׃</bdo>
genesis:31:50@01-genesis/31.tex.english: “If you degrade my daughters and if you take wives in addition to my daughters, no man is with us. See: God is witness between me and you.”

genesis:31:51@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR LBN LY]QB HNH HGL HZH WHNH HMCBH AVR YRYTY BYNY WBYNK׃</bdo>
genesis:31:51@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And Laban said to Jacob, “Here is this pile, and here is the pillar that I’ve cast between me and you.

genesis:31:52@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">]D HGL HZH W]DH HMCBH AM ANY LA A]BR ALYK AT HGL HZH WAM ATH LA T]BR ALY AT HGL HZH WAT HMCBH HZAT LR]H׃</bdo>
genesis:31:52@01-genesis/31.tex.english: This pile is a witness, and the pillar is a witness that I won’t cross this pile to you and you won’t cross this pile and this pillar to me for bad.

genesis:31:53@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">ALHY ABRHM WALHY NXWR YVPJW BYNYNW ALHY ABYHM WYVB] Y]QB BPXD ABYW YCXQ׃</bdo>
genesis:31:53@01-genesis/31.tex.english: Let Abraham’s God and Nahor’s gods, their father’s gods, judge between us.” And Jacob swore by the Awe of his father, Isaac.

genesis:31:54@01-genesis/31.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYZBX Y]QB ZBX BHR WYQRA LAXYW LAKL LXM WYAKLW LXM WYLYNW BHR׃</bdo>
genesis:31:54@01-genesis/31.tex.english: And Jacob made a sacrifice in the mountain and called his brothers to eat bread, and they ate bread and spent the night in the mountain.

genesis:32:1@01-genesis/32.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYVKM LBN BBQR WYNVQ LBNYW WLBNWTYW WYBRK ATHM WYLK WYVB LBN LMQMW׃</bdo>
genesis:32:1@01-genesis/32.tex.english: And Laban got up early in the morning and kissed his sons and his daughters and blessed them and went. And Laban went back to his place,

genesis:32:2@01-genesis/32.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WY]QB HLK LDRKW WYPG]W BW MLAKY ALHYM׃</bdo>
genesis:32:2@01-genesis/32.tex.english: and Jacob went his way. And angels of God came upon him.

genesis:32:3@01-genesis/32.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR Y]QB KAVR RAM MXNH ALHYM ZH WYQRA VM HMQWM HHWA MXNYM׃</bdo>
genesis:32:3@01-genesis/32.tex.english: And Jacob said when he saw them, “This is a camp of God,” and he called that place’s name Mahanaim.

genesis:32:4@01-genesis/32.tex.original: וישלח יעקב מלאכים לפניו אל עשו אחיו ארצה שעיר שדה אדום׃
genesis:32:4@01-genesis/32.tex.english: And Jacob sent messengers ahead of him to Esau, his brother, to the land of Seir, the territory of Edom,

genesis:32:5@01-genesis/32.tex.original: ויצו אתם לאמר כה תאמרון לאדני לעשו כה אמר עבדך יעקב עם לבן גרתי ואחר עד עתה׃
genesis:32:5@01-genesis/32.tex.english: and commanded them saying, “You shall say this: ‘To my lord, to Esau, your servant Jacob said this, “I’ve stayed with Laban and delayed until now,

genesis:32:6@01-genesis/32.tex.original: ויהי לי שור וחמור צאן ועבד ושפחה ואשלחה להגיד לאדני למצא חן בעיניך׃
genesis:32:6@01-genesis/32.tex.english: and ox and ass and sheep and male and female servant have become mine. And I’m sending to tell my lord so as to find favor in your eyes.”’”

genesis:32:7@01-genesis/32.tex.original: וישבו המלאכים אל יעקב לאמר באנו אל אחיך אל עשו וגם הלך לקראתך וארבע מאות איש עמו׃
genesis:32:7@01-genesis/32.tex.english: And the messengers came back to Jacob saying, “We came to your brother, to Esau, and also he’s coming to you—and four hundred men with him.”

genesis:32:8@01-genesis/32.tex.original: ויירא יעקב מאד ויצר לו ויחץ את העם אשר אתו ואת הצאן ואת הבקר והגמלים לשני מחנות׃
genesis:32:8@01-genesis/32.tex.english: And Jacob was very afraid, and he had anguish. And he divided the people who were with him and the sheep and the oxen and the camels into two camps.

genesis:32:9@01-genesis/32.tex.original: ויאמר אם יבוא עשו אל המחנה האחת והכהו והיה המחנה הנשאר לפליטה׃
genesis:32:9@01-genesis/32.tex.english: And he said, “If Esau will come to one camp and strike it, then the camp that is left will survive.”

genesis:32:10@01-genesis/32.tex.original: ויאמר יעקב אלהי אבי אברהם ואלהי אבי יצחק יהוה האמר אלי שוב לארצך ולמולדתך ואיטיבה עמך׃
genesis:32:10@01-genesis/32.tex.english: And Jacob said, “God of my father Abraham and God of my father Isaac, YHWH, who said to me, ‘Go back to your land and to your birthplace, and I’ll deal well with you,’

genesis:32:11@01-genesis/32.tex.original: קטנתי מכל החסדים ומכל האמת אשר עשית את עבדך כי במקלי עברתי את הירדן הזה ועתה הייתי לשני מחנות׃
genesis:32:11@01-genesis/32.tex.english: I’m not worthy of all the kindnesses and all the faithfulness that you’ve done with your servant, because I crossed this Jordan with just my rod, and now I’ve become two camps.

genesis:32:12@01-genesis/32.tex.original: הצילני נא מיד אחי מיד עשו כי ירא אנכי אתו פן יבוא והכני אם על בנים׃
genesis:32:12@01-genesis/32.tex.english: Save me from my brother’s hand, from Esau’s hand, because I fear him, in case he’ll come and strike me, mother with children.

genesis:32:13@01-genesis/32.tex.original: ואתה אמרת היטב איטיב עמך ושמתי את זרעך כחול הים אשר לא יספר מרב׃
genesis:32:13@01-genesis/32.tex.english: And you’ve said, ‘I’ll do well with you, and I’ll make your seed like the sand of the sea, that it won’t be countable because of its great number.’”

genesis:32:14@01-genesis/32.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-rje hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="RJE">WYLN VM BLYLH HHWA WYQX MN HBA BYDW MNXH L]VW AXYW׃</bdo>
genesis:32:14@01-genesis/32.tex.english: And he spent that night there. And he took an offering for Esau, his brother, from what had come into his hand:

genesis:32:15@01-genesis/32.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">]ZYM MATYM WTYVYM ]VRYM RXLYM MATYM WAYLYM ]VRYM׃</bdo>
genesis:32:15@01-genesis/32.tex.english: two hundred she-goats and twenty he-goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,

genesis:32:16@01-genesis/32.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">GMLYM MYNYQWT WBNYHM VLVYM PRWT ARB]YM WPRYM ]VRH ATNT ]VRYM W]YRM ]VRH׃</bdo>
genesis:32:16@01-genesis/32.tex.english: thirty nursing camels and their offspring, forty cows and ten bulls, twenty she-asses and ten he-asses.

genesis:32:17@01-genesis/32.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYTN BYD ]BDYW ]DR ]DR LBDW WYAMR AL ]BDYW ]BRW LPNY WRWX TVYMW BYN ]DR WBYN ]DR׃</bdo>
genesis:32:17@01-genesis/32.tex.english: And he placed them in his servants’ hands, each herd by itself, and he said to his servants, “Pass on in front of me, and keep a distance between each herd and the next.”

genesis:32:18@01-genesis/32.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYCW AT HRAVWN LAMR KY YPGVK ]VW AXY WVALK LAMR LMY ATH WANH TLK WLMY ALH LPNYK׃</bdo>
genesis:32:18@01-genesis/32.tex.english: And he commanded the first, saying, “When my brother, Esau, meets you and asks you, saying, ‘To whom do you belong, and where are you going, and to whom do these in front of you belong?’

genesis:32:19@01-genesis/32.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WAMRT L]BDK LY]QB MNXH HWA VLWXH LADNY L]VW WHNH GM HWA AXRYNW׃</bdo>
genesis:32:19@01-genesis/32.tex.english: then you’ll say, ‘To your servant, to Jacob. It’s an offering sent to my lord, to Esau. And here he is behind us as well.’”

genesis:32:20@01-genesis/32.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYCW GM AT HVNY GM AT HVLYVY GM AT KL HHLKYM AXRY H]DRYM LAMR KDBR HZH TDBRWN AL ]VW BMCAKM ATW׃</bdo>
genesis:32:20@01-genesis/32.tex.english: And he also commanded the second, also the third, also all of those who were going behind the herds, saying, “You’ll speak this way to Esau when you find him,

genesis:32:21@01-genesis/32.tex.original: WAMRTM GM HNH ]BDK Y]QB AXRYNW KY AMR AKPRH PNYW BMNXH HHLKT L PNY WAXRY KN ARAH PNYW AWLY YVA PNY׃
genesis:32:21@01-genesis/32.tex.english: and you’ll say, ‘Here is your servant, Jacob, behind us as well.’” Because he said, “Let me appease his face with the offering that’s going in front of me, and after that I’ll see his face; maybe he’ll raise my face.”

genesis:32:22@01-genesis/32.tex.original: WT]BR HMNXH ]L PNYW WHWA LN BLYLH HHWA BMXNH׃
genesis:32:22@01-genesis/32.tex.english: And the offering passed ahead of him. And he spent that night in the camp.

genesis:32:23@01-genesis/32.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYQM BLYLH HWA WYQX AT VTY NVYW WAT VTY VPXTYW WAT AXD ]VR YLDYW WY]BR AT M]BR YBQ׃</bdo>
genesis:32:23@01-genesis/32.tex.english: And he got up in that night and took his two wives and his two maids and his eleven boys and crossed the Jabbok ford.

genesis:32:24@01-genesis/32.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYQXM WY]BRM AT HNXL WY]BR AT AVR LW׃</bdo>
genesis:32:24@01-genesis/32.tex.english: And he took them and had them cross the wadi, and he had everything that was his cross.

genesis:32:25@01-genesis/32.tex.original: ויותר יעקב לבדו ויאבק איש עמו עד עלות השחר׃
genesis:32:25@01-genesis/32.tex.english: And Jacob was left by himself. And a man^[Lit. איש in the original.] wrestled with him until the dawn’s rising.

genesis:32:26@01-genesis/32.tex.original: וירא כי לא יכל לו ויגע בכף ירכו ותקע כף ירך יעקב בהאבקו עמו׃
genesis:32:26@01-genesis/32.tex.english: And he saw that he was not able against him, and he touched the inside of his thigh, and the inside of Jacob’s thigh was dislocated during his wrestling with him.

genesis:32:27@01-genesis/32.tex.original: ויאמר שלחני כי עלה השחר ויאמר לא אשלחך כי אם ברכתני׃
genesis:32:27@01-genesis/32.tex.english: And he said, “Let me go, because the dawn has risen.” And he said, “I won’t let you go unless you bless me.”

genesis:32:28@01-genesis/32.tex.original: ויאמר אליו מה שמך ויאמר יעקב׃
genesis:32:28@01-genesis/32.tex.english: And he said to him, “What is your name?” And he said, “Jacob.”

genesis:32:29@01-genesis/32.tex.original: ויאמר לא יעקב יאמר עוד שמך כי אם ישראל כי שרית עם אלהים ועם אנשים ותוכל׃
genesis:32:29@01-genesis/32.tex.english: And he said, “Your name won’t be said ‘Jacob’ anymore but ‘Israel,’ because you’ve struggled with God and with people and were able.”

genesis:32:30@01-genesis/32.tex.original: ו ישאל יעקב ויאמר הגידה נא שמך ויאמר למה זה תשאל לשמי ויברך אתו שם׃
genesis:32:30@01-genesis/32.tex.english: And Jacob asked. And he said, “Tell your name.” And he said, “Why is this that you ask my name?” And he blessed him there.

genesis:32:31@01-genesis/32.tex.original: ויקרא יעקב שם המקום פניאל כי ראיתי אלהים פנים אל פנים ותנצל נפשי׃
genesis:32:31@01-genesis/32.tex.english: And Jacob called the place’s name Peni-El, “because I’ve seen God face-to-face, and my life has been delivered.”

genesis:32:32@01-genesis/32.tex.original: ויזרח לו השמש כאשר עבר את פנואל והוא צלע על ירכו׃
genesis:32:32@01-genesis/32.tex.english: And the sun rose on him as he passed Penuel, and he was faltering on his thigh.

genesis:32:33@01-genesis/32.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">]L KN LA YAKLW BNY YVRAL AT GYD HNVH AVR ]L KP HYRK ]D HYWM HZH KY NG] BKP YRK Y]QB BGYD HNVH׃</bdo>
genesis:32:33@01-genesis/32.tex.english: On account of this the children of Israel to this day will not eat the tendon of the vein that is on the inside of the thigh, because he touched the inside of Jacob’s thigh, the tendon of the vein.

genesis:33:1@01-genesis/33.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYVA Y]QB ]YNYW WYRA WHNH ]VW BA W]MW ARB] MAWT AYV WYXC AT HYLDYM ]L LAH W]L RXL W]L VTY HVPXWT׃</bdo>
genesis:33:1@01-genesis/33.tex.english: And Jacob raised his eyes and looked, and here was Esau coming, and four hundred men with him. And he divided the children among Leah and Rachel and the two maids;

genesis:33:2@01-genesis/33.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYVM AT HVPXWT WAT YLDYHN RAVNH WAT LAH WYLDYH AXRNYM WAT RXL WAT YWSP AXRNYM׃</bdo>
genesis:33:2@01-genesis/33.tex.english: and he placed the maids and their children first, and Leah and her children following, and Rachel and Joseph following,

genesis:33:3@01-genesis/33.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WHWA ]BR LPNYHM WYVTXW ARCH VB] P]MYM ]D GVTW ]D AXYW׃</bdo>
genesis:33:3@01-genesis/33.tex.english: and he passed in front of them. And he bowed to the ground seven times until he came up to his brother.

genesis:33:4@01-genesis/33.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYRC ]VW LQRATW WYXBQHW WYPL ]L CWARW WYVQHW WYBKW׃</bdo>
genesis:33:4@01-genesis/33.tex.english: And Esau ran to him and embraced him and fell on his neck and kissed him. And they wept.

genesis:33:5@01-genesis/33.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYVA AT ]YNYW WYRA AT HNVYM WAT HYLDYM WYAMR MY ALH LK WYAMR HYLDYM AVR XNN ALHYM AT ]BDK׃</bdo>
genesis:33:5@01-genesis/33.tex.english: And he raised his eyes and saw the women and the children, and he said, “Who are these whom you have?” And he said, “The children with whom God has graced your servant.”

genesis:33:6@01-genesis/33.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WTGVN HVPXWT HNH WYLDYHN WTVTXWYN׃</bdo>
genesis:33:6@01-genesis/33.tex.english: And the maids came over, they and their children, and bowed.

genesis:33:7@01-genesis/33.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WTGV GM LAH WYLDYH WYVTXWW WAXR NGV YWSP WRXL WYVTXWW׃</bdo>
genesis:33:7@01-genesis/33.tex.english: And Leah and her children, too, came over, and they bowed. And then Joseph and Rachel came over, and they bowed.

genesis:33:8@01-genesis/33.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR MY LK KL HMXNH HZH AVR PGVTY WYAMR LMCA XN B]YNY ADNY׃</bdo>
genesis:33:8@01-genesis/33.tex.english: And he said, “Who is all this camp of yours that I met?” And he said, “To find favor in my lord’s eyes.”

genesis:33:9@01-genesis/33.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR ]VW YV LY RB AXY YHY LK AVR LK׃</bdo>
genesis:33:9@01-genesis/33.tex.english: And Esau said, “I have a great deal, my brother. Let what’s yours be yours.”

genesis:33:10@01-genesis/33.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR Y]QB AL NA AM NA MCATY XN B]YNYK WLQXT MNXTY MYDY KY ]L KN RAYTY PNYK KRAT PNY ALHYM WTRCNY׃</bdo>
genesis:33:10@01-genesis/33.tex.english: And Jacob said, “Don’t. If I’ve found favor in your eyes, then you’ll take my offering from my hand, because on account of this I’ve seen your face—like seeing God’s face!—and you’ve accepted me.

genesis:33:11@01-genesis/33.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">QX NA AT BRKTY AVR HBAT LK KY XNNY ALHYM WKY YV LY KL WYPCR BW WYQX׃</bdo>
genesis:33:11@01-genesis/33.tex.english: Take my blessing that’s been brought to you, because God has been gracious to me and because I have everything.” And he pressed him, and he took it.

genesis:33:12@01-genesis/33.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR NS]H WNLKH WALKH LNGDK׃</bdo>
genesis:33:12@01-genesis/33.tex.english: And he said, “Let’s travel, and let’s go. And let me go alongside you.”

genesis:33:13@01-genesis/33.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR ALYW ADNY YD] KY HYLDYM RKYM WHCAN WHBQR ]LWT ]LY WDPQWM YWM AXD WMTW KL HCAN׃</bdo>
genesis:33:13@01-genesis/33.tex.english: And he said to him, “My lord knows that the children are weak and the nursing sheep and oxen are with me, and they’ll drive them one day and all the sheep will die.

genesis:33:14@01-genesis/33.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">Y]BR NA ADNY LPNY ]BDW WANY ATNHLH LAJY LRGL HMLAKH AVR LPNY WLRGL HYLDYM ]D AVR ABA AL ADNY V]YRH׃</bdo>
genesis:33:14@01-genesis/33.tex.english: Let my lord pass on in front of his servant; and I, let me move along at my pace required by the task that’s before me and required by the children until I come to my lord at Seir.”

genesis:33:15@01-genesis/33.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR ]VW ACYGH NA ]MK MN H]M AVR ATY WYAMR LMH ZH AMCA XN B]YNY ADNY׃</bdo>
genesis:33:15@01-genesis/33.tex.english: And Esau said, “Let me set with you some of the people who are with me.” And he said, “Why have I found favor in my lord’s eyes?”

genesis:33:16@01-genesis/33.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYVB BYWM HHWA ]VW LDRKW V]YRH׃</bdo>
genesis:33:16@01-genesis/33.tex.english: And Esau went back on his way to Seir that day,

genesis:33:17@01-genesis/33.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WY]QB NS] SKTH WYBN LW BYT WLMQNHW ]VH SKT ]L KN QRA VM HMQWM SKWT׃</bdo>
genesis:33:17@01-genesis/33.tex.english: and Jacob traveled to Sukkot. And he built a house for himself and made booths for his cattle. On account of this he called the place’s name Sukkot.

genesis:33:18@01-genesis/33.tex.original: WYBA Y]QB VLM ]YR VKM אשר בארץ כנען בבאו מפדן ארם WYXN AT PNY H]YR׃
genesis:33:18@01-genesis/33.tex.english: And Jacob came, safe, to the city of Shechem, which was in the land of Canaan, when he was coming from Paddan Aram, and camped in front of the city.

genesis:33:19@01-genesis/33.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYQN AT XLQT HVDH AVR NJH VM AHLW MYD BNY XMWR ABY VKM BMAH QVYJH׃</bdo>
genesis:33:19@01-genesis/33.tex.english: And he bought the section of field in which he pitched his tent from the hand of the sons of Hamor, father of Shechem, for a hundred qesita.

genesis:33:20@01-genesis/33.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYCB VM MZBX WYQRA LW AL ALHY YVRAL׃</bdo>
genesis:33:20@01-genesis/33.tex.english: And he set up an altar there and called it “El, God of Israel.”

genesis:34:1@01-genesis/34.tex.original: ותצא דינה בת לאה אשר ילדה ליעקב לראות בבנות הארץ׃
genesis:34:1@01-genesis/34.tex.english: And Dinah, Leah’s daughter, whom she had borne to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

genesis:34:2@01-genesis/34.tex.original: וירא אתה שכם בן חמור החוי נשיא הארץ ויקח אתה וישכב אתה ויענה׃
genesis:34:2@01-genesis/34.tex.english: And Shechem, son of Hamor, the Hivite, the chieftain of the land, saw her. And he took her and lay with her and degraded her.

genesis:34:3@01-genesis/34.tex.original: ותדבק נפשו בדינה בת יעקב ויאהב את הנער וידבר על לב הנער׃
genesis:34:3@01-genesis/34.tex.english: And his soul clung to Dinah, Jacob’s daughter, and he loved the girl and spoke on the girl’s heart.

genesis:34:4@01-genesis/34.tex.original: ויאמר שכם אל חמור אביו לאמר קח לי את הילדה הזאת לאשה׃
genesis:34:4@01-genesis/34.tex.english: And Shechem said to Hamor, his father, “Get me this girl for a wife.”

genesis:34:5@01-genesis/34.tex.original: ויעקב שמע כי טמא את דינה בתו ובניו היו את מקנהו בשדה והחרש יעקב עד באם׃
genesis:34:5@01-genesis/34.tex.english: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah, his daughter; and his sons were with his cattle in the field, and Jacob kept quiet until they came.

genesis:34:6@01-genesis/34.tex.original: ויצא חמור אבי שכם אל יעקב לדבר אתו׃
genesis:34:6@01-genesis/34.tex.english: And Hamor, Shechem’s father, went out to Jacob to speak with him.

genesis:34:7@01-genesis/34.tex.original: ובני יעקב באו מן השדה כשמעם ויתעצבו האנשים ויחר להם מאד כי נבלה עשה בישראל לשכב את בת יעקב וכן לא יעשה׃
genesis:34:7@01-genesis/34.tex.english: And Jacob’s sons came from the field when they heard, and the men were pained, and they were very furious, for he had done a foolhardy thing among Israel, to lie with Jacob’s daughter, and such a thing is not done.

genesis:34:8@01-genesis/34.tex.original: וידבר חמור אתם לאמר שכם בני חשקה נפשו בבתכם תנו נא אתה לו לאשה׃
genesis:34:8@01-genesis/34.tex.english: And Hamor spoke with them, saying, “Shechem—my son—his soul longs for your daughter. Give her to him as a wife,

genesis:34:9@01-genesis/34.tex.original: והתחתנו אתנו בנתיכם תתנו לנו ואת בנתינו תקחו לכם׃
genesis:34:9@01-genesis/34.tex.english: and marry with us; give your daughters to us and take our daughters to you,

genesis:34:10@01-genesis/34.tex.original: ואתנו תשבו והארץ תהיה לפניכם שבו וסחרוה והאחזו בה׃
genesis:34:10@01-genesis/34.tex.english: and live with us; and the land will be before you: live and go around in it and take possession in it.”

genesis:34:11@01-genesis/34.tex.original: ויאמר שכם אל אביה ואל אחיה אמצא חן בעיניכם ואשר תאמרו אלי אתן׃
genesis:34:11@01-genesis/34.tex.english: And Shechem said to her father and to her brothers, “Let me find favor in your eyes, and I’ll give whatever you say to me.

genesis:34:12@01-genesis/34.tex.original: הרבו עלי מאד מהר ומתן ואתנה כאשר תאמרו אלי ותנו לי את הנער לאשה׃
genesis:34:12@01-genesis/34.tex.english: Make a bride-price and gift on me very great, and let me give whatever you say to me, and give me the girl as a wife.”

genesis:34:13@01-genesis/34.tex.original: ויענו בני יעקב את שכם ואת חמור אביו במרמה וידברו אשר טמא את דינה אחתם׃
genesis:34:13@01-genesis/34.tex.english: And Jacob’s sons answered Shechem and Hamor, his father, with deception as they spoke because he had defiled Dinah, their sister.

genesis:34:14@01-genesis/34.tex.original: ויאמרו אליהם לא נוכל לעשות הדבר הזה לתת את אחתנו לאיש אשר לו ערלה כי חרפה הוא לנו׃
genesis:34:14@01-genesis/34.tex.english: And they said to them, “We aren’t able to do this thing, to give our sister to a man who has a foreskin, because that’s a disgrace to us.

genesis:34:15@01-genesis/34.tex.original: אך בזאת נאות לכם אם תהיו כמנו להמל לכם כל זכר׃
genesis:34:15@01-genesis/34.tex.english: Only this way will we consent to you: if you’ll be like us, every male among you to be circumcised.

genesis:34:16@01-genesis/34.tex.original: ונתנו את בנתינו לכם ואת בנתיכם נקח לנו וישבנו אתכם והיינו לעם אחד׃
genesis:34:16@01-genesis/34.tex.english: And we’ll give our daughters to you and take your daughters to us, and we’ll live with you, and we’ll become one people.

genesis:34:17@01-genesis/34.tex.original: ואם לא תשמעו אלינו להמול ולקחנו את בתנו והלכנו׃
genesis:34:17@01-genesis/34.tex.english: And if you won’t listen to us, to be circumcised, then we’ll take our daughter and go.”

genesis:34:18@01-genesis/34.tex.original: וייטבו דבריהם בעיני חמור ובעיני שכם בן חמור׃
genesis:34:18@01-genesis/34.tex.english: And their words were good in Hamor’s eyes and in Hamor’s son Shechem’s eyes.

genesis:34:19@01-genesis/34.tex.original: ולא אחר הנער לעשות הדבר כי חפץ בבת יעקב והוא נכבד מכל בית אביו׃
genesis:34:19@01-genesis/34.tex.english: And the boy did not delay to do the thing, for he desired Jacob’s daughter. And he was more respected than all his father’s house.

genesis:34:20@01-genesis/34.tex.original: ויבא חמור ושכם בנו אל שער עירם וידברו אל אנשי עירם לאמר׃
genesis:34:20@01-genesis/34.tex.english: And Hamor and his son Shechem came to the gate of their city and spoke to the people of their city, saying,

genesis:34:21@01-genesis/34.tex.original: האנשים האלה שלמים הם אתנו וישבו בארץ ויסחרו אתה והארץ הנה רחבת ידים לפניהם את בנתם נקח לנו לנשים ואת בנתינו נתן להם׃
genesis:34:21@01-genesis/34.tex.english: “These people are peaceable with us, and they’ll live in the land and go around in it, and the land, here, has enough breadth for them. Let’s take their daughters for us as wives and give our daughters to them.

genesis:34:22@01-genesis/34.tex.original: אך בזאת יאתו לנו האנשים לשבת אתנו להיות לעם אחד בהמול לנו כל זכר כאשר הם נמלים׃
genesis:34:22@01-genesis/34.tex.english: Only in this way will these people consent to us to live with us, to be one people: if every male among us is circumcised as they are circumcised.

genesis:34:23@01-genesis/34.tex.original: מקנהם וקנינם וכל בהמתם הלוא לנו הם אך נאותה להם וישבו אתנו׃
genesis:34:23@01-genesis/34.tex.english: Their cattle and possessions and all their animals: won’t they be ours? Only let’s consent to them, and they’ll live with us.”

genesis:34:24@01-genesis/34.tex.original: וישמעו אל חמור ואל שכם בנו כל יצאי שער עירו וימלו כל זכר כל יצאי שער עירו׃
genesis:34:24@01-genesis/34.tex.english: And everyone who went out of the gate of his city listened to Hamor and to his son Shechem; and every male, everyone who went out of the gate of his city, was circumcised.

genesis:34:25@01-genesis/34.tex.original: ויהי ביום השלישי בהיותם כאבים ויקחו שני בני יעקב שמעון ולוי אחי דינה איש חרבו ויבאו על העיר בטח ויהרגו כל זכר׃
genesis:34:25@01-genesis/34.tex.english: And it was on the third day, when they were hurting, and two of Jacob’s sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers, each took his sword, and they came upon the city stealthily, and they killed every male.

genesis:34:26@01-genesis/34.tex.original: ואת חמור ואת שכם בנו הרגו לפי חרב ויקחו את דינה מבית שכם ויצאו׃
genesis:34:26@01-genesis/34.tex.english: And they killed Hamor and his son Shechem by the sword and took Dinah from Shechem’s house and went out.

genesis:34:27@01-genesis/34.tex.original: בני יעקב באו על החללים ויבזו העיר אשר טמאו אחותם׃
genesis:34:27@01-genesis/34.tex.english: Jacob’s sons had come upon the corpses and despoiled the city because they had defiled their sister.

genesis:34:28@01-genesis/34.tex.original: את צאנם ואת בקרם ואת חמריהם ואת אשר בעיר ואת אשר בשדה לקחו׃
genesis:34:28@01-genesis/34.tex.english: They took their sheep and their oxen and their asses and what was in the city and what was in the field.

genesis:34:29@01-genesis/34.tex.original: ואת כל חילם ואת כל טפם ואת נשיהם שבו ויבזו ואת כל אשר בבית׃
genesis:34:29@01-genesis/34.tex.english: And they captured and despoiled all their wealth and all their infants and their wives and everything that was in the house.

genesis:34:30@01-genesis/34.tex.original: ויאמר יעקב אל שמעון ואל לוי עכרתם אתי להבאישני בישב הארץ בכנעני ובפרזי ואני מתי מספר ונאספו עלי והכוני ונשמדתי אני וביתי׃
genesis:34:30@01-genesis/34.tex.english: And Jacob said to Simeon and to Levi, “You’ve caused me anguish, making me odious to those who live in the land, to the Canaanite and to the Perizzite, and I’m few in number, and they’ll be gathered against me and strike me, and I’ll be destroyed, I and my house.”

genesis:34:31@01-genesis/34.tex.original: ויאמרו הכזונה יעשה את אחותנו׃
genesis:34:31@01-genesis/34.tex.english: And they said, “Shall he treat our sister like a prostitute?”

genesis:35:1@01-genesis/35.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR ALHYM AL Y]QB QWM ]LH BYT AL WVB VM W]VH VM MZBX LAL HNRAH ALYK BBRXK MPNY ]VW AXYK׃</bdo>
genesis:35:1@01-genesis/35.tex.english: And God said to Jacob, “Get up. Go up to Beth-El and live there and make an altar there to God, who appeared to you when you were fleeing from Esau, your brother.”

genesis:35:2@01-genesis/35.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR Y]QB AL BYTW WAL KL AVR ]MW HSRW AT ALHY HNKR AVR BTKKM WHJHRW WHXLYPW VMLTYKM׃</bdo>
genesis:35:2@01-genesis/35.tex.english: And Jacob said to his house and to everyone who was with him, “Put away the foreign gods that are among you and be purified and change your clothes;

genesis:35:3@01-genesis/35.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WNQWMH WN]LH BYT AL WA]VH VM MZBX LAL H]NH ATY BYWM CRTY WYHY ]MDY BDRK AVR HLKTY׃</bdo>
genesis:35:3@01-genesis/35.tex.english: and let’s get up and go up to Beth-El, and I’ll make an altar there to God, who answered me in a day of my trouble, and He was with me in the way that I went.”

genesis:35:4@01-genesis/35.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYTNW AL Y]QB AT KL ALHY HNKR AVR BYDM WAT HNZMYM AVR BAZNYHM WYJMN ATM Y]QB TXT HALH AVR ]M VKM׃</bdo>
genesis:35:4@01-genesis/35.tex.english: And they gave all the foreign gods that were in their hand and the rings that were in their ears to Jacob, and Jacob stashed them under the oak that was by Shechem.

genesis:35:5@01-genesis/35.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYS]W WYHY XTT ALHYM ]L H]RYM AVR SBYBWTYHM WLA RDPW AXRY BNY Y]QB׃</bdo>
genesis:35:5@01-genesis/35.tex.english: And they traveled, and God’s terror was on the cities that were around them, and they did not pursue the children of Jacob.

genesis:35:6@01-genesis/35.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYBA Y]QB LWZH AVR BARC KN]N HWA BYT AL HWA WKL H]M AVR ]MW׃</bdo>
genesis:35:6@01-genesis/35.tex.english: And Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan—it is Beth-El—he and all the people who were with him.

genesis:35:7@01-genesis/35.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYBN VM MZBX WYQRA LMQWM AL BYT AL KY VM NGLW ALYW HALHYM BBRXW MPNY AXYW׃</bdo>
genesis:35:7@01-genesis/35.tex.english: And he built an altar there and called the place El of Beth-El because God was revealed to him there when he was fleeing from his brother.

genesis:35:8@01-genesis/35.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WTMT DBRH MYNQT RBQH WTQBR MTXT LBYT AL TXT HALWN WYQRA VMW ALWN BKWT׃</bdo>
genesis:35:8@01-genesis/35.tex.english: And Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died and was buried beneath Beth-El, beneath an oak, and he called its name Oak of Weeping.

genesis:35:9@01-genesis/35.tex.original: וַיֵּרָא אֱלֹהִים אֶל יַעֲקֹב עוד בְּבֹאוֹ מִפַּדַּן אֲרָם וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתוֹ׃
genesis:35:9@01-genesis/35.tex.english: And God appeared to Jacob again when he was coming from Paddan Aram, and He blessed him.

genesis:35:10@01-genesis/35.tex.original: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֱלֹהִים שִׁמְךָ יַעֲקֹב לֹא יִקָּרֵא שִׁמְךָ עוֹד יַעֲקֹב כִּי אִם יִשְׂרָאֵל יִהְיֶה שְׁמֶךָ וַיִּקְרָא אֶת שְׁמוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
genesis:35:10@01-genesis/35.tex.english: And God said to him, “Your name is Jacob. Your name will not be called Jacob anymore, but rather Israel will be your name.” And He called his name Israel.

genesis:35:11@01-genesis/35.tex.original: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֱלֹהִים אֲנִי אֵל שַׁדַּי פְּרֵה וּרְבֵה גּוֹי וּקְהַל גּוֹיִם יִהְיֶה מִמֶּךָּ וּמְלָכִים מֵחֲלָצֶיךָ יֵצֵאוּ׃
genesis:35:11@01-genesis/35.tex.english: And God said to him, “I am El Shadday Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a community of nations will be from you, and kings will come out from your hips.

genesis:35:12@01-genesis/35.tex.original: וְאֶת הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לְאַבְרָהָם וּלְיִצְחָק לְךָ אֶתְּנֶנָּה וּלְזַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ אֶתֵּן אֶת הָאָרֶץ׃
genesis:35:12@01-genesis/35.tex.english: And the land that I gave to Abraham and to Isaac: I’ll give it to you, and I’ll give the land to your seed after you.”

genesis:35:13@01-genesis/35.tex.original: וַיַּעַל מֵעָלָיו אֱלֹהִים בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אִתּוֹ׃
genesis:35:13@01-genesis/35.tex.english: And God went up from on him in the place where He had spoken with him.

genesis:35:14@01-genesis/35.tex.original: וַיַּצֵּב יַעֲקֹב מַצֵּבָה בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אִתּוֹ מַצֶּבֶת אָבֶן וַיַּסֵּךְ עָלֶיהָ נֶסֶךְ וַיִּצֹק עָלֶיהָ שָׁמֶן׃
genesis:35:14@01-genesis/35.tex.english: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where He had spoken with him, a stone pillar, and he poured a libation on it and spilled oil on it.

genesis:35:15@01-genesis/35.tex.original: וַיִּקְרָא יַעֲקֹב אֶת שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אִתּוֹ שָׁם אֱלֹהִים בֵּית אֵל׃
genesis:35:15@01-genesis/35.tex.english: And Jacob called the name of the place where God had spoken to him there Beth-El.

genesis:35:16@01-genesis/35.tex.original: ויסעו מבית אל WYHY ]WD KBRT HARC LBWA APRTH WTLD RXL WTQV BLDTH׃
genesis:35:16@01-genesis/35.tex.english: And they traveled from Beth-El. And there was still the span of the land to come to Ephrat. And Rachel gave birth. And she had difficulty in her labor.

genesis:35:17@01-genesis/35.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYHY BHQVTH BLDTH WTAMR LH HMYLDT AL TYRAY KY GM ZH LK BN׃</bdo>
genesis:35:17@01-genesis/35.tex.english: And it was when she was having difficulty in her labor, and the midwife said to her, “Don’t be afraid, because this, too, is a son for you.”

genesis:35:18@01-genesis/35.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYHY BCAT NPVH KY MTH WTQRA VMW BN AWNY WABYW QRA LW BNYMYN׃</bdo>
genesis:35:18@01-genesis/35.tex.english: And it was as her soul was going out—because she died—and she called his name Ben-oni. And his father called him Benjamin.

genesis:35:19@01-genesis/35.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WTMT RXL WTQBR BDRK APRTH HWA BYT LXM׃</bdo>
genesis:35:19@01-genesis/35.tex.english: And Rachel died. And she was buried on the road to Ephrat. It is Bethlehem.

genesis:35:20@01-genesis/35.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYCB Y]QB MCBH ]L QBRTH HWA MCBT QBRT RXL ]D HYWM׃</bdo>
genesis:35:20@01-genesis/35.tex.english: And Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. It is the pillar of Rachel’s grave to this day.

genesis:35:21@01-genesis/35.tex.original: ויסע ישראל ויט אהלה מהלאה למגדל עדר׃
genesis:35:21@01-genesis/35.tex.english: And Israel traveled and pitched his tent past Migdal-Eder.

genesis:35:22@01-genesis/35.tex.original: ויהי בשכן ישראל בארץ ההוא וילך ראובן וישכב את בלהה פילגש אביו וישמע ישרא͏ל׃ פ. וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי יַעֲקֹב שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃
genesis:35:22@01-genesis/35.tex.english: And it was when Israel was tenting in that land: and Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father’s concubine. And Israel heard. And Jacob’s sons were twelve.

genesis:35:23@01-genesis/35.tex.original: בְּנֵי לֵאָה בְּכוֹר יַעֲקֹב רְאוּבֵן וְשִׁמְעוֹן וְלֵוִי וִיהוּדָה וְיִשָּׂשכָר וּזְבֻלוּן׃
genesis:35:23@01-genesis/35.tex.english: The sons of Leah were Jacob’s firstborn, Reuben, and Simeon and Levi and Judah and Issachar and Zebulun.

genesis:35:24@01-genesis/35.tex.original: בְּנֵי רָחֵל יוֹסֵף וּבִנְיָמִן׃
genesis:35:24@01-genesis/35.tex.english: The sons of Rachel were Joseph and Benjamin.

genesis:35:25@01-genesis/35.tex.original: וּבְנֵי בִלְהָה שִׁפְחַת רָחֵל דָּן וְנַפְתָּלִי׃
genesis:35:25@01-genesis/35.tex.english: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel’s maid, were Dan and Naphtali.

genesis:35:26@01-genesis/35.tex.original: וּבְנֵי זִלְפָּה שִׁפְחַת לֵאָה גָּד וְאָשֵׁר אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב אֲשֶׁר יֻלַּד לוֹ בְּפַדַּן אֲרָם׃
genesis:35:26@01-genesis/35.tex.english: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah’s maid, were Gad and Asher. These were Jacob’s sons, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.

genesis:35:27@01-genesis/35.tex.original: וַיָּבֹא יַעֲקֹב אֶל יִצְחָק אָבִיו מַמְרֵא קִרְיַת הָאַרְבַּע הִוא חֶבְרוֹן אֲשֶׁר גָּר שָׁם אַבְרָהָם וְיִצְחָק׃
genesis:35:27@01-genesis/35.tex.english: And Jacob came to Isaac, his father, at Mamre, at Kiriath Arba—it is Hebron—where Abraham and Isaac had resided.

genesis:35:28@01-genesis/35.tex.original: וַיִּהְיוּ יְמֵי יִצְחָק מְאַת שָׁנָה וּשְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה׃
genesis:35:28@01-genesis/35.tex.english: And Isaac’s days were a hundred years and eighty years,

genesis:35:29@01-genesis/35.tex.original: וַיִּגְוַע יִצְחָק וַיָּמת וַיֵּאָסֶף אֶל עַמָּיו זָקֵן וּשְׂבַע יָמִים וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ עֵשָׂו וְיַעֲקֹב בָּנָיו׃
genesis:35:29@01-genesis/35.tex.english: and Isaac expired. And he died and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. And Esau and Jacob, his sons, buried him.

genesis:36:1@01-genesis/36.tex.original: ואלה תלדות עשו הוא אדום׃
genesis:36:1@01-genesis/36.tex.english: And these are the records of Esau: He is Edom.

genesis:36:2@01-genesis/36.tex.original: עֵשָׂו לָקַח אֶת נָשָׁיו מִבְּנוֹת כְּנָעַן אֶת עָדָה בַּת אֵילוֹן הַחִתִּי וְאֶת אהֳלִיבָמָה בַּת עֲנָה בַּת צִבְעוֹן הַחִוִּי׃
genesis:36:2@01-genesis/36.tex.english: Esau had taken his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah, daughter of Elon, the Hittite, and Aholibamah, daughter of Anah, daughter of Zibeon, the Hivite,

genesis:36:3@01-genesis/36.tex.original: וְאֶת בָּשְׂמַת בַּת יִשְׁמָעֵאל אֲחוֹת נְבָיוֹת׃
genesis:36:3@01-genesis/36.tex.english: and Basemath, daughter of Ishmael, sister of Nebaioth.

genesis:36:4@01-genesis/36.tex.original: וַתֵּלֶד עָדָה לְעֵשָׂו אֶת אֱלִיפָז וּבָשְׂמַת יָלְדָה אֶת רְעוּאֵל׃
genesis:36:4@01-genesis/36.tex.english: And Adah gave birth for Esau to Eliphaz, and Basemath gave birth to Reuel,

genesis:36:5@01-genesis/36.tex.original: וְאהֳלִיבָמָה יָלְדָה אֶת [יְעוּשׁ] (יעיש) וְאֶת יַעְלָם וְאֶת קֹרַח אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי עֵשָׂו אֲשֶׁר יֻלְּדוּ לוֹ בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃
genesis:36:5@01-genesis/36.tex.english: and Aholibamah gave birth to Jeush and Jalam and Korah. These are Esau’s sons, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.

genesis:36:6@01-genesis/36.tex.original: וַיִּקַּח עֵשָׂו אֶת נָשָׁיו וְאֶת בָּנָיו וְאֶת בְּנֹתָיו וְאֶת כּל נַפְשׁוֹת בֵּיתוֹ וְאֶת מִקְנֵהוּ וְאֶת כּל בְּהֶמְתּוֹ וְאֵת כּל קִנְיָנוֹ אֲשֶׁר רָכַשׁ בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל אֶרֶץ מִפְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב אָחִיו׃
genesis:36:6@01-genesis/36.tex.english: And Esau took his wives and his sons and his daughters and all the persons of his household and his cattle and all of his animals and all of his possessions that he had acquired in the land of Canaan, and he went to a land, from the presence of Jacob, his brother,

genesis:36:7@01-genesis/36.tex.original: כִּי הָיָה רְכוּשָׁם רָב מִשֶּׁבֶת יַחְדָּו וְלֹא יָכְלָה אֶרֶץ מְגוּרֵיהֶם לָשֵׂאת אֹתָם מִפְּנֵי מִקְנֵיהֶם׃
genesis:36:7@01-genesis/36.tex.english: because their property was too great for them to live together, and the land of their residences was not able to suffice them because of their cattle.

genesis:36:8@01-genesis/36.tex.original: וַיֵּשֶׁב עֵשָׂו בְּהַר שֵׂעִיר עֵשָׂו הוּא אֱדוֹם׃
genesis:36:8@01-genesis/36.tex.english: And Esau lived in Mount Seir. Esau: he is Edom.

genesis:36:9@01-genesis/36.tex.original: וְאֵלֶּה תֹּלְדוֹת עֵשָׂו אֲבִי אֱדוֹם בְּהַר שֵׂעִיר׃
genesis:36:9@01-genesis/36.tex.english: And these are the records of Esau, father of Edom, in Mount Seir.

genesis:36:10@01-genesis/36.tex.original: אֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי עֵשָׂו אֱלִיפַז בֶּן עָדָה אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו רְעוּאֵל בֶּן בָּשְׂמַת אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו׃
genesis:36:10@01-genesis/36.tex.english: These are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, son of Adah, Esau’s wife; Reuel, son of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

genesis:36:11@01-genesis/36.tex.original: וַיִּהְיוּ בְּנֵי אֱלִיפָז תֵּימָן אוֹמָר צְפוֹ וְגַעְתָּם וּקְנַז׃
genesis:36:11@01-genesis/36.tex.english: And Eliphaz’s sons were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam and Kenaz.

genesis:36:12@01-genesis/36.tex.original: וְתִמְנַע הָיְתָה פִילֶגֶשׁ לֶאֱלִיפַז בֶּן עֵשָׂו וַתֵּלֶד לֶאֱלִיפַז אֶת עֲמָלֵק אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי עָדָה אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו׃
genesis:36:12@01-genesis/36.tex.english: And Timna had been a concubine of Eliphaz, son of Esau, and she gave birth to Amalek for Eliphaz. These are the sons of Adah, Esau’s wife.

genesis:36:13@01-genesis/36.tex.original: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי רְעוּאֵל נַחַת וָזֶרַח שַׁמָּה וּמִזָּה אֵלֶּה הָיוּ בְּנֵי בָשְׂמַת אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו׃
genesis:36:13@01-genesis/36.tex.english: And these are the sons of Reuel: Nahath and Zerah, Shammah and Mizzeh. These were the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

genesis:36:14@01-genesis/36.tex.original: וְאֵלֶּה הָיוּ בְּנֵי אהֳלִיבָמָה בַת עֲנָה בַּת צִבְעוֹן אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו וַתֵּלֶד לְעֵשָׂו אֶת [יְעוּשׁ] (יעיש) וְאֶת יַעְלָם וְאֶת קֹרַח׃
genesis:36:14@01-genesis/36.tex.english: And these were the sons of Aholibamah, daughter of Anah, daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: and she gave birth for Esau to Jeush and Jalam and Korah.
