genesis:36:15@01-genesis/36.tex.original: אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי בְנֵי עֵשָׂו בְּנֵי אֱלִיפַז בְּכוֹר עֵשָׂו אַלּוּף תֵּימָן אַלּוּף אוֹמָר אַלּוּף צְפוֹ אַלּוּף קְנַז׃
genesis:36:15@01-genesis/36.tex.english: These are the chiefs of the children of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz, Esau’s firstborn: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,

genesis:36:16@01-genesis/36.tex.original: אַלּוּף קֹרַח אַלּוּף גַּעְתָּם אַלּוּף עֲמָלֵק אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי אֱלִיפַז בְּאֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי עָדָה׃
genesis:36:16@01-genesis/36.tex.english: chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek. These are the chiefs of Eliphaz in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Adah.

genesis:36:17@01-genesis/36.tex.original: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי רְעוּאֵל בֶּן עֵשָׂו אַלּוּף נַחַת אַלּוּף זֶרַח אַלּוּף שַׁמָּה אַלּוּף מִזָּה אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי רְעוּאֵל בְּאֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי בָשְׂמַת אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו׃
genesis:36:17@01-genesis/36.tex.english: And these are the sons of Reuel, son of Esau: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah. These are the chiefs of Reuel in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

genesis:36:18@01-genesis/36.tex.original: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי אהֳלִיבָמָה אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו אַלּוּף יְעוּשׁ אַלּוּף יַעְלָם אַלּוּף קֹרַח אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי אהֳלִיבָמָה בַּת עֲנָה אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו׃
genesis:36:18@01-genesis/36.tex.english: And these are the sons of Aholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah. These were the chiefs of Aholibamah, daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.

genesis:36:19@01-genesis/36.tex.original: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי עֵשָׂו וְאֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵיהֶם הוּא אֱדוֹם׃
genesis:36:19@01-genesis/36.tex.english: These are the sons of Esau, and these are their chiefs. That is Edom.

genesis:36:20@01-genesis/36.tex.original: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי שֵׂעִיר הַחֹרִי יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ לוֹטָן וְשׁוֹבָל וְצִבְעוֹן וַעֲנָה׃
genesis:36:20@01-genesis/36.tex.english: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who live in the land: Lotan and Shobal and Zibeon and Anah

genesis:36:21@01-genesis/36.tex.original: וְדִשׁוֹן וְאֵצֶר וְדִישָׁן אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי הַחֹרִי בְּנֵי שֵׂעִיר בְּאֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם׃
genesis:36:21@01-genesis/36.tex.english: and Dishon and Ezer and Dishan. These are the chiefs of the Horites, the children of Seir, in the land of Edom.

genesis:36:22@01-genesis/36.tex.original: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי לוֹטָן חֹרִי וְהֵימָם וַאֲחוֹת לוֹטָן תִּמְנָע׃
genesis:36:22@01-genesis/36.tex.english: And the children of Lotan are Hori and Hemam, and Lotan’s sister is Timna.

genesis:36:23@01-genesis/36.tex.original: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי שׁוֹבָל עַלְוָן וּמָנַחַת וְעֵיבָל שְׁפוֹ וְאוֹנָם׃
genesis:36:23@01-genesis/36.tex.english: And these are the children of Shobal: Alvan and Manahath and Ebal, Shepho and Onam.

genesis:36:24@01-genesis/36.tex.original: וְאֵלֶּה בְנֵי צִבְעוֹן וְאַיָּה וַעֲנָה הוּא עֲנָה אֲשֶׁר מָצָא אֶת הַיֵּמִם בַּמִּדְבָּר בִּרְעֹתוֹ אֶת הַחֲמֹרִים לְצִבְעוֹן אָבִיו׃
genesis:36:24@01-genesis/36.tex.english: And these are the children of Zibeon: Ajah and Anah—that is Anah who found the water in the wilderness when he tended the asses of Zibeon, his father.

genesis:36:25@01-genesis/36.tex.original: וְאֵלֶּה בְנֵי עֲנָה דִּשֹׁן וְאהֳלִיבָמָה בַּת עֲנָה׃
genesis:36:25@01-genesis/36.tex.english: And these are the children of Anah: Dishon and Aholibamah, daughter of Anah.

genesis:36:26@01-genesis/36.tex.original: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי דִישָׁן חֶמְדָּן וְאֶשְׁבָּן וְיִתְרָן וּכְרָן׃
genesis:36:26@01-genesis/36.tex.english: And these are the children of Dishon: Hemdan and Eshban and Ithran and Cheran.

genesis:36:27@01-genesis/36.tex.original: אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי אֵצֶר בִּלְהָן וְזַעֲוָן וַעֲקָן׃
genesis:36:27@01-genesis/36.tex.english: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan and Zaavan and Akan.

genesis:36:28@01-genesis/36.tex.original: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי דִישָׁן עוּץ וַאֲרָן׃
genesis:36:28@01-genesis/36.tex.english: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

genesis:36:29@01-genesis/36.tex.original: אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי הַחֹרִי אַלּוּף לוֹטָן אַלּוּף שׁוֹבָל אַלּוּף צִבְעוֹן אַלּוּף עֲנָה׃
genesis:36:29@01-genesis/36.tex.english: These are the chiefs of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,

genesis:36:30@01-genesis/36.tex.original: אַלּוּף דִּשֹׁן אַלּוּף אֵצֶר אַלּוּף דִּישָׁן אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי הַחֹרִי לְאַלֻּפֵיהֶם בְּאֶרֶץ שֵׂעִיר׃
genesis:36:30@01-genesis/36.tex.english: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, chief Dishan. These are the chiefs of the Horites by their chiefdoms in the land of Seir.

genesis:36:31@01-genesis/36.tex.original: ואלה המלכים אשר מלכו בארץ אדום לפני מלך מלך לבני ישראל׃
genesis:36:31@01-genesis/36.tex.english: And these are the kings who ruled in the land of Edom before a king ruled the children of Israel.

genesis:36:32@01-genesis/36.tex.original: וימלך באדום בלע בן בעור ושם עירו דנהבה׃
genesis:36:32@01-genesis/36.tex.english: And Bela son of Beor ruled in Edom, and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

genesis:36:33@01-genesis/36.tex.original: וימת בלע וימלך תחתיו יובב בן זרח מבצרה׃
genesis:36:33@01-genesis/36.tex.english: And Bela died, and Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah ruled in his place.

genesis:36:34@01-genesis/36.tex.original: וימת יובב וימלך תחתיו חשם מארץ התימני׃
genesis:36:34@01-genesis/36.tex.english: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani ruled in his place.

genesis:36:35@01-genesis/36.tex.original: וימת חשם וימלך תחתיו הדד בן בדד המכה את מדין בשדה מואב ושם עירו עוית׃
genesis:36:35@01-genesis/36.tex.english: And Husham died, and Hadad son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, ruled in his place, and the name of his city was Avith.

genesis:36:36@01-genesis/36.tex.original: וימת הדד וימלך תחתיו שמלה ממשרקה׃
genesis:36:36@01-genesis/36.tex.english: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah ruled in his place.

genesis:36:37@01-genesis/36.tex.original: וימת שמלה וימלך תחתיו שאול מרחבות הנהר׃
genesis:36:37@01-genesis/36.tex.english: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth on the river ruled in his place.

genesis:36:38@01-genesis/36.tex.original: וימת שאול וימלך תחתיו בעל חנן בן עכבור׃
genesis:36:38@01-genesis/36.tex.english: And Saul died, and Baal-hanan son of Achbor ruled in his place.

genesis:36:39@01-genesis/36.tex.original: וימת בעל חנן בן עכבור וימלך תחתיו הדר ושם עירו פעו ושם אשתו מהיטבאל בת מטרד בת מי זהב׃
genesis:36:39@01-genesis/36.tex.english: And Baal-hanan son of Achbor died, and Hadar ruled in his place, and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred daughter of Mezahab.

genesis:36:40@01-genesis/36.tex.original: ואלה שמות אלופי עשו למשפחתם למקמתם בשמתם אלוף תמנע אלוף עלוה אלוף יתת׃
genesis:36:40@01-genesis/36.tex.english: And these are the names of the chiefs of Esau by their families, by their places, by their names: chief Timnah, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,

genesis:36:41@01-genesis/36.tex.original: אלוף אהליבמה אלוף אלה אלוף פינן׃
genesis:36:41@01-genesis/36.tex.english: chief Aholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

genesis:36:42@01-genesis/36.tex.original: אלוף קנז אלוף תימן אלוף מבצר׃
genesis:36:42@01-genesis/36.tex.english: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

genesis:36:43@01-genesis/36.tex.original: אלוף מגדיאל אלוף עירם אלה אלופי אדום למשבתם בארץ אחזתם הוא עשו אבי אדום׃
genesis:36:43@01-genesis/36.tex.english: chief Magdiel, chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom by their homes in the land of their possession. That is Esau, father of Edom.

genesis:37:1@01-genesis/37.tex.original: וַיֵּשֶׁב יַעֲקֹב בְּאֶרֶץ מְגוּרֵי אָבִיו בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃
genesis:37:1@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And Jacob lived in the land of his father’s residences, in the land of Canaan.

genesis:37:2@01-genesis/37.tex.original: אלה תלדות יעקב יוסף בן שבע עשרה שנה היה רעה את אחיו בצאן והוא נער את בני בלהה ואת בני זלפה נשי אביו ויבא יוסף את דבתם רעה אל אביהם׃
genesis:37:2@01-genesis/37.tex.english: These are the records of Jacob: Joseph, at seventeen years old, had been tending the sheep with his brothers, and he was a boy with the sons of Bilhah and the sons of Zilpah, his father’s wives; and Joseph brought a bad report of them to their father.

genesis:37:3@01-genesis/37.tex.original: WYVRAL AHB AT YWSP MKL BNYW KY BN ZQNYM HWA LW ועשה לו כתנת פסים׃
genesis:37:3@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And Israel had loved Joseph the most of all his children because he was a son of old age to him. And he made him a coat of many colors.

genesis:37:4@01-genesis/37.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYRAW AXYW KY ATW AHB ABYHM MKL AXYW WYVNAW ATW WLA YKLW DBRW LVLM׃</bdo>
genesis:37:4@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And his brothers saw that their father loved him the most of all his brothers. And they hated him. And they were not able to speak a greeting to him.

genesis:37:5@01-genesis/37.tex.original: ויחלם יוסף חלום ויגד לאחיו ויוספו עוד שנא אתו׃
genesis:37:5@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And Joseph had a dream and told it to his brothers, and they went on to hate him more.

genesis:37:6@01-genesis/37.tex.original: ויאמר אליהם שמעו נא החלום הזה אשר חלמתי׃
genesis:37:6@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And he said to them, “Listen to this dream that I had:

genesis:37:7@01-genesis/37.tex.original: והנה אנחנו מאלמים אלמים בתוך השדה והנה קמה אלמתי וגם נצבה והנה תסבינה אלמתיכם ותשתחוין לאלמתי׃
genesis:37:7@01-genesis/37.tex.english: and here we were binding sheaves in the field; and here was my sheaf rising and standing up, too; and, here, your sheaves surrounded and bowed to my sheaf.”

genesis:37:8@01-genesis/37.tex.original: ויאמרו לו אחיו המלך תמלך עלינו אם משול תמשל בנו ויוספו עוד שנא אתו על חלמתיו ועל דבריו׃
genesis:37:8@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And his brothers said to him, “Will you rule over us?! Will you dominate us?!” And they went on to hate him more because of his dreams and because of his words.

genesis:37:9@01-genesis/37.tex.original: ויחלם עוד חלום אחר ויספר אתו לאחיו ויאמר הנה חלמתי חלום עוד והנה השמש והירח ואחד עשר כוכבים משתחוים לי׃
genesis:37:9@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And he had yet another dream and told it to his brothers. And he said, “Here, I’ve had another dream, and here were the sun and the moon and eleven stars bowing to me.”

genesis:37:10@01-genesis/37.tex.original: ויספר אל אביו ואל אחיו ויגער בו אביו ויאמר לו מה החלום הזה אשר חלמת הבוא נבוא אני ואמך ואחיך להשתחות לך ארצה׃
genesis:37:10@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And he told it to his father and to his brothers. And his father was annoyed at him and said to him, “What is this dream that you’ve had? Shall we come, I and your mother and your brothers, to bow to you to the ground?!”

genesis:37:11@01-genesis/37.tex.original: ויקנאו בו אחיו ואביו שמר את הדבר׃
genesis:37:11@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And his brothers were jealous of him, and his father took note of the thing.

genesis:37:12@01-genesis/37.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYLKW AXYW LR]WT AT CAN ABYHM BVKM׃</bdo>
genesis:37:12@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And his brothers went to feed their father’s sheep in Shechem.

genesis:37:13@01-genesis/37.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR YVRAL AL YWSP HLWA AXYK R]YM BVKM LKH WAVLXK ALYHM WYAMR LW HNNY׃</bdo>
genesis:37:13@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And Israel said to Joseph, “Aren’t your brothers feeding in Shechem? Come on and I’ll send you to them.” And he said to him, “I’m here.”

genesis:37:14@01-genesis/37.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR LW LK NA RAH AT VLWM AXYK WAT VLWM HCAN WHVBNY DBR WYVLXHW M]MQ XBRWN WYBA VKMH׃</bdo>
genesis:37:14@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And he said to him, “Go, see how your brothers are and how the sheep are and bring me back word.” And he sent him from the valley of Hebron. And he came to Shechem.

genesis:37:15@01-genesis/37.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYMCAHW AYV WHNH T]H BVDH WYVALHW HAYV LAMR MH TBQV׃</bdo>
genesis:37:15@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And a man found him, and here he was straying in a field. And the man asked him, saying, “What are you looking for?”

genesis:37:16@01-genesis/37.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR AT AXY ANKY MBQV HGYDH NA LY AYPH HM R]YM׃</bdo>
genesis:37:16@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And he said, “I’m looking for my brothers. Tell me, where are they feeding?”

genesis:37:17@01-genesis/37.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR HAYV NS]W MZH KY VM]TY AMRYM NLKH DTYNH WYLK YWSP AXR AXYW WYMCAM BDTN׃</bdo>
genesis:37:17@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And the man said, “They traveled on from here. Because I heard them saying, ‘Let’s go to Dothan.’” And Joseph went after his brothers and found them in Dothan.

genesis:37:18@01-genesis/37.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYRAW ATW MRXQ WBJRM YQRB ALYHM WYTNKLW ATW LHMYTW׃</bdo>
genesis:37:18@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And they saw him from a distance, and before he came close to them they conspired against him: to kill him.

genesis:37:19@01-genesis/37.tex.original: ויאמרו איש אל אחיו הנה בעל החלמות הלזה בא׃
genesis:37:19@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And the brothers said to one another, “Here comes the dream-master, that one there!

genesis:37:20@01-genesis/37.tex.original: ועתה לכו ונהרגהו ונשלכהו באחד הברות ואמרנו חיה רעה אכלתהו ונראה מה יהיו חלמתיו׃
genesis:37:20@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And now, come on and let’s kill him and throw him in one of the pits, and we’ll say a wild animal ate him, and we’ll see what his dreams will be!”

genesis:37:21@01-genesis/37.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYVM] RAWBN WYCLHW MYDM WYAMR LA NKNW NPV׃</bdo>
genesis:37:21@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And Reuben heard, and he saved him from their hand. And he said, “Let’s not take his life.”

genesis:37:22@01-genesis/37.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR ALHM RAWBN AL TVPKW DM HVLYKW ATW AL HBWR HZH AVR BMDBR WYD AL TVLXW BW LM]N HCYL ATW MYDM LHVYBW AL ABYW׃</bdo>
genesis:37:22@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And Reuben said to them, “Don’t spill blood. Throw him into this pit that’s in the wilderness, and don’t put out a hand against him”—in order to save him from their hand, to bring him back to his father.

genesis:37:23@01-genesis/37.tex.original: ויהי כאשר בא יוסף אל אחיו ויפשיטו את יוסף את כתנתו את כתנת הפסים אשר עליו׃
genesis:37:23@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And it was when Joseph came to his brothers: and they took off Joseph’s coat, the coat of many colors, which he had on.

genesis:37:24@01-genesis/37.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYQXHW WYVLKW ATW HBRH WHBWR RQ AYN BW MYM׃</bdo>
genesis:37:24@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And they took him and threw him into the pit. And the pit was empty; there was no water in it.

genesis:37:25@01-genesis/37.tex.original: WYVBW LAKL LXM וישאו עיניהם ויראו והנה ארחת ישמעאלים באה מגלעד וגמליהם נשאים נכאת וצרי ולט הולכים להוריד מצרימה׃
genesis:37:25@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And they sat down to eat bread. And they raised their eyes and saw, and here was a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead, and their camels were carrying spices and balsam and myrrh, going to bring them down to Egypt.

genesis:37:26@01-genesis/37.tex.original: ויאמר יהודה אל אחיו מה בצע כי נהרג את אחינו וכסינו את דמו׃
genesis:37:26@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And Judah said to his brothers, “What profit is there if we kill our brother and cover his blood?

genesis:37:27@01-genesis/37.tex.original: לכו ונמכרנו לישמעאלים וידנו אל תהי בו כי אחינו בשרנו הוא וישמעו אחיו׃
genesis:37:27@01-genesis/37.tex.english: Come on and let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites, and let our hand not be on him, because he’s our brother, our flesh.” And his brothers listened.

genesis:37:28@01-genesis/37.tex.original: WY]BRW ANVYM MDYNYM SXRYM WYMVKW WY]LW AT YWSP MN HBWR וימכרו את יוסף לישמעאלים בעשרים כסף ויביאו את יוסף מצרימה׃
genesis:37:28@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And Midianite people, merchants, passed, and they pulled and lifted Joseph from the pit. And they sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty weights of silver. And they brought Joseph to Egypt.

genesis:37:29@01-genesis/37.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYVB RAWBN AL HBWR WHNH AYN YWSP BBWR WYQR] AT BGDYW׃</bdo>
genesis:37:29@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And Reuben came back to the pit, and here: Joseph was not in the pit. And he tore his clothes.

genesis:37:30@01-genesis/37.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYVB AL AXYW WYAMR HYLD AYNNW WANY ANH ANY BA׃</bdo>
genesis:37:30@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And he went back to his brothers and said, “The boy’s gone! And I, where can I go?”

genesis:37:31@01-genesis/37.tex.original: ויקחו את כתנת יוסף וישחטו שעיר עזים ויטבלו את הכתנת בדם׃
genesis:37:31@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And they took Joseph’s coat and slaughtered a he-goat and dipped the coat in the blood.

genesis:37:32@01-genesis/37.tex.original: וישלחו את כתנת הפסים ויביאו אל אביהם ויאמרו זאת מצאנו הכר נא הכתנת בנך הוא אם לא׃
genesis:37:32@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And they sent the coat of many colors and brought it to their father and said, “We found this. Recognize: is it your son’s coat or not?”

genesis:37:33@01-genesis/37.tex.original: ויכירה ויאמר כתנת בני חיה רעה אכלתהו טרף טרף יוסף׃
genesis:37:33@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And he recognized it and said, “My son’s coat. A wild animal ate him. Joseph is torn up!”

genesis:37:34@01-genesis/37.tex.original: ויקרע יעקב שמלתיו וישם שק במתניו ויתאבל על בנו ימים רבים׃
genesis:37:34@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And Jacob ripped his clothes and wore sackcloth on his hips and mourned over his son many days.

genesis:37:35@01-genesis/37.tex.original: ויקמו כל בניו וכל בנתיו לנחמו וימאן להתנחם ויאמר כי ארד אל בני אבל שאלה ויבך אתו אביו׃
genesis:37:35@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And all his sons and all his daughters got up to console him, and he refused to be consoled, and he said, “Because I’ll go down mourning to my son at Sheol,” and his father wept for him.

genesis:37:36@01-genesis/37.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WHMDNYM MKRW ATW AL MCRYM LPWJYPR SRYS PR]H VR HJBXYM׃</bdo>
genesis:37:36@01-genesis/37.tex.english: And the Medanites sold him to Egypt, to Potiphar, an official of Pharaoh, chief of the guards.

genesis:38:1@01-genesis/38.tex.original: ויהי בעת ההוא וירד יהודה מאת אחיו ויט עד איש עדלמי ושמו חירה׃
genesis:38:1@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And it was at that time, and Judah went down from his brothers and turned to an Adullamite man, and his name was Hirah.

genesis:38:2@01-genesis/38.tex.original: וירא שם יהודה בת איש כנעני ושמו שוע ויקחה ויבא אליה׃
genesis:38:2@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And Judah saw a daughter of a Canaanite man there, and his name was Shua. And he took her and came to her.

genesis:38:3@01-genesis/38.tex.original: ותהר ותלד בן ויקרא את שמו ער׃
genesis:38:3@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And she became pregnant and gave birth to a son, and he called his name Er.

genesis:38:4@01-genesis/38.tex.original: ותהר עוד ותלד בן ותקרא את שמו אונן׃
genesis:38:4@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And she became pregnant again and gave birth to a son, and she called his name Onan.

genesis:38:5@01-genesis/38.tex.original: ותסף עוד ותלד בן ותקרא את שמו שלה והיה בכזיב בלדתה אתו׃
genesis:38:5@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And she proceeded again to give birth to a son, and she called his name Shelah. (And he was at Chezib when she gave birth to him.)

genesis:38:6@01-genesis/38.tex.original: ויקח יהודה אשה לער בכורו ושמה תמר׃
genesis:38:6@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And Judah took a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.

genesis:38:7@01-genesis/38.tex.original: ויהי ער בכור יהודה רע בעיני יהוה וימתהו יהוה׃
genesis:38:7@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And Er, Judah’s firstborn, was bad in YHWH’s eyes, and YHWH killed him.

genesis:38:8@01-genesis/38.tex.original: ויאמר יהודה לאונן בא אל אשת אחיך ויבם אתה והקם זרע לאחיך׃
genesis:38:8@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And Judah said to Onan, “Come to your brother’s wife and couple as a brother-in-law with her and raise seed for your brother.”

genesis:38:9@01-genesis/38.tex.original: וידע אונן כי לא לו יהיה הזרע והיה אם בא אל אשת אחיו ושחת ארצה לבלתי נתן זרע לאחיו׃
genesis:38:9@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And Onan knew that the seed would not be his. And it was when he came to his brother’s wife: and he spent on the ground so as not to give seed for his brother.

genesis:38:10@01-genesis/38.tex.original: וירע בעיני יהוה אשר עשה וימת גם אתו׃
genesis:38:10@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And what he did was bad in YHWH’s eyes, and He killed him, too.

genesis:38:11@01-genesis/38.tex.original: ויאמר יהודה לתמר כלתו שבי אלמנה בית אביך עד יגדל שלה בני כי אמר פן ימות גם הוא כאחיו ותלך תמר ותשב בית אביה׃
genesis:38:11@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And Judah said to Tamar, his daughter-in-law, “Live as a widow at your father’s house until my son Shelah grows up” (because he said, “Or else he, too, will die like his brothers”). And Tamar went and lived at her father’s house.

genesis:38:12@01-genesis/38.tex.original: וירבו הימים ותמת בת שוע אשת יהודה וינחם יהודה ויעל על גזזי צאנו הוא וחירה רעהו העדלמי תמנתה׃
genesis:38:12@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And the days were many, and Judah’s wife, the daughter of Shua, died. And Judah was consoled. And he went up to his sheepshearers, he and his friend Hirah, the Adullamite, to Timnah.

genesis:38:13@01-genesis/38.tex.original: ויגד לתמר לאמר הנה חמיך עלה תמנתה לגז צאנו׃
genesis:38:13@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And it was told to Tamar, saying, “Here, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”

genesis:38:14@01-genesis/38.tex.original: ותסר בגדי אלמנותה מעליה ותכס בצעיף ותתעלף ותשב בפתח עינים אשר על דרך תמנתה כי ראתה כי גדל שלה והוא לא נתנה לו לאשה׃
genesis:38:14@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And she took off her widowhood clothes from on her and covered herself with a veil and wrapped herself and sat in a visible place that was on the road to Timnah, because she saw that Shelah had grown up and she had not been given to him as a wife.

genesis:38:15@01-genesis/38.tex.original: ויראה יהודה ויחשבה לזונה כי כסתה פניה׃
genesis:38:15@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And Judah saw her and thought her to be a prostitute because she had covered her face.

genesis:38:16@01-genesis/38.tex.original: ויט אליה אל הדרך ויאמר הבה נא אבוא אליך כי לא ידע כי כלתו הוא ותאמר מה תתן לי כי תבוא אלי׃
genesis:38:16@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And he turned to her by the road. And he said, “Come on. Let me come to you,” because he did not know that she was his daughter-in-law. And she said, “What will you give me when you come to me?”

genesis:38:17@01-genesis/38.tex.original: ויאמר אנכי אשלח גדי עזים מן הצאן ותאמר אם תתן ערבון עד שלחך׃
genesis:38:17@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And he said, “I’ll have a goat kid sent from the flock.” And she said, “If you’ll give a pledge until you send it.”

genesis:38:18@01-genesis/38.tex.original: ויאמר מה הערבון אשר אתן לך ותאמר חתמך ופתילך ומטך אשר בידך ויתן לה ויבא אליה ותהר לו׃
genesis:38:18@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And he said, “What is the pledge that I’ll give you?” And she said, “Your seal and your cord and your staff that’s in your hand.” And he gave them to her, and he came to her, and she became pregnant by him.

genesis:38:19@01-genesis/38.tex.original: ותקם ותלך ותסר צעיפה מעליה ותלבש בגדי אלמנותה׃
genesis:38:19@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And she got up and went and took off her veil from on her and put on her widowhood clothes.

genesis:38:20@01-genesis/38.tex.original: וישלח יהודה את גדי העזים ביד רעהו העדלמי לקחת הערבון מיד האשה ולא מצאה׃
genesis:38:20@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And Judah sent the goat kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite to take back the pledge from the woman’s hand, and he did not find her.

genesis:38:21@01-genesis/38.tex.original: וישאל את אנשי מקמה לאמר איה הקדשה הוא בעינים על הדרך ויאמרו לא היתה בזה קדשה׃
genesis:38:21@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And he asked the people of her place, saying, “Where is the sacred prostitute? She was visibly by the road.” And they said, “There was no sacred prostitute here.”

genesis:38:22@01-genesis/38.tex.original: וישב אל יהודה ויאמר לא מצאתיה וגם אנשי המקום אמרו לא היתה בזה קדשה׃
genesis:38:22@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And he came back to Judah and said, “I didn’t find her, and also the people of the place said There was no sacred prostitute here.’”

genesis:38:23@01-genesis/38.tex.original: ויאמר יהודה תקח לה פן נהיה לבוז הנה שלחתי הגדי הזה ואתה לא מצאתה׃
genesis:38:23@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And Judah said, “Let her take them or else we’ll be a disgrace. Here, I’ve sent this goat kid, and you didn’t find her.”

genesis:38:24@01-genesis/38.tex.original: ויהי כמשלש חדשים ויגד ליהודה לאמר זנתה תמר כלתך וגם הנה הרה לזנונים ויאמר יהודה הוציאוה ותשרף׃
genesis:38:24@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And it was about three months, and it was told to Judah, saying, “Your daughter-in-law Tamar has whored, and, here, she’s pregnant by whoring as well.” And Judah said, “Bring her out and let her be burned.”

genesis:38:25@01-genesis/38.tex.original: הוא מוצאת והיא שלחה אל חמיה לאמר לאיש אשר אלה לו אנכי הרה ותאמר הכר נא למי החתמת והפתילים והמטה האלה׃
genesis:38:25@01-genesis/38.tex.english: She was brought out. And she sent to her father-in-law, saying, “I’m pregnant by the man to whom these belong,” and she said, “Recognize: to whom do these seal and cords and staff belong?”

genesis:38:26@01-genesis/38.tex.original: ויכר יהודה ויאמר צדקה ממני כי על כן לא נתתיה לשלה בני ולא יסף עוד לדעתה׃
genesis:38:26@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And Judah recognized and said, “She’s more right than I am, because of the fact that I didn’t give her to my son Shelah.” And he did not go on to know her again.

genesis:38:27@01-genesis/38.tex.original: ויהי בעת לדתה והנה תאומים בבטנה׃
genesis:38:27@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And it was at the time that she was giving birth, and here were twins in her womb.

genesis:38:28@01-genesis/38.tex.original: ויהי בלדתה ויתן יד ותקח המילדת ותקשר על ידו שני לאמר זה יצא ראשנה׃
genesis:38:28@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And it was as she was giving birth, and one put out his hand, and the midwife took a scarlet thread and tied it on his hand, saying, “This one came out first.”

genesis:38:29@01-genesis/38.tex.original: ויהי כמשיב ידו והנה יצא אחיו ותאמר מה פרצת עליך פרץ ויקרא שמו פרץ׃
genesis:38:29@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And it was as he pulled his hand back, and here his brother came out. And she said, “What a breach you’ve made for yourself!” And he called his name Perez.

genesis:38:30@01-genesis/38.tex.original: ואחר יצא אחיו אשר על ידו השני ויקרא שמו זרח׃
genesis:38:30@01-genesis/38.tex.english: And his brother who had the scarlet thread on his hand came out after. And he called his name Zerah.

genesis:39:1@01-genesis/39.tex.original: ויוסף הורד מצרימה ויקנהו פוטיפר סריס פרעה שר הטבחים איש מצרי מיד הישמעאלים אשר הורדהו שמה׃
genesis:39:1@01-genesis/39.tex.english: And Joseph had been brought down to Egypt. And an Egyptian man, Potiphar, an official of Pharaoh, chief of the guards, bought him from the hand of the Ishmaelites who had brought him down there.

genesis:39:2@01-genesis/39.tex.original: ויהי יהוה את יוסף ויהי איש מצליח ויהי בבית אדניו המצרי׃
genesis:39:2@01-genesis/39.tex.english: And YHWH was with Joseph, and he was a successful man, and he was in his Egyptian lord’s house.

genesis:39:3@01-genesis/39.tex.original: וירא אדניו כי יהוה אתו וכל אשר הוא עשה יהוה מצליח בידו׃
genesis:39:3@01-genesis/39.tex.english: And his lord saw that YHWH was with him, and YHWH made everything he was doing successful in his hand.

genesis:39:4@01-genesis/39.tex.original: וימצא יוסף חן בעיניו וישרת אתו ויפקדהו על ביתו וכל יש לו נתן בידו׃
genesis:39:4@01-genesis/39.tex.english: And Joseph found favor in his eyes, and he attended him, and he appointed him over his house and put everything he had in his hand.

genesis:39:5@01-genesis/39.tex.original: ויהי מאז הפקיד אתו בביתו ועל כל אשר יש לו ויברך יהוה את בית המצרי בגלל יוסף ויהי ברכת יהוה בכל אשר יש לו בבית ובשדה׃
genesis:39:5@01-genesis/39.tex.english: And it was from the time that he appointed him in his house and over all that he had that YHWH blessed the Egyptian’s house because of Joseph, and YHWH’s blessing was in everything that he had, in the house and in the field.

genesis:39:6@01-genesis/39.tex.original: ויעזב כל אשר לו ביד יוסף ולא ידע אתו מאומה כי אם הלחם אשר הוא אוכל ויהי יוסף יפה תאר ויפה מראה׃
genesis:39:6@01-genesis/39.tex.english: And he left everything that he had in Joseph’s hand and did not know a thing about what he had except the bread that he was eating. And Joseph had an attractive figure and was handsome.

genesis:39:7@01-genesis/39.tex.original: ויהי אחר הדברים האלה ותשא אשת אדניו את עיניה אל יוסף ותאמר שכבה עמי׃
genesis:39:7@01-genesis/39.tex.english: And it was after these things, and his lord’s wife raised her eyes to Joseph and said, “Lie with me.”

genesis:39:8@01-genesis/39.tex.original: וימאן ויאמר אל אשת אדניו הן אדני לא ידע אתי מה בבית וכל אשר יש לו נתן בידי׃
genesis:39:8@01-genesis/39.tex.english: And he refused, and he said to his lord’s wife, “Here, my lord doesn’t know what he has with me in the house, and he’s put everything that he has in my hand.

genesis:39:9@01-genesis/39.tex.original: איננו גדול בבית הזה ממני ולא חשך ממני מאומה כי אם אותך באשר את אשתו ואיך אעשה הרעה הגדלה הזאת וחטאתי לאלהים׃
genesis:39:9@01-genesis/39.tex.english: No one is bigger than I am in this house, and he hasn’t held back a thing from me except you because you’re his wife, and how could I do this great wrong? And I would sin against God.”

genesis:39:10@01-genesis/39.tex.original: ויהי כדברה אל יוסף יום יום ולא שמע אליה לשכב אצלה להיות עמה׃
genesis:39:10@01-genesis/39.tex.english: And it was, when she spoke to Joseph day after day, that he didn’t listen to her, to lie by her, to be with her.

genesis:39:11@01-genesis/39.tex.original: ויהי כהיום הזה ויבא הביתה לעשות מלאכתו ואין איש מאנשי הבית שם בבית׃
genesis:39:11@01-genesis/39.tex.english: And it was on a day like this, and he came to the house to do his work, and not one of the people of the house was there in the house.

genesis:39:12@01-genesis/39.tex.original: ותתפשהו בבגדו לאמר שכבה עמי ויעזב בגדו בידה וינס ויצא החוצה׃
genesis:39:12@01-genesis/39.tex.english: And she grasped him by his garment, saying, “Lie with me!” And he left his garment in her hand and fled and went outside.

genesis:39:13@01-genesis/39.tex.original: ויהי כראותה כי עזב בגדו בידה וינס החוצה׃
genesis:39:13@01-genesis/39.tex.english: And it was, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand and run off outside,

genesis:39:14@01-genesis/39.tex.original: ותקרא לאנשי ביתה ותאמר להם לאמר ראו הביא לנו איש עברי לצחק בנו בא אלי לשכב עמי ואקרא בקול גדול׃
genesis:39:14@01-genesis/39.tex.english: that she called to the people of her house and said to them, saying, “See, he brought us a Hebrew man to fool with us. He came to me, to lie with me, and I called in a loud voice.

genesis:39:15@01-genesis/39.tex.original: ויהי כשמעו כי הרימתי קולי ואקרא ויעזב בגדו אצלי וינס ויצא החוצה׃
genesis:39:15@01-genesis/39.tex.english: And it was when he heard that I raised my voice and called that he left his garment by me and fled and went outside.”

genesis:39:16@01-genesis/39.tex.original: ותנח בגדו אצלה עד בוא אדניו אל ביתו׃
genesis:39:16@01-genesis/39.tex.english: And she laid his garment down by her until his lord came to his house.

genesis:39:17@01-genesis/39.tex.original: ותדבר אליו כדברים האלה לאמר בא אלי העבד העברי אשר הבאת לנו לצחק בי׃
genesis:39:17@01-genesis/39.tex.english: And she spoke things like these to him, saying, “The Hebrew slave, whom you brought us, came to me, to fool with me.

genesis:39:18@01-genesis/39.tex.original: ויהי כהרימי קולי ואקרא ויעזב בגדו אצלי וינס החוצה׃
genesis:39:18@01-genesis/39.tex.english: And it was when I raised my voice and called that he left his garment by me and fled outside.”

genesis:39:19@01-genesis/39.tex.original: ויהי כשמע אדניו את דברי אשתו אשר דברה אליו לאמר כדברים האלה עשה לי עבדך ויחר אפו׃
genesis:39:19@01-genesis/39.tex.english: And it was, when his lord heard his wife’s words that she spoke to him, saying, “Your servant did things like these to me,” that his anger flared.

genesis:39:20@01-genesis/39.tex.original: ויקח אדני יוסף אתו ויתנהו אל בית הסהר מקום אשר [אסירי] (אסורי) המלך אסורים ויהי שם בבית הסהר׃
genesis:39:20@01-genesis/39.tex.english: And Joseph’s lord took him and put him in prison, a place where the king’s prisoners were kept. And he was there in the prison,

genesis:39:21@01-genesis/39.tex.original: ויהי יהוה את יוסף ויט אליו חסד ויתן חנו בעיני שר בית הסהר׃
genesis:39:21@01-genesis/39.tex.english: and YHWH was with Joseph and extended kindness to him and gave him favor in the eyes of the warden.

genesis:39:22@01-genesis/39.tex.original: ויתן שר בית הסהר ביד יוסף את כל האסירם אשר בבית הסהר ואת כל אשר עשים שם הוא היה עשה׃
genesis:39:22@01-genesis/39.tex.english: And the warden put all the prisoners who were in the prison into Joseph’s hand, and he was doing all the things that they do there.

genesis:39:23@01-genesis/39.tex.original: אין שר בית הסהר ראה את כל מאומה בידו באשר יהוה אתו ואשר הוא עשה יהוה מצליח׃
genesis:39:23@01-genesis/39.tex.english: The warden was not seeing anything in his hand because YHWH was with him, and YHWH would make whatever he did successful.

genesis:40:1@01-genesis/40.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYHY AXR HDBRYM HALH XJAW MVQH MLK MCRYM WHAPH LADNYHM LMLK MCRYM׃</bdo>
genesis:40:1@01-genesis/40.tex.english: And it was, after these things, the drink-steward of the king of Egypt and the baker sinned against their lord, against the king of Egypt.

genesis:40:2@01-genesis/40.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYQCP PR]H ]L VNY SRYSYW ]L VR HMVQYM W]L VR HAWPYM׃</bdo>
genesis:40:2@01-genesis/40.tex.english: And Pharaoh was angry at his two officers, at the chief of the drink-stewards and at the chief of the bakers,

genesis:40:3@01-genesis/40.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYTN ATM BMVMR BYT VR HJBXYM AL BYT HSHR MQWM AVR YWSP ASWR VM׃</bdo>
genesis:40:3@01-genesis/40.tex.english: and he put them under watch at the house of the chief of the guards, into prison, the place where Joseph was held.

genesis:40:4@01-genesis/40.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYPQD VR HJBXYM AT YWSP ATM WYVRT ATM WYHYW YMYM BMVMR׃</bdo>
genesis:40:4@01-genesis/40.tex.english: And the chief of the guards assigned Joseph with them, and he attended them. And they were under watch for days.

genesis:40:5@01-genesis/40.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYXLMW XLWM VNYHM AYV XLMW BLYLH AXD AYV KPTRWN XLMW HMVQH WHAPH AVR LMLK MCRYM AVR ASWRYM BBYT HSHR׃</bdo>
genesis:40:5@01-genesis/40.tex.english: And the two of them had a dream, each his own dream, in one night, each with his own dream’s meaning, the drink-steward and the baker whom the king of Egypt had, who were held in the prison.

genesis:40:6@01-genesis/40.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYBA ALYHM YWSP BBQR WYRA ATM WHNM Z]PYM׃</bdo>
genesis:40:6@01-genesis/40.tex.english: And Joseph came to them in the morning and saw them, and here they were upset.

genesis:40:7@01-genesis/40.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYVAL AT SRYSY PR]H AVR ATW BMVMR BYT ADNYW LAMR MDW] PNYKM R]YM HYWM׃</bdo>
genesis:40:7@01-genesis/40.tex.english: And he asked Pharaoh’s officers who were with him under watch at his lord’s house, saying, “Why are your faces bad today?”

genesis:40:8@01-genesis/40.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMRW ALYW XLWM XLMNW WPTR AYN ATW WYAMR ALHM YWSP HLWA LALHYM PTRNYM SPRW NA LY׃</bdo>
genesis:40:8@01-genesis/40.tex.english: And they said to him, “We had a dream, and there’s no one who can tell the meaning of it.” And Joseph said to them, “Don’t meanings belong to God? Tell me.”

genesis:40:9@01-genesis/40.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYSPR VR HMVQYM AT XLMW LYWSP WYAMR LW BXLWMY WHNH GPN LPNY׃</bdo>
genesis:40:9@01-genesis/40.tex.english: And the chief of the drink-stewards told his dream to Joseph, and he said to him, “In my dream: And here was a vine in front of me,

genesis:40:10@01-genesis/40.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WBGPN VLVH VRYGM WHWA KPRXT ]LTH NCH HBVYLW AVKLTYH ]NBYM׃</bdo>
genesis:40:10@01-genesis/40.tex.english: and in the vine were three branches, and it was like it was blooming: its blossom came up; its clusters produced grapes.

genesis:40:11@01-genesis/40.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WKWS PR]H BYDY WAQX AT H]NBYM WAVXJ ATM AL KWS PR]H WATN AT HKWS ]L KP PR]H׃</bdo>
genesis:40:11@01-genesis/40.tex.english: And Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand. And I took the grapes and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup and set the cup on Pharaoh’s hand.”

genesis:40:12@01-genesis/40.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR LW YWSP ZH PTRNW VLVT HVRGYM VLVT YMYM HM׃</bdo>
genesis:40:12@01-genesis/40.tex.english: And Joseph said to him, “This is its meaning: The three branches, they’re three days.

genesis:40:13@01-genesis/40.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">B]WD VLVT YMYM YVA PR]H AT RAVK WHVYBK ]L KNK WNTT KWS PR]H BYDW KMVPJ HRAVWN AVR HYYT MVQHW׃</bdo>
genesis:40:13@01-genesis/40.tex.english: In three more days Pharaoh will lift your head up, and he’ll put you back at your station, and you’ll set Pharaoh’s cup in his hand—like the original manner when you were his drink-steward.

genesis:40:14@01-genesis/40.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">KY AM ZKRTNY ATK KAVR YYJB LK W]VYT NA ]MDY XSD WHZKRTNY AL PR]H WHWCATNY MN HBYT HZH׃</bdo>
genesis:40:14@01-genesis/40.tex.english: So if you’ll remember me with you when it will be good for you, and you’ll practice kindness with me, then you’ll bring up the memory of me to Pharaoh, and you’ll bring me out of this house.

genesis:40:15@01-genesis/40.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">KY GNB GNBTY MARC H]BRYM WGM PH LA ]VYTY MAWMH KY VMW ATY BBWR׃</bdo>
genesis:40:15@01-genesis/40.tex.english: Because I was stolen from the land of the Hebrews; and here, too, I haven’t done anything that they should have put me in the pit.”

genesis:40:16@01-genesis/40.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYRA VR HAPYM KY JWB PTR WYAMR AL YWSP AP ANY BXLWMY WHNH VLVH SLY XRY ]L RAVY׃</bdo>
genesis:40:16@01-genesis/40.tex.english: And the chief of the bakers saw that he told a good meaning, and he said to Joseph, “Me, too. In my dream: And here were three baskets of white bread on my head,

genesis:40:17@01-genesis/40.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WBSL H]LYWN MKL MAKL PR]H M]VH APH WH]WP AKL ATM MN HSL M]L RAVY׃</bdo>
genesis:40:17@01-genesis/40.tex.english: and in the highest basket were some of all of Pharaoh’s foods, baked goods. And the birds were eating them from the basket, from on my head.”

genesis:40:18@01-genesis/40.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WY]N YWSP WYAMR ZH PTRNW VLVT HSLYM VLVT YMYM HM׃</bdo>
genesis:40:18@01-genesis/40.tex.english: And Joseph answered, and he said, “This is its meaning: The three baskets, they’re three days.

genesis:40:19@01-genesis/40.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">B]WD VLVT YMYM YVA PR]H AT RAVK M]LYK WTLH AWTK ]L ]C WAKL H]WP AT BVRK M]LYK׃</bdo>
genesis:40:19@01-genesis/40.tex.english: In three more days Pharaoh will lift your head up from you, and he’ll hang you on a tree, and the birds will eat your flesh from you.”

genesis:40:20@01-genesis/40.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYHY BYWM HVLYVY YWM HLDT AT PR]H WY]V MVTH LKL ]BDYW WYVA AT RAV VR HMVQYM WAT RAV VR HAPYM BTWK ]BDYW׃</bdo>
genesis:40:20@01-genesis/40.tex.english: And it was in the third day, Pharaoh’s birthday, and Pharaoh made a feast for all his servants. And he held up the head of the chief of the drink-stewards and the head of the chief of the bakers among his servants.

genesis:40:21@01-genesis/40.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYVB AT VR HMVQYM ]L MVQHW WYTN HKWS ]L KP PR]H׃</bdo>
genesis:40:21@01-genesis/40.tex.english: And he put the chief of the drink-stewards back over his stewardship, and he set the cup on Pharaoh’s hand;

genesis:40:22@01-genesis/40.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WAT VR HAPYM TLH KAVR PTR LHM YWSP׃</bdo>
genesis:40:22@01-genesis/40.tex.english: and he hanged the chief of the bakers—as Joseph had told the meaning for them.

genesis:40:23@01-genesis/40.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WLA ZKR VR HMVQYM AT YWSP WYVKXHW׃</bdo>
genesis:40:23@01-genesis/40.tex.english: And the chief of the drink-stewards did not remember Joseph. And he forgot him.

genesis:41:1@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYHY MQC VNTYM YMYM WPR]H XLM WHNH ]MD ]L HYAR׃</bdo>
genesis:41:1@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And it was at the end of two years’ time, and Pharaoh was dreaming: and here he was standing by the Nile.

genesis:41:2@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WHNH MN HYAR ]LT VB] PRWT YPWT MRAH WBRYAT BVR WTR]YNH BAXW׃</bdo>
genesis:41:2@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And here, coming up from the Nile, were seven cows, beautiful-looking and fat-fleshed, and they fed in the reeds.

genesis:41:3@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WHNH VB] PRWT AXRWT ]LWT AXRYHN MN HYAR R]WT MRAH WDQWT BVR WT]MDNH ACL HPRWT ]L VPT HYAR׃</bdo>
genesis:41:3@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And here were seven other cows coming up after them from the Nile, bad-looking and thin-fleshed, and they stood by the cows that were by the bank of the Nile.

genesis:41:4@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WTAKLNH HPRWT R]WT HMRAH WDQT HBVR AT VB] HPRWT YPT HMRAH WHBRYAT WYYQC PR]H׃</bdo>
genesis:41:4@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And the bad-looking and thin-fleshed cows ate the seven beautiful-looking and fat cows—and Pharaoh woke up.

genesis:41:5@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYYVN WYXLM VNYT WHNH VB] VBLYM ]LWT BQNH AXD BRYAWT WJBWT׃</bdo>
genesis:41:5@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And he slept and dreamed a second time, and here were seven ears of grain coming up on one stalk, fat and good.

genesis:41:6@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WHNH VB] VBLYM DQWT WVDWPT QDYM CMXWT AXRYHN׃</bdo>
genesis:41:6@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And here were seven ears of grain, thin and scorched by the east wind, growing after them.

genesis:41:7@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WTBL]NH HVBLYM HDQWT AT VB] HVBLYM HBRYAWT WHMLAWT WYYQC PR]H WHNH XLWM׃</bdo>
genesis:41:7@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And the thin ears of grain swallowed the seven fat and full ears of grain—and Pharaoh woke up, and here it was a dream.

genesis:41:8@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYHY BBQR WTP]M RWXW WYVLX WYQRA AT KL XRJMY MCRYM WAT KL XKMYH WYSPR PR]H LHM AT XLMW WAYN PWTR AWTM LPR]H׃</bdo>
genesis:41:8@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And it was in the morning, and his spirit was moved, and he sent and called all of Egypt’s magicians and all its wise men. And Pharaoh told them his dream, and there was no one who could tell the meaning of them to Pharaoh.

genesis:41:9@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYDBR VR HMVQYM AT PR]H LAMR AT XJAY ANY MZKYR HYWM׃</bdo>
genesis:41:9@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And the chief of the drink-stewards spoke to Pharaoh, saying, “I’m recalling my sins today:

genesis:41:10@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">PR]H QCP ]L ]BDYW WYTN ATY BMVMR BYT VR HJBXYM ATY WAT VR HAPYM׃</bdo>
genesis:41:10@01-genesis/41.tex.english: Pharaoh had been angry at his servants, and he put me under watch at the house of the chief of the guards, me and the chief of the bakers.

genesis:41:11@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WNXLMH XLWM BLYLH AXD ANY WHWA AYV KPTRWN XLMW XLMNW׃</bdo>
genesis:41:11@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And we had a dream in one night, I and he; we each dreamed with his own dream’s meaning.

genesis:41:12@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WVM ATNW N]R ]BRY ]BD LVR HJBXYM WNSPR LW WYPTR LNW AT XLMTYNW AYV KXLMW PTR׃</bdo>
genesis:41:12@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And there, with us, was a Hebrew boy, a slave of the chief of the guards; and we told him, and he told us the meaning of our dreams. He told the meaning according to each one’s dream.

genesis:41:13@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYHY KAVR PTR LNW KN HYH ATY HVYB ]L KNY WATW TLH׃</bdo>
genesis:41:13@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And it was—as he told the meaning for us, so it was: me he put back at my station, and him he hanged.”

genesis:41:14@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYVLX PR]H WYQRA AT YWSP WYRYCHW MN HBWR WYGLX WYXLP VMLTYW WYBA AL PR]H׃</bdo>
genesis:41:14@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they rushed him from the pit, and he shaved and changed his clothing and came to Pharaoh.

genesis:41:15@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR PR]H AL YWSP XLWM XLMTY WPTR AYN ATW WANY VM]TY ]LYK LAMR TVM] XLWM LPTR ATW׃</bdo>
genesis:41:15@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I’ve had a dream, and there’s no one who can tell the meaning of it, and I’ve heard about you, saying you hear a dream so as to tell the meaning of it.”

genesis:41:16@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WY]N YWSP AT PR]H LAMR BL]DY ALHYM Y]NH AT VLWM PR]H׃</bdo>
genesis:41:16@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, “Not I. will answer regarding Pharaoh’s well-being.”

genesis:41:17@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYDBR PR]H AL YWSP BXLMY HNNY ]MD ]L VPT HYAR׃</bdo>
genesis:41:17@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, “In my dream, here I was standing by the bank of the Nile.

genesis:41:18@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WHNH MN HYAR ]LT VB] PRWT BRYAWT BVR WYPT TAR WTR]YNH BAXW׃</bdo>
genesis:41:18@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And here, coming up from the Nile, were seven cows, fat-fleshed and beautiful-figured, and they fed in the reeds.

genesis:41:19@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WHNH VB] PRWT AXRWT ]LWT AXRYHN DLWT WR]WT TAR MAD WRQWT BVR LA RAYTY KHNH BKL ARC MCRYM LR]׃</bdo>
genesis:41:19@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And here were seven other cows coming up after them, weak and very bad-figured and scrawny-fleshed. I haven’t seen any like these in all the land of Egypt for bad!

genesis:41:20@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WTAKLNH HPRWT HRQWT WHR]WT AT VB] HPRWT HRAVNWT HBRYAT׃</bdo>
genesis:41:20@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And the cows that were scrawny and bad ate the first seven cows that were fat,

genesis:41:21@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WTBANH AL QRBNH WLA NWD] KY BAW AL QRBNH WMRAYHN R] KAVR BTXLH WAYQC׃</bdo>
genesis:41:21@01-genesis/41.tex.english: and they came inside, and it wasn’t known that they had come inside! And their appearance was bad, as at first. And I woke up.

genesis:41:22@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WARA BXLMY WHNH VB] VBLYM ]LT BQNH AXD MLAT WJBWT׃</bdo>
genesis:41:22@01-genesis/41.tex.english: “And I saw in my dream, and here were seven ears of grain coming up on one stalk, full and good.

genesis:41:23@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WHNH VB] VBLYM CNMWT DQWT VDPWT QDYM CMXWT AXRYHM׃</bdo>
genesis:41:23@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And here were seven ears of grain, dried up, thin, scorched by the east wind, growing after them.

genesis:41:24@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WTBL]N HVBLYM HDQT AT VB] HVBLYM HJBWT WAMR AL HXRJMYM WAYN MGYD LY׃</bdo>
genesis:41:24@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And the thin ears of grain swallowed the seven good ears of grain. “And I said it to the magicians, and there’s no one who can tell me.”

genesis:41:25@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR YWSP AL PR]H XLWM PR]H AXD HWA AT AVR HALHYM ]VH HGYD LPR]H׃</bdo>
genesis:41:25@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And Joseph said to Pharaoh, “Pharaoh’s dream: it is one. It has told to Pharaoh what God is doing.

genesis:41:26@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">VB] PRT HJBT VB] VNYM HNH WVB] HVBLYM HJBT VB] VNYM HNH XLWM AXD HWA׃</bdo>
genesis:41:26@01-genesis/41.tex.english: The seven good cows: they’re seven years. And the seven good ears of grain: they’re seven years. It’s one dream.

genesis:41:27@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WVB] HPRWT HRQWT WHR]T H]LT AXRYHN VB] VNYM HNH WVB] HVBLYM HRQWT VDPWT HQDYM YHYW VB] VNY R]B׃</bdo>
genesis:41:27@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And the seven cows that were scrawny and bad that were coming up after them: they’re seven years. And the seven ears of grain that were scrawny, scorched by the east wind, will be seven years of famine.

genesis:41:28@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">HWA HDBR AVR DBRTY AL PR]H AVR HALHYM ]VH HRAH AT PR]H׃</bdo>
genesis:41:28@01-genesis/41.tex.english: That is the thing that I spoke to Pharaoh: it has shown Pharaoh what God is doing.

genesis:41:29@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">HNH VB] VNYM BAWT VB] GDWL BKL ARC MCRYM׃</bdo>
genesis:41:29@01-genesis/41.tex.english: Here, seven years are coming: big bountifulness in all the land of Egypt.

genesis:41:30@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WQMW VB] VNY R]B AXRYHN WNVKX KL HVB] BARC MCRYM WKLH HR]B AT HARC׃</bdo>
genesis:41:30@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And seven years of famine will rise after them, and all the bountifulness in the land of Egypt will be forgotten, and the famine will finish off the land.

genesis:41:31@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WLA YWD] HVB] BARC MPNY HR]B HHWA AXRY KN KY KBD HWA MAD׃</bdo>
genesis:41:31@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And the bountifulness won’t be known in the land on account of that famine afterwards because it will be very heavy.

genesis:41:32@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">W]L HVNWT HXLWM AL PR]H P]MYM KY NKWN HDBR M]M HALHYM WMMHR HALHYM L]VTW׃</bdo>
genesis:41:32@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And about the recurrence of the dream to Pharaoh two times: because the thing is right from God, and God is hurrying to do it.

genesis:41:33@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">W]TH YRA PR]H AYV NBWN WXKM WYVYTHW ]L ARC MCRYM׃</bdo>
genesis:41:33@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And now, let Pharaoh look out for an understanding and wise man and set him over the land of Egypt.

genesis:41:34@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">Y]VH PR]H WYPQD PQDYM ]L HARC WXMV AT ARC MCRYM BVB] VNY HVB]׃</bdo>
genesis:41:34@01-genesis/41.tex.english: Let Pharaoh do it and appoint overseers over the land and five-out the land of Egypt in the seven years of bountifulness.

genesis:41:35@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYQBCW AT KL AKL HVNYM HJBWT HBAT HALH WYCBRW BR TXT YD PR]H AKL B]RYM WVMRW׃</bdo>
genesis:41:35@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And let them gather all the food of these coming good years and pile up grain under Pharaoh’s hand, food in the cities, and watch over it.

genesis:41:36@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WHYH HAKL LPQDWN LARC LVB] VNY HR]B AVR THYYN BARC MCRYM WLA TKRT HARC BR]B׃</bdo>
genesis:41:36@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And the food will become a deposit for the land for the seven years of famine that will be in the land of Egypt so the land won’t be cut off in the famine.”

genesis:41:37@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYYJB HDBR B]YNY PR]H WB]YNY KL ]BDYW׃</bdo>
genesis:41:37@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And the thing was good in Pharaoh’s eyes and in all his servants’ eyes.

genesis:41:38@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR PR]H AL ]BDYW HNMCA KZH AYV AVR RWX ALHYM BW׃</bdo>
genesis:41:38@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And Pharaoh said to his servants, “Will we find such a man as this, that God’s spirit is in him?”

genesis:41:39@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR PR]H AL YWSP AXRY HWDY] ALHYM AWTK AT KL ZAT AYN NBWN WXKM KMWK׃</bdo>
genesis:41:39@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Since God has made you know all this, there’s no one as understanding and wise as you.

genesis:41:40@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">ATH THYH ]L BYTY W]L PYK YVQ KL ]MY RQ HKSA AGDL MMK׃</bdo>
genesis:41:40@01-genesis/41.tex.english: You shall be over my house, and at your mouth all my people shall conform. I shall be greater than you only in the throne.”

genesis:41:41@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR PR]H AL YWSP RAH NTTY ATK ]L KL ARC MCRYM׃</bdo>
genesis:41:41@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, “See, I’ve put you over all the land of Egypt.”

genesis:41:42@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYSR PR]H AT JB]TW M]L YDW WYTN ATH ]L YD YWSP WYLBV ATW BGDY VV WYVM RBD HZHB ]L CWARW׃</bdo>
genesis:41:42@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand and put it on Joseph’s hand, and he had him dressed in linen garments, and he set a gold chain on his neck,

genesis:41:43@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYRKB ATW BMRKBT HMVNH AVR LW WYQRAW LPNYW ABRK WNTWN ATW ]L KL ARC MCRYM׃</bdo>
genesis:41:43@01-genesis/41.tex.english: and he had him driven in the chariot of the second-in-command whom he had, and they called in front of him, “Kneel,” so putting him over all the land of Egypt.

genesis:41:44@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR PR]H AL YWSP ANY PR]H WBL]DYK LA YRYM AYV AT YDW WAT RGLW BKL ARC MCRYM׃</bdo>
genesis:41:44@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh, and without you a man won’t lift his hand and his foot in all the land of Egypt.”

genesis:41:45@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYQRA PR]H VM YWSP CPNT P]NX WYTN LW AT ASNT BT PWJY PR] KHN AN LAVH WYCA YWSP ]L ARC MCRYM׃</bdo>
genesis:41:45@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphenathpaneah. And he gave him Asenath, daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, as a wife. And Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.

genesis:41:46@01-genesis/41.tex.original: וְיוֹסֵף בֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה בְּעמְדוֹ לִפְנֵי פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם ויצא יוסף מלפני פרעה ויעבר בכל ארץ מצרים׃
genesis:41:46@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood in front of Pharaoh, king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from in front of Pharaoh and passed through all the land of Egypt.

genesis:41:47@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WT]V HARC BVB] VNY HVB] LQMCYM׃</bdo>
genesis:41:47@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And the land produced in the seven years of bountifulness by fistfuls.

genesis:41:48@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYQBC AT KL AKL VB] VNYM AVR HYW BARC MCRYM WYTN AKL B]RYM AKL VDH H]YR AVR SBYBTYH NTN BTWKH׃</bdo>
genesis:41:48@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And he gathered all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and he put food in cities; he put the food of the city’s fields that were around it inside of it.

genesis:41:49@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYCBR YWSP BR KXWL HYM HRBH MAD ]D KY XDL LSPR KY AYN MSPR׃</bdo>
genesis:41:49@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And Joseph piled up grain like the sand of the sea, very much, until he stopped counting, because it was without number.

genesis:41:50@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WLYWSP YLD VNY BNYM BJRM TBWA VNT HR]B AVR YLDH LW ASNT BT PWJY PR] KHN AWN׃</bdo>
genesis:41:50@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And two sons were born to Joseph before the year of famine came—to whom Asenath, daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, gave birth for him.

genesis:41:51@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYQRA YWSP AT VM HBKWR MNVH KY NVNY ALHYM AT KL ]MLY WAT KL BYT ABY׃</bdo>
genesis:41:51@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And Joseph called the firstborn’s name Manasseh, “because God has made me forget all of my trouble and all of my father’s house.”

genesis:41:52@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WAT VM HVNY QRA APRYM KY HPRNY ALHYM BARC ]NYY׃</bdo>
genesis:41:52@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And he called the second one’s name Ephraim, “because God has made me fruitful in the land of my degradation.”

genesis:41:53@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WTKLYNH VB] VNY HVB] AVR HYH BARC MCRYM׃</bdo>
genesis:41:53@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And the seven years of the bountifulness that was in the land of Egypt finished,

genesis:41:54@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WTXLYNH VB] VNY HR]B LBWA KAVR AMR YWSP WYHY R]B BKL HARCWT WBKL ARC MCRYM HYH LXM׃</bdo>
genesis:41:54@01-genesis/41.tex.english: and the seven years of famine started to come, as Joseph had said. And there was famine in all the lands, and in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

genesis:41:55@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WTR]B KL ARC MCRYM WYC]Q H]M AL PR]H LLXM WYAMR PR]H LKL MCRYM LKW AL YWSP AVR YAMR LKM T]VW׃</bdo>
genesis:41:55@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And all the land of Egypt hungered, and the people cried to Pharaoh for the bread, and Pharaoh said to all Egypt, “Go to Joseph. Do what he’ll tell you.”

genesis:41:56@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WHR]B HYH ]L KL PNY HARC WYPTX YWSP AT KL AVR BHM WYVBR LMCRYM WYXZQ HR]B BARC MCRYM׃</bdo>
genesis:41:56@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And the famine was on all the face of the earth. And Joseph opened everything that was in them and sold to Egypt. And the famine was strong in the land of Egypt.

genesis:41:57@01-genesis/41.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WKL HARC BAW MCRYMH LVBR AL YWSP KY XZQ HR]B BKL HARC׃</bdo>
genesis:41:57@01-genesis/41.tex.english: And all the earth came to Egypt to buy, to Joseph, because the famine was strong in all the earth.

genesis:42:1@01-genesis/42.tex.original: וירא יעקב כי יש שבר במצרים ויאמר יעקב לבניו למה תתראו׃
genesis:42:1@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt, and Jacob said to his sons, “Why do you look at each other?”

genesis:42:2@01-genesis/42.tex.original: ויאמר הנה שמעתי כי יש שבר במצרים רדו שמה ושברו לנו משם ונחיה ולא נמות׃
genesis:42:2@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And he said, “Here I’ve heard that there’s grain in Egypt. Go down there and buy grain for us from there, and we’ll live and not die.”

genesis:42:3@01-genesis/42.tex.original: וירדו אחי יוסף עשרה לשבר בר ממצרים׃
genesis:42:3@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And ten of Joseph’s brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt,

genesis:42:4@01-genesis/42.tex.original: ואת בנימין אחי יוסף לא שלח יעקב את אחיו כי אמר פן יקראנו אסון׃
genesis:42:4@01-genesis/42.tex.english: and Jacob did not send Joseph’s brother Benjamin with his brothers because, he said, “In case some harm will happen to him.”

genesis:42:5@01-genesis/42.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYBAW BNY YVRAL LVBR BTWK HBAYM KY HYH HR]B BARC KN]N׃</bdo>
genesis:42:5@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And the sons of Israel came to buy among those who were coming, because the famine was in the land of Canaan.

genesis:42:6@01-genesis/42.tex.original: ויוסף הוא השליט על הארץ הוא המשביר לכל עם הארץ ויבאו אחי יוסף וישתחוו לו אפים ארצה׃
genesis:42:6@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And Joseph was the one in charge over the land; he was the one who sold grain to all the people of the land. And Joseph’s brothers came and bowed to him, noses to the ground.

genesis:42:7@01-genesis/42.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYRA YWSP AT AXYW WYKRM WYTNKR ALYHM WYDBR ATM QVWT WYAMR ALHM MAYN BATM WYAMRW MARC KN]N LVBR AKL׃</bdo>
genesis:42:7@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And Joseph saw his brothers and recognized them, but he made himself unrecognizable to them, and he spoke with them in hard tones. And he said to them, “From where have you come?” And they said, “From the land of Canaan, to buy food.”

genesis:42:8@01-genesis/42.tex.original: ויכר יוסף את אחיו והם לא הכרהו׃
genesis:42:8@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And Joseph recognized his brothers, but they did not recognize him,

genesis:42:9@01-genesis/42.tex.original: ויזכר יוסף את החלמות אשר חלם להם ויאמר אלהם מרגלים אתם לראות את ערות הארץ באתם׃
genesis:42:9@01-genesis/42.tex.english: and Joseph remembered the dreams that he had had about them. And he said to them, “You’re spies. You came to see the land exposed.”

genesis:42:10@01-genesis/42.tex.original: ויאמרו אליו לא אדני ועבדיך באו לשבר אכל׃
genesis:42:10@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And they said to him, “No, my lord, your servants came to buy food.

genesis:42:11@01-genesis/42.tex.original: כלנו בני איש אחד נחנו כנים אנחנו לא היו עבדיך מרגלים׃
genesis:42:11@01-genesis/42.tex.english: We’re all sons of one man. We’re honest men. Your servants weren’t spying.”

genesis:42:12@01-genesis/42.tex.original: ויאמר אלהם לא כי ערות הארץ באתם לראות׃
genesis:42:12@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And he said to them, “No, but you’ve come to see the land exposed.”

genesis:42:13@01-genesis/42.tex.original: ויאמרו שנים עשר עבדיך אחים אנחנו בני איש אחד בארץ כנען והנה הקטן את אבינו היום והאחד איננו׃
genesis:42:13@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And they said, “Your servants are twelve brothers. We’re sons of one man in the land of Canaan, and, here, the youngest is with our father today, and one is no more.”

genesis:42:14@01-genesis/42.tex.original: ויאמר אלהם יוסף הוא אשר דברתי אלכם לאמר מרגלים אתם׃
genesis:42:14@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And Joseph said to them, “It’s as I spoke to you, saying: you’re spies.

genesis:42:15@01-genesis/42.tex.original: בזאת תבחנו חי פרעה אם תצאו מזה כי אם בבוא אחיכם הקטן הנה׃
genesis:42:15@01-genesis/42.tex.english: By this you’ll be tested: by Pharaoh’s life, you won’t go out of here except by your youngest brother’s coming here.

genesis:42:16@01-genesis/42.tex.original: שלחו מכם אחד ויקח את אחיכם ואתם האסרו ויבחנו דבריכם האמת אתכם ואם לא חי פרעה כי מרגלים אתם׃
genesis:42:16@01-genesis/42.tex.english: Send one from among you, and let him get your brother, and you remain in prison, and your words will be tested: is the truth with you? And if not, then by Pharaoh’s life you’re spies.”

genesis:42:17@01-genesis/42.tex.original: ויאסף אתם אל משמר שלשת ימים׃
genesis:42:17@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And he gathered them under watch for three days.

genesis:42:18@01-genesis/42.tex.original: ויאמר אלהם יוסף ביום השלישי זאת עשו וחיו את האלהים אני ירא׃
genesis:42:18@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And Joseph said to them on the third day, “Do this and live, as I fear God:

genesis:42:19@01-genesis/42.tex.original: אם כנים אתם אחיכם אחד יאסר בבית משמרכם ואתם לכו הביאו שבר רעבון בתיכם׃
genesis:42:19@01-genesis/42.tex.english: If you’re honest, one brother from among you will be held at the place where you’re under watch; and you, go, bring grain for the famine in your houses.

genesis:42:20@01-genesis/42.tex.original: ואת אחיכם הקטן תביאו אלי ויאמנו דבריכם ולא תמותו ויעשו כן׃
genesis:42:20@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And you will bring your youngest brother to me, and your words will be confirmed, and you won’t die.” And they did so.

genesis:42:21@01-genesis/42.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMRW AYV AL AXYW ABL AVMYM ANXNW ]L AXYNW AVR RAYNW CRT NPVW BHTXNNW ALYNW WLA VM]NW ]L KN BAH ALYNW HCRH HZAT׃</bdo>
genesis:42:21@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And they said, each to his brother, “But we’re guilty over our brother, because we saw his soul’s distress when he implored us and we didn’t listen. On account of that this distress has come to us!”

genesis:42:22@01-genesis/42.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WY]N RAWBN ATM LAMR HLWA AMRTY ALYKM LAMR AL TXJAW BYLD WLA VM]TM WGM DMW HNH NDRV׃</bdo>
genesis:42:22@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And Reuben answered them, saying, “Didn’t I say to you, saying, ‘Don’t sin against the boy’? And you didn’t listen. And his blood, too, is required here!”

genesis:42:23@01-genesis/42.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WHM LA YD]W KY VM] YWSP KY HMLYC BYNTM׃</bdo>
genesis:42:23@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And they did not know that Joseph was listening, because an interpreter was between them.

genesis:42:24@01-genesis/42.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYSB M]LYHM WYBK WYVB ALHM WYDBR ALHM WYQX MATM AT VM]WN WYASR ATW L]YNYHM׃</bdo>
genesis:42:24@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And he turned from them and wept. And he came back to them and spoke to them and took Simeon from them and shackled him before their eyes.

genesis:42:25@01-genesis/42.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYCW YWSP WYMLAW AT KLYHM BR WLHVYB KSPYHM AYV AL VQW WLTT LHM CDH LDRK WY]V LHM KN׃</bdo>
genesis:42:25@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And Joseph commanded that they fill their containers with grain and to put their silver back in each man’s sack and to give them provisions for the road. And he did that for them.

genesis:42:26@01-genesis/42.tex.original: וישאו את שברם על חמריהם וילכו משם׃
genesis:42:26@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And they loaded their grain on their asses and went from there.

genesis:42:27@01-genesis/42.tex.original: ויפתח האחד את שקו לתת מספוא לחמרו במלון וירא את כספו והנה הוא בפי אמתחתו׃
genesis:42:27@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And one opened his sack to give fodder to his ass at a lodging place, and he saw his silver, and here it was in the mouth of his bag.

genesis:42:28@01-genesis/42.tex.original: ויאמר אל אחיו הושב כספי וגם הנה באמתחתי ויצא לבם ויחרדו איש אל אחיו לאמר מה זאת עשה אלהים לנו׃
genesis:42:28@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And he said to his brothers, “My silver’s been put back, and here it is in my bag, too.” And their heart went out, and the brothers trembled to one another, saying, “What is this that God has done to us?”

genesis:42:29@01-genesis/42.tex.original: ויבאו אל יעקב אביהם ארצה כנען ויגידו לו את כל הקרת אתם לאמר׃
genesis:42:29@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And they came to Jacob, their father, to the land of Canaan, and told him all the things that happened to them, saying,

genesis:42:30@01-genesis/42.tex.original: דבר האיש אדני הארץ אתנו קשות ויתן אתנו כמרגלים את הארץ׃
genesis:42:30@01-genesis/42.tex.english: “The man, the lord of the land, spoke with us hard and accused us of spying on the land.

genesis:42:31@01-genesis/42.tex.original: ונאמר אליו כנים אנחנו לא היינו מרגלים׃
genesis:42:31@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And we said to him, ‘We’re honest. We weren’t spying.

genesis:42:32@01-genesis/42.tex.original: שנים עשר אנחנו אחים בני אבינו האחד איננו והקטן היום את אבינו בארץ כנען׃
genesis:42:32@01-genesis/42.tex.english: We’re twelve brothers, our father’s sons; one is no more, and the youngest is with our father in the land of Canaan today’.

genesis:42:33@01-genesis/42.tex.original: ויאמר אלינו האיש אדני הארץ בזאת אדע כי כנים אתם אחיכם האחד הניחו אתי ואת רעבון בתיכם קחו ולכו׃
genesis:42:33@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And the man, the lord of the land, said to us, ‘By this I’ll know that you’re honest: leave one brother from among you with me, and take for the famine in your houses and go,

genesis:42:34@01-genesis/42.tex.original: והביאו את אחיכם הקטן אלי ואדעה כי לא מרגלים אתם כי כנים אתם את אחיכם אתן לכם ואת הארץ תסחרו׃
genesis:42:34@01-genesis/42.tex.english: and bring your youngest brother to me, so I may know that you aren’t spies, that you’re honest. I’ll give you your brother, and you’ll go around in the land.’”

genesis:42:35@01-genesis/42.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYHY HM MRYQYM VQYHM WHNH AYV CRWR KSPW BVQW WYRAW AT CRRWT KSPYHM HMH WABYHM WYYRAW׃</bdo>
genesis:42:35@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And it was: they were emptying their sacks, and here was each man’s bundle of silver in his sack, and they saw the bundles of their silver, they and their father, and they were afraid.

genesis:42:36@01-genesis/42.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR ALHM Y]QB ABYHM ATY VKLTM YWSP AYNNW WVM]WN AYNNW WAT BNYMN TQXW ]LY HYW KLNH׃</bdo>
genesis:42:36@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And their father, Jacob, said to them, “You’ve bereaved me! Joseph is gone, and Simeon’s gone, and you’ll take Benjamin. All these have happened to me!”

genesis:42:37@01-genesis/42.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR RAWBN AL ABYW LAMR AT VNY BNY TMYT AM LA ABYANW ALYK TNH ATW ]L YDY WANY AVYBNW ALYK׃</bdo>
genesis:42:37@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And Reuben said to his father, saying, “Kill my two sons if I don’t bring him back to you. Put him in my hand, and I’ll bring him back to you.”

genesis:42:38@01-genesis/42.tex.original: ויאמר לא ירד בני עמכם כי אחיו מת והוא לבדו נשאר וקראהו אסון בדרך אשר תלכו בה והורדתם את שיבתי ביגון שאולה׃
genesis:42:38@01-genesis/42.tex.english: And he said, “My son will not go down with you. Because his brother’s dead, and he’s left by himself, and if some harm would happen to him on the way in which you’re going then you’ll bring down my gray hair in anguish to Sheol.”

genesis:43:1@01-genesis/43.tex.original: והרעב כבד בארץ׃
genesis:43:1@01-genesis/43.tex.english: And the famine was heavy in the land.

genesis:43:2@01-genesis/43.tex.original: ויהי כאשר כלו לאכל את השבר אשר הביאו ממצרים ויאמר אליהם אביהם שבו שברו לנו מעט אכל׃
genesis:43:2@01-genesis/43.tex.english: And it was when they had finished eating the grain that they had brought from Egypt: and their father said to them, “Go back. Buy us a little food.”

genesis:43:3@01-genesis/43.tex.original: ויאמר אליו יהודה לאמר העד העד בנו האיש לאמר לא תראו פני בלתי אחיכם אתכם׃
genesis:43:3@01-genesis/43.tex.english: And Judah said to him, saying, “The man certified to us, saying, ‘You won’t see my face unless your brother is with you.’

genesis:43:4@01-genesis/43.tex.original: אם ישך משלח את אחינו אתנו נרדה ונשברה לך אכל׃
genesis:43:4@01-genesis/43.tex.english: If you’re sending our brother with us, we’ll go down and buy food for you,

genesis:43:5@01-genesis/43.tex.original: ואם אינך משלח לא נרד כי האיש אמר אלינו לא תראו פני בלתי אחיכם אתכם׃
genesis:43:5@01-genesis/43.tex.english: and if you’re not sending, we won’t go down, because the man said to us, ‘You won’t see my face unless your brother is with you.’”

genesis:43:6@01-genesis/43.tex.original: ויאמר ישראל למה הרעתם לי להגיד לאיש העוד לכם אח׃
genesis:43:6@01-genesis/43.tex.english: And Israel said, “Why have you done me wrong, to tell the man that you have another brother?”

genesis:43:7@01-genesis/43.tex.original: ויאמרו שאול שאל האיש לנו ולמולדתנו לאמר העוד אביכם חי היש לכם אח ונגד לו על פי הדברים האלה הידוע נדע כי יאמר הורידו את אחיכם׃
genesis:43:7@01-genesis/43.tex.english: And they said, “The man asked about us and about our birthplace, saying, ‘Is your father still alive? Do you have a brother?’ And we told him about these things. Could we have known that he would say, ‘Bring your brother down’?”

genesis:43:8@01-genesis/43.tex.original: ויאמר יהודה אל ישראל אביו שלחה הנער אתי ונקומה ונלכה ונחיה ולא נמות גם אנחנו גם אתה גם טפנו׃
genesis:43:8@01-genesis/43.tex.english: And Judah said to Israel, his father, “Send the boy with me, so we may get up and go, and we’ll live and not die, we and you and our infants as well.

genesis:43:9@01-genesis/43.tex.original: אנכי אערבנו מידי תבקשנו אם לא הביאתיו אליך והצגתיו לפניך וחטאתי לך כל הימים׃
genesis:43:9@01-genesis/43.tex.english: I’ll be security for him. You’ll seek him from my hand. If I don’t bring him to you and set him before you, then I’ll have sinned against you for all time.

genesis:43:10@01-genesis/43.tex.original: כי לולא התמהמהנו כי עתה שבנו זה פעמים׃
genesis:43:10@01-genesis/43.tex.english: For, if we hadn’t delayed, by now we would have come back twice.”

genesis:43:11@01-genesis/43.tex.original: ויאמר אלהם ישראל אביהם אם כן אפוא זאת עשו קחו מזמרת הארץ בכליכם והורידו לאיש מנחה מעט צרי ומעט דבש נכאת ולט בטנים ושקדים׃
genesis:43:11@01-genesis/43.tex.english: And Israel, their father, said to them, “If that’s how it is, then do this: Take some of the best fruit of the land in your containers and take a gift down to the man, a little balm and a little honey, gum and myrrh, pistachios and almonds.

genesis:43:12@01-genesis/43.tex.original: וכסף משנה קחו בידכם ואת הכסף המושב בפי אמתחתיכם תשיבו בידכם אולי משגה הוא׃
genesis:43:12@01-genesis/43.tex.english: And take double the silver in your hand, and take back in your hand the silver that was put back in the mouth of your bags. Maybe it was a mistake.

genesis:43:13@01-genesis/43.tex.original: ואת אחיכם קחו וקומו שובו אל האיש׃
genesis:43:13@01-genesis/43.tex.english: And take your brother. And get up, go back to the man.

genesis:43:14@01-genesis/43.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WAL VDY YTN LKM RXMYM LPNY HAYV WVLX LKM AT AXYKM AXR WAT BNYMYN WANY KAVR VKLTY VKLTY׃</bdo>
genesis:43:14@01-genesis/43.tex.english: And may El Shadday give you mercy before the man, so he’ll send your other brother and Benjamin to you. And I: if I’m bereaved I’m bereaved!”

genesis:43:15@01-genesis/43.tex.original: ויקחו האנשים את המנחה הזאת ומשנה כסף לקחו בידם ואת בנימן ויקמו וירדו מצרים ויעמדו לפני יוסף׃
genesis:43:15@01-genesis/43.tex.english: And the men took this gift and took double the silver in their hand and Benjamin and got up and went down to Egypt and stood before Joseph.

genesis:43:16@01-genesis/43.tex.original: וירא יוסף אתם את בנימין ויאמר לאשר על ביתו הבא את האנשים הביתה וטבח טבח והכן כי אתי יאכלו האנשים בצהרים׃
genesis:43:16@01-genesis/43.tex.english: And Joseph saw Benjamin with them and said to the one who was over his house, “Bring the men to the house, and slaughter and prepare an animal, because the men will eat with me at noon.”

genesis:43:17@01-genesis/43.tex.original: ויעש האיש כאשר אמר יוסף ויבא האיש את האנשים ביתה יוסף׃
genesis:43:17@01-genesis/43.tex.english: And the man did as Joseph said, and the man brought the men to Joseph’s house.

genesis:43:18@01-genesis/43.tex.original: וייראו האנשים כי הובאו בית יוסף ויאמרו על דבר הכסף השב באמתחתינו בתחלה אנחנו מובאים להתגלל עלינו ולהתנפל עלינו ולקחת אתנו לעבדים ואת חמרינו׃
genesis:43:18@01-genesis/43.tex.english: And the men were afraid because they were brought to Joseph’s house, and they said, “We’re being brought on account of the silver that came back in our bags the first time, in order to roll over us and to fall upon us and to take us as slaves—and our asses.”

genesis:43:19@01-genesis/43.tex.original: ויגשו אל האיש אשר על בית יוסף וידברו אליו פתח הבית׃
genesis:43:19@01-genesis/43.tex.english: And they went over to the man who was over Joseph’s house and spoke to him at the entrance of the house

genesis:43:20@01-genesis/43.tex.original: ויאמרו בי אדני ירד ירדנו בתחלה לשבר אכל׃
genesis:43:20@01-genesis/43.tex.english: and said, “Please, my lord, we came down the first time to buy food,

genesis:43:21@01-genesis/43.tex.original: ויהי כי באנו אל המלון ונפתחה את אמתחתינו והנה כסף איש בפי אמתחתו כספנו במשקלו ונשב אתו בידנו׃
genesis:43:21@01-genesis/43.tex.english: and it was when we came to the lodging place, and we opened our bags, and here was each man’s silver in the mouth of his bag, our money in its full weight. And we’ve brought it in our hand,

genesis:43:22@01-genesis/43.tex.original: וכסף אחר הורדנו בידנו לשבר אכל לא ידענו מי שם כספנו באמתחתינו׃
