genesis:43:22@01-genesis/43.tex.english: and we’ve brought down additional silver in our hand to buy food. We don’t know who put our silver in our bags.”

genesis:43:23@01-genesis/43.tex.original: ויאמר שלום לכם אל תיראו אלהיכם ואלהי אביכם נתן לכם מטמון באמתחתיכם כספכם בא אלי WYWCA ALHM AT VM]WN׃
genesis:43:23@01-genesis/43.tex.english: And he said, “Peace to you. Don’t be afraid. Your God and your father’s God put treasure in your bags for you. Your silver came to me.” And he brought Simeon out to them.

genesis:43:24@01-genesis/43.tex.original: ויבא האיש את האנשים ביתה יוסף ויתן מים וירחצו רגליהם ויתן מספוא לחמריהם׃
genesis:43:24@01-genesis/43.tex.english: And the man brought the men to Joseph’s house, and he gave water, and they washed their feet, and he gave fodder for their asses.

genesis:43:25@01-genesis/43.tex.original: ויכינו את המנחה עד בוא יוסף בצהרים כי שמעו כי שם יאכלו לחם׃
genesis:43:25@01-genesis/43.tex.english: And they prepared the gift until Joseph’s arrival at noon because they heard that they would eat bread there.

genesis:43:26@01-genesis/43.tex.original: ויבא יוסף הביתה ויביאו לו את המנחה אשר בידם הביתה וישתחוו לו ארצה׃
genesis:43:26@01-genesis/43.tex.english: And Joseph came to the house, and they brought the gift for him that was in their hand to the house, and they bowed to him to the ground.

genesis:43:27@01-genesis/43.tex.original: וישאל להם לשלום ויאמר השלום אביכם הזקן אשר אמרתם העודנו חי׃
genesis:43:27@01-genesis/43.tex.english: And he asked if they were well, and he said, “Is your old father whom you mentioned well? Is he still alive?”

genesis:43:28@01-genesis/43.tex.original: ויאמרו שלום לעבדך לאבינו עודנו חי ויקדו (וישתחו) [וישתחוו]׃
genesis:43:28@01-genesis/43.tex.english: And they said, “Your servant, our father, is well. He’s still alive.” And they knelt and bowed.

genesis:43:29@01-genesis/43.tex.original: וישא עיניו וירא את בנימין אחיו בן אמו ויאמר הזה אחיכם הקטן אשר אמרתם אלי ויאמר אלהים יחנך בני׃
genesis:43:29@01-genesis/43.tex.english: And he raised his eyes and saw Benjamin, his brother, his mother’s son, and said, “Is this your youngest brother whom you mentioned to me?” And he said, “May God be gracious to you, my son.”

genesis:43:30@01-genesis/43.tex.original: וימהר יוסף כי נכמרו רחמיו אל אחיו ויבקש לבכות ויבא החדרה ויבך שמה׃
genesis:43:30@01-genesis/43.tex.english: And Joseph hurried because his feelings for his brother were boiling, and he looked for a place to weep and came to his room and wept there.

genesis:43:31@01-genesis/43.tex.original: וירחץ פניו ויצא ויתאפק ויאמר שימו לחם׃
genesis:43:31@01-genesis/43.tex.english: And he washed his face and went out and restrained himself and said, “Put out bread.”

genesis:43:32@01-genesis/43.tex.original: וישימו לו לבדו ולהם לבדם ולמצרים האכלים אתו לבדם כי לא יוכלון המצרים לאכל את העברים לחם כי תועבה הוא למצרים׃
genesis:43:32@01-genesis/43.tex.english: And they put it out for him by himself and for them by themselves and for the Egyptians who were eating with him by themselves, because the Egyptians could not eat bread with the Hebrews because that is an offensive thing to Egypt.

genesis:43:33@01-genesis/43.tex.original: וישבו לפניו הבכר כבכרתו והצעיר כצערתו ויתמהו האנשים איש אל רעהו׃
genesis:43:33@01-genesis/43.tex.english: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright and the youngest according to his youth. And the men looked amazed at one another.

genesis:43:34@01-genesis/43.tex.original: וישא משאת מאת פניו אלהם ותרב משאת בנימן ממשאת כלם חמש ידות וישתו וישכרו עמו׃
genesis:43:34@01-genesis/43.tex.english: And he conveyed portions from before him to them, and he made Benjamin’s portion five times more than the portions of all of them, and they drank and were drunk with him.

genesis:44:1@01-genesis/44.tex.original: ויצו את אשר על ביתו לאמר מלא את אמתחת האנשים אכל כאשר יוכלון שאת ושים כסף איש בפי אמתחתו׃
genesis:44:1@01-genesis/44.tex.english: And he commanded the one who was over his house, saying, “Fill the men’s bags with as much food as they can carry and put each man’s silver in the mouth of his bag,

genesis:44:2@01-genesis/44.tex.original: ואת גביעי גביע הכסף תשים בפי אמתחת הקטן ואת כסף שברו ויעש כדבר יוסף אשר דבר׃
genesis:44:2@01-genesis/44.tex.english: and put my cup, the silver cup, in the mouth of the youngest one’s bag, and the silver for his grain.” And he did according to Joseph’s word that he spoke.

genesis:44:3@01-genesis/44.tex.original: הבקר אור והאנשים שלחו המה וחמריהם׃
genesis:44:3@01-genesis/44.tex.english: The morning was light: and the men had been sent away, they and their asses.

genesis:44:4@01-genesis/44.tex.original: הם יצאו את העיר לא הרחיקו ויוסף אמר לאשר על ביתו קום רדף אחרי האנשים והשגתם ואמרת אלהם למה שלמתם רעה תחת טובה׃
genesis:44:4@01-genesis/44.tex.english: They had gone out of the city. They had not gone far, and Joseph had said to the one who was over his house, “Get up. Pursue the men, and you’ll catch up with them and say to them, ‘Why did you pay back bad for good?

genesis:44:5@01-genesis/44.tex.original: הלוא זה אשר ישתה אדני בו והוא נחש ינחש בו הרעתם אשר עשיתם׃
genesis:44:5@01-genesis/44.tex.english: Isn’t this the thing from which my lord drinks? And he divines by it! You’ve done bad, this thing that you’ve done.’”

genesis:44:6@01-genesis/44.tex.original: וישגם וידבר אלהם את הדברים האלה׃
genesis:44:6@01-genesis/44.tex.english: And he caught up with them and spoke these things to them.

genesis:44:7@01-genesis/44.tex.original: ויאמרו אליו למה ידבר אדני כדברים האלה חלילה לעבדיך מעשות כדבר הזה׃
genesis:44:7@01-genesis/44.tex.english: And they said to him, “Why would my lord speak things like these? Far be it from your servants to do a thing like this.

genesis:44:8@01-genesis/44.tex.original: הן כסף אשר מצאנו בפי אמתחתינו השיבנו אליך מארץ כנען ואיך נגנב מבית אדניך כסף או זהב׃
genesis:44:8@01-genesis/44.tex.english: Here, we brought the silver that we found in the mouth of our bags back to you from the land of Canaan, so how would we steal silver or gold from your lord’s house?!

genesis:44:9@01-genesis/44.tex.original: אשר ימצא אתו מעבדיך ומת וגם אנחנו נהיה לאדני לעבדים׃
genesis:44:9@01-genesis/44.tex.english: The one among your servants with whom it’s found, let him die, and also we’ll become my lord’s servants.”

genesis:44:10@01-genesis/44.tex.original: ויאמר גם עתה כדבריכם כן הוא אשר ימצא אתו יהיה לי עבד ואתם תהיו נקים׃
genesis:44:10@01-genesis/44.tex.english: And he said, “Now, also, it will be so according to your words: the one with whom it’s found will become my servant. And you will be free.”

genesis:44:11@01-genesis/44.tex.original: וימהרו ויורדו איש את אמתחתו ארצה ויפתחו איש אמתחתו׃
genesis:44:11@01-genesis/44.tex.english: And they hurried, and each man lowered his bag to the ground, and each man opened his bag.

genesis:44:12@01-genesis/44.tex.original: ויחפש בגדול החל ובקטן כלה וימצא הגביע באמתחת בנימן׃
genesis:44:12@01-genesis/44.tex.english: And he searched. With the oldest he began, and with the youngest he finished. And the cup was found in Benjamin’s bag.

genesis:44:13@01-genesis/44.tex.original: ויקרעו שמלתם ויעמס איש על חמרו וישבו העירה׃
genesis:44:13@01-genesis/44.tex.english: And they ripped their clothes, and each man loaded his ass, and they went back to the city.

genesis:44:14@01-genesis/44.tex.original: ויבא יהודה ואחיו ביתה יוסף והוא עודנו שם ויפלו לפניו ארצה׃
genesis:44:14@01-genesis/44.tex.english: And Judah and his brothers came to Joseph’s house, and he was still there, and they fell to the ground before him.

genesis:44:15@01-genesis/44.tex.original: ויאמר להם יוסף מה המעשה הזה אשר עשיתם הלוא ידעתם כי נחש ינחש איש אשר כמני׃
genesis:44:15@01-genesis/44.tex.english: And Joseph said to them, “What is this thing that you’ve done? Didn’t you know that a man like me would divine?”

genesis:44:16@01-genesis/44.tex.original: ויאמר יהודה מה נאמר לאדני מה נדבר ומה נצטדק האלהים מצא את עון עבדיך הננו עבדים לאדני גם אנחנו גם אשר נמצא הגביע בידו׃
genesis:44:16@01-genesis/44.tex.english: And Judah said, “What shall we say to my lord? What shall we speak? By what shall we justify ourselves? has found your servants’ crime. Here we’re my lord’s servants, both we and the one in whose hand the cup was found.”

genesis:44:17@01-genesis/44.tex.original: ויאמר חלילה לי מעשות זאת האיש אשר נמצא הגביע בידו הוא יהיה לי עבד ואתם עלו לשלום אל אביכם׃
genesis:44:17@01-genesis/44.tex.english: And he said, “Far be it from me to do this. The man in whose hand the cup was found: he will be my servant; and you, go up in peace to your father.”

genesis:44:18@01-genesis/44.tex.original: ויגש אליו יהודה ויאמר בי אדני ידבר נא עבדך דבר באזני אדני ואל יחר אפך בעבדך כי כמוך כפרעה׃
genesis:44:18@01-genesis/44.tex.english: And Judah went over to him and said, “Please, my lord, let your servant speak something in my lord’s ears, and let your anger not flare at your servant, because you’re like Pharaoh himself.

genesis:44:19@01-genesis/44.tex.original: אדני שאל את עבדיו לאמר היש לכם אב או אח׃
genesis:44:19@01-genesis/44.tex.english: My lord asked his servants, saying, ‘Do you have a father or brother?’

genesis:44:20@01-genesis/44.tex.original: ונאמר אל אדני יש לנו אב זקן וילד זקנים קטן ואחיו מת ויותר הוא לבדו לאמו ואביו אהבו׃
genesis:44:20@01-genesis/44.tex.english: and we said to my lord, ‘We have an old father and a young son of his old age, and his brother’s dead, and he’s left alone of his mother, and his father loves him.’

genesis:44:21@01-genesis/44.tex.original: ותאמר אל עבדיך הורדהו אלי ואשימה עיני עליו׃
genesis:44:21@01-genesis/44.tex.english: And you said to your servants, ‘Bring him down to me, so I may set my eye on him.’

genesis:44:22@01-genesis/44.tex.original: ונאמר אל אדני לא יוכל הנער לעזב את אביו ועזב את אביו ומת׃
genesis:44:22@01-genesis/44.tex.english: And we said to my lord, The boy can’t leave his father; if he left his father he’d die.’

genesis:44:23@01-genesis/44.tex.original: ותאמר אל עבדיך אם לא ירד אחיכם הקטן אתכם לא תספון לראות פני׃
genesis:44:23@01-genesis/44.tex.english: And you said to your servants, ‘If your youngest brother doesn’t come down with you, you won’t see my face again.’

genesis:44:24@01-genesis/44.tex.original: ויהי כי עלינו אל עבדך אבי ונגד לו את דברי אדני׃
genesis:44:24@01-genesis/44.tex.english: And it was, when we went up to your servant, my father, and told him my lord’s words,

genesis:44:25@01-genesis/44.tex.original: ויאמר אבינו שבו שברו לנו מעט אכל׃
genesis:44:25@01-genesis/44.tex.english: that our father said, ‘Go back. Buy us a little food.’

genesis:44:26@01-genesis/44.tex.original: ונאמר לא נוכל לרדת אם יש אחינו הקטן אתנו וירדנו כי לא נוכל לראות פני האיש ואחינו הקטן איננו אתנו׃
genesis:44:26@01-genesis/44.tex.english: And we said, ‘We can’t go down. If our youngest brother is with us then we’ll go down, because we can’t see the man’s face if our youngest brother isn’t with us.’

genesis:44:27@01-genesis/44.tex.original: ויאמר עבדך אבי אלינו אתם ידעתם כי שנים ילדה לי אשתי׃
genesis:44:27@01-genesis/44.tex.english: And your servant, my father, said to us, ‘You know that my wife gave birth to two for me,

genesis:44:28@01-genesis/44.tex.original: ויצא האחד מאתי ואמר אך טרף טרף ולא ראיתיו עד הנה׃
genesis:44:28@01-genesis/44.tex.english: and one went away from me, and I said he’s surely torn up, and I haven’t seen him since.

genesis:44:29@01-genesis/44.tex.original: ולקחתם גם את זה מעם פני וקרהו אסון והורדתם את שיבתי ברעה שאלה׃
genesis:44:29@01-genesis/44.tex.english: And if you take this one from me as well and some harm happens to him, then you’ll bring down my gray hair in wretchedness to Sheol.’

genesis:44:30@01-genesis/44.tex.original: ועתה כבאי אל עבדך אבי והנער איננו אתנו ונפשו קשורה בנפשו׃
genesis:44:30@01-genesis/44.tex.english: And now, when I come to your servant, my father, and the boy isn’t with us, and he’s bound to him soul to soul,

genesis:44:31@01-genesis/44.tex.original: והיה כראותו כי אין הנער ומת והורידו עבדיך את שיבת עבדך אבינו ביגון שאלה׃
genesis:44:31@01-genesis/44.tex.english: it will be, when he sees that the boy isn’t there, that he’ll die. And your servants will have brought down your servant our father’s gray hair in anguish to Sheol,

genesis:44:32@01-genesis/44.tex.original: כי עבדך ערב את הנער מעם אבי לאמר אם לא אביאנו אליך וחטאתי לאבי כל הימים׃
genesis:44:32@01-genesis/44.tex.english: because your servant offered security for the boy to my father, saying, ‘If I don’t bring him to you, then I’ll have sinned against my father for all time.’

genesis:44:33@01-genesis/44.tex.original: ועתה ישב נא עבדך תחת הנער עבד לאדני והנער יעל עם אחיו׃
genesis:44:33@01-genesis/44.tex.english: And now, let your servant stay as my lord’s servant in place of the boy, and let the boy go up with his brothers—

genesis:44:34@01-genesis/44.tex.original: כי איך אעלה אל אבי והנער איננו אתי פן אראה ברע אשר ימצא את אבי׃
genesis:44:34@01-genesis/44.tex.english: for how could I go up to my father and the boy isn’t with me—or else I’ll see the wretchedness that will find my father.”

genesis:45:1@01-genesis/45.tex.original: ולא יכל יוסף להתאפק לכל הנצבים עליו ויקרא הוציאו כל איש מעלי ולא עמד איש אתו בהתודע יוסף אל אחיו׃
genesis:45:1@01-genesis/45.tex.english: And Joseph was not able to restrain himself in front of everyone who was standing by him, and he called, “Take everyone out from my presence.” And not a man stood with him when Joseph made himself known to his brothers.

genesis:45:2@01-genesis/45.tex.original: ויתן את קלו בבכי וישמעו מצרים וישמע בית פרעה׃
genesis:45:2@01-genesis/45.tex.english: And he wept out loud. And Egypt heard, and Pharaoh’s house heard.

genesis:45:3@01-genesis/45.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR YWSP AL AXYW ANY YWSP H]WD ABY XY WLA YKLW AXYW L]NWT ATW KY NBHLW MPNYW׃</bdo>
genesis:45:3@01-genesis/45.tex.english: And Joseph said to his brothers, “I’m Joseph. Is my father still alive?” And his brothers were not able to answer him, because they were terrified in front of him.

genesis:45:4@01-genesis/45.tex.original: ויאמר יוסף אל אחיו גשו נא אלי ויגשו ויאמר אני יוסף אחיכם אשר מכרתם אתי מצרימה׃
genesis:45:4@01-genesis/45.tex.english: And Joseph said to his brothers, “Come over to me.” And they went over. And he said, “I’m Joseph, your brother, whom you sold to Egypt.

genesis:45:5@01-genesis/45.tex.original: ועתה אל תעצבו ואל יחר בעיניכם כי מכרתם אתי הנה כי למחיה שלחני אלהים לפניכם׃
genesis:45:5@01-genesis/45.tex.english: And now, don’t be sad and let there be no anger in your eyes because you sold me here, because God sent me before you to preserve life.

genesis:45:6@01-genesis/45.tex.original: כי זה שנתים הרעב בקרב הארץ ועוד חמש שנים אשר אין חריש וקציר׃
genesis:45:6@01-genesis/45.tex.english: For it’s two years that the famine is in the land, and for five more years there’ll be no plowing and harvest.

genesis:45:7@01-genesis/45.tex.original: וישלחני אלהים לפניכם לשום לכם שארית בארץ ולהחיות לכם לפליטה גדלה׃
genesis:45:7@01-genesis/45.tex.english: And God sent me ahead of you to provide a remnant for you in the earth and to keep you alive as a big, surviving community.

genesis:45:8@01-genesis/45.tex.original: ועתה לא אתם שלחתם אתי הנה כי האלהים וישימני לאב לפרעה ולאדון לכל ביתו ומשל בכל ארץ מצרים׃
genesis:45:8@01-genesis/45.tex.english: And now, it wasn’t you who sent me here, but God, and he made me into a father to Pharaoh and a lord to all his house and a ruler in all the land of Egypt.

genesis:45:9@01-genesis/45.tex.original: מהרו ועלו אל אבי ואמרתם אליו כה אמר בנך יוסף שמני אלהים לאדון לכל מצרים רדה אלי אל תעמד׃
genesis:45:9@01-genesis/45.tex.english: Hurry, and go up to my father and say to him: ‘Your son Joseph said this: God has made me a lord to all Egypt. Come down to me. Don’t stand back.

genesis:45:10@01-genesis/45.tex.original: וישבת בארץ גשן והיית קרוב אלי אתה ובניך ובני בניך וצאנך ובקרך וכל אשר לך׃
genesis:45:10@01-genesis/45.tex.english: And you’ll live in the land of Goshen, and you’ll be close to me, you and your children and your children’s children and your flock and your oxen and everything you have.

genesis:45:11@01-genesis/45.tex.original: וכלכלתי אתך שם כי עוד חמש שנים רעב פן תורש אתה וביתך וכל אשר לך׃
genesis:45:11@01-genesis/45.tex.english: And I’ll provide for you there, because there are five more years of famine, or else you and your house and everything you have will be impoverished.’

genesis:45:12@01-genesis/45.tex.original: והנה עיניכם ראות ועיני אחי בנימין כי פי המדבר אליכם׃
genesis:45:12@01-genesis/45.tex.english: And here your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it’s my mouth that speaks to you.

genesis:45:13@01-genesis/45.tex.original: והגדתם לאבי את כל כבודי במצרים ואת כל אשר ראיתם ומהרתם והורדתם את אבי הנה׃
genesis:45:13@01-genesis/45.tex.english: And you’ll tell my father of all my glory in Egypt and of all that you’ve seen, and hurry and bring my father down here.”

genesis:45:14@01-genesis/45.tex.original: ויפל על צוארי בנימן אחיו ויבך ובנימן בכה על צואריו׃
genesis:45:14@01-genesis/45.tex.english: And he fell on his brother Benjamin’s neck and wept, and Benjamin wept on his neck.

genesis:45:15@01-genesis/45.tex.original: וינשק לכל אחיו ויבך עלהם ואחרי כן דברו אחיו אתו׃
genesis:45:15@01-genesis/45.tex.english: And he kissed all his brothers and wept over them. And after that his brothers spoke with him.

genesis:45:16@01-genesis/45.tex.original: והקל נשמע בית פרעה לאמר באו אחי יוסף וייטב בעיני פרעה ובעיני עבדיו׃
genesis:45:16@01-genesis/45.tex.english: And the report was heard at Pharaoh’s house, saying, “Joseph’s brothers have come.” And it was good in Pharaoh’s eyes and in his servants’ eyes.

genesis:45:17@01-genesis/45.tex.original: ויאמר פרעה אל יוסף אמר אל אחיך זאת עשו טענו את בעירכם ולכו באו ארצה כנען׃
genesis:45:17@01-genesis/45.tex.english: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Say to your brothers, ‘Do this: load your beasts and go; come to the land of Canaan,

genesis:45:18@01-genesis/45.tex.original: וקחו את אביכם ואת בתיכם ובאו אלי ואתנה לכם את טוב ארץ מצרים ואכלו את חלב הארץ׃
genesis:45:18@01-genesis/45.tex.english: and take your father and your households and come to me, and I’ll give you the best of the land of Egypt; and eat the fat of the land.’

genesis:45:19@01-genesis/45.tex.original: ואתה צויתה זאת עשו קחו לכם מארץ מצרים עגלות לטפכם ולנשיכם ונשאתם את אביכם ובאתם׃
genesis:45:19@01-genesis/45.tex.english: And you are commanded, ‘Do this: Take wagons from the land of Egypt for your infants and for your wives, and carry your father and come.

genesis:45:20@01-genesis/45.tex.original: ועינכם אל תחס על כליכם כי טוב כל ארץ מצרים לכם הוא׃
genesis:45:20@01-genesis/45.tex.english: And let your eye not care about your possessions, for the best of all the land of Egypt is yours.’”

genesis:45:21@01-genesis/45.tex.original: ויעשו כן בני ישראל ויתן להם יוסף עגלות על פי פרעה ויתן להם צדה לדרך׃
genesis:45:21@01-genesis/45.tex.english: And the children of Israel did so. And Joseph gave them wagons by order of Pharaoh and gave them provisions for the road.

genesis:45:22@01-genesis/45.tex.original: לכלם נתן לאיש חלפות שמלת ולבנימן נתן שלש מאות כסף וחמש חלפת שמלת׃
genesis:45:22@01-genesis/45.tex.english: For all of them he gave each man changes of clothes, and he gave Benjamin three hundred weights of silver and five changes of clothes.

genesis:45:23@01-genesis/45.tex.original: ולאביו שלח כזאת עשרה חמרים נשאים מטוב מצרים ועשר אתנת נשאת בר ולחם ומזון לאביו לדרך׃
genesis:45:23@01-genesis/45.tex.english: And to his father he sent as follows: ten asses bearing Egypt’s best, and ten she-asses bearing grain, bread, and food supply for his father for the road.

genesis:45:24@01-genesis/45.tex.original: וישלח את אחיו וילכו ויאמר אלהם אל תרגזו בדרך׃
genesis:45:24@01-genesis/45.tex.english: And he sent his brothers off, and they went, and he said to them, “Don’t quarrel on the road.”

genesis:45:25@01-genesis/45.tex.original: ויעלו ממצרים ויבאו ארץ כנען אל יעקב אביהם׃
genesis:45:25@01-genesis/45.tex.english: And they went up from Egypt and came to the land of Canaan, to Jacob, their father,

genesis:45:26@01-genesis/45.tex.original: ויגדו לו לאמר עוד יוסף חי וכי הוא משל בכל ארץ מצרים ויפג לבו כי לא האמין להם׃
genesis:45:26@01-genesis/45.tex.english: and told him, saying, “Joseph is still alive! And he rules all the land of Egypt!” And his heart grew numb because he did not believe them.

genesis:45:27@01-genesis/45.tex.original: וידברו אליו את כל דברי יוסף אשר דבר אלהם וירא את העגלות אשר שלח יוסף לשאת אתו ותחי רוח יעקב אביהם׃
genesis:45:27@01-genesis/45.tex.english: And they spoke to him all of Joseph’s words that he had spoken to them, and he saw the wagons that Joseph had sent to carry him, and their father Jacob’s spirit came alive.

genesis:45:28@01-genesis/45.tex.original: ויאמר ישראל רב עוד יוסף בני חי אלכה ואראנו בטרם אמות׃
genesis:45:28@01-genesis/45.tex.english: And Israel said, “So much! Joseph, my son, is still alive. Let me go and see him before I die.”

genesis:46:1@01-genesis/46.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYS] YVRAL WKL AVR LW WYBA BARH VB] WYZBX ZBXYM LALHY ABYW YCXQ׃</bdo>
genesis:46:1@01-genesis/46.tex.english: And Israel and everyone he had traveled and came to Beer-sheba, and he offered sacrifices to the God of his father, Isaac.

genesis:46:2@01-genesis/46.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR ALHYM LYVRAL BMRAT HLYLH WYAMR Y]QB Y]QB WYAMR HNNY׃</bdo>
genesis:46:2@01-genesis/46.tex.english: And God said to Israel in night visions, and He said, “Jacob, Jacob.” And he said, “I’m here.”

genesis:46:3@01-genesis/46.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR ANKY HAL ALHY ABYK AL TYRA MRDH MCRYMH KY LGWY GDWL AVYMK VM׃</bdo>
genesis:46:3@01-genesis/46.tex.english: And He said, “I am God, your father’s God. Don’t be afraid of going down to Egypt, because I’ll make you into a big nation there.

genesis:46:4@01-genesis/46.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">ANKY ARD ]MK MCRYMH WANKY A]LK GM ]LH WYWSP YVYT YDW ]L ]YNYK׃</bdo>
genesis:46:4@01-genesis/46.tex.english: I shall go down with you to Egypt, and I shall also bring you up. And Joseph will set his hand on your eyes.”

genesis:46:5@01-genesis/46.tex.original: WYQM Y]QB MBAR VB] וישאו בני ישראל את יעקב אביהם ואת טפם ואת נשיהם בעגלות אשר שלח פרעה לשאת אתו׃
genesis:46:5@01-genesis/46.tex.english: And Jacob got up from Beer-sheba. And the children of Israel carried Jacob, their father, and their infants and their wives in the wagons that Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

genesis:46:6@01-genesis/46.tex.original: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת מִקְנֵיהֶם וְאֶת רְכוּשָׁם אֲשֶׁר רָכְשׁוּ בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן וַיָּבֹאוּ מִצְרָיְמָה יַעֲקֹב וְכל זַרְעוֹ אִתּוֹ׃
genesis:46:6@01-genesis/46.tex.english: And they took their cattle and their property that they had acquired in the land of Canaan, and they came to Egypt, Jacob and all his seed with him.

genesis:46:7@01-genesis/46.tex.original: בָּנָיו וּבְנֵי בָנָיו אִתּוֹ בְּנֹתָיו וּבְנוֹת בָּנָיו וְכל זַרְעוֹ הֵבִיא אִתּוֹ מִצְרָיְמָה׃
genesis:46:7@01-genesis/46.tex.english: He brought his sons and his grandsons with him, his daughters and his granddaughters and all his seed with him to Egypt.

genesis:46:8@01-genesis/46.tex.original: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַבָּאִים מִצְרַיְמָה יַעֲקֹב וּבָנָיו בְּכֹר יַעֲקֹב רְאוּבֵן׃
genesis:46:8@01-genesis/46.tex.english: And these are the names of the children of Israel who came to Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Jacob’s firstborn was Reuben.

genesis:46:9@01-genesis/46.tex.original: וּבְנֵי רְאוּבֵן חֲנוֹךְ וּפַלּוּא וְחֶצְרֹן וְכַרְמִי׃
genesis:46:9@01-genesis/46.tex.english: And Reuben’s sons were Hanoch and Pallu and Hezron and Carmi.

genesis:46:10@01-genesis/46.tex.original: וּבְנֵי שִׁמְעוֹן יְמוּאֵל וְיָמִין וְאֹהַד וְיָכִין וְצֹחַר וְשָׁאוּל בֶּן הַכְּנַעֲנִית׃
genesis:46:10@01-genesis/46.tex.english: And Simeon’s sons were Jemuel and Jamin and Ohad and Jachin and Zohar and Saul, the son of a Canaanite woman.

genesis:46:11@01-genesis/46.tex.original: וּבְנֵי לֵוִי גֵּרְשׁוֹן קְהָת וּמְרָרִי׃
genesis:46:11@01-genesis/46.tex.english: And Levi’s sons were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

genesis:46:12@01-genesis/46.tex.original: וּבְנֵי יְהוּדָה עֵר וְאוֹנָן וְשֵׁלָה וָפֶרֶץ וָזָרַח וַיָּמת עֵר וְאוֹנָן בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי פֶרֶץ חֶצְרֹן וְחָמוּל׃
genesis:46:12@01-genesis/46.tex.english: And Judah’s sons were Er and Onan and Shelah and Perez and Zerah. And Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan, and Perez’s sons were Hezron and Hamul.

genesis:46:13@01-genesis/46.tex.original: וּבְנֵי יִשָּׂשכָר תּוֹלָע וּפֻוָה וְיוֹב וְשִׁמְרֹן׃
genesis:46:13@01-genesis/46.tex.english: And Issachar’s sons were Tola and Puvah and Job and Shimron.

genesis:46:14@01-genesis/46.tex.original: וּבְנֵי זְבֻלוּן סֶרֶד וְאֵלוֹן וְיַחְלְאֵל׃
genesis:46:14@01-genesis/46.tex.english: And Zebulun’s sons were Sered and Elon and Jahleel.

genesis:46:15@01-genesis/46.tex.original: אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי לֵאָה אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לְיַעֲקֹב בְּפַדַּן אֲרָם וְאֵת דִּינָה בִתּוֹ כּל נֶפֶשׁ בָּנָיו וּבְנוֹתָיו שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשָׁלֹשׁ׃
genesis:46:15@01-genesis/46.tex.english: These were the sons of Leah, to whom she gave birth for Jacob in Paddan Aram, and Dinah, his daughter, every person of his sons and his daughters, thirty-three.

genesis:46:16@01-genesis/46.tex.original: וּבְנֵי גָד צִפְיוֹן וְחַגִּי שׁוּנִי וְאֶצְבֹּן עֵרִי וַאֲרוֹדִי וְאַרְאֵלִי׃
genesis:46:16@01-genesis/46.tex.english: And Gad’s sons were Ziphion and Haggai and Shuni and Ezbon, Eri and Arodi and Areli.

genesis:46:17@01-genesis/46.tex.original: וּבְנֵי אָשֵׁר יִמְנָה וְיִשְׁוָה וְיִשְׁוִי וּבְרִיעָה וְשֶׂרַח אֲחֹתָם וּבְנֵי בְרִיעָה חֶבֶר וּמַלְכִּיאֵל׃
genesis:46:17@01-genesis/46.tex.english: And Asher’s sons were Imnah and Ishvah and Ishvi and Beriah, and Serah was their sister. And Beriah’s sons were Hever and Malchiel.

genesis:46:18@01-genesis/46.tex.original: אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי זִלְפָּה אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָבָן לְלֵאָה בִתּוֹ וַתֵּלֶד אֶת אֵלֶּה לְיַעֲקֹב שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה נָפֶשׁ׃
genesis:46:18@01-genesis/46.tex.english: These were the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah, his daughter, and she gave birth to these for Jacob, sixteen persons.

genesis:46:19@01-genesis/46.tex.original: בְּנֵי רָחֵל אֵשֶׁת יַעֲקֹב יוֹסֵף וּבִנְיָמִן׃
genesis:46:19@01-genesis/46.tex.english: The sons of Rachel, Jacob’s wife, were Joseph and Benjamin.

genesis:46:20@01-genesis/46.tex.original: וַיִּוָּלֵד לְיוֹסֵף בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לּוֹ אָסְנַת בַּת פּוֹטִי פֶרַע כֹּהֵן אֹן אֶת מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶת אֶפְרָיִם׃
genesis:46:20@01-genesis/46.tex.english: And Manasseh and Ephraim were born to Joseph in the land of Egypt, to whom Asenath, daughter of Poti-phera, priest of On, gave birth for him.

genesis:46:21@01-genesis/46.tex.original: וּבְנֵי בִנְיָמִן בֶּלַע וָבֶכֶר וְאַשְׁבֵּל גֵּרָא וְנַעֲמָן אֵחִי וָרֹאשׁ מֻפִּים וְחֻפִּים וָאָרְדְּ׃
genesis:46:21@01-genesis/46.tex.english: And Benjamin’s sons were Bela and Becher and Ashbel, Gera and Naaman, Ehi and Rosh, Muppim and Huppim and Ard.

genesis:46:22@01-genesis/46.tex.original: אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי רָחֵל אֲשֶׁר יֻלַּד לְיַעֲקֹב כּל נֶפֶשׁ אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר׃
genesis:46:22@01-genesis/46.tex.english: These were Rachel’s sons, who were born to Jacob. All the persons were fourteen.

genesis:46:23@01-genesis/46.tex.original: וּבְנֵי דָן חֻשִׁים׃
genesis:46:23@01-genesis/46.tex.english: And Dan’s sons: Hushim.

genesis:46:24@01-genesis/46.tex.original: וּבְנֵי נַפְתָּלִי יַחְצְאֵל וְגוּנִי וְיֵצֶר וְשִׁלֵּם׃
genesis:46:24@01-genesis/46.tex.english: And Naphtali’s sons were Jahzeel and Guni and Jezer and Shillem.

genesis:46:25@01-genesis/46.tex.original: אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי בִלְהָה אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לָבָן לְרָחֵל בִּתּוֹ וַתֵּלֶד אֶת אֵלֶּה לְיַעֲקֹב כּל נֶפֶשׁ שִׁבְעָה׃
genesis:46:25@01-genesis/46.tex.english: These were the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel, his daughter, and she gave birth to these for Jacob. All the persons were seven.

genesis:46:26@01-genesis/46.tex.original: כּל הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַבָּאָה לְיַעֲקֹב מִצְרַיְמָה יֹצְאֵי יְרֵכוֹ מִלְּבַד נְשֵׁי בְנֵי יַעֲקֹב כּל נֶפֶשׁ שִׁשִּׁים וָשֵׁשׁ׃
genesis:46:26@01-genesis/46.tex.english: All the persons of Jacob’s who came to Egypt, who came out from his thigh, outside of Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the persons were sixty-six.

genesis:46:27@01-genesis/46.tex.original: וּבְנֵי יוֹסֵף אֲשֶׁר יֻלַּד לוֹ בְמִצְרַיִם נֶפֶשׁ שְׁנָיִם כּל הַנֶּפֶשׁ לְבֵית יַעֲקֹב הַבָּאָה מִצְרַיְמָה שִׁבְעִים׃
genesis:46:27@01-genesis/46.tex.english: And Joseph’s sons who were born to him in Egypt were two persons. All the persons of Jacob’s house who came to Egypt were seventy.

genesis:46:28@01-genesis/46.tex.original: ואת יהודה שלח לפניו אל יוסף להורת לפניו גשנה ויבאו ארצה גשן׃
genesis:46:28@01-genesis/46.tex.english: And he sent Judah ahead of him to Joseph to direct him in advance to Goshen. And they came to the land of Goshen.

genesis:46:29@01-genesis/46.tex.original: ויאסר יוסף מרכבתו ויעל לקראת ישראל אביו גשנה וירא אליו ויפל על צואריו ויבך על צואריו עוד׃
genesis:46:29@01-genesis/46.tex.english: And Joseph hitched his chariot and went up to Israel, his father, at Goshen. And he appeared to him and fell on his neck and wept on his neck a long time.

genesis:46:30@01-genesis/46.tex.original: ויאמר ישראל אל יוסף אמותה הפעם אחרי ראותי את פניך כי עודך חי׃
genesis:46:30@01-genesis/46.tex.english: And Israel said to Joseph, “Let me die now after I’ve seen your face, that you’re still alive.”

genesis:46:31@01-genesis/46.tex.original: ויאמר יוסף אל אחיו ואל בית אביו אעלה ואגידה לפרעה ואמרה אליו אחי ובית אבי אשר בארץ כנען באו אלי׃
genesis:46:31@01-genesis/46.tex.english: And Joseph said to his brothers and to his father’s house, “Let me go up and tell Pharaoh and say to him, ‘My brothers and my father’s house that were in the land of Canaan have come to me.

genesis:46:32@01-genesis/46.tex.original: והאנשים רעי צאן כי אנשי מקנה היו וצאנם ובקרם וכל אשר להם הביאו׃
genesis:46:32@01-genesis/46.tex.english: And the people are shepherds, because they were livestock people, and they’ve brought their flock and their oxen and all they have.’

genesis:46:33@01-genesis/46.tex.original: והיה כי יקרא לכם פרעה ואמר מה מעשיכם׃
genesis:46:33@01-genesis/46.tex.english: And it will be, when Pharaoh will call you and say, ‘What is your occupation?’

genesis:46:34@01-genesis/46.tex.original: ואמרתם אנשי מקנה היו עבדיך מנעורינו ועד עתה גם אנחנו גם אבתינו בעבור תשבו בארץ גשן כי תועבת מצרים כל רעה צאן׃
genesis:46:34@01-genesis/46.tex.english: that you’ll say, ‘Your servants were livestock people from our youth until now, both we and our fathers,’ so that you’ll live in the land of Goshen, because any shepherd is an offensive thing to Egypt.”

genesis:47:1@01-genesis/47.tex.original: ויבא יוסף ויגד לפרעה ויאמר אבי ואחי וצאנם ובקרם וכל אשר להם באו מארץ כנען והנם בארץ גשן׃
genesis:47:1@01-genesis/47.tex.english: And Joseph came and told Pharaoh and said, “My father and my brothers and their flock and their oxen and all that they own have come from the land of Canaan, and here they are in the land of Goshen.”

genesis:47:2@01-genesis/47.tex.original: ומקצה אחיו לקח חמשה אנשים ויצגם לפני פרעה׃
genesis:47:2@01-genesis/47.tex.english: And he took several of his brothers, five men, and set them before Pharaoh.

genesis:47:3@01-genesis/47.tex.original: ויאמר פרעה אל אחיו מה מעשיכם ויאמרו אל פרעה רעה צאן עבדיך גם אנחנו גם אבותינו׃
genesis:47:3@01-genesis/47.tex.english: And Pharaoh said to his brothers, “What is your work?” And they said to Pharaoh, “Your servants are shepherds, both we and our fathers,”

genesis:47:4@01-genesis/47.tex.original: ויאמרו אל פרעה לגור בארץ באנו כי אין מרעה לצאן אשר לעבדיך כי כבד הרעב בארץ כנען ועתה ישבו נא עבדיך בארץ גשן׃
genesis:47:4@01-genesis/47.tex.english: and they said to Pharaoh, “We came to reside in the land because there’s no pasture for your servants’ flock because the famine is heavy in the land of Canaan. And now may your servants live in the land of Goshen.”

genesis:47:5@01-genesis/47.tex.original: ויאמר פרעה אל יוסף לאמר אביך ואחיך באו אליך׃
genesis:47:5@01-genesis/47.tex.english: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, saying, “Your father and your brothers have come to you.

genesis:47:6@01-genesis/47.tex.original: ארץ מצרים לפניך הוא במיטב הארץ הושב את אביך ואת אחיך ישבו בארץ גשן ואם ידעת ויש בם אנשי חיל ושמתם שרי מקנה על אשר לי׃
genesis:47:6@01-genesis/47.tex.english: The land of Egypt is before you. Settle your father and your brothers in the best of the land. Let them live in the land of Goshen. And if you know—and if there are among them—worthy men, then you shall make them livestock officers over those that I have.”

genesis:47:7@01-genesis/47.tex.original: ויבא יוסף את יעקב אביו ויעמדהו לפני פרעה ויברך יעקב את פרעה׃
genesis:47:7@01-genesis/47.tex.english: And Joseph brought Jacob, his father, and stood him in front of Pharaoh. And Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

genesis:47:8@01-genesis/47.tex.original: ויאמר פרעה אל יעקב כמה ימי שני חייך׃
genesis:47:8@01-genesis/47.tex.english: And Pharaoh said to Jacob, “How many are the days of the years of your life?”

genesis:47:9@01-genesis/47.tex.original: ויאמר יעקב אל פרעה ימי שני מגורי שלשים ומאת שנה מעט ורעים היו ימי שני חיי ולא השיגו את ימי שני חיי אבתי בימי מגוריהם׃
genesis:47:9@01-genesis/47.tex.english: And Jacob said to Pharaoh, “The days of the years of my residences are a hundred thirty years. The days of the years of my life have been few and bad, and they haven’t attained the days of the years of my fathers’ lives, in the days of their residences.”

genesis:47:10@01-genesis/47.tex.original: ויברך יעקב את פרעה ויצא מלפני פרעה׃
genesis:47:10@01-genesis/47.tex.english: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh and went out from in front of Pharaoh.

genesis:47:11@01-genesis/47.tex.original: ויושב יוסף את אביו ואת אחיו ויתן להם אחזה בארץ מצרים במיטב הארץ בארץ רעמסס כאשר צוה פרעה׃
genesis:47:11@01-genesis/47.tex.english: And Joseph settled his father and his brothers and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

genesis:47:12@01-genesis/47.tex.original: ויכלכל יוסף את אביו ואת אחיו ואת כל בית אביו לחם לפי הטף׃
genesis:47:12@01-genesis/47.tex.english: And Joseph supported his father and his brothers and all of his father’s household, bread by the number of infants.

genesis:47:13@01-genesis/47.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-je hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="JE">WLXM AYN BKL HARC KY KBD HR]B MAD WTLH ARC MCRYM WARC KN]N MPNY HR]B׃</bdo>
genesis:47:13@01-genesis/47.tex.english: And there was no bread in all the land of Egypt, because the famine was very heavy, and the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan languished because of the famine.

genesis:47:14@01-genesis/47.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYLQJ YWSP AT KL HKSP HNMCA BARC MCRYM WBARC KN]N BVBR AVR HM VBRYM WYBA YWSP AT HKSP BYTH PR]H׃</bdo>
genesis:47:14@01-genesis/47.tex.english: And Joseph collected all the silver that was found in the land of Egypt and in the land of Canaan for the grain that they were buying, and Joseph brought the silver to Pharaoh’s house.

genesis:47:15@01-genesis/47.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYTM HKSP MARC MCRYM WMARC KN]N WYBAW KL MCRYM AL YWSP LAMR HBH LNW LXM WLMH NMWT NGDK KY APS KSP׃</bdo>
genesis:47:15@01-genesis/47.tex.english: And the silver came to an end from the land of Egypt and from the land of Canaan. And all of Egypt came to Joseph, saying, “Give us bread! And why should we die in front of you? Because there’s no more silver!”

genesis:47:16@01-genesis/47.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR YWSP HBW MQNYKM WATNH LKM BMQNYKM AM APS KSP׃</bdo>
genesis:47:16@01-genesis/47.tex.english: And Joseph said, “Give your livestock, and I’ll give it to you for your livestock if there’s no more silver.”

genesis:47:17@01-genesis/47.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYBYAW AT MQNYHM AL YWSP WYTN LHM YWSP LXM BSWSYM WBMQNH HCAN WBMQNH HBQR WBXMRYM WYNHLM BLXM BKL MQNHM BVNH HHWA׃</bdo>
genesis:47:17@01-genesis/47.tex.english: And they brought their livestock to Joseph, and Joseph gave them bread for the horses and for the livestock of the flocks and for the livestock of the oxen and for the asses, and he sustained them with bread for all their livestock in that year.

genesis:47:18@01-genesis/47.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WTTM HVNH HHWA WYBAW ALYW BVNH HVNYT WYAMRW LW LA NKXD MADNY KY AM TM HKSP WMQNH HBHMH AL ADNY LA NVAR LPNY ADNY BLTY AM GWYTNW WADMTNW׃</bdo>
genesis:47:18@01-genesis/47.tex.english: And that year came to an end, and they came to him in the second year and said to him, “We won’t conceal from my lord that the silver has come to an end and the cattle livestock have gone to my lord. Nothing is left in front of my lord except our body and our land.

genesis:47:19@01-genesis/47.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">LMH NMWT L]YNYK GM ANXNW GM ADMTNW QNH ATNW WAT ADMTNW BLXM WNHYH ANXNW WADMTNW ]BDYM LPR]H WTN ZR] WNXYH WLA NMWT WHADMH LA TVM׃</bdo>
genesis:47:19@01-genesis/47.tex.english: Why should we die before your eyes, both we and our land? Buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants to Pharaoh; and give seed so we’ll live and not die, and the land won’t be devastated.”

genesis:47:20@01-genesis/47.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYQN YWSP AT KL ADMT MCRYM LPR]H KY MKRW MCRYM AYV VDHW KY XZQ ]LHM HR]B WTHY HARC LPR]H׃</bdo>
genesis:47:20@01-genesis/47.tex.english: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh, because Egypt, each man, sold his field, because the famine was strong on them. And the land became Pharaoh’s.

genesis:47:21@01-genesis/47.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WAT H]M H]BYR ATW L]RYM MQCH GBWL MCRYM W]D QCHW׃</bdo>
genesis:47:21@01-genesis/47.tex.english: And the people: he moved them into cities, from one edge of Egypt’s border to its other edge.

genesis:47:22@01-genesis/47.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">RQ ADMT HKHNYM LA QNH KY XQ LKHNYM MAT PR]H WAKLW AT XQM AVR NTN LHM PR]H ]L KN LA MKRW AT ADMTM׃</bdo>
genesis:47:22@01-genesis/47.tex.english: Only the priests’ land he did not buy, because it was a law for the priests from Pharaoh, and they ate their statutory share that Pharaoh had given them. On account of this they did not sell their land.

genesis:47:23@01-genesis/47.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR YWSP AL H]M HN QNYTY ATKM HYWM WAT ADMTKM LPR]H HA LKM ZR] WZR]TM AT HADMH׃</bdo>
genesis:47:23@01-genesis/47.tex.english: And Joseph said to the people, “Here, I’ve bought you and your land for Pharaoh today. Look: seed for you. And you’ll sow the land;

genesis:47:24@01-genesis/47.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WHYH BTBWAT WNTTM XMYVYT LPR]H WARB] HYDT YHYH LKM LZR] HVDH WLAKLKM WLAVR BBTYKM WLAKL LJPKM׃</bdo>
genesis:47:24@01-genesis/47.tex.english: and it will be, at the harvests, that you’ll give a fifth to Pharaoh, and the four parts will be yours for field seed and for you to eat and for whoever is in your households and for your infants to eat.”

genesis:47:25@01-genesis/47.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMRW HXYTNW NMCA XN B]YNY ADNY WHYYNW ]BDYM LPR]H׃</bdo>
genesis:47:25@01-genesis/47.tex.english: And they said, “You’ve kept us alive! Let us find favor in my lord’s eyes, and we’ll be servants to Pharaoh.”

genesis:47:26@01-genesis/47.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYVM ATH YWSP LXQ ]D HYWM HZH ]L ADMT MCRYM LPR]H LXMV RQ ADMT HKHNYM LBDM LA HYTH LPR]H׃</bdo>
genesis:47:26@01-genesis/47.tex.english: And Joseph set it as a law to this day on Egypt’s land: to Pharaoh the fifth. Only the land of the priests alone was not Pharaoh’s.

genesis:47:27@01-genesis/47.tex.original: וישב ישראל בארץ מצרים בארץ גֹּשֶׁן וַיֵּאָחֲזוּ בָהּ וַיִּפְרוּ וַיִּרְבּוּ מְאֹד׃
genesis:47:27@01-genesis/47.tex.english: And Israel lived in Egypt in the land of Goshen, and they held property in it. And they were fruitful and multiplied very much.

genesis:47:28@01-genesis/47.tex.original: וַיְחִי יַעֲקֹב בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם שְׁבַע עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה וַיְהִי יְמֵי יַעֲקֹב שְׁנֵי חַיָּיו שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וְאַרְבָּעִים וּמְאַת שָׁנָה׃
genesis:47:28@01-genesis/47.tex.english: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years. And Jacob’s days, the years of his life, were seven years and a hundred forty years.

genesis:47:29@01-genesis/47.tex.original: ויקרבו ימי ישראל למות ויקרא לבנו ליוסף ויאמר לו אם נא מצאתי חן בעיניך שים נא ידך תחת ירכי ועשית עמדי חסד ואמת אל נא תקברני במצרים׃
genesis:47:29@01-genesis/47.tex.english: And Israel’s days to die drew close. And he called his son, Joseph, and said to him, “If I’ve found favor in your eyes, place your hand under my thigh and practice kindness and faithfulness with me: don’t bury me in Egypt.

genesis:47:30@01-genesis/47.tex.original: ושכבתי עם אבתי ונשאתני ממצרים וקברתני בקברתם ויאמר אנכי אעשה כדברך׃
genesis:47:30@01-genesis/47.tex.english: And I’ll lie with my fathers, and you’ll carry me out of Egypt and bury me in their burial place.” And he said, “I’ll do according to your word.”

genesis:47:31@01-genesis/47.tex.original: ויאמר השבעה לי וישבע לו וישתחו ישראל על ראש המטה׃
genesis:47:31@01-genesis/47.tex.english: And he said, “Swear to me.” And he swore to him. And Israel bowed at the head of the bed.

genesis:48:1@01-genesis/48.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYHY AXRY HDBRYM HALH WYAMR LYWSP HNH ABYK XLH WYQX AT VNY BNYW ]MW AT MNVH WAT APRYM׃</bdo>
genesis:48:1@01-genesis/48.tex.english: And it was after these things, and one said to Joseph, “Here, your father is sick.” And he took his two sons with him, Man-asseh and Ephraim.

genesis:48:2@01-genesis/48.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYGD LY]QB WYAMR HNH BNK YWSP BA ALYK WYTXZQ YVRAL WYVB ]L HMJH׃</bdo>
genesis:48:2@01-genesis/48.tex.english: And one told Jacob and said, “Here, your son Joseph is coming to you.” And Israel fortified himself and sat up on the bed.

genesis:48:3@01-genesis/48.tex.original: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אֶל יוֹסֵף אֵל שַׁדַּי נִרְאָה אֵלַי בְּלוּז בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתִי׃
genesis:48:3@01-genesis/48.tex.english: And Jacob said to Joseph, “El Shadday appeared to me in Luz in the land of Canaan, and He blessed me

genesis:48:4@01-genesis/48.tex.original: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי הִנְנִי מַפְרְךָ וְהִרְבִּיתִךָ וּנְתַתִּיךָ לִקְהַל עַמִּים וְנָתַתִּי אֶת הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת לְזַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ אֲחֻזַּת עוֹלָם׃
genesis:48:4@01-genesis/48.tex.english: and said to me, ‘Here, I’m making you fruitful and multiplying you, and I’ll make you into a community of peoples, and I’ll give this land to your seed after you, an eternal possession.’

genesis:48:5@01-genesis/48.tex.original: וְעַתָּה שְׁנֵי בָנֶיךָ הַנּוֹלָדִים לְךָ בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם עַד בֹּאִי אֵלֶיךָ מִצְרַיְמָה לִי הֵם אֶפְרַיִם וּמְנַשֶּׁה כִּרְאוּבֵן וְשִׁמְעוֹן יִהְיוּ לִי׃
genesis:48:5@01-genesis/48.tex.english: And now, your two sons who were born to you in the land of Egypt by my arrival to you at Egypt: they’re mine. Ephraim and Man-asseh will be like Reuben and Simeon to me.

genesis:48:6@01-genesis/48.tex.original: וּמוֹלַדְתְּךָ אֲשֶׁר הוֹלַדְתָּ אַחֲרֵיהֶם לְךָ יִהְיוּ עַל שֵׁם אֲחֵיהֶם יִקָּרְאוּ בְּנַחֲלָתָם׃
genesis:48:6@01-genesis/48.tex.english: And your offspring that you’ll have after them will be yours. They shall be called by their brothers’ names with regard to their inheritance.

genesis:48:7@01-genesis/48.tex.original: ואני בבאי מפדן מתה עלי רחל בארץ כנען בדרך בעוד כברת ארץ לבא אפרתה ואקברה שם בדרך אפרת הוא בית לחם׃
genesis:48:7@01-genesis/48.tex.english: And I: when I was coming from Paddan Aram, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan on the way when there was still a span of land to come to Ephrat, and I buried her there on the Ephrat road. That’s Bethlehem.”

genesis:48:8@01-genesis/48.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYRA YVRAL AT BNY YWSP WYAMR MY ALH׃</bdo>
genesis:48:8@01-genesis/48.tex.english: And Israel saw Joseph’s sons and said, “Who are these?”

genesis:48:9@01-genesis/48.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR YWSP AL ABYW BNY HM AVR NTN LY ALHYM BZH WYAMR QXM NA ALY WABRKM׃</bdo>
genesis:48:9@01-genesis/48.tex.english: And Joseph said to his father, “They’re my sons, whom God has given me here.” And he said, “Bring them to me, and I’ll bless them.”

genesis:48:10@01-genesis/48.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">W]YNY YVRAL KBDW MZQN LA YWKL LRAWT WYGV ATM ALYW WYVQ LHM WYXBQ LHM׃</bdo>
genesis:48:10@01-genesis/48.tex.english: And Israel’s eyes were heavy from old age. He was not able to see. And he brought them close to him, and he kissed them and embraced them.

genesis:48:11@01-genesis/48.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR YVRAL AL YWSP RAH PNYK LA PLLTY WHNH HRAH ATY ALHYM GM AT ZR]K׃</bdo>
genesis:48:11@01-genesis/48.tex.english: And Israel said to Joseph, “I didn’t expect to see your face; and, here, God has shown me your seed as well.”

genesis:48:12@01-genesis/48.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYWCA YWSP ATM M]M BRKYW WYVTXW LAPYW ARCH׃</bdo>
genesis:48:12@01-genesis/48.tex.english: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed, his nose to the ground.

genesis:48:13@01-genesis/48.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYQX YWSP AT VNYHM AT APRYM BYMYNW MVMAL YVRAL WAT MNVH BVMALW MYMYN YVRAL WYGV ALYW׃</bdo>
genesis:48:13@01-genesis/48.tex.english: And Joseph took the two of them, Ephraim in his right hand, at Israel’s left; and Manasseh in his left hand, at Israel’s right; and he brought them over to him.

genesis:48:14@01-genesis/48.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYVLX YVRAL AT YMYNW WYVT ]L RAV APRYM WHWA HC]YR WAT VMALW ]L RAV MNVH VKL AT YDYW KY MNVH HBKWR׃</bdo>
genesis:48:14@01-genesis/48.tex.english: And Israel put out his right hand and placed it on Ephraim’s head—and he was the younger—and his left hand on Manasseh’s head. He crossed his hands—because Manasseh was the firstborn.

genesis:48:15@01-genesis/48.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYBRK AT YWSP WYAMR HALHYM AVR HTHLKW ABTY LPNYW ABRHM WYCXQ HALHYM HR]H ATY M]WDY ]D HYWM HZH׃</bdo>
genesis:48:15@01-genesis/48.tex.english: And he blessed Joseph and said, “The God before whom my fathers, Abraham and Isaac, walked, who shepherded me from my start to this day,

genesis:48:16@01-genesis/48.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">HMLAK HGAL ATY MKL R] YBRK AT HN]RYM WYQRA BHM VMY WVM ABTY ABRHM WYCXQ WYDGW LRB BQRB HARC׃</bdo>
genesis:48:16@01-genesis/48.tex.english: the angel who redeemed me from all bad, may He bless the boys. And may my name be called on them, and the name of my fathers, Abraham and Isaac. And may they spawn into a great number within the earth.”

genesis:48:17@01-genesis/48.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYRA YWSP KY YVYT ABYW YD YMYNW ]L RAV APRYM WYR] B]YNYW WYTMK YD ABYW LHSYR ATH M]L RAV APRYM ]L RAV MNVH׃</bdo>
genesis:48:17@01-genesis/48.tex.english: And Joseph saw that his father had placed his right hand on Ephraim’s head, and it was bad in his eyes, and he held up his father’s hand to turn it from on Ephraim’s head onto Manasseh’s head,

genesis:48:18@01-genesis/48.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR YWSP AL ABYW LA KN ABY KY ZH HBKR VYM YMYNK ]L RAVW׃</bdo>
genesis:48:18@01-genesis/48.tex.english: and Joseph said to his father, “Not like that, my father, because this is the firstborn. Set your right hand on his head.”

genesis:48:19@01-genesis/48.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYMAN ABYW WYAMR YD]TY BNY YD]TY GM HWA YHYH L]M WGM HWA YGDL WAWLM AXYW HQJN YGDL MMNW WZR]W YHYH MLA HGWYM׃</bdo>
genesis:48:19@01-genesis/48.tex.english: And his father refused and said, “I know, my son, I know. He, too, will become a people; and he, too, will be great. But in fact his little brother will be greater than he, and his seed will be full-fledged of nations.”

genesis:48:20@01-genesis/48.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYBRKM BYWM HHWA LAMWR BK YBRK YVRAL LAMR YVMK ALHYM KAPRYM WKMNVH WYVM AT APRYM LPNY MNVH׃</bdo>
genesis:48:20@01-genesis/48.tex.english: And he blessed them in that day, saying, “Israel will bless with you, saying: ‘May God make you like Ephraim and like Manasseh.’” And he set Ephraim before Manasseh.

genesis:48:21@01-genesis/48.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR YVRAL AL YWSP HNH ANKY MT WHYH ALHYM ]MKM WHVYB ATKM AL ARC ABTYKM׃</bdo>
genesis:48:21@01-genesis/48.tex.english: And Israel said to Joseph, “Here, I’m dying. And God will be with you and will bring you back to your fathers’ land.

genesis:48:22@01-genesis/48.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WANY NTTY LK VKM AXD ]L AXYK AVR LQXTY MYD HAMRY BXRBY WBQVTY׃</bdo>
genesis:48:22@01-genesis/48.tex.english: And I’ve given you one shoulder over your brothers, which I took from the Amorite’s hand with my sword and my bow.

genesis:49:1@01-genesis/49.tex.original: ויקרא יעקב אל בניו ויאמר HASP WAGD LKM [ ]
genesis:49:1@01-genesis/49.tex.english: And Jacob called to his sons and said: Gather, and I’ll tell you what will happen to you in the future days.

genesis:49:2@01-genesis/49.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">HQBCW [ ] BNY YOQB</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">WsMO AL YsRAL ABKM</bdo>
genesis:49:2@01-genesis/49.tex.english: Assemble and listen, sons of Jacob, and listen to Israel, your father.

genesis:49:3@01-genesis/49.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">RAWBN BKR</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">At KX</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">[W־] RAsYt AN</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">[ ] YtR OZ</bdo>
genesis:49:3@01-genesis/49.tex.english: Reuben, you’re my firstborn, my power, and the beginning of my might, preeminent in bearing and preeminent in strength.

genesis:49:4@01-genesis/49.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">______</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">______</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">K OLt <OL> MsKBY [ ]</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">AZ XLLt YCOY <ABKM></bdo>
genesis:49:4@01-genesis/49.tex.english: Unstable as water, you’ll not be preeminent, for you ascended your father’s bed; then you defiled, going up to my couch.

genesis:49:5@01-genesis/49.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">sMOWN WLW AXYM</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">KL XMS MKRtM [ ]</bdo>
genesis:49:5@01-genesis/49.tex.english: Simeon and Levi are brothers: Implements of violence are their tools of trade.

genesis:49:6@01-genesis/49.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">BSDM AL tBA NPs</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">BQHLM AL tXD KBDY</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">[ ] BAPM HRG As</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">[W־] BRCNM OQR sR</bdo>
genesis:49:6@01-genesis/49.tex.english: Let my soul not come in their council; let my glory not be united in their society. For in their anger they killed a man, and by their will they crippled an ox.

genesis:49:7@01-genesis/49.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">ARR APM KY OZ</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">WOBRtM KY Qst</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">AXLQM BYOQB</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">APCM BYsRAL</bdo>
genesis:49:7@01-genesis/49.tex.english: Cursed is their anger, for it’s strong, and their wrath, for it’s hard. I’ll divide them in Jacob, and I’ll scatter them in Israel.

genesis:49:8@01-genesis/49.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">YHD HD At</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">YDK BORP AYBK</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">YHD YDK AXK</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">YstXW LK BNY ABK</bdo>
genesis:49:8@01-genesis/49.tex.english: Judah: You, your brothers will praise you. Your hand on your enemies’ neck, your father’s sons will bow to you.

genesis:49:9@01-genesis/49.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">GR ARY YHD</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">MTRP BNY OLt</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">KRO RBC KARY</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">[W־] KLBA MY YQMNW</bdo>
genesis:49:9@01-genesis/49.tex.english: A lion’s whelp is Judah; from prey, my son, you’ve risen. He bent, crouched, like a lion; and, like a feline, who will rouse him?

genesis:49:10@01-genesis/49.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">LA YSR sPT MYHD</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">WMXQQ MBYN DGLW</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">______</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">______</bdo>
genesis:49:10@01-genesis/49.tex.english: The scepter won’t depart from Judah or the staff from between his legs until he comes to Shiloh, and peoples’ obedience is his.

genesis:49:11@01-genesis/49.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">ASR LGPNW ORW</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">[W־] LsRQ BNY AtNW</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">KBS BYN LBs</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">[W־] BDM ONBYM SWt</bdo>
genesis:49:11@01-genesis/49.tex.english: Tying his ass to the vine and his she-ass’s foal to the choice vine, he washed in wine his clothing and in blood of grapes his garment,

genesis:49:12@01-genesis/49.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">XKLL ONM MYYN</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">LBN sNM MXLB</bdo>
genesis:49:12@01-genesis/49.tex.english: eyes darker than wine and teeth whiter than milk.

genesis:49:14@01-genesis/49.tex.english: Issachar is a strong ass crouching between the saddle-packs:

genesis:49:15@01-genesis/49.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">YRA MNXH KY TWB</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">YBT ARCW KY NOM</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">YT sKMW LSBL</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">WYH LMS OBD</bdo>
genesis:49:15@01-genesis/49.tex.english: and he saw rest, that it was good, and the land, that it was pleasant, and he leaned his shoulder to bear and became a work-company servant.

genesis:49:16@01-genesis/49.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">DN YDN <DYN> OM</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">KAXD sBT YsRAL</bdo>
genesis:49:16@01-genesis/49.tex.english: Dan will judge his people as one of the tribes of Israel:

genesis:49:17@01-genesis/49.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">[ ] DN NXs OL DRK</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">sPPN OL ARX</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">HNsK OQBY SS</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">WYPL RKB AXR [ ]</bdo>
genesis:49:17@01-genesis/49.tex.english: Dan will be a snake on a road, a venomous snake on a path, that bites a horse’s heels, and its rider falls backward.

genesis:49:18@01-genesis/49.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">LYsWOtK QWYtY YHWH</bdo>
genesis:49:18@01-genesis/49.tex.english: I wait for your salvation, YHWH.

genesis:49:19@01-genesis/49.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">GD GDD YGDNW</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">WHA YGD OQB M</bdo>
genesis:49:19@01-genesis/49.tex.english: Gad: a troop will trap him, and he’ll trap their heel s.

genesis:49:20@01-genesis/49.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">[W־] AsR sMN LXMW</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">sMNH ARCW</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">[ ] YtN MODNY MLK</bdo>
genesis:49:20@01-genesis/49.tex.english: Asher: his bread will be rich, and he’ll provide a king’s delights.

genesis:49:21@01-genesis/49.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">______</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">______</bdo>
genesis:49:21@01-genesis/49.tex.english: Naphtali: a hind let loose, who gives lovely words.

genesis:49:22@01-genesis/49.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">______</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">______</bdo>
genesis:49:22@01-genesis/49.tex.english: A fruitful bough is Joseph, a fruitful bough over a spring, branches running over a wall:

genesis:49:23@01-genesis/49.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">______</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">______</bdo>
genesis:49:23@01-genesis/49.tex.english: And archers bitterly attacked him, shot at him, and despised him.

genesis:49:24a@01-genesis/49.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">______ ______</bdo>

genesis:49:24b@01-genesis/49.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">MYD ABYR YOQB</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">MsMR R־BNY YsRAL</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">MRO</bdo>
genesis:49:24b@01-genesis/49.tex.english: From the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, from the Keeper of the sons of Israel, from the Shepherd.

genesis:49:25@01-genesis/49.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">MAL ABK WYOZRK</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">WAL־sDY WYBRKK</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">BRKt sMM MOL</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">BRKt tHM [R] MtXt</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">BRKt sDM WRXM</bdo>
genesis:49:25@01-genesis/49.tex.english: from your father’s God, and He’ll strengthen you, and Shadday, and He’ll bless you, blessings of skies from above, blessings of deep, crouching below, blessings of breast and womb.

genesis:49:26@01-genesis/49.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">BRKt AB <WAM></bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">GBR WOL</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">BRKt HRY OD</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">BRKt GBOt OLM</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">tHYYN LRAs YSP</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">WLQDQD NZR AXYW</bdo>
genesis:49:26@01-genesis/49.tex.english: blessings of your father, the mighty and most high, blessings of the mountains of old desired object of the hills of antiquity. They’ll be on Joseph’s head, on the top of the head of the one separate from his brothers.

genesis:49:27@01-genesis/49.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">BNYMN ZAB YTRP</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">BBQR YAKL OD</bdo> <bdo class="source source-proto hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="Proto">LORB YXLQ sLL</bdo>
genesis:49:27@01-genesis/49.tex.english: Benjamin is a tearing wolf: in the morning eating prey, and at evening dividing booty.

genesis:49:28@01-genesis/49.tex.original: כל אלה שבטי ישראל שנים עשר וזאת אשר דבר להם אביהם ויברך אותם איש אשר כברכתו ברך אתם
genesis:49:28@01-genesis/49.tex.english: All these are the tribes of Israel, twelve, and this is what their father spoke to them, and he blessed them. He blessed them each according to his blessing.

genesis:49:29@01-genesis/49.tex.original: וַיְצַו אוֹתָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אֲנִי נֶאֱסָף אֶל עַמִּי קִבְרוּ אֹתִי אֶל אֲבֹתָי אֶל הַמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׂדֵה עֶפְרוֹן הַחִתִּי
genesis:49:29@01-genesis/49.tex.english: And he commanded them and said to them, “I’m being gathered to my people. Bury me: to my fathers, to the cave that’s in the field of Ephron, the Hittite,

genesis:49:30@01-genesis/49.tex.original: בַּמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׂדֵה הַמַּכְפֵּלָה אֲשֶׁר עַל פְּנֵי מַמְרֵא בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן אֲשֶׁר קָנָה אַבְרָהָם אֶת הַשָּׂדֶה מֵאֵת עֶפְרֹן הַחִתִּי לַאֲחֻזַּת קָבֶר
genesis:49:30@01-genesis/49.tex.english: in the cave that’s in the field of Machpelah, which faces Mamre in the land of Canaan, as Abraham bought the field from Ephron, the Hittite, as a possession for a tomb.

genesis:49:31@01-genesis/49.tex.original: שָׁמָּה קָבְרוּ אֶת אַבְרָהָם וְאֵת שָׂרָה אִשְׁתּוֹ שָׁמָּה קָבְרוּ אֶת יִצְחָק וְאֵת רִבְקָה אִשְׁתּוֹ וְשָׁמָּה קָבַרְתִּי אֶת לֵאָה
genesis:49:31@01-genesis/49.tex.english: There they buried Abraham and Sarah, his wife. There they buried Isaac and Rebekah, his wife. And there I buried Leah.

genesis:49:32@01-genesis/49.tex.original: מִקְנֵה הַשָּׂדֶה וְהַמְּעָרָה אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ מֵאֵת בְּנֵי חֵת
genesis:49:32@01-genesis/49.tex.english: The field and the cave that’s in it were a purchase from the children of Heth.”

genesis:49:33@01-genesis/49.tex.original: וַיְכַל יַעֲקֹב לְצַוֺּת אֶת בָּנָיו וַיֶּאֱסֹף רַגְלָיו אֶל הַמִּטָּה וַיִּגְוַע וַיֵּאָסֶף אֶל עַמָּיו
genesis:49:33@01-genesis/49.tex.english: And Jacob finished commanding his sons, and he gathered his feet into the bed, and he expired, and he was gathered to his people.

genesis:50:1@01-genesis/50.tex.original: ויפל יוסף על פני אביו ויבך עליו וישק לו׃
genesis:50:1@01-genesis/50.tex.english: And Joseph fell upon his father’s face and wept over him and kissed him.

genesis:50:2@01-genesis/50.tex.original: ויצו יוסף את עבדיו את הרפאים לחנט את אביו ויחנטו הרפאים את ישראל׃
genesis:50:2@01-genesis/50.tex.english: And Joseph commanded his servants, the physicians, to embalm his father. And the physicians embalmed Israel,

genesis:50:3@01-genesis/50.tex.original: וימלאו לו ארבעים יום כי כן ימלאו ימי החנטים ויבכו אתו מצרים שבעים יום׃
genesis:50:3@01-genesis/50.tex.english: and they spent forty days on him, because that is the number of days they spent on the embalming, and Egypt mourned him seventy days.

genesis:50:4@01-genesis/50.tex.original: ויעברו ימי בכיתו וידבר יוסף אל בית פרעה לאמר אם נא מצאתי חן בעיניכם דברו נא באזני פרעה לאמר׃
genesis:50:4@01-genesis/50.tex.english: And his mourning days passed, and Joseph spoke to Pharaoh’s house, saying, “If I’ve found favor in your eyes, speak in Pharaoh’s ears, saying,

genesis:50:5@01-genesis/50.tex.original: אבי השביעני לאמר הנה אנכי מת בקברי אשר כריתי לי בארץ כנען שמה תקברני ועתה אעלה נא ואקברה את אבי ואשובה׃
genesis:50:5@01-genesis/50.tex.english: ‘My father had me swear, saying, “Here I’m dying. In my tomb, which I dug for me in the land of Canaan: you shall bury me there.” And now, let me go up so I may bury my father and come back.’”

genesis:50:6@01-genesis/50.tex.original: ויאמר פרעה עלה וקבר את אביך כאשר השביעך׃
genesis:50:6@01-genesis/50.tex.english: And Pharaoh said, “Go up and bury your father as he had you swear.”

genesis:50:7@01-genesis/50.tex.original: ויעל יוסף לקבר את אביו ויעלו אתו כל עבדי פרעה זקני ביתו וכל זקני ארץ מצרים׃
genesis:50:7@01-genesis/50.tex.english: And Joseph went up to bury his father, and all of Pharaoh’s servants, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,

genesis:50:8@01-genesis/50.tex.original: וכל בית יוסף ואחיו ובית אביו רק טפם וצאנם ובקרם עזבו בארץ גשן׃
genesis:50:8@01-genesis/50.tex.english: and all of Joseph’s house and his brothers and his father’s house. Only their infants and their flock and their oxen they left in the land of Goshen.

genesis:50:9@01-genesis/50.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-je hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="JE">WY]L ]MW GM RKB GM PRVYM WYHY HMXNH KBD MAD׃</bdo>
genesis:50:9@01-genesis/50.tex.english: And both chariots and horsemen went up with him. It was a very heavy camp.

genesis:50:10@01-genesis/50.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-je hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="JE">WYBAW ]D GRN HAJD AVR B]BR HYRDN WYSPDW VM MSPD GDWL WKBD MAD WY]V LABYW ABL VB]T YMYM׃</bdo>
genesis:50:10@01-genesis/50.tex.english: And they came to the threshing floor of Atad, which is across the Jordan, and they had a very big and heavy funeral, and he made a mourning for his father for seven days.

genesis:50:11@01-genesis/50.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-je hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="JE">WYRA YWVB HARC HKN]NY AT HABL BGRN HAJD WYAMRW ABL KBD ZH LMCRYM ]L KN QRA VMH ABL MCRYM AVR B]BR HYRDN׃</bdo>
genesis:50:11@01-genesis/50.tex.english: And the Canaanite residents of the land saw the mourning at the threshing floor of Atad and said, “This is a heavy mourning to Egypt.” On account of this its name was called Abel of Egypt, which is beyond the Jordan.

genesis:50:12@01-genesis/50.tex.original: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בָנָיו לוֹ כֵּן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּם׃
genesis:50:12@01-genesis/50.tex.english: And his sons did so for him, as he had commanded them.

genesis:50:13@01-genesis/50.tex.original: וַיִּשְׂאוּ אֹתוֹ בָנָיו אַרְצָה כְּנַעַן וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ בִּמְעָרַת שְׂדֵה הַמַּכְפֵּלָה אֲשֶׁר קָנָה אַבְרָהָם אֶת הַשָּׂדֶה לַאֲחֻזַּת קֶבֶר מֵאֵת עֶפְרֹן הַחִתִּי עַל פְּנֵי מַמְרֵא׃
genesis:50:13@01-genesis/50.tex.english: And his sons carried him to the land of Canaan and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, as Abraham had bought the field as a possession for a tomb from Ephron, the Hittite, facing Mamre.

genesis:50:14@01-genesis/50.tex.original: וישב יוסף מצרימה הוא ואחיו וכל העלים אתו לקבר את אביו אחרי קברו את אביו׃
genesis:50:14@01-genesis/50.tex.english: And, after his burial of his father, Joseph came back to Egypt, he and his brothers and all those who went up with him to bury his father.

genesis:50:15@01-genesis/50.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYRAW AXY YWSP KY MT ABYHM WYAMRW LW YVJMNW YWSP WHVB YVYB LNW AT KL HR]H AVR GMLNW ATW׃</bdo>
genesis:50:15@01-genesis/50.tex.english: And Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, and they said, “If Joseph will despise us he’ll pay us back all the bad that we dealt to him.”

genesis:50:16@01-genesis/50.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYCWW AL YWSP LAMR ABYK CWH LPNY MWTW LAMR׃</bdo>
genesis:50:16@01-genesis/50.tex.english: And they commanded to Joseph, saying, “Your father had commanded before his death, saying,

genesis:50:17@01-genesis/50.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">KH TAMRW LYWSP ANA VA NA PV] AXYK WXJATM KY R]H GMLWK W]TH VA NA LPV] ]BDY ALHY ABYK WYBK YWSP BDBRM ALYW׃</bdo>
genesis:50:17@01-genesis/50.tex.english: ‘You shall say this to Joseph: Please, bear your brothers’ offense and their sin, because they dealt you bad.’ And now bear the offense of the servants of your father’s God.” And Joseph wept when they spoke to him.

genesis:50:18@01-genesis/50.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYLKW GM AXYW WYPLW LPNYW WYAMRW HNNW LK L]BDYM׃</bdo>
genesis:50:18@01-genesis/50.tex.english: And his brothers also went and fell in front of him and said, “Here, we’re yours as slaves.”

genesis:50:19@01-genesis/50.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR ALHM YWSP AL TYRAW KY HTXT ALHYM ANY׃</bdo>
genesis:50:19@01-genesis/50.tex.english: And Joseph said to them, “Don’t be afraid, because am I in God’s place?

genesis:50:20@01-genesis/50.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WATM XVBTM ]LY R]H ALHYM XVBH LJBH LM]N ]VH KYWM HZH LHXYT ]M RB׃</bdo>
genesis:50:20@01-genesis/50.tex.english: And you thought bad against me. God thought for good: in order to do as it is today, to keep alive a numerous people.

genesis:50:21@01-genesis/50.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">W]TH AL TYRAW ANKY AKLKL ATKM WAT JPKM WYNXM AWTM WYDBR ]L LBM׃</bdo>
genesis:50:21@01-genesis/50.tex.english: And now, don’t be afraid. I’ll provide for you and your infants.” And he consoled them. And he spoke on their heart.

genesis:50:22@01-genesis/50.tex.original: וישב יוסף במצרים הוא ובית אביו ויחי יוסף מאה ועשר שנים׃
genesis:50:22@01-genesis/50.tex.english: And Joseph lived in Egypt, he and his father’s house. And Joseph lived a hundred ten years,

genesis:50:23@01-genesis/50.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYRA YWSP LAPRYM BNY VLVYM GM BNY MKYR BN MNVH YLDW ]L BRKY YWSP׃</bdo>
genesis:50:23@01-genesis/50.tex.english: and Joseph saw children of Ephraim’s of the third generation. Also children of Machir, son of Manasseh, were born on Joseph’s knees.

genesis:50:24@01-genesis/50.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYAMR YWSP AL AXYW ANKY MT WALHYM PQD YPQD ATKM WH]LH ATKM MN HARC HZAT AL HARC AVR NVB] LABRHM LYCXQ WLY]QB׃</bdo>
genesis:50:24@01-genesis/50.tex.english: And Joseph said to his brothers, “I’m dying. And God will take account of you and will bring you up from this land to the land that He swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.”

genesis:50:25@01-genesis/50.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYVB] YWSP AT BNY YVRAL LAMR PQD YPQD ALHYM ATKM WH]LTM AT ]CMTY MZH׃</bdo>
genesis:50:25@01-genesis/50.tex.english: And Joseph had the children of Israel swear, saying, “God will take account of you, and you’ll bring up my bones from here.”

genesis:50:26@01-genesis/50.tex.original: <bdo class="source source-e hebrew" lang="he" dir="rtl" data-source="E">WYMT YWSP BN MAH W]VR VNYM WYXNJW ATW WYYVM BARWN BMCRYM׃</bdo>
genesis:50:26@01-genesis/50.tex.english: And Joseph died, a hundred ten years old, and they embalmed him and set him in a coffin in Egypt.
